## Reading: one rainy day

A narrative with its cause, process and result.

> {那|nà}{天|tiān}{的|de}{事|shì}，{我|wǒ}{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{记得|jì de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu}。
>
> {那|nà}{是|shì}{去年|qù nián}{秋天|qiū tiān}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}。{早上|zǎo shang}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}。{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{下班|xià bān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{外面|wài miàn}{突然|tū rán}{下|xià}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}。{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{了|le}{半天|bàn tiān}，{雨|yǔ}{越|yuè}{下|xià}{越|yuè}{大|dà}。{我|wǒ}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}：{怎么办|zěn me bàn}？{没有|méi yǒu}{伞|sǎn}，{我|wǒ}{怎么|zěn me}{回|huí}{家|jiā}？
>
> {这|zhè}{时候|shí hou}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{女孩儿|nǚ háir}{走|zǒu}{过来|guò lái}{问|wèn}{我|wǒ}：“{你|nǐ}{是|shì}{不|bu}{是|shì}{韩冰|Hán Bīng}？”{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{她|tā}{半天|bàn tiān}，{才|cái}{发现|fā xiàn}{她|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{小学|xiǎo xué}{同学|tóng xué}{冯雪|Féng Xuě}。{我们|wǒ men}{已经|yǐ jīng}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{没|méi}{见|jiàn}{了|le}！{过去|guò qù}{她|tā}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{矮|ǎi}，{现在|xiàn zài}{长|zhǎng}{高|gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{我|wǒ}{当然|dāng rán}{认|rèn}{不|bu}{出来|chū lái}{了|le}。
>
> {冯雪|Féng Xuě}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{把|bǎ}{大|dà}{伞|sǎn}。{她|tā}{说|shuō}：“{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}，{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{这儿|zhèr}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}。”{路上|lù shang}，{我们|wǒ men}{聊|liáo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{关于|guān yú}{小学|xiǎo xué}{的|de}{事|shì}。{其实|qí shí}，{她|tā}{就|jiù}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{旁边|páng biān}{的|de}{小区|xiǎo qū}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{我们|wǒ men}{一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{遇见|yù jiàn}{过|guo}。
>
> {到|dào}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{楼|lóu}{下|xià}，{我们|wǒ men}{才|cái}{分开|fēn kāi}。{从|cóng}{那|nà}{天|tiān}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{常常|cháng cháng}{一起|yì qǐ}{下班|xià bān}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。{现在|xiàn zài}，{她|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{最好|zuì hǎo}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}。{一|yì}{场|cháng}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{遇到|yù dào}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{朋友|péng you}。

{认|rèn}{不|bu}{出来|chū lái} is "can't recognise" (a potential complement of {认|rèn}{出来|chū lái}, to make out). {一|yì}{场|cháng}{雨|yǔ} is
"a spell of rain" ({场|cháng} as a measure word).

1. Why didn't the writer have an umbrella?
2. Why didn't he recognise Feng Xue at first?
3. What did they discover on the way?
4. How did the story end?

<details>
<summary>Answers and translation</summary>

1. The weather was fine in the morning ({早上|zǎo shang}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}).
2. She had grown a lot: she used to be short and is much taller now ({过去|guò qù}{她|tā}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{矮|ǎi}，{现在|xiàn zài}{长|zhǎng}{高|gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}).
3. That she lives in the compound next to his ({其实|qí shí}，{她|tā}{就|jiù}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{旁边|páng biān}{的|de}{小区|xiǎo qū}), though they'd never met.
4. They became best friends and now often go home from work together.

"I still remember that day clearly. It was a Friday last autumn. When I went out in the morning
the weather was fine, so I didn't take an umbrella. At five in the afternoon, as I left work, it
suddenly started pouring. I waited at the office door for ages, and the rain only got heavier. I
was worried: what could I do? How would I get home without an umbrella? Just then a young woman
came over and asked, 'Are you Han Bing?' I looked at her for a long time before I realised she was
Feng Xue, a classmate from primary school. We hadn't seen each other for over ten years! She used
to be short, but she's grown a lot taller, so of course I didn't recognise her. Feng Xue had a
big umbrella. 'Let's walk together,' she said, 'I don't live far from here.' On the way we talked
a lot about primary school. In fact she lives in the compound next to mine: we just had never run
into each other. We only parted when we got to my building. Since that day we've often gone home
from work together, and now she's my best friend. One rainstorm brought me an old friend."
</details>

## Write it: what happened?

Write two or three sentences about something that happened to you: say what started it, what
happened, and how it ended. Use at least two of {有一次|yǒu yí cì}, {先|xiān}, {然后|rán hòu}, {后来|hòu lái}, {最后|zuì hòu}, {发现|fā xiàn}, {遇到|yù dào}.

<details>
<summary>Model answer</summary>

{有一次|yǒu yí cì}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{商场|shāng chǎng}{遇到|yù dào}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}。{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{跟|gēn}{她|tā}{聊|liáo}{了|le}{一会儿|yí huìr}，{然后|rán hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{喝|hē}{了|le}{咖啡|kā fēi}。{最后|zuì hòu}{我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}，{她|tā}{就|jiù}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{附近|fù jìn}！

— Once I ran into my teacher at the shopping centre. First I chatted with her for a while, then we
had coffee together. In the end I found out she lives right near me!
</details>

## Say it

```speak
# Telling and arguing
{有一次|yǒu yí cì}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{路上|lù shang}{遇到|yù dào}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{同学|tóng xué}。
= Once, I ran into an old classmate in the street.
{我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。
= I found my phone was missing.
{后来|hòu lái}，{我们|wǒ men}{终于|zhōng yú}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}。
= Later on, we finally found it.
{你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{吗|ma}？
= You've been to Beijing, haven't you?
{其实|qí shí}，{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{不|bù}{难|nán}。
= Actually, this question isn't hard.
{当然|dāng rán}{可以|kě yǐ}！
= Of course you can!
```

## Pronunciation

- {重要|zhòng yào} zhòng yào: two falling tones; let the second fall all the way.
- {当然|dāng rán} dāng rán: a high level tone, then a rise. The *r* of {然|rán} is soft, as in {如果|rú guǒ}.
- {其实|qí shí} qí shí: two rising tones. Don't confuse {实|shí} shí with {是|shì} shì (fourth) or {十|shí} shí (also second).
- {长|zhǎng} (grow) vs {长|cháng} (long): different initials and tones. {张|zhāng} zhāng (a measure word,
  lesson 09) has the same initial as zhǎng but the first tone.
- {遇到|yù dào} yù dào, {遇见|yù jiàn} yù jiàn: *yu* is the rounded ü.
- {发现|fā xiàn} fā xiàn: {发|fā} is first tone here, as in {发烧|fā shāo}.
- {不行|bù xíng} bù xíng: {不|bù} stays fourth before the rising {行|xíng}.

## Common mistakes

- ~~{我|wǒ}{结束|jié shù}{了|le}{作业|zuò yè}~~: a person finishing a task uses {完|wán}: {我|wǒ}{写|xiě}{完|wán}{了|le}{作业|zuò yè}. {结束|jié shù} is for events: {比赛|bǐ sài}{结束|jié shù}{了|le}.
- ~~{我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}~~ for "I found my phone (that I was looking for)": say {我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}. {发现|fā xiàn} is for
  facts you notice: {我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}.
- ~~{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{路上|lù shang}{遇见|yù jiàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}~~: problems are {遇到|yù dào}, not {遇见|yù jiàn}.
- ~~{他|tā}{变|biàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{大人|dà ren}~~: naming what someone becomes needs {变成|biàn chéng}: {他|tā}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{大人|dà ren}.
- Answering a rhetorical question: "{你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{吗|ma}？" doesn't want "{不|bú}{是|shì}": the speaker knows you have
  been. Answer {是|shì}{啊|a} / {对|duì} and carry on.
- Reading 长 as cháng in {长大|zhǎng dà} or {校长|xiào zhǎng}: both are zhǎng.

## Key points

- A story: cause ({有一次|yǒu yí cì}, {那|nà}{天|tiān}), process ({先|xiān}, {然后|rán hòu}, {后来|hòu lái}, {突然|tū rán}, {这|zhè}{时候|shí hou}), result ({最后|zuì hòu}, {终于|zhōng yú}, {从|cóng}{那|nà}{天|tiān}{以后|yǐ hòu}).
- {遇到|yù dào} (come across: people, problems), {遇见|yù jiàn} (meet by chance), {发现|fā xiàn} (find out, notice), {找|zhǎo}{到|dào} (find
  what you looked for).
- {结束|jié shù} (an event ends), {分开|fēn kāi} (part, separate), {变成|biàn chéng} (become).
- {长|zhǎng}: grow ({长大|zhǎng dà}, {长|zhǎng}{高|gāo}, {长|zhǎng}{得|de}{像|xiàng}) and "head of" ({校长|xiào zhǎng}); {过去|guò qù}: the past.
- {当然|dāng rán} (of course), {其实|qí shí} (actually), {比如|bǐ rú} (for example), {关于|guān yú} (about), {主要|zhǔ yào} (main), {重要|zhòng yào} (important).
- Rhetorical questions: {不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ {这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ {怎么|zěn me}{会|huì}…{呢|ne}？ {谁|shéi}{不|bù}…？ {哪儿|nǎr}…{啊|a}？ A negative question makes a
  positive point.
- New characters: {主|zhǔ} {重|zhòng} {遇|yù} {束|shù} {当|dāng} {实|shí}; handwriting: {主|zhǔ} {重|zhòng} {当|dāng} {实|shí}.

The words from this lesson are listed below; they join your vocabulary reviews when you complete
the lesson.

lessons.title: Studying abroad: plans, the library and the speaking test
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

The last new words of the course are about studying in China: arriving on campus, using the
library, making plans and meeting people. With them you'll practise two parts of the HSK 3
exam that ask you to produce Chinese rather than recognise it:

- writing one or two sentences about your experiences and plans (the level-3 writing task);
- the speaking test that now comes with the written exam.

The words and patterns:

- {留学|liú xué} (to study abroad), {留学生|liú xué shēng} (international student), {校园|xiào yuán} (campus), {图书馆|tú shū guǎn} (library),
  {校长|xiào zhǎng} (head of a school), {男生|nán shēng} / {女生|nǚ shēng} (male / female students), {名单|míng dān} (list of names);
- {打算|dǎ suàn} (to plan; a plan) and {机会|jī huì} (an opportunity);
- {帮助|bāng zhù} beside {帮|bāng} and {帮忙|bāng máng};
- {见面|jiàn miàn}, a separable verb ({跟|gēn}…{见面|jiàn miàn}, {见|jiàn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{面|miàn});
- {关系|guān xi} (relationship, connection);
- {借|jiè} (to borrow; to lend) and {还|huán} (to give back).

## {留学|liú xué} and {留学生|liú xué shēng}

{留学|liú xué} is "to study abroad": {留|liú} (to stay, HSK 2's character) + {学|xué}. Where you study goes before it
with {在|zài}, or after {去|qù}:

{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。 — I'm planning to go and study in China next year.

{她|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}。 — She's studied in Beijing. ({留学|liú xué} splits like a separable verb: {留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}, {留|liú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}{学|xué}.)

{留学生|liú xué shēng} is an international student, whichever country you're in: in China, the foreign students
are {留学生|liú xué shēng}; a Chinese student in Britain is a {留学生|liú xué shēng} there too. {男生|nán shēng} and {女生|nǚ shēng} are male and female
students (in everyday speech also "boys" and "girls", even for adults at university).

{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{留学生|liú xué shēng}，{十二|shí èr}{个|gè}{女生|nǚ shēng}，{八|bā}{个|gè}{男生|nán shēng}。 — There are twenty international students in our class:
twelve women and eight men.

{校长|xiào zhǎng} is the head of a school or the president of a university: the {长|zhǎng} of lesson 28, "head
of", after {校|xiào} (school). {校园|xiào yuán} is the campus, {校|xiào} + {园|yuán} (garden, park).

## {打算|dǎ suàn} and {机会|jī huì}

{打算|dǎ suàn} is "to plan, to intend", a verb before another verb, and also a noun, "a plan":

{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{暑假|shǔ jià} (the summer holidays) {去|qù}{旅游|lǚ yóu}。 — I'm planning to travel in the summer holidays.

{你|nǐ}{毕业|bì yè} (to graduate) {以后|yǐ hòu}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{打算|dǎ suàn}？ — What are your plans after you graduate?

Compare: {想|xiǎng} (would like: a wish), {打算|dǎ suàn} (intend: a decision), {准备|zhǔn bèi} (HSK 2: get ready; be about to).
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó} is a wish; {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó} means you've decided; {我|wǒ}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó} means it's close.

{机会|jī huì} is "a chance, an opportunity". {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì} + verb is a common pattern: {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì}{的话|de huà}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{看看|kàn kan}。 (If
I get the chance, I'd like to visit Shanghai.) {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{练习|liàn xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{好|hǎo}{机会|jī huì}。 (It's a good opportunity to
practise Chinese.)

## {帮助|bāng zhù}, {帮|bāng} and {帮忙|bāng máng}

All three are "help", in different shapes:

| Word | Kind | Pattern | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| {帮|bāng} (HSK 2) | verb | {帮|bāng} + person (+ verb) | {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{拿|ná}{一下|yí xià}{吗|ma}？ Could you hold this for me? |
| {帮忙|bāng máng} (HSK 2) | separable verb, no object | {帮忙|bāng máng} / {帮|bāng} + person + {个|gè}{忙|máng} | {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{个|gè}{忙|máng}{吗|ma}？ Could you give me a hand? |
| {帮助|bāng zhù} | verb and noun, a little more formal | {帮助|bāng zhù} + person; {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù} | {老师|lǎo shī}{帮助|bāng zhù}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。 The teacher has helped me a lot. |

So ×{帮忙|bāng máng}{我|wǒ} is wrong ({帮忙|bāng máng} already has its object {忙|máng}: say {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng} or {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}), and only {帮助|bāng zhù} is also a
noun: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}！ (Thank you for your help!)

## {见面|jiàn miàn}: meeting by arrangement

{见面|jiàn miàn} is "to meet (by arrangement), to see each other". It is a separable verb ({见|jiàn} + {面|miàn}, "see
face"), so the person can't follow it as an object:

- ~~{我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{见面|jiàn miàn}{他|tā}~~ → {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{见面|jiàn miàn}。 (I'm meeting him tomorrow.)
- Words go inside: {我们|wǒ men}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{面|miàn}。 (We've met once.) {见|jiàn}{了|le}{面|miàn}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{吧|ba}。 (Let's talk about it when we meet.)

The meeting place goes before it, with {在|zài}: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{门口|mén kǒu}{见面|jiàn miàn}{吧|ba}。 (Let's meet at the library entrance.)
For meeting by chance, lesson 28's {遇到|yù dào} and {遇见|yù jiàn} take a direct object: {我|wǒ}{遇见|yù jiàn}{了|le}{他|tā}.

## {关系|guān xi}: relationships and connections

{关系|guān xi} is a relationship between people ({我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{关系|guān xi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, we get on well) or a connection between
things: {跟|gēn}…{有|yǒu}{关系|guān xi} (to have to do with): {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{关系|guān xi}。 (This has nothing to do with you.) You know
{没关系|méi guān xi} (it doesn't matter, HSK 1) already; it is literally "there's no connection". The second
syllable is light: guān xi.

## {借|jiè} and {还|huán}: borrowing and returning

{借|jiè} means both "borrow" and "lend": the little words around it show which.

- **Borrow** from someone: {跟|gēn} / {向|xiàng} + person + {借|jiè} + thing: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{借|jiè}{了|le}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。 (I borrowed a book from a
  friend.) Or simply: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{借|jiè}{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}。 (I'd like to borrow this book.)
- **Lend** to someone: {借|jiè}{给|gěi} + person + thing: {我|wǒ}{借|jiè}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{一百|yì bǎi}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。 (I lent him a hundred yuan.)

{还|huán} is "to give back, to return (something)": {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{还|huán}{你|nǐ}。 (I'll give it back to you tomorrow.)
{还|huán}{书|shū} (return books), {还|huán}{给|gěi}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn} (give back to the library).

还 has two readings. You know {还|hái} hái (still, also; {还是|hái shi}) from HSK 1 and 2; as a verb meaning "give
back" it's huán. The verb comes before an object or {给|gěi}, so: {他|tā}{还|hái}{没|méi}{还|huán}{书|shū} (tā hái méi huán shū): he
still hasn't returned the book. With the traditional script on, both are 還.

## Characters
{=

| Character | Meaning | Pinyin | Radical | Strokes | Words |

## Writing one or two sentences: experiences and plans

The writing section of HSK 3 asks for short sentences in characters. A sentence about your life
has a reliable shape: **time + (place) + action**, and a reason or a feeling if you have room.

| You want to say | Pattern | Example |
|---|---|---|
| an experience | verb + {过|guo} | {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。 I've been to Shanghai twice. |
| when and how it happened | {是|shì}…{的|de} | {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{去年|qù nián}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}。 I came to China last year. |
| a plan | {打算|dǎ suàn} / {想|xiǎng} / {准备|zhǔn bèi} + verb | {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。 |
| a plan with a condition | {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù}… | {如果|rú guǒ}{有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{北京|Běi jīng}{工作|gōng zuò}。 |
| a reason | {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ}… / {为了|wèi le} | {为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中文|Zhōng wén}{书|shū}。 |

Checklist before you hand it in: is the time before the verb? Does every number have its measure
word? Have you used {了|le} or {过|guo} for the past, and not {是|shì} before an adjective?

## Preparing the speaking test

From level 3, reports say the new HSK includes a speaking test, registered for with the written
exam and lasting about 15 minutes. One detailed report on the official speaking sample paper
describes three parts: repeating short sentences you hear, describing pictures, and answering two
questions after a few minutes' preparation. We couldn't open the sample paper ourselves, so look at
it before your test (lesson 30 has the details). These habits help whatever the tasks are:

1. **Answer in full sentences**, not single words: asked {你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{运动|yùn dòng}？, say {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{游泳|yóu yǒng}，{因为|yīn wèi}… rather
   than just {游泳|yóu yǒng}.
2. **Add one reason or one example**: {因为|yīn wèi}…, {比如|bǐ rú}…. Two or three sentences per answer is a good
   length at this level.
3. **Buy time politely** if you need to think: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}……{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{一|yi}{想|xiǎng}。 (Let me think.)
4. **Describe a picture in order**: where ({在|zài}…), who ({有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}…), what they're doing ({正在|zhèng zài}…), and what you
   think ({我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}…).
5. **Use what you're sure of.** A short correct sentence scores better than a long one that falls
   apart.
6. **Practise repeating**: play a line of a dialogue or a Say it block, then say it back without
   looking, in the same rhythm and tones.

## Pronunciation

- {留学|liú xué} liú xué: two rising tones; {学|xué} has the rounded *ü* (xué).
- {机会|jī huì} jī huì: high, then falling. {会|huì} is huì in both {机会|jī huì} and {会|huì} "meeting".
- {打算|dǎ suàn} dǎ suàn: a dip, then a fall. *s* is a plain hissing s.
- {关系|guān xi} guān xi: the second syllable is light.
- {还|huán} (give back) vs {还|hái} (still): {他|tā}{还|hái}{没|méi}{还|huán}{书|shū} tā hái méi huán shū.
- {借|jiè} jiè: the *j* of {姐|jiě} jiě, falling tone.
- {图书馆|tú shū guǎn} tú shū guǎn: rise, level, dip.

## Common mistakes

- ~~{我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{见面|jiàn miàn}{他|tā}~~: {见面|jiàn miàn} takes no object. Say {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{见面|jiàn miàn}.
- ~~{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{帮忙|bāng máng}{我|wǒ}{吗|ma}？~~: {帮忙|bāng máng} has its own object. Say {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{吗|ma}？ or {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng}{吗|ma}？
- Leaving "lend" unclear: in speech {他|tā}{借|jiè}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū} is heard for "he lent me a book", but it can be misread; {借|jiè}{给|gěi} makes it
  clear: {他|tā}{借|jiè}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}. {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{借|jiè}{了|le}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū} is "I borrowed a book from him".
- Reading 还 as hái when it means "give back": {还|huán}{书|shū} is huán shū.
- ~~{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{去|qù}{过|guo}{中国|Zhōng guó}~~: a plan is in the future; experiences take {过|guo} without {打算|dǎ suàn}: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{中国|Zhōng guó} / {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}.
- Mixing up {借|jiè} and {错|cuò}: both have 昔 on the right, with 亻 for {借|jiè} and 钅 for {错|cuò}.

## Key points

- {留学|liú xué} (study abroad; separable: {留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}), {留学生|liú xué shēng}, {校园|xiào yuán}, {图书馆|tú shū guǎn}, {校长|xiào zhǎng}, {男生|nán shēng} / {女生|nǚ shēng}, {名单|míng dān}.
- {打算|dǎ suàn} (intend; a plan) vs {想|xiǎng} (wish) vs {准备|zhǔn bèi} (get ready). {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì} + verb.
- {帮|bāng} + person, {帮忙|bāng máng} (no object; {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng}), {帮助|bāng zhù} (also a noun: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}).
- {见面|jiàn miàn}: {跟|gēn} + person + {见面|jiàn miàn}, {见|jiàn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{面|miàn}; no object after it.
- {关系|guān xi} guān xi: relationship; {跟|gēn}…{有|yǒu} / {没有|méi yǒu}{关系|guān xi}.
- {借|jiè}: borrow ({跟|gēn} / {向|xiàng}…{借|jiè}) and lend ({借|jiè}{给|gěi}…); {还|huán}: give back ({还|huán}{书|shū}, {还|huán}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}).
- Sentences about yourself: time + place + action, with {过|guo}, {是|shì}…{的|de}, {打算|dǎ suàn}, {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù}, {因为|yīn wèi}.
- Speaking test: full sentences, one reason or example, buy time, describe in order.
- New characters: {助|zhù} {算|suàn} {借|jiè}; handwriting: {助|zhù} {借|jiè}.

The words from this lesson are listed below; they join your vocabulary reviews when you complete
the lesson.

lessons.title: The HSK 3 exam
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

You now know the 1,000 words and 655 characters that the new HSK 3 covers, and the grammar of the
level. This last lesson is about the exam itself: how it is built, what kinds of tasks to expect,
how to use your time, and a short practice set written for this course. It adds no new words.

Everything here about the exam's format comes from reports on the official sample papers and
notices, which we couldn't open ourselves. Formats can change: before you register, check the
official HSK website of Chinese Testing International (chinesetest.cn) and do an official sample
paper.

## The HSK and its new version

The **[[HSK]]** ({汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{考试|kǎo shì}, the Chinese Proficiency Test) is the standard test of Chinese for
learners. Its new version, often called HSK 3.0, has nine levels and a new syllabus, published
in November 2025 and in force since July 2026. Level 3 now covers 1,000 words and 655 characters,
with 250 characters to write by hand: the numbers this course and the two before it were built on.

Two things are new at level 3 compared with the old exam:

- the **writing** part asks you to make a sentence of your own (the old exam had you put given
  words in order);
- a **[[speaking test]]** is now part of the exam from level 3 up, reports say, instead of a separate
  one you could choose to take.

The first official sitting of the new exam was scheduled for December 2026, after two pilot
rounds earlier that year. Dates change, so check them on the official site.

## How the new HSK 3 is built

| Part | Questions | Time | Tasks, as reported |
|---|---|---|---|
| Listening | 30 | about 23 minutes | a short dialogue matched with a picture (10); a dialogue between two people with a question (10); a short talk with a question (10); three choices |
| Reading | 30 | 30 minutes | the right reply in a short dialogue (10); the right word for a gap (10); short texts with questions (10) |
| Writing | 10 | 20 minutes | a character from its pinyin (5); a sentence of your own with a given word (5) |
| **Written exam** | **70** | **about 83 minutes** in all, with time for your details and the answer sheet | |
| Speaking test | 15 | about 15 minutes, with preparation time | repeating sentences you hear (8); describing pictures (5); answering two questions after a few minutes' preparation (2) |

The question numbers and times agree across the reports we found; the task list comes mainly from
one detailed report on the sample papers, so treat it as a guide. Reports say candidates at level 3
register for the speaking test together with the written exam and take it at a separate time (one
report adds that in some countries the two can still be booked separately). The exam can be on
paper or on a computer, depending on the test centre.

### Listening

As reported, the first part matches short dialogues with pictures; the second and third ask a
question about a dialogue between two people or about a short talk (an announcement, a message, a
short account, of the kind lesson 26's pool notice would be if it were read aloud), with three
choices. The level description speaks of up to about 300 characters at near-normal speed: faster
than the dialogues in your lessons when played slowly. Typical questions ask where
something happens, when, why, what someone will do next, or what someone means: a rhetorical
question ({你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？) or a polite refusal ({我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可是|kě shì}…) is a favourite.

### Reading

As reported, the three parts are choosing the right reply in a short dialogue, choosing the word
that fills a gap (only {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái} fits, not {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}), and short texts with questions: notices, emails,
posters and short narratives, the text types of this course's reading sections. Skimming and scanning (see Strategies)
matter more here than at level 2, because the texts are longer.

### Writing

The writing part is where HSK 3.0 asks more than the old exam. The old HSK 3 had two writing
tasks, putting given words in order and writing a missing character from its pinyin. Reports on
the new sample paper keep the characters and replace the word order with a sentence of your own
built on a given word (one report says the sentence task has a picture as a prompt), and the
level-3 task outline asks for one or two sentences about experiences or plans. This course has
practised each of these:

- writing a character from its pinyin (each lesson's "write the missing character" question), with
  the 250 handwriting characters the likeliest to be asked;
- writing a sentence or two of your own (the "Write it" tasks of lessons 26–29);
- putting words in order (the build questions): not reported for the new paper, but the quickest
  way to check that your own sentences have the right word order.

On paper you write by hand; on a computer, check how answers are entered when you register, and
practise both handwriting and typing.

### Speaking

Lesson 29 has the habits that help. One detailed report on the speaking sample paper describes
three parts: repeating short sentences you hear, describing pictures, and answering two questions
after a few minutes' preparation. Practise saying back the lines of the dialogues and Say it
blocks, answer in full sentences, add a reason or an example, and use what you're sure of.

## Scoring

The old HSK 3 gave up to 100 points each for listening, reading and writing, and was passed with
180 of 300. For the new exam, no score scale or pass mark had been published in the sources we
found: don't assume the old figures still apply.

## Strategies

### Before the exam

- **Do an official sample paper**, first without a timer, to see what every task looks like; then
  again with one.
- **Review every word.** Your vocabulary reviews hold all 1,000 words of HSK 1–3. In the last
  weeks, bring every word to at least Advanced, and spend most time on the ones you keep missing.
- **Read with pinyin off.** The exam won't help you with pinyin. Turn the switch off in the
  reviews and the lessons.
- **Listen every day**: play the dialogues of lessons 21–29 with the words hidden, then with them
  shown.
- **Write by hand**: ten minutes a day on the 150 characters at the end of this lesson, and the 100
  of HSK 1 and 2.
- **Say your answers aloud**: the self-introduction of lesson 29, and two or three sentences on
  each topic of the course (family, home, food, the weather, travel, school, work, hobbies,
  festivals, feelings).

### During the exam

1. **Read the choices before the audio.** If they are times, listen for {点|diǎn}, {半|bàn} and {刻|kè}; if places,
   for {在|zài}, {到|dào} and the position words.
2. **Listen for the connectors.** {可是|kě shì} and {只是|zhǐ shì} bring the real point; {除了|chú le}…{都|dōu} makes an exception;
   {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái} a condition you can't skip.
3. **Skim, then scan.** **[[Skimming]]**: read the title, the first line and the last line of a text
   to know what it is. **[[Scanning]]**: read the question, then look for the one fact it asks for (a
   time, a price, a place).
4. **Answer every question.** Cross out the choices you know are wrong, then choose.
5. **Check your sentences** in the writing part: time before the verb, a measure word with every
   number, {了|le} or {过|guo} for the past, no {是|shì} before an adjective, {把|bǎ} and {被|bèi} with something after the verb.
6. **Keep moving.** Leave a hard item and come back to it; in listening the audio doesn't wait.

## A short practice set

Original items in the style of the tasks above. Answers are under each part.

### A. Listening

Play each dialogue with the words hidden first.

```dialogue
# A1
女: {明天|míng tiān}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{过|guo}{生日|shēng rì}，{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}？
= It's Xiao Wang's birthday tomorrow. Are you going?
男: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可是|kě shì}{明天|míng tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{加班|jiā bān}。
= I'd love to, but I have to work late tomorrow evening.
女: {那|nà}{你|nǐ}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}{个|gè}{电话|diàn huà}{吧|ba}。
= Then give him a ring.
```

```dialogue
# A2
男: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}？
= How much is this shirt?
女: {一百二十|yì bǎi èr shí}{块|kuài}。{如果|rú guǒ}{买|mǎi}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}，{一共|yí gòng}{两百|liǎng bǎi}。
= A hundred and twenty. If you buy two, it's two hundred altogether.
男: {那|nà}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}。
= Then I'll take two.
```

```dialogue
# A3
导游: {各位|gè wèi}{游客|yóu kè}，{欢迎|huān yíng}{来|lái}{到|dào}{动物园|dòng wù yuán}！{今天|jīn tiān}{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{大家|dà jiā}{最好|zuì hǎo}{多|duō}{喝|hē}{水|shuǐ}。{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{馆|guǎn}{中午|zhōng wǔ}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{休息|xiū xi}，{如果|rú guǒ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{上午|shàng wǔ}{去|qù}。{除了|chú le}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{以外|yǐ wài}，{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{别的|bié de}{动物|dòng wù}。{祝|zhù}{大家|dà jiā}{玩儿|wánr}{得|de}{开心|kāi xīn}！
= Welcome to the zoo, everyone! It's very hot today, so you'd better drink plenty of water. The panda house closes from twelve noon to two in the afternoon: if you want to see the pandas, it's best to go in the morning. Besides the pandas, the zoo has lots of other animals. Have a great time!
```

1. A1: Is the man going to the party? Why or why not?
2. A2: How much does the man pay?
3. A3: When can't you see the pandas? What does the guide advise because of the heat?

{加班|jiā bān} is "to work overtime", {导游|dǎo yóu} a tour guide.

<details>
<summary>Answers</summary>

1. No: he has to work late ({明天|míng tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{加班|jiā bān}). {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可是|kě shì}… is a polite way to say no.
2. Two hundred yuan for two shirts ({如果|rú guǒ}{买|mǎi}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}，{一共|yí gòng}{两百|liǎng bǎi}).
3. From 12 to 2 ({中午|zhōng wǔ}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{休息|xiū xi}); drink plenty of water ({大家|dà jiā}{最好|zuì hǎo}{多|duō}{喝|hē}{水|shuǐ}).
</details>

### B. Reading

> **{找|zhǎo}{同屋|tóng wū}**
>
> {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{留学生|liú xué shēng}，{在|zài}{北京大学|Běi jīng Dà xué}{学习|xué xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{附近|fù jìn}{租|zū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{房子|fáng zi}，{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{房间|fáng jiān}，{打算|dǎ suàn}{找|zhǎo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{同屋|tóng wū}。{房子|fáng zi}{离|lí}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}，{走路|zǒu lù}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}，{旁边|páng biān}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{超市|chāo shì}{和|hé}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}。{房间|fáng jiān}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{可是|kě shì}{很|hěn}{干净|gān jìng}，{也|yě}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}。{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。{我|wǒ}{希望|xī wàng}{同屋|tóng wū}{不但|bú dàn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{安静|ān jìng}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{这样|zhè yàng}{我们|wǒ men}{可以|kě yǐ}{一起|yì qǐ}{练习|liàn xí}。{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{兴趣|xìng qù}，{请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{发|fā}{邮件|yóu jiàn}。
>
> {莎拉|Shā lā}

{同屋|tóng wū} is a flatmate, and {租|zū} "to rent".

1. What is Sarah looking for, and why?
2. What is the flat like? Give two points.
3. What two things does she hope for in the other person?

<details>
<summary>Answers</summary>

1. A flatmate ({同屋|tóng wū}): she has rented a flat with two rooms.
2. Five minutes' walk from the metro; a supermarket and restaurants nearby; the room isn't big but
   is clean and quiet; 2,000 yuan a month (any two).
3. Someone who likes quiet and speaks a little Chinese ({不但|bú dàn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{安静|ān jìng}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}), so they can
   practise together.
</details>

### C. Choose the connector

Fill each gap with one of: {只要|zhǐ yào}, {只有|zhǐ yǒu}, {不但|bú dàn}, {如果|rú guǒ}, {除了|chú le}.

1. ___ {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}。
2. ___ {多|duō}{练习|liàn xí}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{说|shuō}{得|de}{好|hǎo}。
3. {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}___ {好吃|hǎo chī}，{而且|ér qiě}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}。
4. ___ {明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{了|le}。
5. ___ {小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{以外|yǐ wài}，{我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。

<details>
<summary>Answers</summary>

1. {只要|zhǐ yào} (with {就|jiù}: the condition is enough). 2. {只有|zhǐ yǒu} (with {才|cái}: the only way). 3. {不但|bú dàn} (with {而且|ér qiě}). 4. {如果|rú guǒ}
(a supposition, with {就|jiù}). 5. {除了|chú le} (with {以外|yǐ wài} and {都|dōu}: an exception).
</details>

### D. Put the words in order

1. {被|bèi} / {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē} / {骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le} / {别人|bié ren}
2. {把|bǎ} / {请|qǐng} / {关|guān}{上|shàng} / {门|mén}
3. {打算|dǎ suàn} / {我|wǒ} / {去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó} / {明年|míng nián} / {留学|liú xué}

<details>
<summary>Answers</summary>

1. {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{别人|bié ren}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 (My bike's been taken by someone.)
2. {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{门|mén}{关|guān}{上|shàng}。 (Please shut the door.)
3. {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。 or {我|wǒ}{明年|míng nián}{打算|dǎ suàn}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。 (I'm planning to study in China next year.)
</details>

### E. Writing

Write the words in characters:

1. {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{门口|mén kǒu} jiàn miàn。
2. {学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{最|zuì} zhòng yào {的|de}{是|shì}{多|duō}{说|shuō}。
3. {他|tā} bú dàn {会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。

Then write one or two sentences of your own: what did you do last weekend, and what will you do
next weekend?

<details>
<summary>Answers and a model</summary>

1. {见面|jiàn miàn} 2. {重要|zhòng yào} 3. {不但|bú dàn}

{上|shàng}{个|gè}{周末|zhōu mò}{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{了|le}，{山|shān}{上|shàng}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng} (scenery) {特别|tè bié}{漂亮|piào liang}。{下|xià}{个|gè}{周末|zhōu mò}{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}，{看|kàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
— Last weekend I went hiking with friends, and the scenery at the top was beautiful. Next weekend
I'm planning to stay at home and watch a Chinese film.
</details>

### F. Speaking

Answer each question aloud in two or three sentences, then compare with the model.

```speak
# Speaking practice
{你|nǐ}{为什么|wèi shén me}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}？——{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{主要|zhǔ yào}{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{工作|gōng zuò}。{我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{跟|gēn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{公司|gōng sī}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{关系|guān xi}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{多|duō}{了解|liǎo jiě}{中国|Zhōng guó}。
= Why are you learning Chinese? — Mainly for work. My company works a lot with Chinese companies, so I want to know China better.
{你|nǐ}{周末|zhōu mò}{常常|cháng cháng}{做|zuò}{什么|shén me}？——{周末|zhōu mò}{我|wǒ}{常常|cháng cháng}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{跑步|pǎo bù}。{如果|rú guǒ}{天气|tiān qì}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
= What do you usually do at the weekend? — I often go running in the park. If the weather's bad, I read at home.
{你|nǐ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{哪个|nǎ ge}{季节|jì jié}？——{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{秋天|qiū tiān}，{因为|yīn wèi}{秋天|qiū tiān}{不|bù}{冷|lěng}{也|yě}{不|bú}{热|rè}，{而且|ér qiě}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。
= Which season do you like best? — Autumn, because it's neither cold nor hot, and it's beautiful.
```

## Writing by hand: the 150 characters of HSK 3

HSK 3 adds 150 characters to write by hand, all marked ✎ in your character sections. Here they are
by module. Trace each one, then write it on paper from memory; the ones you can't yet write are
your list for the last weeks. The 100 of levels 1–2 are in the second table of the character
reference.

#### Module 1 (lessons 1–5): 23

```trace
咱区层发冰空调
```

```trace trad=燈方安乾淨放牙
灯方安干净放牙
```

```trace
瓶丢把耳胖轻查
```

```trace
心用
```

#### Module 2 (lessons 6–10): 39

```trace
饺瓜香饱渴斤饮
```

```trace
差加单勺合适换
```

```trace
选种卡信行收办
```

```trace

```

## A study plan for the last month

| Week | Every day | Also |
|---|---|---|
| 4 weeks before | vocabulary reviews (20 minutes), one dialogue with the words hidden | the module quizzes of modules 1–2; the handwriting page, module 1 |
| 3 weeks before | reviews, one reading text with pinyin off | module quizzes 3–4; handwriting, modules 2–3; a sample paper untimed |
| 2 weeks before | reviews, a listening and a reading text | module quizzes 5–6; handwriting, modules 4–6; speaking answers aloud |
| last week | reviews of your weakest words only | a sample paper timed; rest the day before |

## Can you do this?

- Tell a short story with its cause, process and result (lesson 28).
- Give advice and explain rules with {应该|yīng gāi}, {得|děi}, {必须|bì xū} and {不用|bú yòng} (lesson 27).
- Set conditions with {如果|rú guǒ}, {只要|zhǐ yào} and {只有|zhǐ yǒu} (lesson 26).
- Use {把|bǎ} and {被|bèi} (lessons 03 and 13), and compare things with {比|bǐ}, {没有|méi yǒu}…{那么|nà me} and {跟|gēn}…{一样|yí yàng} (lesson 04).
- Read a notice, an email or an invitation and find the time, place and what to do (lessons 20,
  23, 26, 27, 29).
- Write one or two sentences about what you have done and what you plan to do (lesson 29).
- Introduce yourself and answer simple questions aloud for a minute (lesson 29).

If one of these is shaky, go back to its lesson and redo its questions before the exam.

## Common mistakes in the exam

- Answering a rhetorical question as a real one: {你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{去|qù}{过|guo}{吗|ma}？ means you have been.
- Choosing {就|jiù} after {只有|zhǐ yǒu} or {才|cái} after {只要|zhǐ yào}: the pairs are {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} and {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái}.
- Missing the "but": in {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可是|kě shì}…, what follows {可是|kě shì} is the answer.
- In writing, English word order: ~~{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{明年|míng nián}~~ → {我|wǒ}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}.
- In writing, a missing measure word: ~~{三|sān}{书|shū}~~ → {三|sān}{本|běn}{书|shū}.
- Leaving a gap empty: a guess may be right; an empty answer never is.

## Key points

- New HSK 3, as reported: listening 30, reading 30, writing 10 (70 questions, about 83 minutes),
  and a speaking test of 15 questions, about 15 minutes, registered with the written exam and taken
  separately. Check the official site for changes.
- Pass mark not published for the new exam (the old HSK 3: 180 of 300).
- Before: a sample paper, every word to Advanced, pinyin off, daily listening, handwriting, answers
  aloud.
- During: choices before the audio, listen for connectors, skim then scan, answer everything,
  check your sentences.

That's the end of the course: congratulations. {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{考试|kǎo shì}{顺利|shùn lì}！ (Good luck in the exam! {顺利|shùn lì}: smoothly.)

lessons.title: Journey to the West: the White Bone Demon
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》 (Journey to the West) is one of the best-known novels in Chinese, and its hero, the monkey
{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng} (Sun Wukong), is known to almost every child in China. This lesson introduces the novel and
then tells one of its most famous episodes in our own graded Chinese, about 500 characters long,
using the words of this course and a few glossed ones. It's a chance to read a longer story with
cause, process and result, the narrative of lesson 28.

## The novel

- **When**: the Ming dynasty. The earliest edition that survives was printed in Nanjing in 1592;
  earlier editions are thought to have existed, but no copies survive. The novel has 100 chapters.
- **Who wrote it**: it's traditionally credited to {吴承恩|Wú Chéng ēn} (Wu Cheng'en, about 1500–1582). The early
  editions name no author, though, and scholars have argued about the attribution for about a
  century without settling it, so you'll often see "attributed to Wu Cheng'en".
- **The history behind it**: a real monk, {玄奘|Xuán zàng} (Xuanzang, 602–664), travelled from Chang'an, the
  Tang capital, to India and back in the 7th century to bring Buddhist scriptures to China; he
  left in 629 and returned in the 640s. The novel turns his journey into a fantasy full of demons
  and magic, and calls him {唐僧|Táng sēng} (the Tang monk).

### The travellers

| Name | Who | In the story |
|---|---|---|
| {唐僧|Táng sēng} | the monk, the master ({师父|shī fu}) | kind and devout, but easily fooled |
| {孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng} | the Monkey King, first disciple ({徒弟|tú dì}) | can change into many forms and fly on a cloud; his "fiery golden eyes" ({火眼金睛|huǒ yǎn jīn jīng}) see through any disguise |
| {猪八戒|Zhū Bā jiè} | Zhu Bajie, a pig spirit, second disciple | greedy and lazy, and often stirs up trouble |
| {沙僧|Shā Sēng} | Sha Seng, third disciple | quiet and loyal |

{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng} wears a gold band round his head. When {唐僧|Táng sēng} says a certain spell ({紧箍咒|jǐn gū zhòu}, the "tightening
spell"), the band squeezes and his head aches terribly: it's the master's only way of controlling
him.

## Before you read

These words aren't in the course; they're glossed again in the story.

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| {妖怪|yāo guài} | demon, monster |
| {师父|shī fu} | master (a teacher; what the disciples call {唐僧|Táng sēng}) |
| {徒弟|tú dì} | disciple |
| {取经|qǔ jīng} | to fetch the (Buddhist) scriptures |
| {白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng} | the White Bone Demon (literally "white-bone spirit") |
| {长生不老|cháng shēng bù lǎo} | to live for ever and never grow old |
| {念|niàn} | to recite, to say (a spell) |
| {受不了|shòu bu liǎo} | can't bear it |
| {死|sǐ} | to die; {打死|dǎ sǐ}: to kill (by striking) |
| {一堆白骨|yì duī bái gǔ} | a pile of white bones |
| {麻烦|má fan} | trouble |

## The story: {三打白骨精|sān dǎ Bái gǔ jīng} (Sun Wukong beats the White Bone Demon three times)

### Part 1

> {唐僧|Táng sēng}{和|hé}{他|tā}{的|de}{三|sān}{个|gè}{徒弟|tú dì}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}、{猪八戒|Zhū Bā jiè}、{沙僧|Shā Sēng}{要|yào}{去|qù}{西方|xī fāng}{取经|qǔ jīng}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{天|tiān}{了|le}。{一|yì}{天|tiān}，{他们|tā men}{走|zǒu}{到|dào}{一|yí}{座|zuò} ({座|zuò}: a measure word for mountains) {大|dà}{山|shān}{里|lǐ}。{山|shān}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}，{路|lù}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{走|zǒu}，{附近|fù jìn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。{唐僧|Táng sēng}{又|yòu}{饿|è}{又|yòu}{累|lèi}，{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{说|shuō}：“{师父|shī fu}，{您|nín}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{休息|xiū xi}{一下|yí xià}，{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{吃|chī}{的|de}。”{走|zǒu}{以前|yǐ qián}，{他|tā}{告诉|gào su}{大家|dà jiā}：“{这里|zhè lǐ}{可能|kě néng}{有|yǒu}{妖怪|yāo guài}，{你们|nǐ men}{千万|qiān wàn} (whatever you do) {别|bié}{离开|lí kāi}{这儿|zhèr}！”

### Part 2

> {山|shān}{里|lǐ}{住|zhù}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{妖怪|yāo guài}，{叫|jiào}{白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}。{她|tā}{听说|tīng shuō}，{只要|zhǐ yào}{吃|chī}{了|le}{唐僧|Táng sēng}{的|de}{肉|ròu}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{长生不老|cháng shēng bù lǎo}。{她|tā}{看见|kàn jiàn}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，{马上|mǎ shàng}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{漂亮|piào liang}{的|de}{女孩儿|nǚ háir}，{带|dài}{着|zhe}{一些|yì xiē}{饭|fàn}，{走|zǒu}{到|dào}{唐僧|Táng sēng}{面前|miàn qián}{说|shuō}：“{师父|shī fu}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{您|nín}{做|zuò}{的|de}{饭|fàn}，{请|qǐng}{吃|chī}{吧|ba}。”{这|zhè}{时候|shí hou}，{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{回来|huí lái}{了|le}。{他|tā}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{双|shuāng}{火眼金睛|huǒ yǎn jīn jīng}，{一|yí}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{发现|fā xiàn}{她|tā}{是|shì}{妖怪|yāo guài}，{拿|ná}{起|qǐ}{棍子|gùn zi} (a stick: his magic staff) {就|jiù}{打|dǎ}。{妖怪|yāo guài}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}，{地|dì}{上|shang}{只|zhǐ}{留|liú}{下|xià}{了|le}{女孩儿|nǚ háir}{的|de}{身体|shēn tǐ}，{其实|qí shí}{那|nà}{是|shì}{假|jià}{的|de}。{唐僧|Táng sēng}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì}：“{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{打死|dǎ sǐ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{人|rén}？”

### Part 3

> {过|guo}{了|le}{一会儿|yí huìr}，{白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}{又|yòu}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{奶奶|nǎi nai}，{哭|kū}{着|zhe}{说|shuō}：“{我|wǒ}{的|de}{女儿|nǚ ér}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{了|le}？{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{来|lái}{找|zhǎo}{她|tā}{的|de}。”{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{又|yòu}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{了|le}{她|tā}，{又|yòu}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{下去|xià qù}。{唐僧|Táng sēng}{更|gèng}{生气|shēng qì}{了|le}，{念|niàn}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{紧箍咒|jǐn gū zhòu}，{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{头|tóu}{疼|téng}{得|de}{受不了|shòu bu liǎo}。{第|dì}{三|sān}{次|cì}，{白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{爷爷|yé ye}，{说|shuō}{是|shì}{来|lái}{找|zhǎo}{家人|jiā rén}{的|de}。{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{看|kàn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu}，{这|zhè}{次|cì}{一下子|yí xià zi} (at one stroke) {打死|dǎ sǐ}{了|le}{她|tā}。{她|tā}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一堆白骨|yì duī bái gǔ}。

### Part 4

> {孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{说|shuō}：“{师父|shī fu}，{您|nín}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}{一堆白骨|yì duī bái gǔ}{吗|ma}？{她|tā}{真|zhēn}{的|de}{是|shì}{妖怪|yāo guài}！”{可是|kě shì}{唐僧|Táng sēng}{还是|hái shi}{不|bù}{相信|xiāng xìn}。{猪八戒|Zhū Bā jiè}{也|yě}{在|zài}{旁边|páng biān}{说|shuō}：“{他|tā}{打死|dǎ sǐ}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{还|hái}{说|shuō}{是|shì}{妖怪|yāo guài}！”{唐僧|Táng sēng}{又|yòu}{难过|nán guò}{又|yòu}{生气|shēng qì}，{最后|zuì hòu}{让|ràng}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{离开|lí kāi}。{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{哭|kū}{着|zhe}{跟|gēn}{师父|shī fu}{说|shuō}{了|le}{再见|zài jiàn}，{回|huí}{到|dào}{了|le}{他|tā}{的|de}{家|jiā}{花果山|Huā guǒ Shān} (Flower-Fruit Mountain)。{没有|méi yǒu}{了|le}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}，{唐僧|Táng sēng}{他们|tā men}{后来|hòu lái}{遇到|yù dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{麻烦|má fan}……

<details>
<summary>Translation</summary>

**Part 1.** The Tang monk and his three disciples, Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng, were
travelling west to fetch the scriptures, and had been on the road for many days. One day they came into a great mountain. The mountain was
high, the path was hard going, and there wasn't a soul around. The monk was hungry and tired, so
Sun Wukong said, "Master, have a rest here: I'll go and find something to eat." Before he left he
told everyone, "There may be demons here. Whatever you do, don't leave this spot!"

**Part 2.** In the mountain lived a demon called the White Bone Demon. She had heard that as long
as she ate the Tang monk's flesh, she would live for ever. When she saw Sun Wukong leave, she
turned at once into a pretty girl, and carrying some food she went up to the monk and said,
"Master, I've cooked this for you: please eat." Just then Sun Wukong came back. He had fiery
golden eyes, saw at a glance that she was a demon, picked up his staff and struck. The demon fled,
leaving only the girl's body on the ground, though it was in fact a fake. The monk was furious:
"How could you kill a good person?"

**Part 3.** After a while the White Bone Demon turned into an old woman, who wept: "Where has my daughter
gone? I've come to look for her." Sun Wukong recognised her again and struck again. The monk grew even angrier
and began to recite the tightening spell, and Sun Wukong's head hurt so much he could hardly bear
it. The third time, the demon turned into an old man, saying he had come looking for his family.
Sun Wukong saw clearly what she was, and this time killed her with one blow. She turned into a pile
of white bones.

**Part 4.** Sun Wukong said, "Master, look: isn't this a pile of bones? She really was a
demon!" But the monk still didn't believe him. Zhu Bajie chimed in: "He's killed three people,
and he says they were demons!" Sad and angry, the monk finally sent Sun Wukong away. Weeping, Sun
Wukong said goodbye to his master and went back to his home, Flower-Fruit Mountain. Without Sun
Wukong, the monk and the others soon ran into great trouble…
</details>

## Reading it again

Look at how the story is built, as lesson 28 describes:

- **Cause**: {唐僧|Táng sēng}{又|yòu}{饿|è}{又|yòu}{累|lèi}, so {孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng} goes to find food and leaves the others alone; {白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng} has heard that
  eating the monk's flesh brings eternal life ({只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}…, lesson 26).
- **Process**: three disguises, each with {变成|biàn chéng} and the repetition word {又|yòu} ({又|yòu}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}, {又|yòu}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{了|le}, {又|yòu}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{下去|xià qù});
  the time words {一|yì}{天|tiān}, {这|zhè}{时候|shí hou}, {过|guo}{了|le}{一会儿|yí huìr}, {第|dì}{三|sān}{次|cì} move it on.
- **Result**: {最后|zuì hòu} and {后来|hòu lái}: the monk sends his best protector away, and trouble follows.

Some grammar from this course in the story:

- {一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}: "not a single person" ({一|yī} + measure + noun + {也|yě} + negative).
- {一|yí}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{发现|fā xiàn}: {一|yī}…{就|jiù} (lesson 05): as soon as he looked, he saw.
- {疼|téng}{得|de}{受不了|shòu bu liǎo}: a degree complement with {得|de} (HSK 2): hurt so much he couldn't bear it.
- {哭|kū}{着|zhe}: durative {着|zhe}: he said goodbye weeping.
- {让|ràng}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{离开|lí kāi}: pivotal {让|ràng} (HSK 2): made him leave.

## The story today

In the novel this is chapter 27, and the next chapter opens with Sun Wukong back on Flower-Fruit
Mountain. The episode is one of the best known in Chinese culture: it has been retold in
television series, cartoons, films, comics and games, and "{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{三打白骨精|sān dǎ Bái gǔ jīng}" is a phrase many people
know. In the novel Sun Wukong soon returns, and the four travellers reach India in the end.

Our version is simplified. In the novel the monk punishes Sun Wukong with the tightening spell
after the first blow as well as the second, and Zhu Bajie's remarks help turn the monk against
him from the start. Retellings differ in such details, so this lesson keeps one spell and one
remark.

## Key points

- 《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》: a Ming-dynasty novel (earliest surviving edition 1592), 100 chapters, traditionally
  attributed to Wu Cheng'en (disputed).
- Behind it is the real journey of the monk Xuanzang to India in the 7th century.
- The travellers: {唐僧|Táng sēng}, {孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}, {猪八戒|Zhū Bā jiè}, {沙僧|Shā Sēng}. {孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}'s fiery golden eyes see through disguises.
- {三打白骨精|sān dǎ Bái gǔ jīng}: the demon tries three disguises; Sun Wukong strikes each time; the monk, fooled, sends
  him away.

lessons.title: Two Tang poems: 春晓 and 登鹳雀楼
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

Almost everyone who grew up in China can recite these two short poems. Both are from the Tang
dynasty (618–907), the great age of Chinese poetry, and both are only twenty characters long:
four lines of five characters, the form called {五言绝句|wǔ yán jué jù} (a five-character quatrain). Many children
learn them in their first years at primary school; {登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}, for example, is set for memorising in a
common second-year textbook.

For each poem you'll find the text with pinyin, notes on the words, a paraphrase in modern Chinese
made from course words, and our own translation. Classical Chinese is terse: one character often
does the work of a whole modern word, and some characters have older meanings. You don't need to
learn the new characters; enjoy the sound and the pictures.

## {春晓|Chūn xiǎo} (Spring Morning), by {孟浩然|Mèng Hào rán}

{孟浩然|Mèng Hào rán} (Meng Haoran, about 689–740) wrote much about the countryside where he lived, and this poem
of a lazy spring morning is his best known.

> **{春晓|Chūn xiǎo}**
>
> {春眠不觉晓|chūn mián bù jué xiǎo}，
>
> {处处闻啼鸟|chù chù wén tí niǎo}。
>
> {夜来风雨声|yè lái fēng yǔ shēng}，
>
> {花落知多少|huā luò zhī duō shǎo}。

### Words

| Characters | Here | Modern Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| {春眠|chūn mián} | sleeping in spring ({眠|mián}: to sleep) | {春天|chūn tiān}{睡觉|shuì jiào} |
| {不觉晓|bù jué xiǎo} | not noticing the dawn ({觉|jué}: to feel, notice; {晓|xiǎo}: daybreak) | {不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{天亮|tiān liàng}{了|le} |
| {处处|chù chù} | everywhere | {到处|dào chù} |
| {闻|wén} | to hear (in modern Chinese {闻|wén} is "to smell"; it keeps "hear" in {新闻|xīn wén}, news) | {听|tīng}{到|dào} |
| {啼鸟|tí niǎo} | birds calling ({啼|tí}: to call, cry) | {鸟叫|niǎo jiào} |
| {夜来|yè lái} | in the night (that has passed) | {夜里|yè li}, {昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang} |
| {风雨声|fēng yǔ shēng} | the sound of wind and rain | {刮|guā}{风|fēng}{下雨|xià yǔ}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn} |
| {花落|huā luò} | flowers fall ({落|luò}: to fall) | {花落|huā luò}{下来|xià lái} |
| {知多少|zhī duō shǎo} | who knows how many? | {不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{有|yǒu}{多少|duō shao} |

{觉|jué} here is jué, the reading of {觉得|jué de}, not the jiào of {睡觉|shuì jiào}.

### In modern Chinese

{春天|chūn tiān}{的|de}{晚上|wǎn shang}{睡|shuì}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{天亮|tiān liàng}{了|le}{也|yě}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}。{到处|dào chù}{都|dōu}{能|néng}{听|tīng}{到|dào}{鸟叫|niǎo jiào}。{昨天|zuó tiān}{夜里|yè li}{又|yòu}{刮|guā}{风|fēng}{又|yòu}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{有|yǒu}{多少|duō shao}{花落|huā luò}{下来|xià lái}{了|le}。

({天亮|tiān liàng}: daybreak; {夜里|yè li}: in the night; {叫|jiào}: to call, of birds.)

### Our translation

> Asleep in spring, I never noticed dawn;
>
> now everywhere I hear the birds.
>
> All night there was the sound of wind and rain:
>
> how many flowers fell, who knows?

The last line turns a pleasant morning into a small sadness: spring is beautiful, and it is
already passing.

## {登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu} (On the Stork Tower), by {王之涣|Wáng Zhī huàn}

{王之涣|Wáng Zhī huàn} (Wang Zhihuan, about 688–742) is known today for only a handful of poems, and this is the most
famous. The Stork Tower ({鹳雀楼|Guàn què lóu}) stood on the east bank of the Yellow River at Puzhou, in today's
Yongji in Shanxi province, looking over the river and the mountains. The old tower was destroyed
long ago; a new one, built in the Tang style, opened on the same riverside in 2002.

> **{登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}**
>
> {白日依山尽|bái rì yī shān jìn}，
>
> {黄河入海流|Huáng Hé rù hǎi liú}。
>
> {欲穷千里目|yù qióng qiān lǐ mù}，
>
> {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}。

### Words

| Characters | Here | Modern Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| {登|dēng} | to climb (a height) | {上|shàng}, {爬|pá}{上|shàng} |
| {白日|bái rì} | the bright sun | {太阳|tài yang} |
| {依山|yī shān} | along the mountains ({依|yī}: lean on, follow) | {靠|kào}{着|zhe}{山|shān} ({靠|kào}: against) |
| {尽|jìn} | to come to an end: here, to set | {下去|xià qù}, {没有|méi yǒu}{了|le} |
| {黄河|Huáng Hé} | the Yellow River | {黄河|Huáng Hé} |
| {入海流|rù hǎi liú} | flows into the sea ({入|rù}: to enter) | {流进|liú jìn}{大|dà}{海|hǎi} |
| {欲|yù} | to wish to | {想|xiǎng}, {要|yào} |
| {穷|qióng} | to reach the end of (here not "poor") | {看|kàn}{到|dào}{最|zuì}{远|yuǎn}{的|de}{地方|dì fang} |
| {千里目|qiān lǐ mù} | a view of a thousand li ({千|qiān}{里|lǐ}: a thousand li; the li is an old unit of distance, about half a kilometre) | {很|hěn}{远|yuǎn}{的|de}{地方|dì fang} |
| {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu} | go up one more floor | {再|zài}{上|shàng}{一|yì}{层|céng}{楼|lóu} |

The line {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu} has become an everyday phrase: "to go one step further, to do even better".
You might read it in a message of good wishes: {希望|xī wàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}！ (May your Chinese go from
strength to strength!)

### In modern Chinese

{太阳|tài yang}{在|zài}{山|shān}{后面|hòu miàn}{慢|màn}{慢|màn}{地|de}{下去|xià qù}{了|le}，{黄河|Huáng Hé}{向|xiàng}{大|dà}{海|hǎi}{流|liú}{去|qù}。{如果|rú guǒ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{得|de}{更|gèng}{远|yuǎn}，{就|jiù}{要|yào}{再|zài}{上|shàng}{一|yì}{层|céng}{楼|lóu}。

The paraphrase uses three things from lesson 26: {向|xiàng} (towards), {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù} and the "even more" of {更|gèng}.

### Our translation

> The bright sun sinks along the hills;
>
> the Yellow River flows into the sea.
>
> To see a thousand li further,
>
> climb one more storey of the tower.

## Why these poems are learned by heart

- **They are short and regular**: twenty characters, five to a line, with a rhyme at the end of
  lines 2 and 4 ({鸟|niǎo} niǎo / {少|shǎo} shǎo, and {晓|xiǎo} xiǎo at the end of line 1 as well; {流|liú} liú / {楼|lóu} lóu). Both
  still rhyme in Mandarin.
- **Their words are simple**: most characters are ones you know, and the pictures (birds, rain,
  the sun, a river) need no explanation.
- **They say something larger**: one is about spring passing, the other about how a wider view
  needs one more step up. {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu} is quoted far beyond poetry.
- **They are part of growing up**: they're in primary-school textbooks and anthologies for
  children, and parents often teach them before school. Being able to recite them is a small,
  shared piece of culture.

Try it yourself: read each poem aloud three times, then cover the text and say it.

```speak
# {春晓|Chūn xiǎo}
{春眠不觉晓|chūn mián bù jué xiǎo}，{处处闻啼鸟|chù chù wén tí niǎo}。
= Asleep in spring, I never noticed dawn; now everywhere I hear the birds.
{夜来风雨声|yè lái fēng yǔ shēng}，{花落知多少|huā luò zhī duō shǎo}。
= All night there was the sound of wind and rain: how many flowers fell, who knows?
```

```speak
# {登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}
{白日依山尽|bái rì yī shān jìn}，{黄河入海流|Huáng Hé rù hǎi liú}。
= The bright sun sinks along the hills; the Yellow River flows into the sea.
{欲穷千里目|yù qióng qiān lǐ mù}，{更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}。
= To see a thousand li further, climb one more storey of the tower.
```

## Key points

- 《{春晓|Chūn xiǎo}》 by {孟浩然|Mèng Hào rán} and 《{登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}》 by {王之涣|Wáng Zhī huàn}: Tang-dynasty five-character quatrains, twenty characters each.
- Classical words: {觉|jué} (notice), {闻|wén} (hear), {处处|chù chù} (everywhere), {尽|jìn} (come to an end), {欲|yù} (wish to),
  {穷|qióng} (reach the end of).
- {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}: "go one floor higher", today "to do even better".
- Both rhyme on lines 2 and 4 and are among the first poems many Chinese children learn.

{他|tā}{进来|jìn lái}{搬|bān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{沙发|shā fā}。
{他|tā}{搬|bān}{进来|jìn lái}{沙发|shā fā}{一|yí}{个|gè}。
questions.explanation: A thing can go after the whole complement, as new information: {他|tā}{搬|bān}{进来|jìn lái}{一|yí}{个|gè}{沙发|shā fā} (or before {来|lái}: {他|tā}{搬|bān}{进|jìn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{沙发|shā fā}{来|lái}). {他|tā}{进来|jìn lái}{搬|bān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{沙发|shā fā} means "he came in to move a sofa", and the number and measure word always go before the noun.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这个|zhè ge}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí} ___。 (This building has twenty floors.)
questions.explanation: {层|céng} counts floors: {二十|èr shí}{层|céng}. {间|jiān} counts rooms, and {这个|zhè ge}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè} would leave out what there are twenty of. ({二十|èr shí}{楼|lóu} alone is "the twentieth floor", not "twenty floors".)

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{十二|shí èr}{层|céng}。" mean?
choices: We live on the twelfth floor.
questions.explanation: {住|zhù}{在|zài} + number + {层|céng} says which floor: the twelfth (= {十二|shí èr}{楼|lóu}). Building 12 would be {十二|shí èr}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}, and "the building has twelve floors" is {这个|zhè ge}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{十二|shí èr}{层|céng}.

questions.stem: A colleague asks: "{你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{方便|fāng biàn}{吗|ma}？" What does she want to know?
choices: whether you live near the office
whether it's easy to get there tomorrow
whether you'll be at home tomorrow
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}…{方便|fāng biàn}{吗|ma}？ asks whether a time is convenient for you: are you free tomorrow afternoon? {方便|fāng biàn} is also "convenient, easy" for places: {坐|zuò}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{太|tài} ___ {了|le}，{买|mǎi}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{新|xīn}{的|de}{吧|ba}。 (This piece of clothing is too worn: buy a new one.)
questions.explanation: {旧|jiù} is "old, worn, not new" for things; its opposite is {新|xīn}. {老|lǎo} is old for people and long-standing things ({老人|lǎo rén}, {老朋友|lǎo péng you}).

questions.stem: What does {房子|fáng zi} usually mean?
choices: the whole flat or house, as a home
questions.explanation: {房子|fáng zi} is the home as a whole (a flat or a house), and property: {买|mǎi}{房子|fáng zi}. One room is {房间|fáng jiān} (or, in northern speech, {屋子|wū zi}); the bathroom is {卫生间|wèi shēng jiān}.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 层 (floor)?
questions.explanation: {层|céng} is céng: c is "ts" with a puff of air, then -eng, rising.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {冰箱|bīng xiāng}, fridge: two high, level first tones. Keep the pitch up for both.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {空调|kōng tiáo}, air conditioner: a high, level first tone, then a rising second tone. {调|tiáo} is tiáo in this word.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {冰|bīng} ___ (fridge)
questions.explanation: {={冰箱|bīng xiāng}: 箱 (box) is ⺮ (bamboo) on top of 相 xiāng, which gives the sound. {想|xiǎng} (to want) has 心 underneath, and 相 alone is the sound part.=}

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {沙发|shā fā} sofa, {冰箱|bīng xiāng} fridge ("ice box"), {洗衣机|xǐ yī jī} washing machine ("wash-clothes machine"), {空调|kōng tiáo} air conditioner, {灯|dēng} lamp, light. A lift is {电梯|diàn tī}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters): ___ {箱|xiāng} (fridge)
questions.explanation: {={冰箱|bīng xiāng}: {冰|bīng} is 冫 (two dots: ice) + {水|shuǐ}. With three dots on the left it would be water (氵), as in 沙. {冰|bīng} is one of the handwriting characters.=}

questions.stem: Listen. Which floor does the speaker live on, and how does she get up there?

audio.text: 我家在八层，楼里有电梯，很方便。

choices: the eighteenth floor, by the stairs
the eighth floor, by the stairs
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{八|bā}{层|céng}: the eighth floor. {楼里|lóu lǐ}{有|yǒu}{电梯|diàn tī} (there's a lift in the building), so it's convenient ({很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 我们下个月搬家，新房子比现在的大。

choices: They're moving next month, to a bigger home.
questions.explanation: {下个月|xià gè yuè}{搬家|bān jiā}: moving next month. {新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{比|bǐ}{现在|xiàn zài}{的|de}{大|dà}: the new flat is bigger than the present one.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 你住几层？

questions.explanation: {几|jǐ}{层|céng}？ asks which floor: {我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{十二|shí èr}{层|céng} (I live on the twelfth floor). The others answer where you live, how many people are in your family, and how you get up.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker suggest?

audio.text: 屋子里太热了，开空调吧。

questions.explanation: {屋子|wū zi}{里|lǐ}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le} (it's too hot in here), {开|kāi}{空调|kōng tiáo}{吧|ba} (let's put the air conditioning on). {开|kāi}{灯|dēng} would be the light.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{电梯通知|diàn tī tōng zhī}：{三|sān}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}{们|men}，{我们|wǒ men}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{电梯|diàn tī}{很|hěn}{旧|jiù}{了|le}，{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{要|yào}{检查|jiǎn chá}。{那|nà}{天|tiān}{大家|dà jiā}{不|bù}{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{电梯|diàn tī}，{请|qǐng}{走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī}。{要|yào}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}，{请|qǐng}{早|zǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{出门|chū mén}。{住|zhù}{在|zài}{高层|gāo céng}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}{上|shàng}{下|xià}{楼|lóu}{不|bù}{方便|fāng biàn}，{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{可以|kě yǐ}{给|gěi}{小区|xiǎo qū}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}：0000 1234，{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{人|rén}{会|huì}{来|lái}{帮忙|bāng máng}。{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{要|yào}{搬家|bān jiā}、{搬|bān}{沙发|shā fā}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}，{请|qǐng}{换|huàn}{一|yì}{天|tiān}。{楼梯|lóu tī}{的|de}{灯|dēng}{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{也|yě}{要|yào}{换|huàn}{新|xīn}{的|de}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{上|shàng}{下|xià}{楼|lóu}{请|qǐng}{小心|xiǎo xīn}。{星期天|xīng qī tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{电梯|diàn tī}{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{了|le}。{谢谢|xiè xie}{大家|dà jiā}！{阳光小区|Yáng guāng xiǎo qū}" ({通知|tōng zhī}: notice; {检查|jiǎn chá}: to check; {办公室|bàn gōng shì}: office; {换|huàn}: to change; {小心|xiǎo xīn}: careful) What will happen on Saturday?
choices: The lift will be checked and can't be used.
The compound office will be closed.
questions.explanation: {楼里|lóu lǐ}{的|de}{电梯|diàn tī}{要|yào}{检查|jiǎn chá}，{大家|dà jiā}{不|bù}{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{电梯|diàn tī}: the lift is being checked, so nobody can use it; people should take the stairs ({请|qǐng}{走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī}).

questions.stem: Read the notice again: "{电梯通知|diàn tī tōng zhī}：{三|sān}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}{们|men}，{我们|wǒ men}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{电梯|diàn tī}{很|hěn}{旧|jiù}{了|le}，{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{要|yào}{检查|jiǎn chá}。{那|nà}{天|tiān}{大家|dà jiā}{不|bù}{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{电梯|diàn tī}，{请|qǐng}{走|zǒu}{楼梯|lóu tī}。{要|yào}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}，{请|qǐng}{早|zǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{出门|chū mén}。{住|zhù}{在|zài}{高层|gāo céng}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}{上|shàng}{下|xià}{楼|lóu}{不|bù}{方便|fāng biàn}，{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{可以|kě yǐ}{给|gěi}{小区|xiǎo qū}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}：0000 1234，{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{人|rén}{会|huì}{来|lái}{帮忙|bāng máng}。{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{要|yào}{搬家|bān jiā}、{搬|bān}{沙发|shā fā}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}，{请|qǐng}{换|huàn}{一|yì}{天|tiān}。{楼梯|lóu tī}{的|de}{灯|dēng}{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{也|yě}{要|yào}{换|huàn}{新|xīn}{的|de}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{上|shàng}{下|xià}{楼|lóu}{请|qǐng}{小心|xiǎo xīn}。{星期天|xīng qī tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{电梯|diàn tī}{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{了|le}。{谢谢|xiè xie}{大家|dà jiā}！{阳光小区|Yáng guāng xiǎo qū}" Who is asked to choose another day?
choices: people who live on high floors
people planning to move house or move big furniture
questions.explanation: {星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{要|yào}{搬家|bān jiā}、{搬|bān}{沙发|shā fā}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{的|de}{邻居|lín jū}，{请|qǐng}{换|huàn}{一|yì}{天|tiān}: neighbours who want to move house or move sofas and fridges on Saturday should pick another day. Old people and children on high floors can phone the office if they have a problem.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: They've moved into the new flat.
questions.explanation: {他们|tā men}{搬|bān}{进|jìn}{新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{去|qù}{了|le}。 The place ({新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}) goes between {进|jìn} and {去|qù}; {了|le} ends the sentence. Without {去|qù}, {他们|tā men}{搬|bān}{进|jìn}{新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{了|le} is fine too.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: In a {把|bǎ} sentence something must follow the verb: here {了|le} (it's done). ~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{饭|fàn}{吃|chī}~~ stops at the bare verb, and {把|bǎ} + object always comes before the verb.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Please put the books on the table."?
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng} + {把|bǎ} + object + {放|fàng}{在|zài} + place. With {在|zài} + place after the verb Chinese needs {把|bǎ}: ~~{放|fàng}{书|shū}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}~~ is wrong, and {在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng} can't come before {放|fàng} here.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I didn't get the bowls clean."?
questions.explanation: The negative goes before {把|bǎ}: {没|méi}{把|bǎ}…. {没|méi} already says it didn't happen, so no {了|le} at the end. {不|bù}{把|bǎ} is for "won't" or "don't (intend to)".

questions.stem: Which verb can NOT be used in a {把|bǎ} sentence?
questions.explanation: {把|bǎ} is for doing something to a thing with a result: putting ({放|fàng}), washing ({洗|xǐ}), switching off ({关|guān}). Feelings like {喜欢|xǐ huan} don't do anything to their object: say {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{他|tā}, never ~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{喜欢|xǐ huan}~~.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Don't put dirty clothes on the sofa!"?
choices: {把|bǎ}{脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu}{别|bié}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}！
{别|bié}{把|bǎ}{脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}！
{别|bié}{放|fàng}{脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu}{把|bǎ}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}！
{脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu}{别|bié}{把|bǎ}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}！
questions.explanation: {别|bié} (don't) goes before {把|bǎ}: {别|bié} + {把|bǎ} + object + verb + {在|zài} + place. Negatives and modal verbs come before {把|bǎ}, not before the verb.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钥匙|yào shi} ___ {了|le}！ (My keys have gone missing!) ({钥匙|yào shi}: keys)
questions.explanation: {不见|bú jiàn}{了|le} is "has disappeared, can't be found", with the missing thing as the subject. With the person as the subject, say {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{钥匙|yào shi}{丢|diū}{了|le} (I've lost my keys).

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of {脏|zāng} (dirty)?
questions.explanation: {脏|zāng} is zāng: z (not the curled zh of the surname {张|Zhāng} Zhāng), and a high, level tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {干净|gān jìng}, clean: a high, level first tone, then a falling fourth tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {洗澡|xǐ zǎo}, to have a shower or bath: two third tones, written 3+3. You hear the first one rise (xí zǎo); both answers count.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {牙|yá} ___ (toothbrush)
questions.explanation: {={牙刷|yá shuā}: {刷|shuā} is 尸 + 巾 (a cloth) + 刂. All four have 刂 on the right: {刚|gāng} is in {刚才|gāng cái} (lesson 25), {别|bié} is "don't", and 利 isn't a course character.=}

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {碗|wǎn} bowl, {盘子|pán zi} plate, {瓶子|píng zi} bottle, {箱子|xiāng zi} box (also a suitcase), {牙刷|yá shuā} toothbrush. A sofa is {沙发|shā fā}.

questions.stem: Write the measure word (in characters): {一|yì} ___ {椅子|yǐ zi} (a chair)
questions.explanation: {={一|yì}{把|bǎ}{椅子|yǐ zi}: {把|bǎ} is also a measure word for things held by a handle or a back ({一|yì}{把|bǎ}{伞|sǎn}, an umbrella). It's 扌 + 巴, seven strokes, and one of the handwriting characters.=} ({一|yì}{张|zhāng}{椅子|yǐ zi} is also heard, and counts.)

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 你把灯关了吗？

questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{关|guān}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ is "Have you switched off the light?" The short answer repeats the verb with {了|le}: {关|guān}{了|le} (yes, I have). The negative would be {还|hái}{没|méi}{关|guān}.

questions.stem: Listen. What are you asked to do?

audio.text: 请把这些空瓶子丢了。

choices: put the bottles in the fridge
questions.explanation: {把|bǎ}{这些|zhè xiē}{空瓶子|kōng píng zi}{丢|diū}{了|le}: throw these empty bottles away. {丢|diū} is "to lose" and also "to throw away".

questions.stem: Listen. What is the problem?

audio.text: 我的牙刷不见了，你看见了吗？

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{牙刷|yá shuā}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le} (my toothbrush has gone), {你|nǐ}{看见|kàn jiàn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ (have you seen it?).

questions.stem: Listen. What will the person spoken to do after dinner?

audio.text: 吃完饭以后，我洗碗，你扫地。

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{洗碗|xǐ wǎn} (I'll wash up), {你|nǐ}{扫|sǎo}{地|dì} (you sweep the floor). {以后|yǐ hòu} (after) is lesson 25's word.

questions.stem: Read the note: "{小明|Xiǎo Míng}：{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{你|nǐ}{爸爸|bà ba}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{在|zài}{家|jiā}，{晚饭|wǎn fàn}{在|zài}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}，{你|nǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{热|rè}{一下|yí xià}{吃|chī}。{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}{还有|hái yǒu}{牛奶|niú nǎi}{和|hé}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}，{你|nǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{吃|chī}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。{你|nǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}。{吃|chī}{完|wán}{饭|fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{和|hé}{盘子|pán zi}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}，{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}。{你|nǐ}{的|de}{房间|fáng jiān}{太|tài}{脏|zāng}{了|le}，{请|qǐng}{打扫|dǎ sǎo}{一下|yí xià}，{地|dì}{也|yě}{要|yào}{扫|sǎo}{一|yi}{扫|sǎo}。{脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu}{别|bié}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{上|shàng}，{把|bǎ}{它们|tā men}{放|fàng}{进|jìn}{洗衣机|xǐ yī jī}{里|lǐ}。{睡觉|shuì jiào}{以前|yǐ qián}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{洗澡|xǐ zǎo}{刷牙|shuā yá}，{把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{和|hé}{空调|kōng tiáo}{都|dōu}{关|guān}{了|le}。{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。{我们|wǒ men}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{回来|huí lái}。{妈妈|mā ma}" ({热|rè}: here, to heat up; {以后|yǐ hòu}: after; {以前|yǐ qián}: before) Where is Xiaoming's dinner?
questions.explanation: {晚饭|wǎn fàn}{在|zài}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}，{你|nǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{热|rè}{一下|yí xià}{吃|chī}: dinner is in the fridge; he should heat it up himself. The table is where the clean bowls go.

choices: put them in the washing machine
questions.explanation: {脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu}{别|bié}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{上|shàng}，{把|bǎ}{它们|tā men}{放|fàng}{进|jìn}{洗衣机|xǐ yī jī}{里|lǐ}: don't leave them on the bed; put them in the washing machine.

questions.stem: Read the end of the note again: "…{睡觉|shuì jiào}{以前|yǐ qián}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{洗澡|xǐ zǎo}{刷牙|shuā yá}，{把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{和|hé}{空调|kōng tiáo}{都|dōu}{关|guān}{了|le}。{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。{我们|wǒ men}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{回来|huí lái}。{妈妈|mā ma}" Which is NOT on the list for bedtime?
questions.explanation: Before bed: {洗澡|xǐ zǎo} (shower), {刷牙|shuā yá} (brush teeth), {把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{和|hé}{空调|kōng tiáo}{都|dōu}{关|guān}{了|le} (switch off the lights and the air conditioning). Sweeping the floor ({扫|sǎo}{地|dì}) comes earlier, with cleaning his room.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Please put your phone on the table.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}。 {把|bǎ} + the particular object ({你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}), then the verb and where it goes ({放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He's much taller than me."?
questions.explanation: How much more goes after the adjective: {他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}{多了|duō le} (or {高|gāo}{得|de}{多|duō}). {很|hěn} can't go inside a {比|bǐ} sentence, and {多了|duō le} can't come before the adjective.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm not as tall as my sister."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{高|gāo}{多了|duō le}。
questions.explanation: A {没有|méi yǒu} B + adjective: A doesn't reach B's level. {有|yǒu} is never negated with {不|bù}, and {没有|méi yǒu} doesn't take {多了|duō le}. {我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{没有|méi yǒu}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo} says the opposite: my sister isn't as tall as me.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm the same height as my sister."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{一样|yí yàng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{高|gāo}{一样|yí yàng}。
{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{一样|yí yàng}{高|gāo}。
questions.explanation: A {跟|gēn} B {一样|yí yàng} + adjective: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{姐姐|jiě jie}{一样|yí yàng}{高|gāo}. No {很|hěn} before the adjective, and the adjective comes after {一样|yí yàng}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā} ___ {病|bìng}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}{没|méi}{来|lái}{上班|shàng bān}。 (He seems to be ill; he didn't come to work today.)
questions.explanation: {好像|hǎo xiàng} is "to seem, look as if": an impression. {像|xiàng} is resemblance ({他|tā}{像|xiàng}{他|tā}{爸爸|bà ba}, he looks like his dad); ~~{他|tā}{像|xiàng}{病|bìng}{了|le}~~ doesn't work.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {她|tā}{个子|gè zi}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}，{可是|kě shì}{头发|tóu fa}{很|hěn} ___。 (She's tall, but her hair is very short.) ({可是|kě shì}: but)
questions.explanation: {短|duǎn} is short in length (hair, legs, a short time). {矮|ǎi} is short in height, for people and buildings: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{矮|ǎi}.

questions.stem: How do people usually say a height of 1.75 m?
choices: {一百七十五米|yì bǎi qī shí wǔ mǐ}
{一个米七五|yí gè mǐ qī wǔ}
questions.explanation: {一米七五|yì mǐ qī wǔ}: one metre, then the centimetres as two digits ({七五|qī wǔ}). 1.80 is {一米八|yì mǐ bā}. {一百七十五米|yì bǎi qī shí wǔ mǐ} would be 175 metres.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of {嘴|zuǐ} (mouth)?
questions.explanation: {嘴|zuǐ} is zuǐ, a dipping third tone. {最|zuì} (most) is zuì, falling.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {耳朵|ěr duo}, ear: a third tone, then a light, neutral duo.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {年轻|nián qīng}, young: a rising second tone, then a high, level first tone.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {年|nián} ___ (young)
questions.explanation: {={年轻|nián qīng}: 轻 (light) has {车|chē} on the left. 经 (in {经常|jīng cháng}) has the same right side but 纟 on the left; 较 is {车|chē} + 交 (lesson 12's {比较|bǐ jiào}).=}

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {脸|liǎn} face, {嘴|zuǐ} mouth, {腿|tuǐ} leg, {脚|jiǎo} foot, {耳朵|ěr duo} ear. Hair is {头发|tóu fa}. The four single characters all have ⺼, the "meat moon" of body words, except {嘴|zuǐ}, which has {口|kǒu}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters): ___ {朵|duo} (ear)
questions.explanation: {={耳朵|ěr duo}: 耳 (ear) is six strokes, ending with the bottom stroke. It's one of the handwriting characters, and the radical of 聪 and {聊|liáo}.=}

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 我妹妹比我高一点儿，可是没有我胖。

choices: The sister is a little taller and not as heavy.
The sister is much taller and heavier.
The sister is shorter and heavier.
questions.explanation: {比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}: a little taller than me; {没有|méi yǒu}{我|wǒ}{胖|pàng}: not as heavy as me. {可是|kě shì} is "but".

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?

audio.text: 你很像你爸爸。

choices: You look a lot like your dad.
You're as tall as your dad.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{你|nǐ}{爸爸|bà ba}: you look a lot like your dad. {像|xiàng} is resemblance.

questions.stem: Listen. How tall is the man?

audio.text: 他身高一米八，头发很短。

questions.explanation: {一米八|yì mǐ bā} is 1.80 m: one metre, eight (tens of centimetres). 1.08 m would be {一米零八|yì mǐ líng bā}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 你跟你哥哥一样高吗？

questions.explanation: "Are you as tall as your brother?" The answer compares: {不|bù}，{我|wǒ}{比|bǐ}{他|tā}{矮|ǎi}{一点儿|yì diǎnr} (no, I'm a bit shorter than him).

questions.stem: Read: "{这|zhè}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{一家人|yì jiā rén}{的|de}{照片|zhào piàn}。{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{身高|shēn gāo}{一米八五|yì mǐ bā wǔ}，{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{最|zuì}{高|gāo}{的|de}。{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{矮|ǎi}{多了|duō le}，{她|tā}{一米六|yì mǐ liù}。{我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{一样|yí yàng}{高|gāo}，{脸|liǎn}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{爸爸|bà ba}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{他们|tā men}{像|xiàng}{兄弟|xiōng dì}。{爸爸|bà ba}{和|hé}{哥哥|gē ge}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期六|xīng qī liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}。{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{最|zuì}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}，{今年|jīn nián}{十二|shí èr}{岁|suì}，{个子|gè zi}{不|bù}{高|gāo}，{没有|méi yǒu}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{那么|nà me}{高|gāo}。{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{跟|gēn}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}，{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{也|yě}{在|zài}{照片|zhào piàn}{里|lǐ}，{它|tā}{的|de}{耳朵|ěr duo}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}，{腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}，{非常|fēi cháng}{可爱|kě ài}。" ({照片|zhào piàn}: photo; {兄弟|xiōng dì}: brothers) Who in the family is as tall as the father?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{一样|yí yàng}{高|gāo}: the older brother is as tall as the father, and even looks like him. The mother is much shorter ({矮|ǎi}{多了|duō le}).

questions.stem: Read: "{这|zhè}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{一家人|yì jiā rén}{的|de}{照片|zhào piàn}。{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{身高|shēn gāo}{一米八五|yì mǐ bā wǔ}，{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{最|zuì}{高|gāo}{的|de}。{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{矮|ǎi}{多了|duō le}，{她|tā}{一米六|yì mǐ liù}。{我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{一样|yí yàng}{高|gāo}，{脸|liǎn}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{爸爸|bà ba}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{他们|tā men}{像|xiàng}{兄弟|xiōng dì}。{爸爸|bà ba}{和|hé}{哥哥|gē ge}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期六|xīng qī liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}。{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{最|zuì}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}，{今年|jīn nián}{十二|shí èr}{岁|suì}，{个子|gè zi}{不|bù}{高|gāo}，{没有|méi yǒu}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{那么|nà me}{高|gāo}。{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{跟|gēn}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}，{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{也|yě}{在|zài}{照片|zhào piàn}{里|lǐ}，{它|tā}{的|de}{耳朵|ěr duo}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}，{腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}，{非常|fēi cháng}{可爱|kě ài}。" Which is true of the writer?
choices: The writer is taller than the mother.
The writer has eyes like the mother's.
The writer looks like the father.
The writer is the oldest child.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{跟|gēn}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}: the writer's eyes are like the mother's, big and pretty. The writer is the youngest ({最|zuì}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}) and not as tall as the mother ({没有|méi yǒu}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{那么|nà me}{高|gāo}).

questions.stem: Read the end again: "…{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{也|yě}{在|zài}{照片|zhào piàn}{里|lǐ}，{它|tā}{的|de}{耳朵|ěr duo}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}，{腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}，{非常|fēi cháng}{可爱|kě ài}。" What is the dog like?
questions.explanation: {耳朵|ěr duo}{很|hěn}{长|cháng} (long ears), {腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn} (short legs), {非常|fēi cháng}{可爱|kě ài} (very cute).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: This flat isn't as big as that one.
questions.explanation: {这个|zhè ge}{房子|fáng zi}{没有|méi yǒu}{那个|nà ge}{房子|fáng zi}{那么|nà me}{大|dà}。 A {没有|méi yǒu} B ({那么|nà me}) + adjective; {那么|nà me} can be left out. No {很|hěn}: {没有|méi yǒu} already does the comparing. The second {房子|fáng zi} can be left out too: {这个|zhè ge}{房子|fáng zi}{没有|méi yǒu}{那个|nà ge}{那么|nà me}{大|dà}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "As soon as I got home, I went to sleep."?
questions.explanation: {一|yī} goes before the first verb and {就|jiù} before the second, both after the subject: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}{就|jiù}{睡觉|shuì jiào}{了|le}. Without {就|jiù} the two halves don't link.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Whenever she catches a cold, she gets a temperature."?
