questions.explanation: {一|yī} + the first event ({感冒|gǎn mào}), {就|jiù} + what follows ({发烧|fā shāo}). {她|tā}{一|yì}{发烧|fā shāo}{就|jiù}{感冒|gǎn mào} swaps the order of events: a fever first, then a cold.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {明天|míng tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}，___ {上班|shàng bān}。 (Tomorrow is Saturday: there's no need to go to work.)
questions.explanation: {不用|bú yòng} + verb is "there's no need to". {别|bié} and {不要|bú yào} are "don't" (commands), and {没有|méi yǒu} is for the past.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {孩子|hái zi}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{妈妈|mā ma}{在|zài}{家|jiā} ___ {他|tā}。 (The child is ill; his mother is at home looking after him.)
questions.explanation: {照顾|zhào gù} is to look after: patients, children, old people. {小心|xiǎo xīn} is "watch out", {检查|jiǎn chá} "to examine", and {坚持|jiān chí} "to keep at something".

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He was in hospital for three days."?
questions.explanation: {住院|zhù yuàn} is separable: the length of time goes inside, after {了|le}: {住|zhù}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{院|yuàn}. {他|tā}{在|zài}{医院|yī yuàn}{住|zhù}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān} says the same. ~~{住院|zhù yuàn}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}~~ is a common slip.

questions.stem: A friend says: "{天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{小心|xiǎo xīn}{感冒|gǎn mào}！" What does she mean?
choices: Be careful not to catch a cold.
questions.explanation: {小心|xiǎo xīn} + the danger is a warning: be careful of catching a cold. {小心|xiǎo xīn} is "careful", not "small"; looking after someone is {照顾|zhào gù}.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of {检查|jiǎn chá} (to examine)?
questions.explanation: {检查|jiǎn chá} is jiǎn chá: a dipping jiǎn (with soft j), then a rising chá (with curled ch and a puff of air).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {健康|jiàn kāng}, healthy: a falling fourth tone, then a high, level first tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {照顾|zhào gù}, to look after: two falling fourth tones. Let each one drop all the way.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {小|xiǎo} ___ (careful)
questions.explanation: {={小心|xiǎo xīn}: 心 (heart) is four strokes: a dot, the long curved hook, and two dots. 必 (in {必须|bì xū}, lesson 27) has a left-falling stroke through it; {少|shǎo} is "few"; {忙|máng} has the side form 忄.=}

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {感冒|gǎn mào} a cold, {发烧|fā shāo} to have a fever, {住院|zhù yuàn} to be in hospital ({出院|chū yuàn}: to leave it), {锻炼|duàn liàn} to exercise, {担心|dān xīn} to worry. Medicine is {药|yào} (HSK 2).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters): {不|bú} ___ {担心|dān xīn}。 (There's no need to worry.)
questions.explanation: {={不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn}: {不用|bú yòng} + verb is "no need to". {用|yòng} is five strokes, the middle vertical last, and one of the handwriting characters.=}

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?

audio.text: 我一锻炼就累。

choices: I exercise so as not to feel tired.
Whenever I exercise, I get tired.
questions.explanation: {一|yī} + {锻炼|duàn liàn}, {就|jiù} + {累|lèi}: whenever I exercise, I get tired. {一|yī}…{就|jiù} links an event to what always follows it.

questions.stem: Listen. What did the doctor say?

audio.text: 医生说你不用住院，回家多休息。

choices: You have to stay in hospital.
You don't need to go into hospital; rest at home.
You can go back to work.
questions.explanation: {不用|bú yòng}{住院|zhù yuàn}: no need to go into hospital. {回|huí}{家|jiā}{多|duō}{休息|xiū xi}: go home and rest a lot.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want you to do?

audio.text: 天冷了，你要注意身体。

questions.explanation: {注意|zhù yì}{身体|shēn tǐ} is "pay attention to your health": look after yourself. It's a common caring phrase when the weather turns cold.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker telling you?

audio.text: 别担心，我没事，过两天就好了。

choices: Don't worry: she's fine and will be better in a couple of days.
She'll see a doctor in two days.
questions.explanation: {别|bié}{担心|dān xīn} (don't worry), {我|wǒ}{没事|méi shì} (I'm fine), {过|guò}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{好|hǎo}{了|le} (in a couple of days I'll be better).

questions.stem: Read the message to a teacher: "{李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}，{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{三班|sān bān}{王小明|Wáng Xiǎo míng}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}。{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{发烧|fā shāo}{了|le}，{三十九|sān shí jiǔ}{度|dù}。{今天|jīn tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}{看病|kàn bìng}，{医生|yī shēng}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{检查|jiǎn chá}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}，{说|shuō}{他|tā}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{不用|bú yòng}{住院|zhù yuàn}，{可是|kě shì}{要|yào}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。{吃|chī}{了|le}{药|yào}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{现在|xiàn zài}{好|hǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{了|le}。{所以|suǒ yǐ}{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{今天|jīn tiān}{和|hé}{明天|míng tiān}{不|bù}{能|néng}{去|qù}{学校|xué xiào}{上课|shàng kè}{了|le}，{他|tā}{一|yì}{好|hǎo}{就|jiù}{回|huí}{学校|xué xiào}。{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{很|hěn}{担心|dān xīn}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{考试|kǎo shì}，{请|qǐng}{老师|lǎo shī}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{告诉|gào su}{我们|wǒ men}，{他|tā}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{学习|xué xí}。{谢谢|xiè xie}{您|nín}！{王小明|Wáng Xiǎo míng}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}" ({度|dù}: degrees; {作业|zuò yè}: homework; {以后|yǐ hòu}: after) Why is Xiaoming not going to school?
choices: He has to stay in hospital.
He has a cold with a fever, and the doctor told him to rest at home.
He has an exam at another school.
questions.explanation: {小明|Xiǎo Míng}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{发烧|fā shāo}{了|le}…{医生|yī shēng}…{说|shuō}{他|tā}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{不用|bú yòng}{住院|zhù yuàn}，{可是|kě shì}{要|yào}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}: he has a cold with a fever, and must rest at home for two days, but doesn't need to go into hospital.

questions.stem: Read the message again: "{李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}，{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{三班|sān bān}{王小明|Wáng Xiǎo míng}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}。{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{发烧|fā shāo}{了|le}，{三十九|sān shí jiǔ}{度|dù}。{今天|jīn tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}{看病|kàn bìng}，{医生|yī shēng}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{检查|jiǎn chá}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}，{说|shuō}{他|tā}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{不用|bú yòng}{住院|zhù yuàn}，{可是|kě shì}{要|yào}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。{吃|chī}{了|le}{药|yào}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{现在|xiàn zài}{好|hǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{了|le}。{所以|suǒ yǐ}{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{今天|jīn tiān}{和|hé}{明天|míng tiān}{不|bù}{能|néng}{去|qù}{学校|xué xiào}{上课|shàng kè}{了|le}，{他|tā}{一|yì}{好|hǎo}{就|jiù}{回|huí}{学校|xué xiào}。{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{很|hěn}{担心|dān xīn}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{考试|kǎo shì}，{请|qǐng}{老师|lǎo shī}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{告诉|gào su}{我们|wǒ men}，{他|tā}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{学习|xué xí}。{谢谢|xiè xie}{您|nín}！{王小明|Wáng Xiǎo míng}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}" What is Xiaoming worried about?
questions.explanation: {小明|Xiǎo Míng}{很|hěn}{担心|dān xīn}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{考试|kǎo shì}: he's worried about next week's exam. That's why his mother asks for the homework.

questions.stem: Read the end of the message again: "…{他|tā}{一|yì}{好|hǎo}{就|jiù}{回|huí}{学校|xué xiào}。{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{很|hěn}{担心|dān xīn}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{考试|kǎo shì}，{请|qǐng}{老师|lǎo shī}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{告诉|gào su}{我们|wǒ men}，{他|tā}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{学习|xué xí}。…" ({作业|zuò yè}: homework) What does the mother ask the teacher to do?
choices: tell them the homework for these two days
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{老师|lǎo shī}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{告诉|gào su}{我们|wǒ men}: please tell us the homework for these two days, so he can study at home. And {他|tā}{一|yì}{好|hǎo}{就|jiù}{回|huí}{学校|xué xiào}: he'll be back as soon as he's better.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: As soon as I got home, I went to sleep.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}{就|jiù}{睡觉|shuì jiào}{了|le}。 {一|yī} before the first verb ({到|dào}{家|jiā}), {就|jiù} before the second ({睡觉|shuì jiào}), and {了|le} for the completed event. {才|cái} (only then) is lesson 25's.

questions.stem: In a traditional Beijing courtyard house, where is the main house ({正房|zhèng fáng})?
choices: on the south side, facing north
on the north side, facing south
on the east side, facing west
in the middle of the courtyard
questions.explanation: The {正房|zhèng fáng} stands on the north side and faces south, towards the sun, and traditionally housed the oldest generation. The south row ({倒座房|dào zuò fáng}) faces north and gets the least sun.

questions.stem: What are {厢房|xiāng fáng}?
choices: the side houses on the east and west of the courtyard
questions.explanation: {厢房|xiāng fáng} are the side houses on the east and west, traditionally for the younger generations. The lanes are {胡同|hú tòng}, and modern blocks of flats are {楼房|lóu fáng}.

questions.stem: What is a {胡同|hú tòng}?
choices: a courtyard shared by many families
a narrow lane between rows of courtyard houses in Beijing
questions.explanation: {胡同|hú tòng} are Beijing's lanes, formed by rows of courtyard houses; the word also means the neighbourhood along them. Many were laid out in the Yuan dynasty. A shared courtyard is a {大杂院|dà zá yuàn}, a one-storey house a {平房|píng fáng}, and a guard a {保安|bǎo ān}.

questions.stem: What does {大杂院|dà zá yuàn} describe?
choices: a courtyard house shared by several families, with extra rooms built in the yard
questions.explanation: In the 20th century many courtyards built for one family came to be shared by several, who added kitchens and rooms in the yard: a {大杂院|dà zá yuàn}, a "big mixed courtyard".

questions.stem: An address reads "{阳光小区|Yáng guāng xiǎo qū} 3{号楼|hào lóu} 2{单元|dān yuán} 1201". Which floor is the flat on?
questions.explanation: Addresses go big to small: compound, building (3{号楼|hào lóu}), entrance (2{单元|dān yuán}), flat. In the flat number the first digits are usually the floor: 1201 is flat 01 on the twelfth floor ({十二|shí èr}{层|céng}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the three syllables?
questions.explanation: {四合院|sì hé yuàn}, courtyard house: a falling fourth tone, a rising second tone, then a falling fourth tone.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {四合院|sì hé yuàn} courtyard house, {胡同|hú tòng} lane (in Beijing), {院子|yuàn zi} courtyard, {楼房|lóu fáng} a building of several storeys (flats), {平房|píng fáng} a one-storey house. A lift is {电梯|diàn tī}.

questions.stem: Listen. Where did the speaker live as a child?

audio.text: 我小时候住在胡同里的一个四合院。

choices: in a courtyard house in a hutong
questions.explanation: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} (as a child) {住|zhù}{在|zài}{胡同|hú tòng}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{四合院|sì hé yuàn}: in a courtyard house in a hutong.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about her new flat?

audio.text: 楼房比四合院方便多了，可是没有四合院那么热闹。

choices: It's much more convenient, but not as lively.
It's the same as a courtyard house.
It's noisier than a courtyard house.
questions.explanation: {比|bǐ}{四合院|sì hé yuàn}{方便|fāng biàn}{多了|duō le}: much more convenient than a courtyard house; {没有|méi yǒu}{四合院|sì hé yuàn}{那么|nà me}{热闹|rè nao}: not as lively as one. ({热闹|rè nao}: lively)

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{四合院|sì hé yuàn}{里|lǐ}。{那个|nà ge}{院子|yuàn zi}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{可是|kě shì}{住|zhù}{着|zhe}{五|wǔ}{家人|jiā rén}。{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{卫生间|wèi shēng jiān}，{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{洗澡|xǐ zǎo}{也|yě}{不|bù}{方便|fāng biàn}。{可是|kě shì}{邻居们|lín jū men}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{热情|rè qíng}，{谁|shéi}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{事|shì}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{帮忙|bāng máng}。" ({住|zhù}{着|zhe}: lived there; {冬天|dōng tiān}: winter; {热情|rè qíng}: warm, friendly) What was good about life in the courtyard?
choices: The neighbours were friendly and helped each other.
questions.explanation: {邻居们|lín jū men}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{热情|rè qíng}，{谁|shéi}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{事|shì}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{帮忙|bāng máng}: the neighbours were warm, and when anyone had a problem everyone came to help. The courtyard was small, cold in winter, and had no bathroom.

questions.stem: Read: "{后来|hòu lái}，{奶奶|nǎi nai}{搬|bān}{进|jìn}{了|le}{楼房|lóu fáng}，{现在|xiàn zài}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{十二|shí èr}{层|céng}。{她|tā}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{电梯|diàn tī}，{有|yǒu}{空调|kōng tiáo}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{洗衣机|xǐ yī jī}。{可是|kě shì}{她|tā}{说|shuō}：‘{楼房|lóu fáng}{没有|méi yǒu}{四合院|sì hé yuàn}{那么|nà me}{热闹|rè nao}。{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián}，{楼里|lóu lǐ}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{邻居|lín jū}{我|wǒ}{不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}。’" ({后来|hòu lái}: later; {热闹|rè nao}: lively) What does Grandma miss?
choices: the lively life of the courtyard and knowing her neighbours
questions.explanation: {楼房|lóu fáng}{没有|méi yǒu}{四合院|sì hé yuàn}{那么|nà me}{热闹|rè nao}: a block of flats isn't as lively as a courtyard, and after ten years she still doesn't know many neighbours in her building. The lift and the washing machine are what she likes about the flat.

questions.stem: Which statement about Beijing's courtyard houses is true?
choices: They were all built in the 20th century.
Most of those still standing were built in the Ming and Qing dynasties.
Their windows usually face the street.
questions.explanation: The basic form is very old, but most surviving Beijing courtyard houses date from the Ming (1368–1644) and Qing (1644–1912). They're single-storey, and their windows open onto the courtyard, not the street.

questions.stem: Which are China's {四大发明|sì dà fā míng}, "four great inventions"?
choices: paper, printing, the compass and gunpowder
printing, the clock, the compass and silk
gunpowder, the wheel, paper and the abacus
questions.explanation: {造纸术|zào zhǐ shù} (papermaking), {印刷术|yìn shuā shù} (printing), {指南针|zhǐ nán zhēn} (the compass) and {火药|huǒ yào} (gunpowder). Silk and porcelain are just as famous, but they aren't part of the set phrase.

questions.stem: What does {指南针|zhǐ nán zhēn} literally mean?
questions.explanation: {指|zhǐ} (to point) + {南|nán} (south) + {针|zhēn} (needle). The Chinese compass is thought of as pointing south. {火药|huǒ yào} is "fire medicine", {造纸术|zào zhǐ shù} "the art of making paper", and {活字|huó zì} "living characters" (movable type).

questions.stem: What is {蔡伦|Cài Lún} remembered for?
choices: writing the first description of the compass
questions.explanation: About 105 CE {蔡伦|Cài Lún}, an official of the Eastern Han court, presented a way of making paper from bark, hemp, rags and fishing nets. Older paper has been found, so he improved and standardised the method rather than inventing paper.

questions.stem: What did {毕昇|Bì Shēng} make in the 1040s?
choices: movable type of fired clay, one piece per character
questions.explanation: {毕昇|Bì Shēng} made movable type from fired clay, one piece for each character, which could be reused. We know of it from {沈括|Shěn Kuò}'s book 《{梦溪笔谈|Mèng xī Bǐ tán}》. The Diamond Sutra (868) was printed from woodblocks.

questions.stem: Why did woodblock printing stay more common in China than movable type?
choices: Written Chinese needs thousands of different characters, so thousands of pieces of type.
questions.explanation: With thousands of characters, a printer needed thousands of pieces of type; carving a whole page on a block was often simpler. Movable type was used, but it didn't replace woodblocks.

questions.stem: Who discovered gunpowder, according to historians?
choices: Daoist alchemists of the Tang dynasty, looking for a medicine for long life
questions.explanation: Gunpowder was found by Daoist alchemists of the Tang, probably in the 9th century, while mixing substances for a medicine for long life: hence {火药|huǒ yào}, "fire medicine". An early recipe was written down in 1044.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {火药|huǒ yào}, gunpowder: a dipping third tone, then a falling fourth tone.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {造纸术|zào zhǐ shù} papermaking, {印刷术|yìn shuā shù} printing, {指南针|zhǐ nán zhēn} compass, {火药|huǒ yào} gunpowder, {发明|fā míng} invention (to invent). Silk is {丝绸|sī chóu}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which invention is the speaker talking about?

audio.text: 有了它，在海上也不会走错方向。

questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{了|le}{它|tā}，{在|zài}{海上|hǎi shàng}{也|yě}{不|bú}{会|huì}{走|zǒu}{错|cuò}{方向|fāng xiàng}: with it you don't go the wrong way even at sea: the compass ({指南针|zhǐ nán zhēn}).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?

audio.text: 火药是做药的人发现的。

choices: Gunpowder was discovered by people who made medicines.
Gunpowder is a kind of medicine.
Gunpowder was found in a hospital.
questions.explanation: {火药|huǒ yào}{是|shì}{做|zuò}{药|yào}{的|de}{人|rén}{发现|fā xiàn}{的|de}: gunpowder was discovered by people who made medicines. {是|shì}…{的|de} picks out who did it (HSK 2); {发现|fā xiàn} (to discover) is lesson 28's word.

questions.stem: Read: "{很早以前|hěn zǎo yǐ qián}，{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{做纸|zuò zhǐ}{了|le}。{一千九百多年|yì qiān jiǔ bǎi duō nián}{以前|yǐ qián}，{蔡伦|Cài Lún}{把|bǎ}{做纸|zuò zhǐ}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}{变|biàn}{得|de}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}，{用|yòng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{能|néng}{用|yòng}{纸|zhǐ}{写字|xiě zì}{了|le}。" ({以前|yǐ qián}: before; {方法|fāng fǎ}: method; {变|biàn}{得|de}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}: became better) Why could many people write on paper after Cai Lun?
choices: His method was better and used cheap materials.
questions.explanation: {蔡伦|Cài Lún}{把|bǎ}{做纸|zuò zhǐ}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}{变|biàn}{得|de}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}，{用|yòng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}: he made the method better and the materials were cheap, {所以|suǒ yǐ} (so) many people could write on paper.

questions.stem: Read: "{宋朝|Sòng cháo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{毕昇|Bì Shēng}{用|yòng}{泥|ní}{做|zuò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{活字|huó zì}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{字|zì}{一|yí}{个|gè}，{印|yìn}{书|shū}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{放在一起|fàng zài yì qǐ}，{用|yòng}{完|wán}{了|le}{还|hái}{可以|kě yǐ}{再|zài}{用|yòng}。" ({宋朝|Sòng cháo}: the Song dynasty; {泥|ní}: clay; {活字|huó zì}: movable type) What could be done with the pieces after printing?
choices: They were given to the emperor.
questions.explanation: {用|yòng}{完|wán}{了|le}{还|hái}{可以|kě yǐ}{再|zài}{用|yòng}: when you'd finished with them, they could be used again. That was the advantage of movable type over a carved woodblock.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I can't finish it."?
questions.explanation: A result that can't be reached is a potential complement: {不|bù} goes between the verb and the result, {吃不完|chī bu wán}. {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{吃完|chī wán} says you didn't finish (a fact, not an ability), {不|bù}{吃完|chī wán} isn't said, and in the negative {不|bù} replaces {得|de}, so {吃|chī}{得|de}{不|bù}{完|wán} is wrong.

questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{吃得完|chī de wán}。" mean?
questions.explanation: {得|de} followed straight away by a result ({完|wán}) is a potential complement: he can finish it. "He eats a lot" is a degree complement with a description after {得|de}: {他|tā}{吃|chī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}. "He has finished" is {他|tā}{吃完|chī wán}{了|le}, and "he eats quickly" {他|tā}{吃|chī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He doesn't eat much."?
questions.explanation: "How much he eats" is a degree complement, and its negative puts {不|bù} after {得|de}: {他|tā}{吃|chī}{得|de}{不|bù}{多|duō}. {他|tā}{吃不完|chī bu wán} is a potential complement ("he can't finish it"), and a {不|bù} or {没|méi} before the verb doesn't go with a degree complement.

questions.stem: Choose the words: {冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ} ___ {这么|zhè me}{大|dà}{的|de}{西瓜|xī guā}。 (A watermelon this big won't fit in the fridge.)
questions.explanation: "Won't fit" is the potential complement {放不下|fàng bu xià}: {下|xià} says there's room, and {不|bù} in the middle says there isn't. {没|méi}{放|fàng}{下|xià} would be "didn't put it down"; {不|bú}{放|fàng}{下|xià} and {放|fàng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{下|xià} aren't said.

questions.stem: How do you ask "Can you understand or not?" with the two forms side by side?
choices: {你|nǐ}{听得懂|tīng de dǒng}{听不懂|tīng bu dǒng}？
questions.explanation: Like an A-not-A question, the positive and negative potential forms go side by side: {你|nǐ}{听得懂|tīng de dǒng}{听不懂|tīng bu dǒng}？ The answer is {听得懂|tīng de dǒng} or {听不懂|tīng bu dǒng}. {你|nǐ}{听得懂|tīng de dǒng}{吗|ma}？ asks the same.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。
{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{我|wǒ}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。
questions.explanation: The object of a potential complement goes after the whole verb ({我|wǒ}{吃不完|chī bu wán}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}) or, more often, at the front as the topic: {蛋糕|dàn gāo}{我|wǒ}{吃不完|chī bu wán}. A {把|bǎ} sentence reports what was done, so it can't take a potential complement, and the object can't split {吃不完|chī bu wán}.

questions.stem: Choose the words: {冰激凌|bīng jī líng}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{我|wǒ} ___ 。 (There's too much ice cream: I can't finish it.)
questions.explanation: The amount is the problem, so the result "finished" can't be reached: {吃不完|chī bu wán}. {不能|bù néng}{吃|chī} means you mustn't or can't eat it at all ({医生|yī shēng}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{不能|bù néng}{吃|chī}{冰激凌|bīng jī líng}), {不|bù}{吃|chī} that you won't, and {没|méi}{吃|chī} that you didn't.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {饿|è}, hungry: the fourth tone, falling. {我|wǒ}{饿|è}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {蛋糕|dàn gāo}, cake: fourth tone + first tone. {蛋|dàn} falls as in {鸡蛋|jī dàn}, and {糕|gāo} is high and level.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {外卖|wài mài}, takeaway: two falling tones, 4 + 4. {卖|mài} (sell) falls; {买|mǎi} (buy) dips.

questions.stem: Which character means "thirsty" (kě)?
questions.explanation: {渴|kě} has the water radical 氵 on the left: you're thirsty for water. {喝|hē} (drink) has the same right-hand part with a mouth 口; {可|kě} (in {可以|kě yǐ}) sounds the same, and {课|kè} is a class.

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {甜|tián} sweet (tongue 舌 + sweet 甘), {饿|è} hungry and {饱|bǎo} full (both with food 饣), {渴|kě} thirsty (water 氵), {鲜|xiān} fresh (in {新鲜|xīn xiān}). "Cold" is {冷|lěng}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker saying?

audio.text: 我吃饱了，谢谢！

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{吃饱|chī bǎo}{了|le}，{谢谢|xiè xie}！ "I'm full, thank you!": {饱|bǎo} after {吃|chī} is the result, full. It's also the polite way to refuse more food. Hungry would be {饿|è}, thirsty {渴|kě}.

questions.stem: Listen. Why doesn't the speaker want this watermelon?

audio.text: 这个西瓜太大了，我一个人吃不完。

choices: It's too big for one person to finish.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃不完|chī bu wán}: it's too big, and one person can't finish it. Nothing is said about the taste, the price or freshness.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 你还吃得下吗？

choices: {吃不下|chī bu xià}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{吃饱|chī bǎo}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{还|hái}{吃得下|chī de xià}{吗|ma}？ is "Can you still eat any more?" The answer repeats the potential form: {吃不下|chī bu xià}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{吃饱|chī bǎo}{了|le} (I can't, I'm full). {我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài} says how fast you eat, a degree complement.

questions.stem: Listen. How much will the speaker pay for the bananas?

audio.text: 香蕉三块钱一斤，我要两斤。

questions.explanation: {三|sān}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}{一|yì}{斤|jīn} (three kuai a jin) and {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{两|liǎng}{斤|jīn} (I'd like two jin): 2 × 3 = 6 kuai, {六|liù}{块|kuài}.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{赵军|Zhào Jūn}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}。{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{旁边|páng biān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{店|diàn}，{那里|nà lǐ}{的|de}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{很|hěn}{新鲜|xīn xiān}，{也|yě}{不|bú}{贵|guì}。{昨天|zuó tiān}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{三|sān}{斤|jīn}{苹果|píng guǒ}{和|hé}{一|yí}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}。{西瓜|xī guā}{有|yǒu}{十二|shí èr}{斤|jīn}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{拿不动|ná bu dòng}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{店|diàn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{叔叔|shū shu}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{送|sòng}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{妻子|qī zi}{吃|chī}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{半|bàn}{个|gè}，{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}{放不下|fàng bu xià}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{给|gěi}{了|le}{邻居|lín jū}。{邻居|lín jū}{说|shuō}：‘{这|zhè}{个|gè}{西瓜|xī guā}{真|zhēn}{甜|tián}！’" Why did they give half the watermelon to the neighbours?
choices: It wouldn't fit in the fridge.
questions.explanation: {还|hái}{有|yǒu}{半|bàn}{个|gè}，{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}{放不下|fàng bu xià}: half was left, and it wouldn't fit in the fridge, so they gave it to the neighbours, who found it very sweet. {拿不动|ná bu dòng} is "can't carry it" ({动|dòng}: move): the watermelon was too heavy, so the man from the shop took it home for him.

questions.stem: A note for the delivery rider in a takeaway app: "{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{外卖|wài mài}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}，{不用|bú yòng}{打|dǎ}{电话|diàn huà}，{孩子|hái zi}{在|zài}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。" What should the rider do?
choices: Phone on arrival and wait at the door.
Leave the food at the door without phoning.
Bring the food inside to the child.
Take the food back to the restaurant.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{外卖|wài mài}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}: please put the takeaway at the door (a {把|bǎ} sentence from lesson 03); {不用|bú yòng}{打|dǎ}{电话|diàn huà}: no need to phone (lesson 05), because the child is asleep.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The two of us can't finish this many dishes.
questions.explanation: {这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{菜|cài}{我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。 The object goes first as the topic (before or after {我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}), or after the verb: {我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃不完|chī bu wán}{这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{菜|cài}. {把|bǎ} can't be used with a potential complement.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {我|wǒ}{吃|chī} ___ {了|le}，{谢谢|xiè xie}！ (I'm full, thank you!)
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{吃饱|chī bǎo}{了|le}。 {={饱|bǎo} is food 饣 + {包|bāo}: three strokes of 饣, then {包|bāo}=} (traditional {+饱+}: 飠 + 包). Don't confuse it with {包|bāo} alone or with {饭|fàn}.

questions.stem: What does "{这些|zhè xiē}{菜|cài}{个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}。" mean?
choices: Every one of these dishes is delicious.
A few of these dishes are delicious.
These dishes are delicious one at a time.
These dishes are delicious every day.
questions.explanation: A doubled measure word means "every single one": {个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}, every one is delicious. "A few" would be {有的|yǒu de} or {有些|yǒu xiē}; "one at a time" is {一|yí}{个|gè}{一|yí}{个|gè}{地|de}; "every day" is {天天|tiān tiān}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I like every one of them."?
questions.explanation: A doubled measure word can't be the object. It goes first, as the topic, with {都|dōu} before the verb: {个个|gè gè}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}. {我|wǒ}{个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan} (subject first) and {每|měi}{个|gè}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan} say the same. The last choice would mean "every one likes me".

questions.stem: How do you say "It's my treat today!"?
questions.explanation: {请客|qǐng kè} (to treat, to pay for everyone) already has its object {客|kè}, so it takes no other: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{请客|qǐng kè}！ To name the person, use {请|qǐng}: {我|wǒ}{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{吃饭|chī fàn}. {做客|zuò kè} is being a guest yourself.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {星期天|xīng qī tiān}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{朋友|péng you}{家|jiā} ___ 。 (On Sunday I'm going to a friend's home as a guest.)
questions.explanation: {去|qù}…{家|jiā}{做客|zuò kè} is to visit someone's home as a guest. {请客|qǐng kè} is treating others, {客人|kè rén} is the guest (a noun), and {客气|kè qi} is being polite ({不客气|bú kè qi}).

questions.stem: What does "{差不多|chà bu duō}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}。" mean?
choices: It's exactly ten o'clock: let's go.
It's well after ten: let's go.
There are ten minutes left: let's go.
questions.explanation: {差不多|chà bu duō} before a time or number is "almost, about": {差不多|chà bu duō}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}, it's nearly ten. Exactly ten would be {十|shí}{点|diǎn}{整|zhěng} ({整|zhěng}: exactly) or just {十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}; ten minutes is {十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "The dishes came out one by one."?
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{个|gè}{一|yí}{个|gè}{地|de} + verb says how something happens, one after another; it goes before the verb, like other {地|de} phrases. {个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{上来|shàng lái}{了|le} is "every one has come out", and {一|yí}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{上来|shàng lái}{了|le} "one dish has come".

questions.stem: A friend asks about your cold. What does "{我|wǒ}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。" mean?
questions.explanation: Adjective + {多|duō}{了|le} is "much more…" (lesson 04): {好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}, much better. It's not the {好多|hǎo duō} of this lesson, which goes before a noun: {好多|hǎo duō}{人|rén} (lots of people).

questions.stem: How does a waiter ask "Do you want sugar in it?"
questions.explanation: {加|jiā} + what you add: {加|jiā}{糖|táng}, and {要|yào} (want) before it: {要|yào}{加|jiā}{糖|táng}{吗|ma}？ {吗|ma} always ends the question, and the object follows {加|jiā}, not the other way round.

questions.stem: You buy {两|liǎng}{公斤|gōng jīn} of apples. How many {斤|jīn} is that?
questions.explanation: One {公斤|gōng jīn} (kilogram) is two {斤|jīn} (a {斤|jīn} is 500 g), so {两|liǎng}{公斤|gōng jīn} = {四|sì}{斤|jīn}.

questions.stem: Which measure word goes with a spoon? {一|yì} ___ {勺子|sháo zi}
questions.explanation: Things you hold by a handle take {把|bǎ}: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{勺子|sháo zi}, {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{椅子|yǐ zi} (lesson 03). {张|zhāng} is for flat things, {条|tiáo} for long ones (a fish, a road), {本|běn} for books. Chopsticks come in pairs: {一|yì}{双|shuāng}{筷子|kuài zi}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {啤酒|pí jiǔ}, beer: second tone + third tone, rising then dipping. {酒|jiǔ} sounds like {九|jiǔ}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {饮料|yǐn liào}, a drink: third tone + fourth tone. Before a fourth tone the third tone stays low ("half third").

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker ask the waiter for?

audio.text: 服务员，菜单给我们看一下，再加两杯茶。

choices: the menu and two more teas
questions.explanation: {菜单|cài dān}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}: "let us see the menu", and {再|zài}{加|jiā}{两|liǎng}{杯|bēi}{茶|chá}: "and two more cups of tea". The bill would be {买单|mǎi dān}, and nobody asks for {筷子|kuài zi} or {啤酒|pí jiǔ}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___子 (chopsticks, kuàizi)
questions.explanation: {筷子|kuài zi}: {筷|kuài} is bamboo ⺮ on top of {快|kuài} (fast), which gives the sound. {快|kuài} alone is "fast", {块|kuài} is the kuai of money, and {等|děng} (to wait) has the bamboo top too.

questions.stem: Listen. Who is going to pay?

audio.text: 今天我请客，你们想吃什么？

questions.explanation: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{请客|qǐng kè} is "today it's my treat": the speaker pays. Then {你们|nǐ men}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{什么|shén me}？ asks the guests what they'd like.

questions.stem: Listen. What will the speaker drink?

audio.text: 我开车，不能喝酒，给我一瓶矿泉水吧。

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{开车|kāi chē}，{不能|bù néng}{喝|hē}{酒|jiǔ}: the speaker is driving and can't drink alcohol, so {给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{瓶|píng}{矿泉水|kuàng quán shuǐ}{吧|ba}, a bottle of mineral water.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 这家饭馆的菜个个都很好吃，就是人太多了。

choices: Only one dish is good, but the place is quiet.
Every dish is good, but it's too crowded.
The dishes are expensive, but there's lots of room.
There are lots of dishes, but none is good.
questions.explanation: {菜|cài}{个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}: every dish is delicious; {就是|jiù shì}{人|rén}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}: it's just that there are too many people. ({就是|jiù shì} here means "only, it's just that".)

questions.stem: Read the message: "{明天|míng tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{请客|qǐng kè}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{学校|xué xiào}{旁边|páng biān}{的|de}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{吃|chī}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。{那里|nà lǐ}{的|de}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃|chī}{十|shí}{个|gè}{就|jiù}{饱|bǎo}{了|le}。{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{开车|kāi chē}，{我们|wǒ men}{喝|hē}{点儿|diǎnr}{啤酒|pí jiǔ}。" Why does the writer say not to drive?
choices: They're going to have some beer.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{开车|kāi chē}，{我们|wǒ men}{喝|hē}{点儿|diǎnr}{啤酒|pí jiǔ}: don't drive, we'll have a bit of beer. The dumplings are big ({个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{大|dà}: ten fill you up), and the writer is paying ({我|wǒ}{请客|qǐng kè}), but that's not why.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Every one of these dishes is delicious.
questions.explanation: {这些|zhè xiē}{菜|cài}{个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}。 The topic first, then the doubled measure word with {都|dōu} before the predicate. {每|měi} would need a measure word after it ({每|měi}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {我们|wǒ men}{再|zài} ___ {一|yí}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{吧|ba}。 (Let's order one more dish.)
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{再|zài}{加|jiā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{吧|ba}。 {加|jiā} (to add) is {力|lì} (strength) first, then {口|kǒu}: five strokes.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yì} ___ {裙子|qún zi}。
questions.explanation: Skirts, shorts and trousers hang from the waist and take {条|tiáo}, the measure for long things: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{裙子|qún zi}. Tops and coats take {件|jiàn} ({一|yí}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}), pairs take {双|shuāng}, and flat things {张|zhāng}.

questions.stem: How do you say "two pairs of shoes"?
questions.explanation: Things that come in pairs take {双|shuāng}, and "two" before a measure word is {两|liǎng}: {两|liǎng}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}. {一|yì}{双|shuāng}{筷子|kuài zi} works the same way.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This coat is both cheap and good-looking."?
choices: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī}{又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī}{又|yòu}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
{又|yòu}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
questions.explanation: {又|yòu} goes right before each adjective, after the subject: {又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}. The pattern doesn't take {很|hěn}, and the first {又|yòu} can't go before the subject.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}，___ {不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}。 (These shoes are cheap, but they're uncomfortable.)
questions.explanation: Cheap is good and uncomfortable is bad, so the two are contrasted with {但是|dàn shì} (but). {又|yòu}…{又|yòu}… joins two qualities that go the same way: {又|yòu}{贵|guì}{又|yòu}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu} (expensive and uncomfortable).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {你|nǐ}{要|yào}{蓝色|lán sè}{的|de} ___ {黑色|hēi sè}{的|de}？ (Do you want the blue one or the black one?)
questions.explanation: A question asking someone to choose takes {还是|hái shi}: {你|nǐ}{要|yào}{蓝色|lán sè}{的|de}{还是|hái shi}{黑色|hēi sè}{的|de}？ {或者|huò zhě} is "or" in statements ({蓝色|lán sè}{或者|huò zhě}{黑色|hēi sè}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}), and {和|hé} is "and".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {星期六|xīng qī liù} ___ {星期天|xīng qī tiān}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{鞋|xié}。 (We'll go shoe shopping on Saturday or Sunday.)
questions.explanation: This is a statement, not a question, so "or" is {或者|huò zhě}: one day or the other. {还是|hái shi} would turn it into a question ("Saturday or Sunday?").

questions.stem: How do you ask "Is this shirt the right size?"
choices: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{是|shì}{合适|hé shì}{大小|dà xiǎo}{吗|ma}？
{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{衬衫|chèn shān}{大小|dà xiǎo}{合适|hé shì}{吗|ma}？
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{合适|hé shì}{大小|dà xiǎo}{吗|ma}？
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{大小|dà xiǎo}{合适|hé shì}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: {大小|dà xiǎo} (size) is the topic and {合适|hé shì} the adjective predicate: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{大小|dà xiǎo}{合适|hé shì}{吗|ma}？ A shirt takes {件|jiàn}, not {条|tiáo}, and an adjective predicate needs no {是|shì}.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {这|zhè} ___ {大衣|dà yī}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{种|zhǒng}{颜色|yán sè}。 (This kind of coat comes in three colours.)
questions.explanation: It's the style of coat that comes in three colours, not one coat, so the measure is {种|zhǒng} (kind): {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{大衣|dà yī}. {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī} is one particular coat, which has one colour.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm very pleased with these shoes."?
questions.explanation: {对|duì} + the thing comes before {满意|mǎn yì}: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这|zhè}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}{很|hěn}{满意|mǎn yì}. English order puts "with these shoes" at the end, but in Chinese the {对|duì} phrase goes before the predicate. The shoes aren't the ones who are pleased.

questions.stem: What time is "{差|chà}{五|wǔ}{分|fēn}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}"?
questions.explanation: {差|chà} is "short of": eight o'clock short of five minutes, five to eight, 7:55. 8:05 is {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{五|wǔ}{分|fēn}; 8:50 can be {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{五十|wǔ shí} or {差|chà}{十|shí}{分|fēn}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {衬衫|chèn shān}, shirt: fourth tone + first tone, a fall and then high and level.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {黄色|huáng sè}, yellow: second tone + fourth tone, rising then falling. {红色|hóng sè} (red) has the same pattern.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker decide?

audio.text: 这两件衬衫都很合适，我选黄色的吧。

choices: to try on a blue shirt
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}{衬衫|chèn shān}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{合适|hé shì}: both shirts fit well, but {我|wǒ}{选|xuǎn}{黄色|huáng sè}{的|de}{吧|ba}, "I'll choose the yellow one": {吧|ba} marks the decision.

questions.stem: Which character means "shoe" (xié)?
questions.explanation: {鞋|xié} has 革 (leather) on the left: shoes were made of leather. {写|xiě} (write), {谢|xiè} (thank) and {些|xiē} (some) are the same syllable with other tones.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the customer want?

audio.text: 这件有点儿大，能换一件小一点儿的吗？

questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{大|dà}: this one's a bit big; {能|néng}{换|huàn}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{的|de}{吗|ma}？ could I change it for a smaller one?

questions.stem: Listen to the friend. What do they say?

audio.text: 黄色或者蓝色都可以，你先试试。

choices: Either colour is fine: try one on.
questions.explanation: {黄色|huáng sè}{或者|huò zhě}{蓝色|lán sè}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}: yellow or blue, either is fine ({或者|huò zhě} in a statement); {你|nǐ}{先|xiān}{试试|shì shi}: try it on first.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker telling you?

audio.text: 这双鞋我穿着不舒服，太小了。

choices: The shoes are the wrong colour.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}{我|wǒ}{穿|chuān}{着|zhe}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}，{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}: these shoes aren't comfortable to wear, they're too small. ({穿|chuān}{着|zhe} is "wearing them", with durative {着|zhe}.)

questions.stem: A notice in a shop ({本|běn}{店|diàn}: this shop): "{本|běn}{店|diàn}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{七|qī}{天|tiān}{里|lǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{换|huàn}，{但是|dàn shì}{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{洗|xǐ}。{鞋|xié}{不|bù}{能|néng}{换|huàn}。{换|huàn}{衣服|yī fu}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{服务员|fú wù yuán}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{的|de}{订单|dìng dān}。" ({订单|dìng dān}: order) Which is true?
choices: You can change shoes within seven days.
You should wash clothes before changing them.
You can change clothes at any time.
You need to show your order on your phone.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{服务员|fú wù yuán}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{的|de}{订单|dìng dān}: show the assistant the order on your phone. Clothes can be changed within seven days ({七|qī}{天|tiān}{里|lǐ}) if they haven't been washed ({请|qǐng}{别|bié}{洗|xǐ}), and shoes can't be changed at all ({鞋|xié}{不|bù}{能|néng}{换|huàn}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: This coat is both cheap and good-looking.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{大衣|dà yī}{又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}。 Each {又|yòu} goes right before its adjective, with no {很|hěn}; the two adjectives can come in either order. A coat takes {件|jiàn}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng} ___ {一|yí}{件|jiàn}{大|dà}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{的|de}。 (This one's too small; I'd like to change it for a bigger one.)
questions.explanation: {={换|huàn} (to change, exchange) is hand 扌 + 奂: three strokes of 扌, then the right side. Ten strokes in all=} (traditional {+换+}: 扌 + 奐, twelve).

questions.stem: How do people usually say ¥12.50 out loud?
questions.explanation: In speech the units are {块|kuài} and {毛|máo}, and the last unit is usually dropped: {十二|shí èr}{块|kuài}{五|wǔ}({毛|máo}). {元|yuán} goes with {角|jiǎo} in writing ({十二|shí èr}{元|yuán}{五|wǔ}{角|jiǎo}), so {元|yuán}…{毛|máo} mixes the two; {点|diǎn} is for decimals, not prices.

questions.stem: How do you say ¥0.20 in everyday speech?
questions.explanation: 0.2 yuan is two {毛|máo}, and before a measure word "two" is {两|liǎng}: {两|liǎng}{毛|máo}({钱|qián}). {二十|èr shí}{块|kuài} would be ¥20.

questions.stem: A price tag says "{五|wǔ}{元|yuán}{八|bā}{角|jiǎo}". How much is it?
questions.explanation: {元|yuán} is the yuan and {角|jiǎo} a tenth of it, the written words for {块|kuài} and {毛|máo}: {五|wǔ}{元|yuán}{八|bā}{角|jiǎo} = ¥5.80, said {五|wǔ}{块|kuài}{八|bā}.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{办|bàn}{一|yì} ___ {银行卡|yín háng kǎ}。
questions.explanation: Flat things such as cards, tickets, tables and beds take {张|zhāng}: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{银行卡|yín háng kǎ}. {本|běn} is for books and {件|jiàn} for clothes and matters.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I pay with my phone."?
questions.explanation: {用|yòng} + tool comes before the main verb, like {坐|zuò}{车|chē} before {去|qù}: {我|wǒ}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{付|fù}{钱|qián}. English puts "with my phone" at the end; Chinese doesn't. ({付|fù}{钱|qián}: to pay.)

questions.stem: How do you ask "Did you get my text?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{收到|shōu dào}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{短信|duǎn xìn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: The result, "has it reached you?", is {收到|shōu dào} with {了|le}: {你|nǐ}{收到|shōu dào}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{短信|duǎn xìn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ {收|shōu} alone is the action of accepting ({这里|zhè lǐ}{不|bù}{收|shōu}{现金|xiàn jīn}), and {带|dài} is to bring.

questions.stem: Your friend says "{没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ}，{银行|yín háng}{今天|jīn tiān}{不|bù}{开门|kāi mén}。" What does your friend mean?
choices: She doesn't know the way to the bank.
It can't be helped: the bank is closed today.
The bank has no cards today.
questions.explanation: {没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ} is "there's no way round it, it can't be helped", and {银行|yín háng}{今天|jīn tiān}{不|bù}{开门|kāi mén} is "the bank isn't open today". {办法|bàn fǎ} is a way of dealing with something, not a way to a place.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {你|nǐ} ___ {护照|hù zhào}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ (Have you brought your passport?)
questions.explanation: {带|dài} is "to bring, to have with you": {你|nǐ}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ {收|shōu} is to receive, {查|chá} to check and {办|bàn} to get something done ({办|bàn}{护照|hù zhào} would be "apply for a passport").

questions.stem: What is "{三分之一|sān fēn zhī yī}"?
questions.explanation: Fractions are said bottom first: "of three parts, one", {三分之一|sān fēn zhī yī} = 1/3. 3/4 is {四分之三|sì fēn zhī sān}, and 30% is {百分之三十|bǎi fēn zhī sān shí}.

questions.stem: How do you say 50%?
choices: {百分之五十|bǎi fēn zhī wǔ shí}
questions.explanation: A percentage is a fraction of a hundred, so the hundred comes first: {百分之五十|bǎi fēn zhī wǔ shí}, "of a hundred parts, fifty".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {银行|yín háng}, bank: two rising tones, 2 + 2. In this word {行|háng} is read háng, not xíng.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {号码|hào mǎ}, number: fourth tone + third tone. {码|mǎ} dips like {马|mǎ}, which gives it its sound.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want to do?

audio.text: 你好，我想办一张银行卡，要带护照吗？

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{办|bàn}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{银行卡|yín háng kǎ}: "I'd like to get a bank card" ({办|bàn}: to arrange, apply for; {张|zhāng} for cards). The passport is only something to bring ({要|yào}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}{吗|ma}？).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {号|hào}___ (number, hàomǎ)
questions.explanation: {号码|hào mǎ}: {码|mǎ} has stone 石 on the left and {马|mǎ} (horse) for the sound. The same sound part with 口 is {吗|ma}, with 女 {妈|mā}, and {={骂|mà} (to scold) has two 口 on top=} (traditional {+骂+} has 罒).

questions.stem: Listen. How much is it altogether?

audio.text: 一共三十七块八。

questions.explanation: {一共|yí gòng}{三十七|sān shí qī}{块|kuài}{八|bā}: thirty-seven {块|kuài} and eight {毛|máo} (the {毛|máo} is left off), ¥37.80. ¥37.08 would need {零|líng}{八|bā}{分|fēn}.

questions.stem: Listen. What's the problem?

audio.text: 我的手机没电了，关机了。

choices: The phone's battery is dead and it has switched off.
There's no money on the phone.
questions.explanation: {手机|shǒu jī}{没|méi}{电|diàn}{了|le}: the phone has no power left; {关机|guān jī}{了|le}: it has switched off. Lost would be {丢|diū}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Listen to the cashier. Which way of paying is NOT possible?

audio.text: 这里不收现金，可以扫码或者刷卡。

questions.explanation: {这里|zhè lǐ}{不|bù}{收|shōu}{现金|xiàn jīn}: no cash here. {可以|kě yǐ}{扫码|sǎo mǎ}{或者|huò zhě}{刷卡|shuā kǎ}: you can scan the code or pay by card (bank or credit).

questions.stem: A notice ({通知|tōng zhī}) at a bank: "{从|cóng}12{月|yuè}1{日|rì}{起|qǐ}，{星期六|xīng qī liù}{和|hé}{星期日|xīng qī rì}{银行|yín háng}{不|bù}{开门|kāi mén}。{您|nín}{可以|kě yǐ}{在|zài}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{查|chá}{钱|qián}、{办|bàn}{事|shì}。{办|bàn}{新|xīn}{卡|kǎ}{请|qǐng}{星期一|xīng qī yī}{到|dào}{星期五|xīng qī wǔ}{来|lái}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}。" Which is true?
choices: You can get a new card on Saturdays.
From 1 December the bank opens at weekends.
You can't check your money on your phone.
To get a new card, bring your passport.
questions.explanation: {办|bàn}{新|xīn}{卡|kǎ}…{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}: for a new card, don't forget your passport. From 1 December ({从|cóng}12{月|yuè}1{日|rì}{起|qǐ}) the bank is closed at weekends, new cards are Monday to Friday, and checking on the phone is possible.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'd like to get a bank card.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{办|bàn}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{银行卡|yín háng kǎ}。 {办|bàn} is the verb for getting a card or document, and cards take {张|zhāng}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {一|yí} ___ {多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}？ (How much is it altogether?)
questions.explanation: {一共|yí gòng}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}？ {共|gòng} is six strokes: the horizontal, two verticals, the long horizontal, then the two short strokes (left-falling, dot) at the bottom.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Today is much colder than yesterday."?
choices: {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{冷|lěng}{多|duō}{了|le}。
{今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{多|duō}{冷|lěng}{了|le}。
{今天|jīn tiān}{冷|lěng}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{多|duō}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: "Much more" comes after the adjective: A {比|bǐ} B + {冷|lěng}{多|duō}{了|le}. {很|hěn} never goes in a {比|bǐ} sentence, {多|duō} can't go before the adjective here, and the {比|bǐ} phrase comes before the adjective.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Spring isn't as hot as summer."?
choices: {夏天|xià tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{春天|chūn tiān}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}。
{春天|chūn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{那么|nà me}{夏天|xià tiān}{热|rè}。
{春天|chūn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{夏天|xià tiān}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}。
{春天|chūn tiān}{比|bǐ}{夏天|xià tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{热|rè}。
questions.explanation: A {没有|méi yǒu} B ({那么|nà me}) + adjective: A isn't as… as B. {春天|chūn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{夏天|xià tiān}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}. {那么|nà me} goes after B, and the first choice says the opposite (summer isn't as hot as spring).

questions.stem: How do you say "Today is five degrees hotter than yesterday." ({度|dù}: degree)
choices: {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}{热|rè}。
{今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{热|rè}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}。
{今天|jīn tiān}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{热|rè}。
{今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{很|hěn}{热|rè}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}。
questions.explanation: The exact difference goes after the adjective, like {大|dà}{三|sān}{岁|suì} (three years older): {热|rè}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}. No {很|hěn} in a {比|bǐ} sentence.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {夏天|xià tiān}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{七月|qī yuè}{比|bǐ}{六月|liù yuè} ___ {热|rè}。 (Summer is hot, and July is even hotter than June.)
questions.explanation: {更|gèng} (even more) goes before the adjective in a {比|bǐ} sentence: {比|bǐ}{六月|liù yuè}{更|gèng}{热|rè}. {很|hěn}, {非常|fēi cháng} and {太|tài} can't be used with {比|bǐ}.

questions.stem: What does "{外面|wài miàn}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}。" describe?
choices: It's raining outside (right now, as the scene).
questions.explanation: Durative {着|zhe} after {下|xià} describes a lasting state: rain is falling out there. {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le} would be "it has started raining", and stopping would be {雨|yǔ}{停|tíng}{了|le} ({停|tíng}: stop).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "It's very windy today."?
questions.explanation: The wind is the subject and {大|dà} the adjective: {风|fēng}{很|hěn}{大|dà} (the wind is strong). You can also say {今天|jīn tiān}{刮|guā}{大|dà}{风|fēng}. {风|fēng} is a noun, so ~~{很|hěn}{风|fēng}~~ doesn't work.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {天气|tiān qì}{突然|tū rán} ___ {冷|lěng}{了|le}。 (The weather suddenly turned cold.)
questions.explanation: {变|biàn} + adjective + {了|le} says what something has become: {变|biàn}{冷|lěng}{了|le}. {换|huàn} swaps one thing for another ({换|huàn}{衣服|yī fu}), and {化|huà} is only part of words such as {变化|biàn huà}.

questions.stem: Your friend says "{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{一般|yì bān}。" What does your friend think of the food?
questions.explanation: As an adjective {一般|yì bān} is "ordinary, so-so", and {很|hěn}{一般|yì bān} is a polite way to say "not great". Before a verb, {一般|yì bān} means "usually": {我|wǒ}{一般|yì bān}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{吃饭|chī fàn}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {秋天|qiū tiān}{不|bù}{冷|lěng}{也|yě}{不|bú}{热|rè}，{很|hěn} ___ 。 (Autumn is neither cold nor hot: it's nice and cool.)
questions.explanation: {凉快|liáng kuai} is a pleasant coolness. {冷|lěng} (cold) contradicts {不|bù}{冷|lěng}, {冰|bīng} is ice (a noun), and {突然|tū rán} is sudden.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "It's getting colder and colder."?
questions.explanation: {越来越|yuè lái yuè} + adjective is "more and more", after the subject and with no {很|hěn}: {天|tiān}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{冷|lěng}{了|le}. The pattern comes back in lesson 12.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {季节|jì jié}, season: fourth tone + second tone, falling then rising.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {突然|tū rán}, suddenly: first tone + second tone, high and level, then rising.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's advice?

audio.text: 下午可能会下雨，你出门的时候带上伞吧。

choices: Take an umbrella when you go out.
Go out before the wind starts.
questions.explanation: {下午|xià wǔ}{可能|kě néng}{会|huì}{下雨|xià yǔ}: it may rain this afternoon, so {出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{带|dài}{上|shang}{伞|sǎn}{吧|ba}, "take an umbrella with you when you go out". Nothing is said about staying in, clothes or wind.

questions.stem: Which character means "winter" (dōng)?
questions.explanation: {冬|dōng} has 夂 on top and two dots of ice below. {东|dōng} (east) sounds the same, {各|gè} (each) has 口 under 夂, and {冷|lěng} (cold) has the ice radical on the left.

questions.stem: Listen. What's the weather like?

audio.text: 外面刮着大风，你多穿一点儿。

questions.explanation: {外面|wài miàn}{刮|guā}{着|zhe}{大|dà}{风|fēng}: a strong wind is blowing outside, so {你|nǐ}{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}, wear something more.

questions.stem: Listen. How does today compare with yesterday?

audio.text: 今天比昨天冷十度。

questions.explanation: {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{冷|lěng}{十|shí}{度|dù}: today is colder than yesterday by ten degrees. The exact amount comes after the adjective.

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the speaker like this season best?

audio.text: 我最喜欢秋天，不冷也不热，很凉快。

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{秋天|qiū tiān}: autumn is the favourite, because {不|bù}{冷|lěng}{也|yě}{不|bú}{热|rè}，{很|hěn}{凉快|liáng kuai}: neither cold nor hot, pleasantly cool.

questions.stem: A weather forecast: "{明天|míng tiān}{白天|bái tiān}{有|yǒu}{太阳|tài yang}，{十八|shí bā}{到|dào}{二十二|èr shí èr}{度|dù}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{天气|tiān qì}{变化|biàn huà}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{会|huì}{刮|guā}{大|dà}{风|fēng}，{也|yě}{可能|kě néng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{最|zuì}{低|dī}{十|shí}{度|dù}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{请|qǐng}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}，{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{衣服|yī fu}。" ({低|dī}: low) What should people going out in the evening do?
choices: Wear less, because it will be hot.
Take an umbrella and wear more clothes.
Stay at home because of snow.
Go out before the sun comes out.
questions.explanation: {晚上|wǎn shang}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{请|qǐng}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}，{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{衣服|yī fu}: take an umbrella and wear more. In the evening the weather changes a lot: strong wind, maybe rain, and as low as ten degrees.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Spring in Beijing isn't as hot as summer.
questions.explanation: {北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{春天|chūn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{夏天|xià tiān}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}。 A {没有|méi yǒu} B {那么|nà me} + adjective. {比|bǐ} would say the opposite kind of comparison ("hotter than"), and {很|hěn} isn't used in comparisons.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {外面|wài miàn}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài} ___ 。 (It's raining outside; don't forget your umbrella.)
questions.explanation: {带|dài}{伞|sǎn}: take an umbrella. {={伞|sǎn} is six strokes: 人 on top, a dot and a short left-falling stroke, the horizontal, and the long vertical last=} (traditional {+伞+} has four 人 under the cover).

questions.stem: The sun's yearly path (360 degrees) is divided into the twenty-four solar terms. How many degrees does each one cover?
questions.explanation: 360 ÷ 24 = 15 degrees, and the sun takes about fifteen days to cross each part. Twelve parts of 30 degrees would be the twelve months of a solar year.

questions.stem: Why does {清明|qīng míng} fall on almost the same Western date (4 or 5 April) every year, while the Spring Festival moves?
choices: The solar terms follow the sun; the festivals of the lunar calendar follow the moon.
The government fixes its date every year.
It always falls on a Sunday.
It is counted from the Spring Festival.
questions.explanation: The solar terms are positions of the sun, so they keep step with the Western (solar) calendar, give or take a day. The Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival are dates of the lunar calendar ({农历|nóng lì}), which moves against it.

questions.stem: What does {立|lì} mean in {立春|lì chūn}, {立夏|lì xià}, {立秋|lì qiū} and {立冬|lì dōng}?
questions.explanation: {立|lì} (to stand, to set up) marks the start of a season: {立春|lì chūn} is Start of Spring, around 4 February. The middle points are the equinoxes ({春分|chūn fēn}, {秋分|qiū fēn}) and solstices ({夏至|xià zhì}, {冬至|dōng zhì}).

questions.stem: Which solar term is the winter solstice, the shortest day of the year?
questions.explanation: {冬至|dōng zhì}: {至|zhì} (arrive, the furthest point) after a season is a solstice. {立冬|lì dōng} is the start of winter in November, and {大寒|dà hán} (Greater Cold) and {小雪|xiǎo xuě} (Lesser Snow) are named for the weather.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT a custom of {清明|qīng míng}?
choices: sweeping the family graves ({扫墓|sǎo mù})
eating mooncakes under the full moon
questions.explanation: Mooncakes and the full moon belong to the Mid-Autumn Festival. {清明|qīng míng}, around 5 April, is for {扫墓|sǎo mù}, spring outings, kite flying and {青团|qīng tuán}, green sticky rice balls.

questions.stem: What do many families in northern China traditionally eat at the winter solstice?
questions.explanation: In the north it's {饺子|jiǎo zi}; folk tradition says they keep your ears from freezing. In the south many families eat {汤圆|tāng yuán}, sweet sticky rice balls. Both are broad tendencies, not rules.

questions.stem: In which year were the twenty-four solar terms inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.explanation: 2016, at the eleventh session of UNESCO's committee. (2008 is the year {清明|qīng míng} became a public holiday in mainland China.)

questions.stem: In the solar terms rhyme, the first line is "{春雨惊春清谷天|chūn yǔ jīng chūn qīng gǔ tiān}". Which term does {清|qīng} stand for?
questions.explanation: The line runs through spring's six terms in order: {立春|lì chūn}, {雨水|yǔ shuǐ}, {惊蛰|jīng zhé}, {春分|chūn fēn}, {清明|qīng míng}, {谷雨|gǔ yǔ}. {清|qīng} is the fifth syllable, {清明|qīng míng}; {天|tiān} just completes the line.

questions.stem: Listen. What is special about today?

audio.text: 今天是冬至，一年里白天最短的一天。

choices: It has the shortest daylight of the year.
It has the longest daylight of the year.
It's the first day of spring.
It's the coldest day of the year.
questions.explanation: {今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{冬至|dōng zhì}: it's the winter solstice, {一|yì}{年|nián}{里|lǐ}{白天|bái tiān}{最|zuì}{短|duǎn}{的|de}{一|yì}{天|tiān}, the day of the year with the shortest daylight. The coldest days usually come later, around {小寒|xiǎo hán} and {大寒|dà hán}.

questions.stem: Listen. What do many people do at this festival? ({老家|lǎo jiā}: home town)

audio.text: 清明节很多人回老家扫墓。

choices: They go back to their home town to sweep the family graves.
questions.explanation: {清明节|qīng míng jié}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}{扫墓|sǎo mù}: at Qingming many people go back to their home town to sweep the graves of their relatives ({扫墓|sǎo mù}: lesson 03's {扫|sǎo}, sweep).

questions.stem: Read: "{谷雨|gǔ yǔ}{是|shì}{春天|chūn tiān}{的|de}{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{节气|jié qì}，{在|zài}{四月|sì yuè}{二十|èr shí}{号|hào}{前后|qián hòu}。{这|zhè}{个|gè}{时候|shí hou}{雨|yǔ}{多|duō}{了|le}，{对|duì}{地|dì}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{谷子|gǔ zi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。{谷雨|gǔ yǔ}{的|de}{下|xià}{一|yí}{个|gè}{节气|jié qì}{是|shì}{立夏|lì xià}，{夏天|xià tiān}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{来|lái}{了|le}。" ({最后|zuì hòu}: last; {前后|qián hòu}: around; {谷子|gǔ zi}: millet, grain) Which is true?
choices: {谷雨|gǔ yǔ} is the last solar term of spring.
There is little rain at {谷雨|gǔ yǔ}.
questions.explanation: {谷雨|gǔ yǔ}{是|shì}{春天|chūn tiān}{的|de}{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{节气|jié qì}: Grain Rain is the last term of spring, around 20 April. The rain increases ({雨|yǔ}{多|duō}{了|le}), which is good for the crops, and the next term, {立夏|lì xià}, starts the summer.

questions.stem: A calendar note in August: "{今天|jīn tiān}{立秋|lì qiū}。{天气|tiān qì}{还|hái}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{但是|dàn shì}{早上|zǎo shang}{和|hé}{晚上|wǎn shang}{凉快|liáng kuai}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{了|le}。" What is the weather like?
choices: It's still hot, but mornings and evenings are a bit cooler.
questions.explanation: {天气|tiān qì}{还|hái}{很|hěn}{热|rè}: it's still hot; {早上|zǎo shang}{和|hé}{晚上|wǎn shang}{凉快|liáng kuai}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{了|le}: mornings and evenings have got a little cooler. {立秋|lì qiū} (Start of Autumn, around 8 August) comes while summer heat is still strong.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {冬至|dōng zhì}, the winter solstice: first tone + fourth tone. {夏至|xià zhì}, the summer solstice, is 4 + 4.

questions.stem: What are {拉面|lā miàn}, the noodles of Lanzhou beef noodle soup?
choices: noodles pulled and stretched by hand
questions.explanation: {拉面|lā miàn} are "pulled noodles": the cook stretches and folds the dough again and again until it becomes thin strands. Knife-cut noodles are Shanxi's {刀削面|dāo xiāo miàn}, and instant noodles are {方便面|fāng biàn miàn}.

questions.stem: A good bowl of Lanzhou beef noodles is "{一清二白三红四绿五黄|yī qīng èr bái sān hóng sì lǜ wǔ huáng}". What is the red?
questions.explanation: Clear soup, white radish, red chilli oil, green coriander and garlic shoots, and yellow noodles.

questions.stem: How are Shanxi's {刀削面|dāo xiāo miàn} made?
choices: Strips are shaved from a block of dough straight into boiling water.
The dough is pulled by hand into thin strands.
They are steamed in bamboo baskets.
questions.explanation: {刀削面|dāo xiāo miàn} are "knife-shaved noodles": the cook holds a block of dough and shaves strip after strip into the pot with a curved blade. Pulling by hand is Lanzhou's {拉面|lā miàn}; bamboo steamers are for dim sum.

questions.stem: Which condiment is Shanxi known for, and adds to its noodles?
questions.explanation: Shanxi is famous for its aged vinegar, {老陈醋|lǎo chén cù}, and a few drops go on a bowl of noodles. Sesame sauce ({麻酱|má jiàng}) is the dip for Beijing's mutton hot pot.

questions.stem: In Guangdong, what is {喝|hē}{早茶|zǎo chá}?
choices: meeting in a teahouse in the morning for tea and dim sum
questions.explanation: "Drinking morning tea" means a long morning meal in a teahouse with family or friends: tea first, then small dishes of {点心|diǎn xin} such as {虾饺|xiā jiǎo} and {烧卖|shāo mài}, shared by everyone.

questions.stem: What is a {鸳鸯锅|yuān yang guō} at a hot pot restaurant?
choices: a pot for two people only
a pot divided in two: spicy on one side, mild on the other
questions.explanation: The {鸳鸯锅|yuān yang guō} has a wall down the middle, so a group can have a {麻辣|má là} broth and a mild one in the same pot. {鸳鸯|yuān yang} are mandarin ducks, which go in pairs.

questions.stem: Which is true of Old Beijing's {涮羊肉|shuàn yáng ròu}?
choices: Thin slices of mutton are dipped in a clear broth in a copper pot and eaten with sesame sauce.
It is a very spicy beef-fat broth with tripe.
It is a dish of noodles pulled by hand.
It is eaten only for breakfast.
questions.explanation: {涮|shuàn} is "to dip-boil": paper-thin mutton swished in a mild, clear broth in a copper pot ({铜锅|tóng guō}), then dipped in {麻酱|má jiàng}. The spicy beef-fat broth with {毛肚|máo dǔ} is Chongqing's.

questions.stem: In a dumpling restaurant you say "{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{三|sān}{两|liǎng}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。" About how much are you ordering?
questions.explanation: Here {两|liǎng} is a traditional weight of 50 grams, a tenth of a {斤|jīn}, and one {两|liǎng} is usually six or seven dumplings. So {三|sān}{两|liǎng} is about 150 g, roughly twenty.

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the speaker suggest a split pot?

audio.text: 我吃不了太辣的，我们点一个鸳鸯锅吧。

choices: The speaker can't handle very spicy food.
The speaker wants to eat quickly.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{吃不了|chī bu liǎo}{太|tài}{辣|là}{的|de}: I can't manage very spicy food (a potential complement with {了|liǎo}), so {我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{鸳鸯锅|yuān yang guō}{吧|ba}, let's order a split pot with a mild side.

questions.stem: Listen to the customer. What is the order?

audio.text: 老板，一碗牛肉面，要二细的，多加一点儿辣。

choices: a bowl of beef noodles, medium-thin, extra chilli
two bowls of beef noodles, not spicy
a bowl of knife-cut noodles with vinegar
a plate of dumplings with chilli
questions.explanation: {一|yì}{碗|wǎn}{牛肉面|niú ròu miàn}: one bowl of beef noodles; {要|yào}{二细|èr xì}{的|de}: the medium-thin kind (not "two"); {多|duō}{加|jiā}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{辣|là}: a bit more chilli.

questions.stem: A noodle shop's price list: "{牛肉面|niú ròu miàn} 10{元|yuán}；{加|jiā}{肉|ròu} 8{元|yuán}；{加|jiā}{鸡蛋|jī dàn} 2{元|yuán}；{饮料|yǐn liào} 3{元|yuán}". You order a bowl of beef noodles with extra meat and an egg. How much is it altogether?
questions.explanation: 10 + 8 ({加|jiā}{肉|ròu}, extra meat) + 2 ({加|jiā}{鸡蛋|jī dàn}, an egg) = 20: {一共|yí gòng}{二十|èr shí}{块|kuài}. You didn't order a drink.

questions.stem: Read: "{吃|chī}{火锅|huǒ guō}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{大家|dà jiā}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{锅|guō}{里|lǐ}{一起|yì qǐ}{煮|zhǔ}{菜|cài}，{一般|yì bān}{要|yào}{吃|chī}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{一|yì}{年|nián}{四|sì}{季|jì}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{吃|chī}{火锅|huǒ guō}，{但是|dàn shì}{冬天|dōng tiān}{吃|chī}{的|de}{人|rén}{最|zuì}{多|duō}。" ({锅|guō}: pot; {煮|zhǔ}: to boil, cook) Which is true?
choices: Each person has their own pot.
Hot pot is eaten only in winter.
Most people eat hot pot in winter.
A hot pot meal usually takes twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: {冬天|dōng tiān}{吃|chī}{的|de}{人|rén}{最|zuì}{多|duō}: the most people eat it in winter, though it's eaten all year ({一|yì}{年|nián}{四|sì}{季|jì}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{吃|chī}). Everyone cooks in one pot together, and a meal usually takes two hours.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {火锅|huǒ guō}, hot pot: third tone + first tone. {火|huǒ} stays low before the high, level {锅|guō}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "The bank is between the bookshop and the supermarket."?
choices: {银行|yín háng}{在|zài}{中间|zhōng jiān}{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}。
{银行|yín háng}{在|zài}{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}{中间|zhōng jiān}。
{银行|yín háng}{中间|zhōng jiān}{在|zài}{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}。
{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}{在|zài}{银行|yín háng}{中间|zhōng jiān}。
questions.explanation: {在|zài} A {和|hé} B {中间|zhōng jiān}: the two places first, joined by {和|hé}, and {中间|zhōng jiān} last: {银行|yín háng}{在|zài}{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}{中间|zhōng jiān}. English order ({在|zài}{中间|zhōng jiān}{书店|shū diàn}{和|hé}{超市|chāo shì}) doesn't work, and the last choice puts the bank in the middle of the other two the wrong way round: the bookshop and supermarket would be between the bank.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}___ {都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}。 (He knows everything.)
questions.explanation: {什么|shén me} + {都|dōu} + verb is "everything": {他|tā}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}. {哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu} would be "everywhere" and {谁|shéi}{都|dōu} "everybody" ({他|tā}{谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào} is "he knows about everybody"). {怎么|zěn me} doesn't make "every-" words with {知道|zhī dào}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm not going anywhere today."?
questions.explanation: Question word + {也|yě} / {都|dōu} + {不|bù} + verb: {我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{哪儿|nǎr}{也|yě}{不|bú}{去|qù}. Without {也|yě} or {都|dōu} the sentence doesn't work, {也|yě} can't come after the verb, and {我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}？ is a real question ("where am I going today?").

questions.stem: What does "{谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}。" mean?
questions.explanation: {谁|shéi} before {都|dōu} is the subject, "everybody": {谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}, everybody likes her. "She likes everybody" would be {她|tā}{谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}, with {她|tā} first; "nobody likes her" needs a negative ({谁|shéi}{也|yě}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}). There's no question: the question mark is missing for a reason.

questions.stem: Which word fits the notice? "{时间|shí jiān}：{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}　___：{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}"
questions.explanation: On notices, tickets and invitations the place of an event is {地点|dì diǎn}, written next to {时间|shí jiān}. {地方|dì fang} is the everyday word for a place in conversation; {方向|fāng xiàng} is a direction and {地图|dì tú} a map.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}___，{走路|zǒu lù}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。 (My home is near the school, five minutes on foot.)
questions.explanation: {附近|fù jìn} is a place word ("the area nearby"), so it follows {学校|xué xiào} after {在|zài}: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{附近|fù jìn}. {近|jìn} is an adjective: it needs {离|lí} ({我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{学校|xué xiào}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}). {中间|zhōng jiān} needs two places ({在|zài} A {和|hé} B {中间|zhōng jiān}), and {在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{路口|lù kǒu} would be "at the school crossing".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {城市|chéng shì}, city: a rising second tone, then a falling fourth tone (2+4).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {地图|dì tú}, map: a falling fourth tone, then a rising second tone (4+2), the other way round from {城市|chéng shì}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {地|dì}___ (map)
questions.explanation: {={地图|dì tú}: {图|tú}, an enclosure with {冬|dōng} inside. All four are boxes with something in them: {国|guó} (country) has {玉|yù} (jade) inside, {回|huí} (to return) a smaller box, and {因|yīn} (because, in {因为|yīn wèi}) has {大|dà}.=} These are the simplified forms: in traditional script {+图+} and {+国+} have other parts inside the box.

questions.stem: Which character is nán, "south"?
questions.explanation: {南|nán} is south: {十|shí} on top and a frame below with more strokes inside. {男|nán} (male) has the same sound nán but is {田|tián} (field) over {力|lì} (strength); {商|shāng} (in {商店|shāng diàn}) starts with a dot and a horizontal; {北|běi} is north.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {东|dōng} east, {西|xī} west, {南|nán} south, {北|běi} north (listed in Chinese as {东|dōng}{南|nán}{西|xī}{北|běi}), and {中间|zhōng jiān} in the middle, between. "Nearby" is {附近|fù jìn}.

questions.stem: Listen. Where is the bank?

audio.text: 银行在超市北边，从这儿走路五分钟。

questions.explanation: {银行|yín háng}{在|zài}{超市|chāo shì}{北边|běi bian}: the bank is north of the supermarket, five minutes' walk from here ({从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{走路|zǒu lù}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}). South would be {南边|nán bian}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 这附近哪儿都有饭馆，你不用担心。

choices: There are restaurants all over the area.
The speaker doesn't know where the restaurants are.
There is only one restaurant nearby.
questions.explanation: {哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}: there are restaurants everywhere, and {你|nǐ}{不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn}, you needn't worry ({不用|bú yòng} and {担心|dān xīn} are lesson 05's). {哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu} isn't a question here: it means "everywhere".

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 请问，这附近有没有超市？

choices: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{超市|chāo shì}{和|hé}{银行|yín háng}{中间|zhōng jiān}。
{有|yǒu}，{往|wǎng}{东|dōng}{走|zǒu}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: "Excuse me, is there a supermarket around here?" is answered with where it is: {有|yǒu}，{往|wǎng}{东|dōng}{走|zǒu}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le} (yes: go east for five minutes and you're there). The others say what the speaker wants to buy, that the supermarket is famous, and where the speaker is.

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker buy?

audio.text: 我在街上走了两个小时，但是什么也没买。

questions.explanation: {什么|shén me}{也|yě}{没|méi}{买|mǎi}: "didn't buy anything". The speaker walked around the streets for two hours ({在|zài}{街|jiē}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}) but bought nothing. {什么|shén me}{也|yě} + {没|méi} + verb is the negative of {什么|shén me}{都|dōu} + verb.

questions.stem: Read the message: "{你好|nǐ hǎo}！{明天|míng tiān}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{吧|ba}。{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{新城|Xīn chéng}{小区|xiǎo qū}，{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}{找|zhǎo}。{你|nǐ}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{到|dào}{东大街|Dōng Dà jiē}{站|zhàn}，{从|cóng}B{口|kǒu}{出来|chū lái}，{往|wǎng}{北|běi}{走|zǒu}。{到|dào}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{路口|lù kǒu}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}{走|zǒu}，{路边|lù biān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{饺子馆|jiǎo zi guǎn}，{小区|xiǎo qū}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{饺子馆|jiǎo zi guǎn}{和|hé}{一|yí}{个|gè}{银行|yín háng}{中间|zhōng jiān}。{小区|xiǎo qū}{的|de}{环境|huán jìng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}，{附近|fù jìn}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}，{楼|lóu}{下|xià}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{超市|chāo shì}{里|lǐ}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{很|hěn}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。{从|cóng}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{走|zǒu}{到|dào}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{要|yào}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{打车|dǎ chē}，{路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{八|bā}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}{三|sān}{层|céng}，{你|nǐ}{到|dào}{了|le}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{我|wǒ}{下|xià}{楼|lóu}{去|qù}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}。" Where is the housing estate?
choices: between a dumpling restaurant and a bank
questions.explanation: {小区|xiǎo qū}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{饺子馆|jiǎo zi guǎn}{和|hé}{一|yí}{个|gè}{银行|yín háng}{中间|zhōng jiān}: the estate is between the dumpling restaurant and a bank. The first crossing is where you turn west; the metro station is where you start. ({新城|Xīn chéng} "New Town" and {东大街|Dōng Dà jiē} "East Street" are names; {饺子馆|jiǎo zi guǎn} is a dumpling restaurant.)

questions.stem: Read the message again: "{你好|nǐ hǎo}！{明天|míng tiān}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{吧|ba}。{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{新城|Xīn chéng}{小区|xiǎo qū}，{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}{找|zhǎo}。{你|nǐ}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{到|dào}{东大街|Dōng Dà jiē}{站|zhàn}，{从|cóng}B{口|kǒu}{出来|chū lái}，{往|wǎng}{北|běi}{走|zǒu}。{到|dào}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{路口|lù kǒu}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}{走|zǒu}，{路边|lù biān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{饺子馆|jiǎo zi guǎn}，{小区|xiǎo qū}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{饺子馆|jiǎo zi guǎn}{和|hé}{一|yí}{个|gè}{银行|yín háng}{中间|zhōng jiān}。{小区|xiǎo qū}{的|de}{环境|huán jìng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}，{附近|fù jìn}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}，{楼|lóu}{下|xià}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{超市|chāo shì}{里|lǐ}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{很|hěn}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。{从|cóng}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{走|zǒu}{到|dào}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{要|yào}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{打车|dǎ chē}，{路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{八|bā}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}{三|sān}{层|céng}，{你|nǐ}{到|dào}{了|le}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{我|wǒ}{下|xià}{楼|lóu}{去|qù}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}。" Which way do you go from the metro exit?
choices: west, then north at the first crossing
north, then west at the first crossing
questions.explanation: {从|cóng}B{口|kǒu}{出来|chū lái}，{往|wǎng}{北|běi}{走|zǒu}。{到|dào}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{路口|lù kǒu}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}{走|zǒu}: out of exit B, go north, and at the first crossing go west. The order matters: north first, then west.

questions.stem: In a message giving directions to someone's new home, what does "{附近|fù jìn}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}" tell you?
choices: There are all kinds of shops and services nearby.
The writer doesn't know what is nearby.
questions.explanation: {什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}, "there's everything": the area has whatever you need. The question word {什么|shén me} with {都|dōu} means "everything", not "what?". "Nothing" would be {什么|shén me}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}.

questions.stem: Write the character for "north" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}___ {边|biān}。
questions.explanation: {北|běi}, běi: five strokes, the left side first (vertical, short horizontal, rising stroke), then the right (left-falling stroke and a vertical that bends into a hook). {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{北边|běi bian}: my home is in the north of the city.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Nobody here knows me.
questions.explanation: {这儿|zhèr}{谁|shéi}{也|yě}{不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}{我|wǒ}。 {谁|shéi} is the subject ("nobody", with the negative), and {也|yě} (or {都|dōu}) comes before {不|bù} and the verb. {什么|shén me} would make "nothing".

questions.stem: How do you say "northeast"?
questions.explanation: East or west comes first in Chinese: {东北|dōng běi} (east-north) is northeast. {北|běi}{东|dōng} follows English order and isn't used; {西北|xī běi} is northwest, and {南|nán}{西|xī} is another English-order mistake for {西南|xī nán} (southwest).

questions.topic: Degree: 越…越, 更, 极了, 比较
questions.stem: Which sentence means "It's getting colder and colder."?
questions.explanation: {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè} + adjective, with {了|le} for the change: {天气|tiān qì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{冷|lěng}{了|le}. Nothing goes between {越|yuè} and the adjective (no {很|hěn}), the order {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè} is fixed, and {更|gèng} doesn't make this pattern.

questions.topic: Degree: 越…越, 更, 极了, 比较
questions.stem: Choose the pair: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}___ {看|kàn}___ {喜欢|xǐ huan}。 (The more I read this book, the more I like it.)
questions.explanation: {越|yuè} + verb, {越|yuè} + verb or adjective: {越|yuè}{看|kàn}{越|yuè}{喜欢|xǐ huan}, "the more I read, the more I like it". {又|yòu}…{又|yòu} is "both… and…" ({又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}: lesson 08), and {更|gèng} and {很|hěn} don't come in pairs like this.

questions.topic: Degree: 越…越, 更, 极了, 比较
questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: In a {比|bǐ} sentence the adjective can take {更|gèng} (even more), placed right before it: {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{更|gèng}{冷|lěng}. {很|hěn} isn't allowed there, and {更|gèng} doesn't go before {比|bǐ} or after the adjective.

questions.topic: Degree: 越…越, 更, 极了, 比较
questions.stem: Which sentence means "The dumplings are absolutely delicious!"?
questions.explanation: {极|jí}{了|le} follows the whole adjective: {好吃|hǎo chī}{极|jí}{了|le}. {很|hěn} says "very" a second time, so it can't come before an adjective with {极|jí}{了|le}, and {极|jí}{了|le} never goes in front of the adjective or inside {好吃|hǎo chī}.

questions.topic: Degree: 越…越, 更, 极了, 比较
questions.stem: What does "{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{比较|bǐ jiào}{便宜|pián yi}。" mean?
choices: Things here are cheaper than over there.
questions.explanation: {比较|bǐ jiào} before an adjective is "fairly, relatively": milder than {很|hěn}. "Cheaper than over there" needs {比|bǐ} and a second place ({比|bǐ}{那儿|nàr}{便宜|pián yi}), "the cheapest" is {最|zuì}{便宜|pián yi}, and {比较|bǐ jiào} as the verb "to compare" would need two things to compare.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: {来自|lái zì} already contains "from": {我|wǒ}{来自|lái zì}{英国|Yīng guó} (I come from the UK). Adding {从|cóng} repeats it, and {是|shì} + {来自|lái zì} mixes two patterns: say {我|wǒ}{来自|lái zì}{英国|Yīng guó} or {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{英国|Yīng guó}{人|rén}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {世界|shì jiè}, world: two falling fourth tones (4+4). Make the first one shorter.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {比较|bǐ jiào}, fairly: a low third tone, then a falling fourth tone (3+4). The second syllable is jiào, not jiǎo as in {饺子|jiǎo zi}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the sentence? {北京|Běi jīng}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{东北|dōng běi}___ {冷|lěng}。 (Beijing is cold; the Northeast is even colder.)
questions.explanation: {更|gèng}, even more: seven strokes, the long left-falling stroke going through the box. {便|pián} (in {便宜|pián yi}, cheap) is {更|gèng} with the person radical in front, {史|shǐ} is the second character of {历史|lì shǐ} (history, lesson 17), and {夏|xià} is the first of {夏天|xià tiān} (summer).

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {东方|dōng fāng} the East, {西方|xī fāng} the West, {北方|běi fāng} the North (of China), {南方|nán fāng} the South, {世界|shì jiè} the world. "Country" is {国家|guó jiā}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is happening?

audio.text: 来北京旅游的外国人越来越多。

choices: Fewer foreigners come to Beijing than before.
The speaker is a foreign tourist.
Lots of foreigners live in Beijing.
More and more foreigners come to Beijing as tourists.
questions.explanation: {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}: more and more. {来|lái}{北京|Běi jīng}{旅游|lǚ yóu}{的|de}{外国|wài guó}{人|rén} are the foreigners who come to Beijing to travel ({旅游|lǚ yóu}), so the number of foreign tourists keeps growing.

questions.stem: Listen. Which place is the coldest?

audio.text: 北京很冷，东北更冷。

questions.explanation: {北京|Běi jīng}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{东北|dōng běi}{更|gèng}{冷|lěng}: Beijing is cold, and the Northeast is even colder ({更|gèng}). {更|gèng} says the second one has even more of the quality.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 你来自哪个国家？

questions.explanation: "Which country do you come from?" is answered with the country: {我|wǒ}{来自|lái zì}{英国|Yīng guó}. The others say how many countries the speaker has been to and where the speaker is, and {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{外地|wài dì} isn't a sentence ({外地人|wài dì rén}).

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. Who gets in without a ticket?

audio.text: 六岁以下的孩子不要门票。

questions.explanation: {六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}: six and under ({以下|yǐ xià} includes the number in rules like this), and {不要|bú yào}{门票|mén piào}: no admission ticket needed. "Over six" would be {六|liù}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}.
