questions.stem: Read the poster: "{北方|běi fāng}{菜|cài}{和|hé}{南方|nán fāng}{菜|cài}：{一起|yì qǐ}{来|lái}{做饭|zuò fàn}！{时间|shí jiān}：{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}。{地点|dì diǎn}：{学校|xué xiào}{三|sān}{层|céng}{的|de}{大|dà}{教室|jiào shì}。{你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{还是|hái shi}{米饭|mǐ fàn}？{北方人|běi fāng rén}{吃|chī}{面条儿|miàn tiáor}、{饺子|jiǎo zi}{比较|bǐ jiào}{多|duō}，{南方人|nán fāng rén}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}{比较|bǐ jiào}{多|duō}。{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}，{来自|lái zì}{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{赵老师|Zhào lǎo shī}{和|hé}{来自|lái zì}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{的|de}{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{做|zuò}{北方|běi fāng}{菜|cài}{和|hé}{南方|nán fāng}{菜|cài}。{赵老师|Zhào lǎo shī}{说|shuō}：‘{北方|běi fāng}{的|de}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{好吃|hǎo chī}{极|jí}{了|le}！’{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}{说|shuō}：‘{南方|nán fāng}{的|de}{菜|cài}{更|gèng}{好吃|hǎo chī}！’{十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{来|lái}，{不要|bú yào}{钱|qián}。{一|yí}{个|gè}{班|bān}{最|zuì}{多|duō}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{越|yuè}{早|zǎo}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}！" Who are the two teachers?
choices: a teacher from Beijing and a teacher from Shanghai
questions.explanation: {来自|lái zì}{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{赵老师|Zhào lǎo shī}{和|hé}{来自|lái zì}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{的|de}{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}: Teacher Zhao from Beijing and Teacher Li from Shanghai, one from the North and one from the South.

questions.stem: Read the poster again: "{北方|běi fāng}{菜|cài}{和|hé}{南方|nán fāng}{菜|cài}：{一起|yì qǐ}{来|lái}{做饭|zuò fàn}！{时间|shí jiān}：{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}。{地点|dì diǎn}：{学校|xué xiào}{三|sān}{层|céng}{的|de}{大|dà}{教室|jiào shì}。{你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{还是|hái shi}{米饭|mǐ fàn}？{北方人|běi fāng rén}{吃|chī}{面条儿|miàn tiáor}、{饺子|jiǎo zi}{比较|bǐ jiào}{多|duō}，{南方人|nán fāng rén}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐ fàn}{比较|bǐ jiào}{多|duō}。{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}，{来自|lái zì}{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{赵老师|Zhào lǎo shī}{和|hé}{来自|lái zì}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{的|de}{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{做|zuò}{北方|běi fāng}{菜|cài}{和|hé}{南方|nán fāng}{菜|cài}。{赵老师|Zhào lǎo shī}{说|shuō}：‘{北方|běi fāng}{的|de}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{好吃|hǎo chī}{极|jí}{了|le}！’{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}{说|shuō}：‘{南方|nán fāng}{的|de}{菜|cài}{更|gèng}{好吃|hǎo chī}！’{十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{来|lái}，{不要|bú yào}{钱|qián}。{一|yí}{个|gè}{班|bān}{最|zuì}{多|duō}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{越|yuè}{早|zǎo}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}！" Who can come?
questions.explanation: {十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{来|lái}: students aged eighteen and over can all come, and {不要|bú yào}{钱|qián}, it's free.

questions.stem: The same poster ends: "…{一|yí}{个|gè}{班|bān}{最|zuì}{多|duō}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{越|yuè}{早|zǎo}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}！" Why does it say "{越|yuè}{早|zǎo}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}"?
choices: Each class takes at most twenty people.
The class starts very early in the morning.
questions.explanation: {越|yuè}{早|zǎo}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo} is "the earlier you come, the better", because {一|yí}{个|gè}{班|bān}{最|zuì}{多|duō}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}: a class takes twenty people at most. The class runs from ten to twelve.

questions.stem: Write the character for "even more" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{北方|běi fāng}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}___ {喜欢|xǐ huan}{南方|nán fāng}。
questions.explanation: {更|gèng}, gèng: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{北方|běi fāng}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{更|gèng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{南方|nán fāng} (I like the North, but I like the South even more). Seven strokes: the top horizontal, the box, then the long left-falling and the right-falling stroke.

questions.topic: Degree: 越…越, 更, 极了, 比较
questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The more I read this book, the more I like it.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{越|yuè}{看|kàn}{越|yuè}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。 The book comes first as the topic, then {我|wǒ} + {越|yuè}{看|kàn}{越|yuè}{喜欢|xǐ huan}. {我|wǒ}{越|yuè}{看|kàn}{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{越|yuè}{喜欢|xǐ huan} is right too. {更|gèng} doesn't build this pattern.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Someone has taken my bike." (ridden it off)?
choices: {我|wǒ}{被|bèi}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{把|bǎ}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: Receiver + {被|bèi} + doer + verb + result: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le} ({人|rén}, someone, is the doer; {走|zǒu} shows the bike went off). {被|bèi}{骑|qí} alone is incomplete, {我|wǒ}{被|bèi}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le} says the bike rode off on me, and with {把|bǎ} the bike would be doing the riding.

questions.stem: "{弟弟|dì di}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃|chī}{了|le}。" Which sentence means the same?
choices: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}。
{弟弟|dì di}{被|bèi}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃|chī}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{把|bǎ}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}。
questions.explanation: {把|bǎ} puts the doer first ({弟弟|dì di}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃|chī}{了|le}); {被|bèi} puts the receiver first: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}. Either way the little brother ate the cake. The other choices turn the cake into the eater, or make {我|wǒ} the thing that was eaten.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "My umbrella wasn't blown away by the wind."?
questions.explanation: The negative goes before {被|bèi}, as before {把|bǎ}: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{没|méi}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}. It can't sit between the doer and the verb, inside the verb and its result, or before the subject.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "There's someone standing at the crossing."?
questions.explanation: Place + verb + {着|zhe} + number + measure + person: {路口|lù kǒu}{站|zhàn}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}. The place comes first, the new person last; {着|zhe} says the standing goes on.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}___ {自行车|zì xíng chē}{上班|shàng bān}。 (I cycle to work every day.)
questions.explanation: You sit astride a bicycle, so it takes {骑|qí}: {骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}. {坐|zuò} is for vehicles you sit in ({汽车|qì chē}, {船|chuán}, {高铁|gāo tiě}) and {开|kāi} is to drive; {走|zǒu} is to walk.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}___ {汽车|qì chē}。
questions.explanation: Vehicles with wheels take {辆|liàng}: {三|sān}{辆|liàng}{汽车|qì chē}. {条|tiáo} is for long thin things (and boats in everyday speech), {本|běn} for books, and {个|gè} isn't used for cars.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {飞机|fēi jī}___ {了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 (The plane was an hour late.)
questions.explanation: Trains, buses and planes {晚点|wǎn diǎn}: {飞机|fēi jī}{晚点|wǎn diǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. People {迟到|chí dào} ({我|wǒ}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}). {马上|mǎ shàng} is "right away" and {着急|zháo jí} "worried".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {汽车|qì chē}, car: a falling fourth tone, then a high level first tone (4+1).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {着急|zháo jí}, worried: two rising second tones (2+2). The {着|zhe} is zháo here, not the light zhe of {站|zhàn}{着|zhe}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {安|ān}___ (safe)
questions.explanation: {安全|ān quán}: {全|quán}, 王 under a roof like {人|rén}. All four start with that roof: {金|jīn} (gold) has more strokes inside, {会|huì} is the {会|huì} of "can", and {合|hé} (in {合适|hé shì}, lesson 08) has {一|yī} and {口|kǒu} below.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {汽车|qì chē} car, {自行车|zì xíng chē} bicycle, {船|chuán} boat, {高铁|gāo tiě} high-speed train, {司机|sī jī} driver. Traffic lights are {红绿灯|hóng lǜ dēng}.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened?

audio.text: 我的伞被风刮走了！

choices: The wind blew the speaker's umbrella away.
The speaker gave away their umbrella.
The speaker bought a new umbrella.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}: my umbrella ({伞|sǎn}) was blown away ({刮|guā}{走|zǒu}) by the wind ({风|fēng}). {被|bèi} + {风|fēng} names what did it.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 对不起，我迟到了二十分钟。

choices: The speaker arrived twenty minutes late.
The speaker will arrive in twenty minutes.
The train was twenty minutes late.
The speaker waited for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: {迟到|chí dào}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}: arrived twenty minutes late, and {对不起|duì bu qǐ} apologises for it. A late train would be {晚点|wǎn diǎn}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 火车晚点了一个小时。

choices: {我|wǒ}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{别|bié}{着急|zháo jí}，{我们|wǒ men}{等|děng}{一会儿|yí huìr}{吧|ba}。
questions.explanation: "The train is an hour late" is answered with comfort and a plan: {别|bié}{着急|zháo jí}，{我们|wǒ men}{等|děng}{一会儿|yí huìr}{吧|ba} (don't worry, let's wait a while). The others don't fit what was said.

questions.stem: Listen. What is at the door?

audio.text: 门口放着两辆自行车。

questions.explanation: {门口|mén kǒu}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}: at the door there are two bikes ({两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}), standing there ({放|fàng}{着|zhe}). This is the existential {着|zhe} sentence: place + verb + {着|zhe} + thing.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{邻居|lín jū}{们|men}：{上|shàng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{把|bǎ}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}，{要|yào}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{门口|mén kǒu}，{那儿|nàr}{有|yǒu}{灯|dēng}。{骑车|qí chē}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán}：{红灯|hóng dēng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{别|bié}{走|zǒu}，{过|guò}{马路|mǎ lù}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{车|chē}。{小区|xiǎo qū}{东|dōng}{门|mén}{外边|wài bian}{的|de}{马路|mǎ lù}{上|shàng}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{早上|zǎo shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{更|gèng}{多|duō}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{骑|qí}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。{骑车|qí chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{别|bié}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{也|yě}{别|bié}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}；{晚上|wǎn shang}{骑车|qí chē}，{车|chē}{上|shàng}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{灯|dēng}。{十二|shí èr}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{骑车|qí chē}{上|shàng}{马路|mǎ lù}。{谢谢|xiè xie}{大家|dà jiā}！——{新城|Xīn chéng}{小区|xiǎo qū}" What happened last month?
questions.explanation: {三|sān}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}: three bikes were ridden off by someone, that is, taken. The rest of the notice is advice about where to leave bikes and how to ride safely.

questions.stem: Read the notice again: "{邻居|lín jū}{们|men}：{上|shàng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{把|bǎ}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}，{要|yào}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{门口|mén kǒu}，{那儿|nàr}{有|yǒu}{灯|dēng}。{骑车|qí chē}{出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán}：{红灯|hóng dēng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{别|bié}{走|zǒu}，{过|guò}{马路|mǎ lù}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{车|chē}。{小区|xiǎo qū}{东|dōng}{门|mén}{外边|wài bian}{的|de}{马路|mǎ lù}{上|shàng}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{早上|zǎo shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{更|gèng}{多|duō}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{骑|qí}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。{骑车|qí chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{别|bié}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{也|yě}{别|bié}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}；{晚上|wǎn shang}{骑车|qí chē}，{车|chē}{上|shàng}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{灯|dēng}。{十二|shí èr}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{骑车|qí chē}{上|shàng}{马路|mǎ lù}。{谢谢|xiè xie}{大家|dà jiā}！——{新城|Xīn chéng}{小区|xiǎo qū}" Where should bikes be left at night?
choices: by the building entrance, where there is a light
questions.explanation: {不要|bú yào}{把|bǎ}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}，{要|yào}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{门口|mén kǒu}，{那儿|nàr}{有|yǒu}{灯|dēng}: not by the road, but by the building entrance, where there's a light.

questions.stem: Read part of the same notice again: "…{小区|xiǎo qū}{东|dōng}{门|mén}{外边|wài bian}{的|de}{马路|mǎ lù}{上|shàng}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{早上|zǎo shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{更|gèng}{多|duō}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{骑|qí}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。" When is the road outside the east gate busiest?
choices: from seven to nine in the morning
questions.explanation: {马路|mǎ lù}{上|shàng}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{早上|zǎo shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{更|gèng}{多|duō}: there are lots of cars, and even more ({更|gèng}{多|duō}) from seven to nine in the morning.

questions.stem: Write the passive marker taught in this lesson (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}___ {弟弟|dì di}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 (My phone has been taken by my little brother.)
questions.explanation: {被|bèi}, bèi: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}. Ten strokes: 衤 (five strokes: dot, bent stroke, vertical, two short strokes) and {皮|pí}. In speech {让|ràng} or {叫|jiào} can take its place.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: There are two bikes standing at the door.
questions.explanation: {门口|mén kǒu}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}。 Place first ({门口|mén kǒu}), then the verb with {着|zhe} ({放|fàng}{着|zhe}), then number + measure word + thing ({两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}). Vehicles take {辆|liàng}, not {个|gè}, and the place needs no {在|zài}. {两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu} (the bikes first, with {在|zài}) is also correct, though less like a description of the scene.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He talks on the phone as he walks."?
choices: {他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
{一边|yì biān}{他|tā}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{他|tā}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
{他|tā}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}{一边|yì biān}。
{他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走路|zǒu lù}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
questions.explanation: Subject once, then {一边|yì biān} before each action: {他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}. The subject doesn't go after {一边|yì biān}, {一边|yì biān} comes before the verbs, not after them, and one {一边|yì biān} alone doesn't make the pattern.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}___。 (We went by high-speed train.)
questions.explanation: {是|shì}…{的|de} tells one detail (here, how) of a trip that has already happened: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{的|de}. The frame takes {的|de}, and the verb takes no {了|le}.

questions.stem: How do you ask "Who did you go with?"
questions.explanation: {是|shì} + the detail ({跟|gēn}{谁|shéi}{一块儿|yí kuàir}, with whom) + verb + {的|de}: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{跟|gēn}{谁|shéi}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{去|qù}{的|de}？ No {了|le} in the {是|shì}…{的|de} frame, and {跟|gēn} comes before {谁|shéi} ({跟|gēn}{谁|shéi}, with whom).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}___ {北京|Běi jīng}。 (We're leaving Beijing tomorrow.)
questions.explanation: {离开|lí kāi} + place: to leave it. {出发|chū fā} takes no object ({从|cóng}{北京|Běi jīng}{出发|chū fā}, set off from Beijing), {起飞|qǐ fēi} is for planes, and {经过|jīng guò}{北京|Běi jīng} would be "pass through Beijing".

questions.stem: What does "{到处|dào chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{人|rén}" mean?
choices: People are going all over the place.
questions.explanation: {到处|dào chù} is "everywhere", and {都|dōu}{是|shì}{人|rén} "it's all people": there are people everywhere. "Everyone has arrived" would be {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{到|dào}{了|le}.

questions.stem: A screen at the station says "{开始|kāi shǐ}{检票|jiǎn piào}". What does it mean?
choices: Boarding: tickets are now being checked.
questions.explanation: {检票|jiǎn piào} is checking tickets, so {开始|kāi shǐ}{检票|jiǎn piào} means the gate is open and you can board. A late train is {晚点|wǎn diǎn}, and a train that has left has {开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{拍|pāi}{了|le}{三百多|sān bǎi duō}___ {照片|zhào piàn}。
questions.explanation: Photos are flat things, like tickets and tables, so they take {张|zhāng}: {三百多|sān bǎi duō}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}. {本|běn} is for books and {件|jiàn} for clothes and matters.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {护照|hù zhào}, passport: two falling fourth tones (4+4).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {行李|xíng li}, luggage: a rising second tone, then a light neutral syllable. On its own {李|Lǐ} dips (lǐ, as in the surname), but in this word it is short and light.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {照|zhào}___ (photo)
questions.explanation: {照片|zhào piàn}: {片|piàn}, four strokes, half a tree trunk. {斤|jīn} (half a kilo, lesson 06) and {牙|yá} (tooth, lesson 04) look a little alike; {开|kāi} is "to open".

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {护照|hù zhào} passport, {行李|xíng li} luggage, {宾馆|bīn guǎn} hotel, {相机|xiàng jī} camera, {游客|yóu kè} tourist. A ticket is {票|piào} (HSK 2).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker suggest?

audio.text: 我们一边吃早饭一边等吧。

questions.explanation: {一边|yì biān}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}{一边|yì biān}{等|děng}: eat breakfast and wait at the same time. {吧|ba} makes it a suggestion.

questions.stem: Listen. Who did the speaker go with?

audio.text: 我是跟朋友一块儿去的。

questions.explanation: {跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{去|qù}{的|de}: went together with a friend. {是|shì}…{的|de} gives the detail, and {一块儿|yí kuàir} is the spoken {一起|yì qǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 护照带了吗？

choices: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{的|de}。
questions.explanation: "Have you brought your passport?" is answered with {带|dài}{了|le} (yes, I have) and where it is: {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{包|bāo}{里|lǐ}. The other replies are about luggage, the flight time and how they travelled.

questions.stem: Listen. When does the plane take off?

audio.text: 飞机十点起飞，我们八点到机场就行。

questions.explanation: {飞机|fēi jī}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{起飞|qǐ fēi}: the plane takes off at ten. Eight o'clock is when the speaker wants to reach the airport ({八|bā}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{机场|jī chǎng}{就|jiù}{行|xíng}, being there by eight is fine).

questions.stem: Read the blog post: "{上|shàng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{朋友|péng you}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{去|qù}{了|le}{南京|Nán jīng}。{我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{的|de}，{从|cóng}{北京|Běi jīng}{出发|chū fā}，{路上|lù shang}{经过|jīng guò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{城市|chéng shì}，{四|sì}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。{我们|wǒ men}{住|zhù}{的|de}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{中间|zhōng jiān}，{离|lí}{哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。{南京|Nán jīng}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{我们|wǒ men}{到处|dào chù}{走|zǒu}，{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{拍照|pāi zhào}，{照|zhào}{了|le}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{多|duō}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}。{第三天|dì sān tiān}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{相机|xiàng jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{原来|yuán lái}{是|shì}{被|bèi}{朋友|péng you}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，{放|fàng}{在|zài}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{的|de}{床|chuáng}{下面|xià miàn}！{离开|lí kāi}{南京|Nán jīng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}：{下|xià}{次|cì}{还|hái}{要|yào}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{来|lái}。" How did the writer get to Nanjing?
choices: by high-speed train, in four hours
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{的|de}…{四|sì}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}: by high-speed train, and they were there in four hours, passing through many cities on the way ({经过|jīng guò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{城市|chéng shì}).

questions.stem: Read the post again: "{上|shàng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{朋友|péng you}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{去|qù}{了|le}{南京|Nán jīng}。{我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{去|qù}{的|de}，{从|cóng}{北京|Běi jīng}{出发|chū fā}，{路上|lù shang}{经过|jīng guò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{城市|chéng shì}，{四|sì}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。{我们|wǒ men}{住|zhù}{的|de}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{中间|zhōng jiān}，{离|lí}{哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。{南京|Nán jīng}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{我们|wǒ men}{到处|dào chù}{走|zǒu}，{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{拍照|pāi zhào}，{照|zhào}{了|le}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{多|duō}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}。{第三天|dì sān tiān}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{相机|xiàng jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{原来|yuán lái}{是|shì}{被|bèi}{朋友|péng you}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，{放|fàng}{在|zài}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{的|de}{床|chuáng}{下面|xià miàn}！{离开|lí kāi}{南京|Nán jīng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}：{下|xià}{次|cì}{还|hái}{要|yào}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{来|lái}。" Where was the camera in the end?
choices: under the bed in the hotel
questions.explanation: {放|fàng}{在|zài}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{的|de}{床|chuáng}{下面|xià miàn}: it had been put under the bed in the hotel. {原来|yuán lái} means "it turned out".

questions.stem: Read part of the same post again: "…{第三天|dì sān tiān}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{相机|xiàng jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{原来|yuán lái}{是|shì}{被|bèi}{朋友|péng you}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，{放|fàng}{在|zài}{宾馆|bīn guǎn}{的|de}{床|chuáng}{下面|xià miàn}！" Who had taken the camera?
questions.explanation: {被|bèi}{朋友|péng you}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}: it was taken by the friend's child ({被|bèi} + doer + verb + result).

questions.stem: Write the first character of "passport" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): ___ {照|zhào}
questions.explanation: {护照|hù zhào}: {护|hù}, hù. {=The simplified form is 扌 (hand) and {户|hù}, which gives the sound. Seven strokes: 扌 first (horizontal, vertical with a hook, rising stroke), then {户|hù}.=} (Traditional {+护+} has 言 on the left and 21 strokes.)

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: She likes listening to music while she cooks.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{一边|yì biān}{听|tīng}{歌|gē}{一边|yì biān}{做饭|zuò fàn}。 {喜欢|xǐ huan} comes first, then the two actions, each with {一边|yì biān}. {又|yòu}…{又|yòu} joins qualities ({又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}), not actions done at the same moment.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{一|yī}___ {牛|niú}。
questions.explanation: Cattle take {头|tóu} (head), as in English "head of cattle": {一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}. {条|tiáo} is for long thin things ({一|yì}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}, {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}), and {个|gè} isn't used for cows.

questions.stem: Which phrase is correct?
questions.explanation: {一|yì}{只|zhī} is the general way to count animals: {一|yì}{只|zhī}{羊|yáng} (a sheep), like {一|yì}{只|zhī}{鸡|jī} and {一|yì}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}. Trees take {棵|kē} ({一|yì}{棵|kē}{树|shù}) and mountains {座|zuò} ({一|yí}{座|zuò}{山|shān}).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Lots of flowers are blooming on the mountain."?
questions.explanation: The existential {着|zhe} sentence: place + verb + {着|zhe} + thing: {山上|shān shàng}{开|kāi}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{花|huā}. The place comes first (without {在|zài}), and what is there comes last.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}___ {花|huā}。 (My mum loves growing flowers.)
questions.explanation: {养|yǎng} is to keep animals or grow plants: {养|yǎng}{花|huā}, {养|yǎng}{狗|gǒu}. {开花|kāi huā} is what the flowers do themselves (bloom), {爬|pá} is to climb and {拍|pāi} to take a photo.

questions.stem: What does "{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{吧|ba}！" suggest?
choices: going to the seaside on Saturday
questions.explanation: {爬|pá}{山|shān} is climbing a mountain or hill, usually a hike up a path, and {吧|ba} makes it a suggestion. The seaside is {海边|hǎi biān} and riding a horse {骑|qí}{马|mǎ}.

questions.stem: A friend says "{你|nǐ}{太|tài}{牛|niú}{了|le}！" after you finish a marathon. What do they mean?
questions.explanation: {牛|niú} is a cow or ox, and in friendly slang also "awesome": {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{牛|niú}{了|le}！ means "you're amazing!". Keep it for friends, not for formal writing.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {动物|dòng wù}, animal: two falling fourth tones (4+4).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {公园|gōng yuán}, park: a high level first tone, then a rising second tone (1+2).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {动|dòng}___ (animal)
questions.explanation: {动物|dòng wù}: {物|wù}, {牛|niú} on the left (its last stroke rising) and {勿|wù} for the sound. {牛|niú} alone is an ox, and {特|tè} (in {特别|tè bié}, lesson 22) also has {牛|niú} on the left.

questions.stem: Which character is hǎi, "sea"?
questions.explanation: {海|hǎi} is 氵 (water) + {每|měi}. {每|měi} alone is "every" (HSK 2), {河|hé} is a river (氵 + {可|kě}) and {汽|qì} is steam (氵 + {={气|qì}=}), as in {汽车|qì chē}.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {山|shān} mountain, {河|hé} river, {海|hǎi} sea, {树|shù} tree, {草|cǎo} grass. A flower is {花|huā} (HSK 2).

questions.stem: Listen. What is at the zoo?

audio.text: 动物园里有两只大熊猫。

questions.explanation: {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}: two giant pandas (animals are counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 我爷爷养了一头牛和很多羊。

choices: Grandpa keeps a cow and lots of sheep.
Grandpa keeps lots of cows and one sheep.
questions.explanation: {养|yǎng}{了|le}{一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}{和|hé}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{羊|yáng}: keeps one cow ({一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}) and lots of sheep ({很|hěn}{多|duō}{羊|yáng}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the right reply?

audio.text: 星期六我们去爬山吧！

choices: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}。
questions.explanation: "Let's go hiking on Saturday!" is answered by accepting: {好|hǎo}{啊|a}, with a reason to go: the flowers on the mountain are out ({山上|shān shàng}{的|de}{花|huā}{都|dōu}{开|kāi}{了|le}).

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker describing?

audio.text: 春天到了，公园里的花都开了。

choices: the flowers out in the park in spring
questions.explanation: {春天|chūn tiān}{到|dào}{了|le} (spring has come), {公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{花|huā}{都|dōu}{开|kāi}{了|le} (the flowers in the park are all out). {开|kāi} here is the {开|kāi} of {开花|kāi huā}, to bloom.

questions.stem: Read the zoo's notice: "{新城|Xīn chéng}{动物园|dòng wù yuán}。{开|kāi}{门|mén}{时间|shí jiān}：{早上|zǎo shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}（{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{不|bù}{开|kāi}{门|mén}）。{门票|mén piào}：{大人|dà ren}{四十|sì shí}{块|kuài}，{六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{门票|mén piào}。{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{动物|dòng wù}：{马|mǎ}、{牛|niú}、{羊|yáng}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{鸟|niǎo}。{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}：{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{住|zhù}{着|zhe}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}，{一|yì}{只|zhī}{五|wǔ}{岁|suì}，{一|yì}{只|zhī}{八|bā}{岁|suì}。{早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{它们|tā men}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}，{你|nǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{一边|yì biān}{看|kàn}{一边|yì biān}{拍照|pāi zhào}，{但是|dàn shì}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{给|gěi}{动物|dòng wù}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}。{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}：{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}，{也|yě}{别|bié}{爬|pá}{树|shù}。{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{东边|dōng bian}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{公园|gōng yuán}，{那儿|nàr}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。" When do the pandas eat?
questions.explanation: {早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{它们|tā men}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}: at nine in the morning they eat bamboo ({竹子|zhú zi}). Eight to five are the opening hours, and the zoo is closed on Mondays.

questions.stem: Read the notice again: "{新城|Xīn chéng}{动物园|dòng wù yuán}。{开|kāi}{门|mén}{时间|shí jiān}：{早上|zǎo shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}（{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{不|bù}{开|kāi}{门|mén}）。{门票|mén piào}：{大人|dà ren}{四十|sì shí}{块|kuài}，{六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{门票|mén piào}。{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{动物|dòng wù}：{马|mǎ}、{牛|niú}、{羊|yáng}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{鸟|niǎo}。{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}：{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{住|zhù}{着|zhe}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}，{一|yì}{只|zhī}{五|wǔ}{岁|suì}，{一|yì}{只|zhī}{八|bā}{岁|suì}。{早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{它们|tā men}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}，{你|nǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{一边|yì biān}{看|kàn}{一边|yì biān}{拍照|pāi zhào}，{但是|dàn shì}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{给|gěi}{动物|dòng wù}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}。{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}：{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}，{也|yě}{别|bié}{爬|pá}{树|shù}。{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{东边|dōng bian}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{公园|gōng yuán}，{那儿|nàr}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。" Who doesn't need a ticket?
questions.explanation: {六|liù}{岁|suì}{以下|yǐ xià}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{不要|bú yào}{门票|mén piào}: children aged six and under need no ticket. Adults pay forty yuan ({大人|dà ren}{四十|sì shí}{块|kuài}).

questions.stem: Read part of the same notice again: "…{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}：{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}，{也|yě}{别|bié}{爬|pá}{树|shù}。{动物园|dòng wù yuán}{东边|dōng bian}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{公园|gōng yuán}，{那儿|nàr}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。" Where can you sit on the grass and eat?
choices: in the small park on the east side
under the trees by the gate
questions.explanation: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{东边|dōng bian}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{公园|gōng yuán}，{那儿|nàr}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}: there's a small park on the east side where you can sit on the grass and eat. Inside the zoo, {请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu} (keep off the grass).

questions.stem: Write the character for "tree" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{棵|kē}{大|dà}___。
questions.explanation: {树|shù}, shù. {=The simplified form is 木, then {又|yòu} and 寸, nine strokes=} (traditional {+树+}: 木 and 尌, 16 strokes). {一|yì}{棵|kē}{大|dà}{树|shù} is "a big tree" ({棵|kē} is the measure word for trees).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: There are lots of people sitting on the grass in the park.
questions.explanation: {公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}。 The place first ({公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}), then the verb with {着|zhe} ({坐|zuò}{着|zhe}), then who is there ({很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}). No {在|zài} is needed before the place. With the people first, {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng} and {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe} are right too.

questions.stem: Where does the name "Silk Road" come from?
choices: It became popular after a German geographer used it in 1877.
It was the Han dynasty's own name for the route.
Zhang Qian gave it to the road.
questions.explanation: The German Seidenstraße became popular after Ferdinand von Richthofen used it in 1877 (it appears in a few German books some decades earlier). {丝绸之路|sī chóu zhī lù} is the Chinese translation. People who used the roads two thousand years ago didn't call them that.

questions.stem: Why did Emperor Wu of Han send Zhang Qian ({张骞|Zhāng Qiān}) west in 138 BCE?
choices: to find allies against the Xiongnu
to build the caves at Dunhuang
questions.explanation: He was sent to find the Yuezhi and make an alliance against the Xiongnu. The Yuezhi said no, but his reports on the western kingdoms led to missions and trade.

questions.stem: What happened to Zhang Qian on his first journey?
choices: The Xiongnu held him for more than ten years before he escaped and went on.
He founded the city of Dunhuang.
questions.explanation: The Xiongnu captured him on the way and held him for more than ten years. He escaped, reached the kingdoms of Central Asia, and came home in about 126 or 125 BCE.

questions.stem: Which of these came into China along the Silk Road?
questions.explanation: Buddhism came from India along these routes in the first centuries CE, with horses, plants such as alfalfa and grapes, and glass. Silk, and later paper, went the other way.

questions.stem: Where is Dunhuang ({敦煌|Dūn huáng})?
choices: in an oasis in Gansu province
questions.explanation: {敦煌|Dūn huáng} is an oasis town in Gansu, in the northwest of China, where the routes divided. Chang'an ({长安|Cháng'ān}, today's Xi'an) was the old capital at the eastern end.

questions.stem: When were the first Mogao Caves ({莫高窟|Mò gāo kū}) cut?
questions.explanation: Monks began cutting caves at Mogao in 366 CE, and people went on making and painting them until the 14th century. 868 is the date of the printed Diamond Sutra, and 1900 the year its library cave was found.

questions.stem: What was found in a sealed room at the Mogao Caves in 1900?
choices: a map of the whole Silk Road
old manuscripts, including the oldest dated printed book known
questions.explanation: The library cave held thousands of old manuscripts, among them a copy of the Diamond Sutra printed in 868: the oldest dated printed book known.

questions.stem: Listen. What did the traders do?

audio.text: 商人们骑着骆驼往西走。

choices: They sold camels in the west.
They walked west with their camels behind them.
questions.explanation: {商人们|shāng rén men} (the traders) {骑|qí}{着|zhe}{骆驼|luò tuo} (riding camels) {往|wǎng}{西|xī}{走|zǒu} (went west). {骑|qí}{着|zhe} is {骑|qí} with the durative {着|zhe}: the way they travelled.

questions.stem: Listen. What is in the caves?

audio.text: 敦煌的洞里有很多画儿。

questions.explanation: {洞里|dòng lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{画儿|huàr}: in the caves there are many paintings. {洞|dòng} is a cave, and {画儿|huàr} (painting) is {画|huà} with erhua.

questions.stem: Read: "{两千多年前|liǎng qiān duō nián qián}，{从|cóng}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{长安|Cháng'ān}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}，{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}。{商人们|shāng rén men}{骑|qí}{着|zhe}{马|mǎ}{和|hé}{骆驼|luò tuo}，{带|dài}{着|zhe}{丝绸|sī chóu}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}{走|zǒu}，{经过|jīng guò}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{国家|guó jiā}。" What did the traders carry west?
questions.explanation: {带|dài}{着|zhe}{丝绸|sī chóu}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}{走|zǒu}: they took silk with them going west. They rode horses and camels ({骑|qí}{着|zhe}{马|mǎ}{和|hé}{骆驼|luò tuo}); grapes came back east.

questions.stem: Read: "{路上|lù shang}{有|yǒu}{山|shān}，{有|yǒu}{河|hé}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{沙漠|shā mò}，{白天|bái tiān}{热|rè}{极|jí}{了|le}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}。{他们|tā men}{从|cóng}{西方|xī fāng}{带回来|dài huí lai}{马|mǎ}、{葡萄|pú tao}{和|hé}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{新东西|xīn dōng xi}。" Which is true?
choices: The deserts were cold all day.
There were no mountains on the way.
They brought back horses and grapes from the West.
They took grapes to the West.
questions.explanation: {从|cóng}{西方|xī fāng}{带回来|dài huí lai}{马|mǎ}、{葡萄|pú tao}{和|hé}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{新东西|xīn dōng xi}: from the West they brought back horses, grapes and many new things. The deserts were scorching by day ({白天|bái tiān}{热|rè}{极|jí}{了|le}) and cold at night, and there were mountains and rivers too.

questions.stem: Which word means "camel"?
questions.explanation: {骆驼|luò tuo} is a camel (both characters have {马|mǎ}, horse, on the left). {沙漠|shā mò} is a desert, {葡萄|pú tao} grapes and {商人|shāng rén} a trader.

questions.stem: Where do giant pandas live in the wild?
choices: in the mountains of Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu
questions.explanation: Wild giant pandas live only in the mountain bamboo forests of three provinces: {四川|Sì chuān} (Sichuan), {陕西|Shǎn xī} (Shaanxi) and {甘肃|Gān sù} (Gansu).

questions.stem: About how much of a giant panda's food is bamboo ({竹子|zhú zi})?
questions.explanation: Bamboo is about 99 percent of what they eat, although pandas belong to the meat-eating order of mammals.

questions.stem: Why does a panda spend around twelve hours a day eating?
choices: It has to store food for the winter.
It shares its food with its cubs.
It eats slowly because it is old.
questions.explanation: Bamboo gives little energy, so a panda has to eat a lot of it, and rests much of the rest of the day.

questions.stem: What did China's fourth national giant panda survey, announced in 2015, find?
questions.explanation: It counted 1,864 giant pandas in the wild (a minimum estimate). Later official reports speak of nearly 1,900.

questions.stem: What did the IUCN do in 2016?
choices: It moved the giant panda from "endangered" to "vulnerable".
It declared the panda extinct in the wild.
It moved the panda from "vulnerable" to "endangered".
It took the panda off its Red List.
questions.explanation: In 2016 the IUCN Red List moved the giant panda from "endangered" to "vulnerable", and China's Ministry of Ecology and Environment did the same in July 2021. "Vulnerable" still means at risk.

questions.stem: What is the Giant Panda National Park?
choices: a park set up in 2021 across Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu
questions.explanation: Set up in 2021 by joining several reserves, it covers parts of all three provinces and about 70 percent of the pandas' wild habitat. The breeding centre founded in 1987 is the one in Chengdu.

questions.stem: What is a {小熊猫|xiǎo xióng māo}?
choices: a giant panda in a zoo
a red panda, a smaller animal that isn't a bear
questions.explanation: {小熊猫|xiǎo xióng māo} ("little bear-cat") is the red panda, a reddish animal of the same mountains. The giant panda is {大熊猫|dà xióng māo}, a bear; its cubs are often called {熊猫宝宝|xióng māo bǎo bao}.

questions.stem: Listen. What do giant pandas love?

audio.text: 大熊猫很爱吃竹子。

questions.explanation: {很|hěn}{爱|ài}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}: they love eating bamboo ({竹子|zhú zi}).

questions.stem: Listen. How did the visitors feel?

audio.text: 我们越看越喜欢它们！

choices: The more they watched, the more they liked them.
They got bored after a while.
They liked them less and less.
questions.explanation: {越|yuè}{看|kàn}{越|yuè}{喜欢|xǐ huan}: the more they watched, the more they liked them ({越|yuè}…{越|yuè}, lesson 12). {它们|tā men} is "them" for animals.

questions.stem: Read: "{我们|wǒ men}{早上|zǎo shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}{熊猫基地|xióng māo jī dì}，{因为|yīn wèi}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{早上|zǎo shang}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}，{下午|xià wǔ}{常常|cháng cháng}{在|zài}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。" Why did they arrive so early?
choices: The base opens only in the morning.
The pandas eat in the morning and often sleep in the afternoon.
They wanted to avoid the tourists.
They had a train in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: {因为|yīn wèi}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{早上|zǎo shang}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}，{下午|xià wǔ}{常常|cháng cháng}{在|zài}{睡觉|shuì jiào}: because pandas eat in the morning and are often asleep in the afternoon. {就|jiù} after {八|bā}{点|diǎn} stresses how early that was.

questions.stem: Read: "{我们|wǒ men}{看见|kàn jiàn}{一|yì}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{地|dì}{上|shàng}，{一边|yì biān}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}{一边|yì biān}{看|kàn}{我们|wǒ men}，{好像|hǎo xiàng}{在|zài}{说|shuō}：‘{你们|nǐ men}{好|hǎo}！’" What was the panda doing?
choices: sitting on the ground, eating bamboo and looking at them
questions.explanation: {坐|zuò}{在|zài}{地|dì}{上|shàng} (sitting on the ground), {一边|yì biān}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}{一边|yì biān}{看|kàn}{我们|wǒ men} (eating bamboo and looking at us at the same time). {好像|hǎo xiàng}{在|zài}{说|shuō} is "as if it were saying".

questions.stem: The Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding was founded in 1987 with…
choices: two pandas from a zoo abroad
six pandas rescued from the wild
questions.explanation: It began in 1987 with six giant pandas rescued from the wild, and is now one of Chengdu's most visited sights.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I've been to Beijing twice."?
questions.explanation: The number + verb measure word goes after the verb and its {过|guo}: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{北京|Běi jīng} (or {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}). "How many times" never goes before the verb, a visit is counted with {次|cì} (not {遍|biàn}), and {过|guo} stays straight after the verb.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān} ___ {上海|Shàng hǎi}。 (I've been to Shanghai three times.)
questions.explanation: A visit is an occasion, counted with {次|cì}: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān}{次|cì}{上海|Shàng hǎi}. {遍|biàn} counts going through something from start to finish (a text, a film), {页|yè} counts pages, and {下|xià} quick actions.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I've met him once."?
questions.explanation: A pronoun object comes before the number: {我|wǒ}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{他|tā}{一|yí}{次|cì}. An ordinary noun usually comes after it ({我|wǒ}{读|dú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}), but ×{我|wǒ}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{他|tā} sounds wrong. Meeting someone is an occasion ({次|cì}), not a run through something ({遍|biàn}).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He said one sentence and left."?
choices: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{了|le}{一|yí}{句子|jù zi}{话|huà}{就|jiù}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {句|jù} is a measure word: {一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà} (a sentence, a remark). Nothing else goes between {一|yī} and {句|jù}, and {句|jù} is never counted with {个|gè}; the noun "sentence" is {句子|jù zi} ({一|yí}{个|gè}{句子|jù zi}).

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {医生|yī shēng}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}。
{孩子们|hái zi men}{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}。
questions.explanation: {放学|fàng xué} is "school is out": its subject is pupils or a school, {孩子们|hái zi men}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}. Adults finish work: {下班|xià bān} ({我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{下班|xià bān}, {医生|yī shēng}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{下班|xià bān}), and a company {下班|xià bān} too.

questions.stem: You want to find out how to write and read a single character. Which book do you open?
questions.explanation: A {字典|zì diǎn} lists characters one by one ({字|zì}, character); a {词典|cí diǎn} lists words ({词|cí}). {课本|kè běn} is a textbook, {笔记本|bǐ jì běn} a notebook (or a laptop), and {黑板|hēi bǎn} the blackboard.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {遍|biàn}: the fourth tone, falling, like {变|biàn} (to change). {边|biān} (side) is first tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {铅笔|qiān bǐ}, pencil: first tone, then third (1+3).

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of {页|yè} (page)?
questions.explanation: {页|yè} falls: yè. {也|yě} (also) dips; that's the one learners confuse it with.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {作|zuò} ___ (homework)
questions.explanation: {={作业|zuò yè} (homework): {业|yè}, two short verticals with a dot and a slash, and a long horizontal at the bottom. {亚|yà} yà (Asia) has a horizontal on top; {北|běi} is "north" and {也|yě} "also".=} (Traditional: {+{作业|zuò yè}+}.)

questions.stem: Which character is zhǐ, "paper"?
questions.explanation: {纸|zhǐ}: the silk radical 纟 and {氏|shì}. {低|dī} dī (low) has the person radical, {张|zhāng} is the measure word for sheets ({一|yì}{张|zhāng}{纸|zhǐ}), and {级|jí} (grade) has 纟 with {及|jí}.

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {级|jí} grade ({年级|nián jí}), {典|diǎn} classic, dictionary ({词典|cí diǎn}), {板|bǎn} board ({黑板|hēi bǎn}), {页|yè} page, {遍|biàn} once through ({读|dú}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}). "Pencil" is the word {铅笔|qiān bǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which page do the students open their books at?

audio.text: 请大家打开课本，看第三十页。

questions.explanation: {第|dì}{三十|sān shí}{页|yè} is page thirty ({三十|sān shí}, 30). Thirteen would be {十三|shí sān}, thirty-three {三十三|sān shí sān}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 这个课文我读了三遍，还是看不懂。

choices: The speaker read the text three times and still doesn't understand it.
The speaker understood the text the third time.
The speaker has read three texts.
The speaker will read the text three times tomorrow.
questions.explanation: {读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn} is "read it three times (through)", and {还是|hái shi}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng} "still can't understand it". Three texts would be {三|sān}{个|gè}{课文|kè wén}, and a plan for tomorrow would have {明天|míng tiān} and no {了|le}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the student want?

audio.text: 老师，请您再说一遍。

choices: the teacher to say it again
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{您|nín}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn} is "please say it again": {再|zài} (again) before the verb, {一|yí}{遍|biàn} (once through) after it.

questions.stem: Listen. When do they finish school?

audio.text: 你们几点放学？我们下午四点半放学。

questions.explanation: {下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}: half past four in the afternoon. {放学|fàng xué} is "school is out".

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{安娜|Ān nà}，{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{学习|xué xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{现在|xiàn zài}{上|shàng}{二|èr}{年级|nián jí}。{我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{课|kè}，{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}。{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}，{新|xīn}{的|de}{课文|kè wén}{要|yào}{读|dú}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}：{第|dì}{一|yī}{遍|biàn}{听|tīng}，{第|dì}{二|èr}{遍|biàn}{读|dú}，{第|dì}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}{写|xiě}。{我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{都|dōu}{这么|zhè me}{做|zuò}。{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{笔记本|bǐ jì běn}，{新|xīn}{的|de}{词|cí}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{上面|shàng miàn}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{五十|wǔ shí}{多|duō}{页|yè}{了|le}。" What does Anna do the third time through a new text?
choices: She looks it up in a dictionary.
questions.explanation: {第|dì}{一|yī}{遍|biàn}{听|tīng}，{第|dì}{二|èr}{遍|biàn}{读|dú}，{第|dì}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}{写|xiě}: the first time through she listens, the second she reads, the third she writes. {第|dì} + number + {遍|biàn} is "the nth time through".

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{安娜|Ān nà}，{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{学习|xué xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{现在|xiàn zài}{上|shàng}{二|èr}{年级|nián jí}。{我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{课|kè}，{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}。{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}，{新|xīn}{的|de}{课文|kè wén}{要|yào}{读|dú}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}：{第|dì}{一|yī}{遍|biàn}{听|tīng}，{第|dì}{二|èr}{遍|biàn}{读|dú}，{第|dì}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}{写|xiě}。{我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{都|dōu}{这么|zhè me}{做|zuò}。{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{笔记本|bǐ jì běn}，{新|xīn}{的|de}{词|cí}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{上面|shàng miàn}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{五十|wǔ shí}{多|duō}{页|yè}{了|le}。" Which is true?
choices: Anna has classes in the afternoon.
Anna is in her fourth year.
Anna reads each new text once.
Anna writes new words in her notebook: more than fifty pages so far.
questions.explanation: {新|xīn}{的|de}{词|cí}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{上面|shàng miàn}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{五十|wǔ shí}{多|duō}{页|yè}{了|le}: she writes the new words in her notebook and has filled more than fifty pages. Classes are in the morning ({上午|shàng wǔ}), she's in year two ({二|èr}{年级|nián jí}), and she goes through each text three times.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Yesterday I read this text three times.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{把|bǎ}{这个|zhè ge}{课文|kè wén}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。 With {把|bǎ}, the definite object ({这个|zhè ge}{课文|kè wén}) comes before the verb, and {三|sān}{遍|biàn} follows {读|dú}{了|le}. The time word {昨天|zuó tiān} can also go first: {昨天|zuó tiān}{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{这个|zhè ge}{课文|kè wén}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it means "page"; characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {请|qǐng}{看|kàn}{第|dì}{二十|èr shí} ___。
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{看|kàn}{第|dì}{二十|èr shí}{页|yè}。 {页|yè} is on the HSK 3 handwriting list: {=six strokes, with the top horizontal first and the dot last=} (traditional {+{页|yè}+}: nine).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He speaks Chinese well."?
questions.explanation: {得|de} must come straight after a verb, so with an object the verb is said twice: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (or, without the first verb, {他|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}). ×{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{得|de} puts {得|de} after the object, and ×{说|shuō}{得|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ} puts the object after {得|de}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means the same as {她|tā}{学|xué}{数学|shù xué}{学|xué}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}？
questions.explanation: The first verb can be dropped and the object put first, as a topic: {她|tā}{数学|shù xué}{学|xué}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}. {得|de} still needs its verb ({学|xué}{得|de}), so ×{数学|shù xué}{得|de} and ×{学|xué}{数学|shù xué}{得|de} are wrong, and ×{学|xué}{得|de}{数学|shù xué} puts the object after {得|de}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I revised history for three hours."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{历史|lì shǐ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{我|wǒ}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{复习|fù xí}{历史|lì shǐ}。
{我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{历史|lì shǐ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{历史|lì shǐ}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
questions.explanation: With an object and a length of time, repeat the verb and put {了|le} on the second one only: {我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{历史|lì shǐ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí} (or {我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{历史|lì shǐ}). A length of time goes after the verb, not before it.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He doesn't play basketball well."?
questions.explanation: The negative goes after {得|de}, on the "how well" part: {他|tā}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}. {不|bù} before the verb would deny the playing itself, and {得|de} must follow a verb.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I want to improve my Chinese."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{提高|tí gāo}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{提高|tí gāo}{得|de}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{高|gāo}{提|tí}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{水平|shuǐ píng}{提高|tí gāo}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
questions.explanation: {提高|tí gāo} raises a level: {提高|tí gāo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng} (raise your level of Chinese), {提高|tí gāo}{成绩|chéng jì}. {提高|tí gāo} is one word ({高|gāo}{提|tí} is nothing), it takes its object straight after it (no {得|de}), and the order is {提高|tí gāo} + {水平|shuǐ píng}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{丢|diū}{了|le}，{真|zhēn}{没|méi} ___！ (I've lost my phone, and there's nothing I can do!)
questions.explanation: A way out of a problem is {办法|bàn fǎ}: {没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ}, "nothing can be done". {方法|fāng fǎ} is a method, a way of doing something ({学习|xué xí}{方法|fāng fǎ}), and doesn't fit after {没|méi} here.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {她|tā}{做|zuò}{作业|zuò yè}{很|hěn} ___，{做|zuò}{完|wán}{了|le}{再|zài}{检查|jiǎn chá}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}，{没有|méi yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{错|cuò}{的|de}。
questions.explanation: {认真|rèn zhēn} (conscientious, careful) is an adjective and fits after {很|hěn}: she checks her work again and makes no mistakes. {提高|tí gāo}, {复习|fù xí} and {练习|liàn xí} are verbs (raise, revise, practise) and can't follow {很|hěn} like this.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {历史|lì shǐ}, history: fourth tone, then third (4+3).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {水平|shuǐ píng}, level: third tone, then second (3+2). The dip is short before another syllable.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {成|chéng} ___ (results, grades)
questions.explanation: {成绩|chéng jì}: {绩|jì}, the silk radical 纟 with {责|zé} on the right. {责|zé} alone is zé (duty), {续|xù} xù (to continue) has a different right side, and {积|jī} jī (to collect) has the grain radical {禾|hé}.

questions.stem: Which character is fù, as in fùxí (to revise)?
questions.explanation: {={复|fù}: a short slash and a horizontal, {日|rì}, and 夊 at the bottom. {夏|xià} (summer, lesson 10) looks alike but has a different top; {服|fú} fú is in {衣服|yī fu} and {父|fù} fù (father) is outside HSK 3.=} (Traditional {+{复习|fù xí}+} has {複|fù}.)

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {成|chéng} become ({成绩|chéng jì}, {完成|wán chéng}), {史|shǐ} history ({历史|lì shǐ}), {育|yù} raise, educate ({体育|tǐ yù}), {言|yán} speech ({语言|yǔ yán}), {提|tí} lift ({提高|tí gāo}). "Level" is the word {水平|shuǐ píng}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which subject is the speaker good at?

audio.text: 我数学学得不好，但是历史学得很好。

questions.explanation: {数学|shù xué}{学|xué}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo} (not good at maths), {历史|lì shǐ}{学|xué}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (good at history): verb repetition without the first verb.

questions.stem: Listen. How long did the speaker revise?

audio.text: 昨天晚上我复习了三个小时。

questions.explanation: {复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}: revised for three hours. Three times would be {三|sān}{遍|biàn} or {三|sān}{次|cì}, three o'clock {三|sān}{点|diǎn}.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened?

audio.text: 这次考试，我的成绩提高了很多。

choices: The speaker's results went up a lot.
The speaker took the exam many times.
questions.explanation: {成绩|chéng jì}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}: the results went up (improved) a lot this time.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's point?

audio.text: 学外语，方法很重要。

choices: Method matters when you learn a foreign language.
questions.explanation: {学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}，{方法|fāng fǎ}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}: in learning a foreign language, method is very important. {外语|wài yǔ} is a foreign language, {方法|fāng fǎ} a method and {重要|zhòng yào} "important" (lesson 28).

questions.stem: Read: "{小|xiǎo}{王|Wáng}{是|shì}{初中|chū zhōng}{三|sān}{年级|nián jí}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}。{他|tā}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{体育|tǐ yù}，{每天|měi tiān}{放学|fàng xué}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}，{一|yì}{打|dǎ}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{的|de}{外语|wài yǔ}{成绩|chéng jì}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{上|shàng}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{五十八|wǔ shí bā}{分|fēn}。{老师|lǎo shī}{告诉|gào su}{他|tā}：‘{你|nǐ}{打|dǎ}{球|qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{因为|yīn wèi}{你|nǐ}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}。{学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{也|yě}{一样|yí yàng}，{要|yào}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}。’{现在|xiàn zài}{小|xiǎo}{王|Wáng}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{外语|wài yǔ}。{这个|zhè ge}{学期|xué qī}，{他|tā}{的|de}{外语|wài yǔ}{成绩|chéng jì}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。" Why, says the teacher, is Xiao Wang good at basketball?
choices: He likes PE more than languages.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{打|dǎ}{球|qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{因为|yīn wèi}{你|nǐ}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}: he plays well because he practises every day, and the teacher says languages are the same ({学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{也|yě}{一样|yí yàng}).

questions.stem: Read: "{小|xiǎo}{王|Wáng}{是|shì}{初中|chū zhōng}{三|sān}{年级|nián jí}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}。{他|tā}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{体育|tǐ yù}，{每天|měi tiān}{放学|fàng xué}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}，{一|yì}{打|dǎ}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{的|de}{外语|wài yǔ}{成绩|chéng jì}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{上|shàng}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{五十八|wǔ shí bā}{分|fēn}。{老师|lǎo shī}{告诉|gào su}{他|tā}：‘{你|nǐ}{打|dǎ}{球|qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{因为|yīn wèi}{你|nǐ}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}。{学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{也|yě}{一样|yí yàng}，{要|yào}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}。’{现在|xiàn zài}{小|xiǎo}{王|Wáng}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{外语|wài yǔ}。{这个|zhè ge}{学期|xué qī}，{他|tā}{的|de}{外语|wài yǔ}{成绩|chéng jì}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。" Which is true?
choices: Xiao Wang got 85 in his last foreign-language exam.
Xiao Wang has stopped playing basketball.
Xiao Wang plays basketball for half an hour a day.
Xiao Wang's foreign-language results have gone up a lot this term.
questions.explanation: {这个|zhè ge}{学期|xué qī}，{他|tā}{的|de}{外语|wài yǔ}{成绩|chéng jì}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}. He got {五十八|wǔ shí bā}{分|fēn} (58) last time, he plays basketball for two hours ({一|yì}{打|dǎ}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}), and it's the language practice that takes half an hour.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: She speaks Chinese very well.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 With an object, say the verb twice; or drop the first {说|shuō} and put the object first: {她|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}. Either way {得|de} follows a verb.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{努|nǔ} ___ {吧|ba}！ (Let's all do our best!)
questions.explanation: {努力|nǔ lì}: {力|lì}, strength, two strokes: the horizontal-turn-hook, then the slash. It's on the HSK 3 handwriting list.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "The teacher speaks too fast: I can't understand."?
questions.explanation: "Can't understand (by listening)" is the potential complement {听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}. Chinese doesn't use {不|bù}{能|néng} + {听|tīng}{懂|dǒng} for this, and {没|méi} goes with the result complement ({没|méi}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng}: didn't understand), never with {得|de}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ} ___ {他|tā}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}，{他|tā}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}！ (I thought he was a teacher, but he's a student!)
questions.explanation: A belief that turned out wrong takes {以为|yǐ wéi}: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{他|tā}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}. {认为|rèn wéi} and {觉得|jué de} give an opinion, and {知道|zhī dào} is "to know" a fact, which can't be wrong.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {你|nǐ} ___ {这个|zhè ge}{方法|fāng fǎ}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ (What do you think of this method?)
questions.explanation: Asking for an opinion: {你|nǐ}{认为|rèn wéi}…{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ ({觉得|jué de} works too). {以为|yǐ wéi} is for a mistaken belief, {听说|tīng shuō} is "to hear that", and {认得|rèn de} "to recognise".

questions.stem: What does {老师|lǎo shī}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu} mean?
choices: The teacher wants to explain it.
questions.explanation: With {很|hěn}, {讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu} is a degree complement: how well the teacher explains. Without {很|hěn}, {讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{清楚|qīng chu} would usually be the potential "can explain clearly", and its negative {讲|jiǎng}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu} "can't explain clearly".

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I can't understand anything."?
questions.explanation: A non-interrogative {什么|shén me} ("anything") goes before the verb with {都|dōu} (or {也|yě}) after it: {我|wǒ}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}. Without {都|dōu} the sentence doesn't work, and {什么|shén me}{都|dōu} can't come after the verb.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This character is hard to write."?
questions.explanation: {难|nán} goes straight before the verb, like {好|hǎo} in {好吃|hǎo chī}: {难|nán}{写|xiě} (hard to write), and the degree word before {难|nán}: {很|hěn}{难|nán}{写|xiě}.

questions.stem: How is {了|le} read in {了解|liǎo jiě} (to find out about)?
questions.explanation: In {了解|liǎo jiě} the first character is liǎo, third tone (said liáo before {解|jiě}, by third-tone sandhi). The particle {了|le} is a different reading of the same character.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {回答|huí dá}, to answer: two rising tones (2+2).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {聪明|cōng ming}, clever: first tone, then a light neutral tone (1+neutral).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {回|huí} ___ (to answer)
questions.explanation: {回答|huí dá}: {答|dá}, the bamboo radical ⺮ over {合|hé}. {合|hé} hé alone has no bamboo top, {笑|xiào} (to laugh) has ⺮ over {夭|yāo}, and {塔|tǎ} tǎ (tower) has the earth radical.

questions.stem: Which character is jiǎng, "to explain"?
questions.explanation: {={讲|jiǎng}: the speech radical 讠 and {井|jǐng} jǐng (a well), which gives the sound. {进|jìn} jìn (to enter) has 辶, and {讨|tǎo} tǎo has 寸 on the right.=} (Traditional {+{讲|jiǎng}+} has 冓 on the right.)

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {难|nán} difficult, {解|jiě} untie, explain ({了解|liǎo jiě}), {清|qīng} clear ({清楚|qīng chu}), {简|jiǎn} simple ({简单|jiǎn dān}), {容|róng} contain ({容易|róng yì}). "Clever" is the word {聪明|cōng ming}.

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the speaker ask for it again?

audio.text: 对不起，我没听清楚，您能再说一遍吗？

choices: The speaker didn't hear it clearly.
The speaker wants to write it down.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听|tīng}{清楚|qīng chu}: "I didn't hear it clearly" (a result complement with {没|méi}), so {您|nín}{能|néng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}{吗|ma}？ (could you say it again?).

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 我以为今天有考试，但是今天没有。

choices: The speaker knew there was no exam.
The speaker thought there was an exam today, but there isn't.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{考试|kǎo shì}: "I thought there was an exam today", and {但是|dàn shì}{今天|jīn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu} shows the belief was wrong. That's what {以为|yǐ wéi} signals.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about the question?

audio.text: 这个问题很容易，谁都会回答。

choices: Only the teacher can answer it.
questions.explanation: {很|hěn}{容易|róng yì} (very easy), {谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{回答|huí dá} (anyone can answer it): the non-interrogative {谁|shéi} with {都|dōu} means "anyone, everyone".

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's opinion?

audio.text: 我认为学汉语，听和说很有用。

choices: Listening and speaking are very useful.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}… gives an opinion: in learning Chinese, listening and speaking ({听|tīng}{和|hé}{说|shuō}) are very useful.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{大卫|Dà wèi}。{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{课|kè}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。{但是|dàn shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}，{我|wǒ}{差不多|chà bu duō}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}，{就|jiù}{去|qù}{问|wèn}{老师|lǎo shī}。{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}：‘{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}{没关系|méi guān xi}，{你|nǐ}{每天|měi tiān}{听|tīng}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng}{了|le}。’{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{话|huà}。{现在|xiàn zài}，{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}{了|le}，{也|yě}{认得|rèn de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{字|zì}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}，{学|xué}{语言|yǔ yán}{要|yào}{多|duō}{听|tīng}。" What did David think of his Chinese classes at first?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{课|kè}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}: he thought (wrongly) that the classes would be simple. {以为|yǐ wéi} tells you he was wrong: the teacher spoke fast and he understood almost nothing.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{叫|jiào}{大卫|Dà wèi}。{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{课|kè}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。{但是|dàn shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}，{我|wǒ}{差不多|chà bu duō}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}，{就|jiù}{去|qù}{问|wèn}{老师|lǎo shī}。{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}：‘{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}{没关系|méi guān xi}，{你|nǐ}{每天|měi tiān}{听|tīng}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng}{了|le}。’{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{话|huà}。{现在|xiàn zài}，{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}{了|le}，{也|yě}{认得|rèn de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{字|zì}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}，{学|xué}{语言|yǔ yán}{要|yào}{多|duō}{听|tīng}。" What did the teacher suggest?
choices: Listening to the text three times a day.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{每天|měi tiān}{听|tīng}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}: listen to the text three times a day, and in a month you'll understand. Now he can understand the teacher ({听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}) and recognises many characters ({认得|rèn de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{字|zì}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I can't see these characters on the board clearly.
questions.explanation: {黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{的|de}{字|zì}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。 The thing seen often comes first as the topic, then the potential complement {看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu} ("can't see clearly"). {我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}{黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{的|de}{字|zì} is also correct. {得|de} would make the positive {看|kàn}{得|de}{清楚|qīng chu}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {请|qǐng}{回|huí} ___ {我|wǒ}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。 (Please answer my question.)
questions.explanation: {回答|huí dá} (to answer): {答|dá}, twelve strokes, the bamboo radical ⺮ over {合|hé}. It's on the HSK 3 handwriting list.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I took three days off."?
questions.explanation: {请假|qǐng jià} is a separable verb: {了|le} goes after the verb part and the quantity before the object part, {请|qǐng}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jià}. ×{请假|qǐng jià}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān} treats it like an ordinary verb, and the time doesn't go before the verb.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "We had a two-hour meeting."?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{开|kāi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{会|huì}。
{我们|wǒ men}{开会|kāi huì}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{开会|kāi huì}{了|le}。
{我们|wǒ men}{开|kāi}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{了|le}{会|huì}。
questions.explanation: {开会|kāi huì} is separable: {开|kāi}{了|le} + {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de} + {会|huì}. A length of time inside it often takes {的|de}. ×{开会|kāi huì}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí} puts the time after the whole word, and {了|le} belongs right after {开|kāi}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Do you need my help?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{需要|xū yào}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{帮忙|bāng máng}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{需要|xū yào}{我|wǒ}{帮忙|bāng máng}{吗|ma}？ is "do you need me to help?": {需要|xū yào} + person + verb. {我|wǒ}{需要|xū yào}{你|nǐ}{帮忙|bāng máng}{吗|ma} asks the opposite, {帮忙|bāng máng} can't take an object straight after it ({帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng}, or {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}), and {了|le} doesn't fit a question about now.

questions.stem: How is {要|yào} read in {要求|yāo qiú} (to require)?
questions.explanation: In {要求|yāo qiú} the {要|yào} is yāo, first tone; in {需要|xū yào}, {不要|bú yào} and {要|yào} "to want" it's yào.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{跟|gēn}{经理|jīng lǐ} ___ {了|le}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{假|jià}。 (I was ill and asked the manager for a day off.)
questions.explanation: Asking for leave is {请假|qǐng jià}: {跟|gēn}{经理|jīng lǐ}{请|qǐng}{了|le}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{假|jià}. {放假|fàng jià} is when the school or company closes for everyone, {休假|xiū jià} is taking your holiday, and {开|kāi} goes with {会|huì} ({开会|kāi huì}).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{我们|wǒ men}{怎么|zěn me} ___？ (How shall we solve this problem?)
questions.explanation: A problem is solved: {解决|jiě jué}{问题|wèn tí}. {完成|wán chéng} is for a task or a piece of work ({完成|wán chéng}{工作|gōng zuò}), {决定|jué dìng} is "to decide", and {服务|fú wù} "to serve".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {经理|jīng lǐ}, manager: first tone, then third (1+3).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {同事|tóng shì}, colleague: second tone, then fourth (2+4).

questions.stem: What does {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{干|gàn}{什么|shén me}{呢|ne}？ mean?
questions.explanation: {干|gàn} gàn is a spoken "to do", so {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{干|gàn}{什么|shén me}{呢|ne}？ is the casual {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{做|zuò}{什么|shén me}{呢|ne}？ The {干|gàn} of {干净|gān jìng} (clean, dry) is gān, a different word (traditional {乾|gān}; "do" is {幹|gàn}).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {决|jué} ___ (to decide)
questions.explanation: {决定|jué dìng}: {定|dìng}, the roof 宀 over a form of {正|zhèng}. {是|shì}, {走|zǒu} and {足|zú} have similar bottoms but no roof.

questions.stem: Which character is qiú, as in yāoqiú (to require)?
questions.explanation: {求|qiú}: a horizontal, a vertical hook, dots and slanting strokes on both sides, and a dot at the top right. {水|shuǐ} is water, {永|yǒng} yǒng (forever) is the right side of {泳|yǒng}, and {救|jiù} jiù (to save) has 攵 beside {求|qiú}.

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {议|yì} discuss ({会议|huì yì}), {理|lǐ} reason, manage ({经理|jīng lǐ}), {决|jué} decide ({解决|jiě jué}, {决定|jué dìng}), {需|xū} need ({需要|xū yào}), {假|jià} time off ({请假|qǐng jià}). "Colleague" is the word {同事|tóng shì}.

questions.stem: Listen. Where is the manager?

audio.text: 经理正在开会呢，你下午再来吧。

questions.explanation: {正在|zhèng zài}{开会|kāi huì}{呢|ne}: in a meeting right now, so {你|nǐ}{下午|xià wǔ}{再|zài}{来|lái}{吧|ba} (come back in the afternoon).

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker going to do next week?

audio.text: 下个星期我要休假，去上海看我爸爸妈妈。

choices: take a holiday and visit their parents in Shanghai
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{休假|xiū jià} (take a holiday), {去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{看|kàn}{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{妈妈|mā ma} (go to Shanghai to see my parents).

questions.stem: Listen. How long will the work take?

audio.text: 这个工作需要三个工作日。

questions.explanation: {需要|xū yào}{三|sān}{个|gè}{工作日|gōng zuò rì}: it needs three working days. {需要|xū yào} + an amount of time is "takes".

questions.stem: Listen. What happens in July?

audio.text: 我们学校七月放假。

questions.explanation: {放假|fàng jià} is "to have a holiday" for everyone: the school breaks up in July ({七|qī}{月|yuè}). The start of term is {开学|kāi xué}.

questions.stem: Read the note: "{王|Wáng}{经理|jīng lǐ}：{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{带|dài}{他|tā}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}，{想|xiǎng}{请|qǐng}{上午|shàng wǔ}{的|de}{假|jià}。{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{我|wǒ}{回|huí}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。{李强|Lǐ Qiáng} {十|shí}{月|yuè}{九|jiǔ}{日|rì}" Which time off does Li Qiang ask for?
questions.explanation: {想|xiǎng}{请|qǐng}{上午|shàng wǔ}{的|de}{假|jià}: the morning off; he'll be back in the office at two ({下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{我|wǒ}{回|huí}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}). The time sits inside {请假|qǐng jià}: {请|qǐng} + {上午|shàng wǔ}{的|de} + {假|jià}.

questions.stem: Read the note: "{王|Wáng}{经理|jīng lǐ}：{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{带|dài}{他|tā}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}，{想|xiǎng}{请|qǐng}{上午|shàng wǔ}{的|de}{假|jià}。{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{我|wǒ}{回|huí}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。{李强|Lǐ Qiáng} {十|shí}{月|yuè}{九|jiǔ}{日|rì}" Why does Li Qiang need the time off?
choices: He has a meeting at the hospital.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{病|bìng}{了|le}: his child is ill, and he's taking him to the hospital ({带|dài}{他|tā}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'd like to take two days off next week.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{想|xiǎng}{请|qǐng}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{假|jià}。 The quantity {两|liǎng}{天|tiān} goes inside the separable verb {请假|qǐng jià}; the time word goes before the verb (also {下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}… or {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{请|qǐng}…). No {了|le} for a plan.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{想|xiǎng}{请|qǐng}{一|yì}{天|tiān} ___。 (I'd like to take a day off tomorrow.)
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{假|jià}: {假|jià}, time off, with the person radical 亻 on the left. It's on the HSK 3 handwriting list.

questions.stem: Which phrase means "a book about Chinese history"?
choices: {一|yì}{本|běn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{关于|guān yú}{的|de}{书|shū}
{一|yì}{本|běn}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}
{一|yì}{本|běn}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{书|shū}
{关于|guān yú}{一|yì}{本|běn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}
questions.explanation: Before a noun, {关于|guān yú} + topic + {的|de}: {一|yì}{本|běn}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}. The {的|de} is needed, and the measure phrase {一|yì}{本|běn} stays at the front of the whole noun phrase.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This has to do with the weather."?
questions.explanation: A {跟|gēn} B {有关|yǒu guān}: {这|zhè}{跟|gēn}{天气|tiān qì}{有关|yǒu guān}. {跟|gēn} + the thing it's related to comes before {有关|yǒu guān}, and {关于|guān yú} ("about") isn't a verb, so it can't end the sentence or replace {有关|yǒu guān}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}，{我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{写|xiě}{一百|yì bǎi}{个|gè}{字|zì}。 (As the teacher requires, we write a hundred characters a day.)
questions.explanation: {根据|gēn jù} is "according to, on the basis of": {根据|gēn jù}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}. {关于|guān yú} is "about (a topic)", {有关|yǒu guān} "to have to do with", and {关心|guān xīn} "to care about".

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{收到|shōu dào}{了|le}{两|liǎng} ___ {邮件|yóu jiàn}。
questions.explanation: Letters and emails take {封|fēng}: {两|liǎng}{封|fēng}{邮件|yóu jiàn}, {一|yì}{封|fēng}{信|xìn}. {张|zhāng} is for flat things such as paper and tickets, {页|yè} for pages and {本|běn} for books. ({个|gè} is heard with {邮件|yóu jiàn} in speech, but {封|fēng} is the measure word to learn.)

questions.stem: A friend asks how you are after you've been ill. You say: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de} ___！
questions.explanation: {关心|guān xīn} is caring about a person: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{关心|guān xīn} (thank you for your concern). {关注|guān zhù} is following news or events closely, {关于|guān yú} is "about", and {影响|yǐng xiǎng} "influence".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{响|xiǎng}{了|le}，{但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{没|méi} ___。 (His phone rang, but he didn't answer.)
questions.explanation: Answering the phone is {接|jiē}{电话|diàn huà}: {他|tā}{没|méi}{接|jiē}. {发|fā} is "to send", {收|shōu} "to receive (mail)", and {送|sòng} "to give as a present".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{的|de} ___ {很|hěn}{大|dà}。 (This book had a big influence on me.)
questions.explanation: {影响|yǐng xiǎng} is also a noun, "influence": {对|duì}…{的|de}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}. {新闻|xīn wén} is news, {节目|jié mù} a programme, and {心里|xīn li} "in one's heart".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {新闻|xīn wén}, news: first tone, then second (1+2).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {影响|yǐng xiǎng}, to affect: two third tones (3+3). You hear 2+3 (yíng xiǎng) by third-tone sandhi; both answers count.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {新|xīn} ___ (news)
questions.explanation: {新闻|xīn wén}: {闻|wén}, the ear {耳|ěr} inside the door {门|mén}. {问|wèn} (to ask) has {口|kǒu} inside, {间|jiān} (room) has {日|rì}, and {们|men} has 亻 beside {门|mén}.

questions.stem: Which character is xiǎng, as in yǐngxiǎng (to affect)?
questions.explanation: {={响|xiǎng}: {口|kǒu} and {向|xiàng} xiàng, which gives the sound. {向|xiàng} alone is "towards", {想|xiǎng} (to think) has {心|xīn} at the bottom, and {香|xiāng} (fragrant) has {禾|hé} over {日|rì}.=} (Traditional {+{影响|yǐng xiǎng}+}: {+{响|xiǎng}+} is {鄉|xiāng} over {音|yīn}.)

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {邮|yóu} post ({邮件|yóu jiàn}), {封|fēng} seal, envelope ({一|yì}{封|fēng}{信|xìn}), {接|jiē} receive ({接|jiē}{电话|diàn huà}), {目|mù} eye ({节目|jié mù}), {根|gēn} root ({根据|gēn jù}). "Newspaper" is the word {报纸|bào zhǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. When did the speaker send the email?

audio.text: 你收到我的邮件了吗？我昨天晚上发给你了。

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{了|le}: "I sent it to you yesterday evening". {你|nǐ}{收到|shōu dào}…{了|le}{吗|ma}？ asks whether it arrived.

questions.stem: Listen. What will the weather be like tomorrow?

audio.text: 根据天气预报，明天会下雪。

questions.explanation: {根据|gēn jù}{天气预报|tiān qì yù bào} (according to the weather forecast), {明天|míng tiān}{会|huì}{下|xià}{雪|xuě} (it will snow tomorrow).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker's grandfather do every morning?

audio.text: 我爷爷每天早上都看报纸。

questions.explanation: {看|kàn}{报纸|bào zhǐ}: reads the newspaper. TV news would be {电视|diàn shì}{新闻|xīn wén}, and e-books {电子书|diàn zǐ shū}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the programme about?

audio.text: 这个电视节目跟中国历史有关。

questions.explanation: {跟|gēn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{有关|yǒu guān}: it has to do with Chinese history. {节目|jié mù} is a programme.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{关于|guān yú}{开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{通知|tōng zhī}：{根据|gēn jù}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}，{本|běn}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{会议|huì yì}{室|shì}{开会|kāi huì}，{时间|shí jiān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{准时|zhǔn shí}{到|dào}。{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{同事|tóng shì}，{请|qǐng}{发|fā}{邮件|yóu jiàn}{给|gěi}{小|xiǎo}{李|Lǐ}。{办公室|bàn gōng shì} {十|shí}{月|yuè}{十二|shí èr}{日|rì}" ({通知|tōng zhī}: notice; {准时|zhǔn shí}: on time) When and where is the meeting?
choices: Friday at 2 p.m., in the meeting room on the third floor
Thursday at 2 p.m., on the second floor
Friday at 3 p.m., in the meeting room
questions.explanation: {本|běn}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn} (this Friday at two in the afternoon), {在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{会议|huì yì}{室|shì} (in the third-floor meeting room). {十|shí}{月|yuè}{十二|shí èr}{日|rì} is the date of the notice.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{关于|guān yú}{开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{通知|tōng zhī}：{根据|gēn jù}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}，{本|běn}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{会议|huì yì}{室|shì}{开会|kāi huì}，{时间|shí jiān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{准时|zhǔn shí}{到|dào}。{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{同事|tóng shì}，{请|qǐng}{发|fā}{邮件|yóu jiàn}{给|gěi}{小|xiǎo}{李|Lǐ}。{办公室|bàn gōng shì} {十|shí}{月|yuè}{十二|shí èr}{日|rì}" ({通知|tōng zhī}: notice; {准时|zhǔn shí}: on time) What should colleagues with questions do?
questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{同事|tóng shì}，{请|qǐng}{发|fā}{邮件|yóu jiàn}{给|gěi}{小|xiǎo}{李|Lǐ}: colleagues with questions should email Xiao Li. {发|fā}{邮件|yóu jiàn} is "to send an email".

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I sent the manager an email.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{经理|jīng lǐ}{发|fā}{了|le}{一|yì}{封|fēng}{邮件|yóu jiàn}。 {给|gěi} + person comes before the verb, and emails are counted with {封|fēng} (not {张|zhāng}, which is for paper and tickets).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{新|xīn} ___ {了|le}{吗|ma}？ (Have you seen today's news?)
questions.explanation: {新闻|xīn wén}: {闻|wén}, {耳|ěr} (ear) inside {门|mén} (door), {=nine strokes=} (traditional {+{闻|wén}+}: fourteen). It's on the HSK 3 handwriting list.

questions.stem: What was Confucius ({孔子|Kǒng zǐ}) above all, in the way he is remembered in China?
questions.explanation: He held office in the state of Lu for a time, but above all he was a teacher, with a great many students ({弟子|dì zǐ}) by tradition.

questions.stem: What are the traditional dates of Confucius?
questions.explanation: By Chinese tradition he was born in 551 BCE and died in 479 BCE; the sources were written later, so the dates are traditional. 221–206 BCE is the Qin dynasty, 618–907 the Tang, and 1701–1754 the life of the novelist Wu Jingzi.

questions.stem: Who put the Analects (《{论语|Lún yǔ}》) together?
choices: an emperor of the Qing dynasty
his students and their students, after his death
questions.explanation: The Analects collects what his students and their students remembered him saying and doing; it was put together after his death and reached roughly its present form later still.

questions.stem: Many passages of the Analects begin with {子曰|zǐ yuē}. What does it mean?
questions.explanation: {子|zǐ} zǐ is "master" (as in {孔子|Kǒng zǐ}) and {曰|yuē} yuē "to say": {子曰|zǐ yuē}, "the Master said".

questions.stem: How is 说 read in 不亦说乎 (isn't it a pleasure?)
questions.explanation: Here {说|shuō} is read yuè: it's an old way of writing {悦|yuè} (pleased). In modern Chinese {说|shuō} is shuō, "to say".

questions.stem: Which line means "Go over the old and learn something new from it, and you can be a teacher"?
choices: {学而时习之|xué ér shí xí zhī}，{不亦说乎|bú yì yuè hū}？
{有朋自远方来|yǒu péng zì yuǎn fāng lái}，{不亦乐乎|bú yì lè hū}？
{三人行|sān rén xíng}，{必有我师焉|bì yǒu wǒ shī yān}。
{温故而知新|wēn gù ér zhī xīn}，{可以为师矣|kě yǐ wéi shī yǐ}。
questions.explanation: {温|wēn} (warm up, go over) {故|gù} (the old) {而|ér} (and) {知|zhī} (know) {新|xīn} (the new), {可以|kě yǐ}{为|wéi}{师|shī}{矣|yǐ} (can be a teacher). The others are about learning and practising, a friend from far away, and three people walking together.

questions.stem: What does the saying {三人行|sān rén xíng}，{必有我师焉|bì yǒu wǒ shī yān} mean today?
choices: Teachers should walk with their students.
questions.explanation: "When three people walk together, there is sure to be a teacher of mine among them": among any people there is someone to learn from.

questions.stem: In {不|bú}{亦|yì}{说|yuè}{乎|hū}？, the final {乎|hū} works like which modern word?
questions.explanation: {乎|hū} hū is a classical question particle, like {吗|ma}: {不|bú}{亦|yì}{说|yuè}{乎|hū}？ is roughly {不|bù}{也|yě}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{快乐|kuài lè}{的|de}{事|shì}{吗|ma}？ ({矣|yǐ} at the end of the third line is closer to {了|le}.)

questions.stem: Listen. What does the sentence say?

audio.text: 孔子是中国很有名的老师。

choices: Confucius was a famous teacher in China.
Confucius lived in a famous city.
