questions.explanation: {孔子|Kǒng zǐ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}: Confucius was a very famous teacher in China. (He didn't write the Analects himself.)

questions.stem: Listen to the modern paraphrase. What is the advice?

audio.text: 学了的东西要经常复习。

choices: Ask your teacher when you don't understand.
Regularly go over what you've learned.
questions.explanation: {学|xué}{了|le}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi} (what you've learned) {要|yào}{经常|jīng cháng}{复习|fù xí} (should be regularly reviewed): the modern Chinese for {学|xué}{而|ér}{时|shí}{习|xí}{之|zhī}.

questions.stem: Read: "{孔子|Kǒng zǐ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}。{两千五百|liǎng qiān wǔ bǎi}{多|duō}{年|nián}{前|qián}，{他|tā}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{鲁国|Lǔ guó}。{他|tā}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{学生|xué sheng}，{他|tā}{教|jiāo}{学生|xué sheng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{不|bú}{看|kàn}{学生|xué sheng}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{没有|méi yǒu}{钱|qián}。" What didn't Confucius care about when he taught?
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{看|kàn}{学生|xué sheng}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{没有|méi yǒu}{钱|qián}: he didn't look at whether the students' families had money.

questions.stem: Read: "{孔子|Kǒng zǐ}{死|sǐ}{了|le}，{他|tā}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}{记|jì}{了|le}{下来|xià lái}，{这|zhè}{就|jiù}{是|shì}《{论语|Lún yǔ}》。{现在|xiàn zài}，{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{还|hái}{在|zài}{读|dú}《{论语|Lún yǔ}》{里|lǐ}{的|de}{句子|jù zi}。" What is the Analects, according to the text?
choices: a history of the state of Lu
a book Confucius wrote for his students
the words of Confucius, written down by his students
questions.explanation: {他|tā}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}{记|jì}{了|le}{下来|xià lái}: his students wrote down what he had said, and that is the 《{论语|Lún yǔ}》. {记|jì} is "to note down".

questions.stem: In which dynasty did the imperial examinations ({科举|kē jǔ}) begin? (The year usually given is 605.)
questions.explanation: The examinations begin under the Sui dynasty (581–618); 605 is the year usually given, though some historians prefer 607 or earlier. The Tang expanded them, and the Qing ended them.

questions.stem: When were the imperial examinations ended?
questions.explanation: The Qing court ended them in 1905, about thirteen hundred years after they began. 1952 is the first {高考|gāo kǎo}.

questions.stem: What was the candidate who came first in the palace examination called?
questions.explanation: {状元|zhuàng yuan} was the top candidate of the palace examination. {秀才|xiù cai} passed the local level, {举人|jǔ rén} the provincial level, and {进士|jìn shì} the examinations in the capital.

questions.stem: A {举人|jǔ rén} had passed which examination?
questions.explanation: {举人|jǔ rén} passed the provincial examination (Ming and Qing). Fan Jin, in the story, becomes a {举人|jǔ rén} after many tries.

questions.stem: What was the "eight-legged essay" ({八股文|bā gǔ wén})?
choices: an essay in a fixed number of parts, on the Confucian classics
an essay written in eight days
questions.explanation: From the Ming dynasty on, answers were written as an essay in a fixed form, with rules for each part; critics said form had become more important than thinking.

questions.stem: What does the saying {行行出状元|háng háng chū zhuàng yuan} mean?
questions.explanation: {行|háng} háng is a trade or profession, and {状元|zhuàng yuan} the top candidate: in every line of work someone can be the best.

questions.stem: What is the novel 《{儒林外史|Rú lín wài shǐ}》 (The Scholars) by {吴敬梓|Wú Jìng zǐ}?
choices: a history of the Tang dynasty
a guide to passing the exams
a novel that makes fun of scholars and the examination system
questions.explanation: The 18th-century novel by Wu Jingzi (1701–1754) satirises scholars and the examination system; Fan Jin's story is its best-known scene.

questions.stem: When was the national college entrance examination ({高考|gāo kǎo}) first held?
questions.explanation: The first {高考|gāo kǎo} was in 1952. It was cancelled in 1966 and brought back in late 1977; today it starts on 7 June.

questions.stem: Listen. How old was Fan Jin?

audio.text: 范进五十多岁的时候考上了举人。

questions.explanation: {五十|wǔ shí}{多|duō}{岁|suì}: over fifty. {考|kǎo}{上|shàng}{了|le}{举人|jǔ rén} is "passed and became a juren".

questions.stem: Listen. When does the {高考|gāo kǎo} start?

audio.text: 高考每年六月七号开始。

questions.explanation: {六|liù}{月|yuè}{七|qī}{号|hào}: 7 June (dates go month, then day). It starts on 7 June every year.

questions.stem: Read: "{范进|Fàn Jìn}{不|bú}{信|xìn}，{回家|huí jiā}{一|yí}{看|kàn}，{真|zhēn}{的|de}{考|kǎo}{上|shàng}{了|le}。{他|tā}{太|tài}{高兴|gāo xìng}{了|le}，{大|dà}{笑|xiào}{起来|qǐ lái}，{一边|yì biān}{笑|xiào}{一边|yì biān}{往|wǎng}{外|wài}{跑|pǎo}，{他|tā}{疯|fēng}{了|le}！" ({疯|fēng}: mad) What happened when Fan Jin saw he had passed?
choices: He laughed and ran outside: he had gone mad with joy.
He cried for a long time.
He went back to the market.
questions.explanation: {大|dà}{笑|xiào}{起来|qǐ lái} (burst out laughing), {一边|yì biān}{笑|xiào}{一边|yì biān}{往|wǎng}{外|wài}{跑|pǎo} (ran outside laughing), {他|tā}{疯|fēng}{了|le} (he had gone mad).

questions.stem: Read: "{范进|Fàn Jìn}{最|zuì}{怕|pà}{他|tā}{的|de}{岳父|yuè fù}。{胡屠户|Hú tú hù}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{打|dǎ}，{因为|yīn wèi}{范进|Fàn Jìn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{是|shì}{举人|jǔ rén}{了|le}。{但是|dàn shì}{大家|dà jiā}{要求|yāo qiú}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}，{他|tā}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{范进|Fàn Jìn}{一下|yí xià}。" ({怕|pà}: to fear; {岳父|yuè fù}: father-in-law) Why didn't Butcher Hu want to hit Fan Jin?
choices: Fan Jin was now a juren.
He was afraid of Fan Jin's mother.
questions.explanation: {因为|yīn wèi}{范进|Fàn Jìn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{是|shì}{举人|jǔ rén}{了|le}: because Fan Jin was already a juren, a man of rank. Everyone insisted ({大家|dà jiā}{要求|yāo qiú}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}), so he hit him once.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "We're playing against Class 3."?
questions.explanation: The other side of a match takes {跟|gēn}: {我们|wǒ men}{跟|gēn}{三|sān}{班|bān}{比赛|bǐ sài}. {比赛|bǐ sài} doesn't take the opponent as an object, and {参加|cān jiā} takes an event ({参加|cān jiā}{比赛|bǐ sài}), not a team or a person.

questions.stem: How is 得 read in "{他|tā}得{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}。" (He came first.)?
questions.explanation: Here 得 is the verb "to get, to win": {得|dé}, second tone. The light {得|de} is the particle of degree complements ({他|tā}{跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}), and {得|děi} "must" comes in lesson 27.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā} ___ {了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{的|de}{关心|guān xīn}。 (He received a lot of people's care.)
questions.explanation: {得到|dé dào} is "to get, to receive" for things that come to you: care, help, a ticket. {收到|shōu dào} is for things sent to you (a letter, a message), {得分|dé fēn} is "to score", and {参加|cān jiā} takes an event.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {等|děng}{了|le}{半天|bàn tiān}，{他|tā} ___ {来|lái}{了|le}。 (After waiting for ages, at last he came.)
questions.explanation: {终于|zhōng yú} is "at last": something you waited for has happened, so the sentence ends in {了|le}. {一直|yì zhí} is "the whole time" ({他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{来|lái}, he didn't come the whole time), {已经|yǐ jīng} "already", {马上|mǎ shàng} "right away".

questions.stem: What time is "{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{三|sān}{刻|kè}"?
questions.explanation: {刻|kè} is a quarter of an hour, so {三|sān}{刻|kè} is three quarters: 2:45. 2:15 is {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè} and 2:30 is {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn} (there's no {两|liǎng}{刻|kè}).

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {这|zhè} ___ {时间|shí jiān}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。 (I've been busy these days.)
questions.explanation: {段|duàn} is the measure word for a stretch or a period: {一|yí}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}, {这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}, {一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù}. {刻|kè} is a quarter of an hour, and {次|cì} counts times.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {一|yī}___ (the whole time; straight on)
questions.explanation: {一直|yì zhí}: 直 is {十|shí} on top, 目 in the middle and a long horizontal at the bottom. {真|zhēn} (really) has {八|bā} at the bottom, 自 (self) has no {十|shí} on top, and {百|bǎi} is a hundred.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {比赛|bǐ sài} match, {参加|cān jiā} take part in, {得分|dé fēn} to score, {终于|zhōng yú} at last, {一直|yì zhí} the whole time. "To jump" is {跳|tiào}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker asking?

audio.text: 我们学校明天开运动会，你参加吗？

choices: whether you'll take part in the sports meeting
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{明天|míng tiān}{开|kāi}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}，{你|nǐ}{参加|cān jiā}{吗|ma}？ "Our school has its sports meeting tomorrow: are you taking part?" {参加|cān jiā} + {运动会|yùn dòng huì}.

questions.stem: Listen. When does the match start?

audio.text: 比赛三点一刻开始，我们三点在体育馆门口见吧。

questions.explanation: {比赛|bǐ sài}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{开始|kāi shǐ}: the match starts at 3:15. They're meeting at three ({三|sān}{点|diǎn}) at the door of the sports hall. 3:45 would be {三|sān}{点|diǎn}{三|sān}{刻|kè}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 他每天下午都去球场练习网球，这次比赛他终于得了第一名。

questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{比赛|bǐ sài}{他|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{得|dé}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}: this time he finally came first. He practises tennis ({网球|wǎng qiú}) on the court every afternoon.

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel?

audio.text: 你去哪儿了？我在这儿等了你半天！

choices: They want to wait half a day.
They have waited a long time and are annoyed.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{了|le}？{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{等|děng}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{半天|bàn tiān}！ "Where did you go? I've been waiting here for ages!" {半天|bàn tiān} after {等|děng}{了|le} is "for ages", said with some annoyance.

questions.stem: Read Anna's message: "{王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{明天|míng tiān}{的|de}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}{你|nǐ}{参加|cān jiā}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{参加|cān jiā}{了|le}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{和|hé}{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}。{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{球场|qiú chǎng}。{我|wǒ}{这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{练习|liàn xí}，{每天|měi tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{练|liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{去年|qù nián}{我|wǒ}{第|dì}{一|yī}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{输|shū}{了|le}，{今年|jīn nián}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{得|dé}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}！{下雨|xià yǔ}{的话|de huà}，{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{里|lǐ}。{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{加油|jiā yóu}{吧|ba}！{安娜|Ān nà}" When and where is the badminton?
questions.explanation: {羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}: the badminton starts at a quarter past nine in the morning in the sports hall. The long jump is at two in the afternoon on the field ({下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{球场|qiú chǎng}).

questions.stem: Read Anna's message again: "{王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{明天|míng tiān}{的|de}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}{你|nǐ}{参加|cān jiā}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{参加|cān jiā}{了|le}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{和|hé}{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}。{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{球场|qiú chǎng}。{我|wǒ}{这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{练习|liàn xí}，{每天|měi tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{练|liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{去年|qù nián}{我|wǒ}{第|dì}{一|yī}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{输|shū}{了|le}，{今年|jīn nián}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{得|dé}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}！{下雨|xià yǔ}{的话|de huà}，{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{里|lǐ}。{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{加油|jiā yóu}{吧|ba}！{安娜|Ān nà}" What has Anna been doing lately?
choices: practising in the sports hall every afternoon
resting so she's ready for the day
practising the long jump in the rain
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{练习|liàn xí}，{每天|měi tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{练|liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}: these days she's been practising the whole time, an hour in the sports hall every afternoon. {这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān} is "this period, these days".

questions.stem: Read Anna's message once more: "{王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{明天|míng tiān}{的|de}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}{你|nǐ}{参加|cān jiā}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{参加|cān jiā}{了|le}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{和|hé}{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}。{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{球场|qiú chǎng}。{我|wǒ}{这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{练习|liàn xí}，{每天|měi tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{练|liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{去年|qù nián}{我|wǒ}{第|dì}{一|yī}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{输|shū}{了|le}，{今年|jīn nián}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{得|dé}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}！{下雨|xià yǔ}{的话|de huà}，{跳远|tiào yuǎn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{里|lǐ}。{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{加油|jiā yóu}{吧|ba}！{安娜|Ān nà}" Which is true?
choices: If it rains, the long jump will be indoors.
Anna is only doing the long jump.
Anna doesn't want her friend to come.

Last year she lost her first match ({第|dì}{一|yī}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{就|jiù}{输|shū}{了|le}), she's doing badminton and the long jump, and she asks her friend to come and cheer ({你|nǐ}{来|lái}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{加油|jiā yóu}{吧|ba}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: She came first in the badminton competition.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{在|zài}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{里|lǐ}{得|dé}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}。 The place phrase {在|zài}…{里|lǐ} goes before the verb (or before the subject), and {得|dé} + {了|le} + {第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng} is "came first". {收到|shōu dào} is for things sent to you, not for places in a ranking.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {比赛|bǐ sài}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{一|yī} ___ {开始|kāi shǐ}。 (The match starts at a quarter past two.)
questions.explanation: {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}: {刻|kè} is 亥 on the left and the knife 刂 on the right, eight strokes.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {比赛|bǐ sài}, match: third tone + fourth tone. Before a fourth tone the third tone stays low.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {参加|cān jiā}, to take part in: first tone + first tone, both high and level.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {跳|tiào}, to jump: the fourth tone, falling. {条|tiáo} (a measure word) rises.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm very interested in music."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}{音乐|yīn yuè}。
{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{音乐|yīn yuè}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。
{我|wǒ}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}{对|duì}{音乐|yīn yuè}。
{音乐|yīn yuè}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。
questions.explanation: A {对|duì} B {感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}: the topic goes before {感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}, with {对|duì}: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{音乐|yīn yuè}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}. {感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù} can't take an object, so {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}{音乐|yīn yuè} is English word order, and {音乐|yīn yuè}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù} says the music is interested in me.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Adjective + {极|jí}{了|le}: {好听|hǎo tīng}{极|jí}{了|le}, "just wonderful". Nothing goes before the adjective (no {很|hěn}), there's no {得|de} (that goes with {很|hěn}: {好|hǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}), and {极|jí}{了|le} comes after the adjective, not before. ({首|shǒu}: the measure word for songs.)

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This film is pretty good." in everyday speech?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{的|de}。
{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{挺|tǐng}{的|de}。
{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{极|jí}{了|le}。
{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{很|hěn}{挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
questions.explanation: {挺|tǐng} + adjective (+ {的|de}): {挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{的|de}, "pretty good". {挺|tǐng} goes before the adjective like {很|hěn}, doesn't join another degree word ({很|hěn}{挺|tǐng}) and isn't used with {极|jí}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Which word is the opposite of {好听|hǎo tīng} (nice to hear)?
questions.explanation: {难|nán} before a verb of the senses makes the opposite of {好|hǎo}: {好听|hǎo tīng} / {难听|nán tīng}, {好看|hǎo kàn} / {难看|nán kàn}. {有名|yǒu míng} is "famous".

questions.stem: How do you say "What are you (all) talking about?"
choices: {你们|nǐ men}{在|zài}{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}{什么|shén me}？
{你们|nǐ men}{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}{在|zài}{什么|shén me}？
questions.explanation: {聊|liáo} takes what you talk about: {聊|liáo}{什么|shén me}, {聊|liáo}{电影|diàn yǐng}. {聊天儿|liáo tiānr} already has its object ({天|tiān}), so it can't take another one: {聊天儿|liáo tiānr}{什么|shén me} is wrong. {在|zài} (progressive) goes before the verb.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{足球|zú qiú} ___。 (There's a football match tomorrow afternoon.)
questions.explanation: A sports match is {比赛|bǐ sài}. {游戏|yóu xì} is a game you play for fun (a party game, a computer game), {表演|biǎo yǎn} a performance, and {节目|jié mù} one item in a show or on TV.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___音 (sound; voice)
questions.explanation: {声音|shēng yīn}: {={声|shēng} is 士 on top with a "door" shape below, seven strokes=} (traditional {+{声|shēng}+}, 17). {生|shēng} and {身|shēn} sound like it, and 星 (xīng) has {生|shēng} in it: {生|shēng} is in {学生|xué sheng}, {身|shēn} in {身体|shēn tǐ}, 星 in {星期|xīng qī}.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {音乐|yīn yuè} music, {故事|gù shi} story, {游戏|yóu xì} game, {耳机|ěr jī} headphones (ear + machine), {画家|huà jiā} painter. A party with performances is {晚会|wǎn huì}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker interested in?

audio.text: 我对中国音乐特别感兴趣，你呢？

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{音乐|yīn yuè}{特别|tè bié}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}，{你|nǐ}{呢|ne}？ "I'm especially interested in Chinese music. And you?"

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think of the story?

audio.text: 这个故事有意思极了，你也看看吧。

questions.explanation: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{有意思|yǒu yì si}{极|jí}{了|le}: "this story is extremely interesting", so the speaker suggests you read it too ({你|nǐ}{也|yě}{看看|kàn kan}{吧|ba}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which of these is NOT mentioned?

audio.text: 晚会八点开始，有唱歌、跳舞，还有游戏。

questions.explanation: {晚会|wǎn huì}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{有|yǒu}{唱|chàng}{歌|gē}、{跳舞|tiào wǔ}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{游戏|yóu xì}: the gala starts at eight, with singing, dancing and games. No film ({电影|diàn yǐng}) is mentioned.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want?

audio.text: 请大声一点儿说，我听不见。

questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{大|dà}{声|shēng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{说|shuō}，{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}{不见|bú jiàn}: "Please speak a bit louder, I can't hear." {大|dà}{声|shēng} is loudly; quietly would be {小|xiǎo}{声|shēng}.

questions.stem: Read the poster and the reply. Poster: "{音乐|yīn yuè}{晚会|wǎn huì}：{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{晚上|wǎn shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}，{学校|xué xiào}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}。{有|yǒu}{唱|chàng}{歌|gē}、{跳舞|tiào wǔ}、{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{和|hé}{游戏|yóu xì}。{对|duì}{音乐|yīn yuè}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{来|lái}{表演|biǎo yǎn}，{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{星期|xīng qī}{三|sān}{前|qián}{告诉|gào su}{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}。" Reply: "{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}，{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{音乐|yīn yuè}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}，{想|xiǎng}{在|zài}{晚会|wǎn huì}{上|shàng}{唱|chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{中国|Zhōng guó}{歌|gē}。{我|wǒ}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}，{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{唱|chàng}。{我|wǒ}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{安娜|Ān nà}{也|yě}{想|xiǎng}{表演|biǎo yǎn}，{她|tā}{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}。{大卫|Dà wèi}" When and where is the gala?
choices: Friday at 7 p.m. in the school sports hall
Friday at 7 a.m. in the school sports hall
Wednesday at 7 p.m. in the sports hall
questions.explanation: {星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{晚上|wǎn shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}，{学校|xué xiào}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}: Friday at seven in the evening, in the school sports hall. Wednesday ({星期|xīng qī}{三|sān}) is the day to sign up by.

questions.stem: Read the poster and the reply again. Poster: "{音乐|yīn yuè}{晚会|wǎn huì}：{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{晚上|wǎn shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}，{学校|xué xiào}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}。{有|yǒu}{唱|chàng}{歌|gē}、{跳舞|tiào wǔ}、{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{和|hé}{游戏|yóu xì}。{对|duì}{音乐|yīn yuè}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{来|lái}{表演|biǎo yǎn}，{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{星期|xīng qī}{三|sān}{前|qián}{告诉|gào su}{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}。" Reply: "{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}，{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{音乐|yīn yuè}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}，{想|xiǎng}{在|zài}{晚会|wǎn huì}{上|shàng}{唱|chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{中国|Zhōng guó}{歌|gē}。{我|wǒ}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}，{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{唱|chàng}。{我|wǒ}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{安娜|Ān nà}{也|yě}{想|xiǎng}{表演|biǎo yǎn}，{她|tā}{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}。{大卫|Dà wèi}" What does David want to do?
questions.explanation: {想|xiǎng}{在|zài}{晚会|wǎn huì}{上|shàng}{唱|chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{中国|Zhōng guó}{歌|gē}: he'd like to sing a Chinese song at the gala. He says he doesn't sing very well ({我|wǒ}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}) but loves singing ({可是|kě shì}, "but", is lesson 27's word).

questions.stem: Read the reply once more: "{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}，{您|nín}{好|hǎo}！{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{音乐|yīn yuè}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}，{想|xiǎng}{在|zài}{晚会|wǎn huì}{上|shàng}{唱|chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{中国|Zhōng guó}{歌|gē}。{我|wǒ}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}，{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{唱|chàng}。{我|wǒ}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{安娜|Ān nà}{也|yě}{想|xiǎng}{表演|biǎo yǎn}，{她|tā}{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}。{大卫|Dà wèi}" What is Anna especially good at?
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}: she tells stories especially well. The verb is repeated before {得|de} ({讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}…), as in lesson 17.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: My younger brother isn't interested in games.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{弟弟|dì di}{对|duì}{游戏|yóu xì}{不|bù}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。 Topic with {对|duì} before the verb, then {不|bù} + {感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}. With {有|yǒu} you'd need {没有|méi yǒu}{兴趣|xìng qù} (never {不|bù}{有|yǒu}), and {极|jí}{了|le} doesn't go with a negative like this.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng} ___ {好看|hǎo kàn}{的|de}。 (This film is pretty good.)
questions.explanation: {挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{的|de}: {挺|tǐng} is the hand 扌 + {廷|tíng} (which gives the sound tǐng). Its last stroke is the long 廴 at the bottom.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {音乐|yīn yuè}, music: first tone + fourth tone. 乐 is yuè here; in {快乐|kuài lè} it's lè.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {耳机|ěr jī}, headphones: third tone + first tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {故事|gù shi}, story: fourth tone + neutral tone. The second syllable is short and light.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He married Zhang Li."?
questions.explanation: {结婚|jié hūn} is a separable verb and takes no object: the person you marry comes before it with {跟|gēn} (or {和|hé}): {他|tā}{跟|gēn}{张丽|Zhāng Lì}{结婚|jié hūn}{了|le}. {他|tā}{结婚|jié hūn}{张丽|Zhāng Lì}{了|le} is English word order.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "They've been married for ten years."?
questions.explanation: After {结婚|jié hūn}, a length of time + {了|le} says how long since the wedding: {他们|tā men}{结婚|jié hūn}{十|shí}{年|nián}{了|le}. Before the verb, {十|shí}{年|nián} would be "when", and {结|jié}{十|shí}{年|nián}{婚|hūn} treats the wedding as something that lasts ten years.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ} ___ {七|qī}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}，{周末|zhōu mò}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}。 (Normally I get up at seven; at weekends, at nine.)
questions.explanation: {平时|píng shí} is "on ordinary days", set against special days like the weekend ({周末|zhōu mò}, lesson 25). {已经|yǐ jīng} is "already", {好久|hǎo jiǔ} "ages" and {不久|bù jiǔ} "soon after".

questions.stem: How do you greet a friend you haven't seen for a long time?
questions.explanation: {好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn}！ (Long time no see!) is a set phrase: {好久|hǎo jiǔ}, "ages", + {不见|bú jiàn}. {不久|bù jiǔ} is "soon", and {长|cháng} is "long" in space; it doesn't make this greeting.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {了|le}{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？ (What happened?)
questions.explanation: {发生|fā shēng} is "to happen": {发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？ {发展|fā zhǎn} is "to develop", {出生|chū shēng} "to be born" and {生活|shēng huó} "life; to live".

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I was born in 2005."?
questions.explanation: {出生|chū shēng} is an ordinary verb (no passive {被|bèi}), and a time goes before the verb. With {是|shì}…{的|de} for the time of a past event: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}2005{年|nián}{出生|chū shēng}{的|de}. {我|wǒ}{出生|chū shēng}2005{年|nián} is English word order.

questions.stem: Which is a correct, polite invitation?
questions.explanation: {欢迎|huān yíng} + the guest + the verb: {欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{参加|cān jiā}！ (You're welcome to come and take part!) The guest comes right after {欢迎|huān yíng}, not at the end.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {生|shēng}___ (life)
questions.explanation: {生活|shēng huó}: 活 is water 氵 on the left and a right side that looks like {舌|shé} (tongue). {={话|huà} (words) has 讠 (speech) on the left=} (traditional {+{话|huà}+}: 言), and 法 (method) has 氵 with {去|qù}.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {节日|jié rì} festival, {礼物|lǐ wù} present, {文化|wén huà} culture, {结婚|jié hūn} to get married, {发展|fā zhǎn} to develop. "To be born" is {出生|chū shēng}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker's family do every year?

audio.text: 我们每年都回家过节。

choices: go to a party at school
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{每年|měi nián}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}: "we go home for the festival every year". {过节|guò jié} is to celebrate a festival.

questions.stem: Listen. Where and when was she born?

audio.text: 她是二零零五年在上海出生的。

questions.explanation: {她|tā}{是|shì}{二零零五|èr líng líng wǔ}{年|nián}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{出生|chū shēng}{的|de}: she was born in Shanghai in 2005. Years are read digit by digit: èr líng líng wǔ.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 谢谢你的邀请，对不起，那天我有事，不能参加。

questions.explanation: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{邀请|yāo qǐng}，{对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{那|nà}{天|tiān}{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{事|shì}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{参加|cān jiā}: "Thank you for the invitation; sorry, I'm busy that day and can't come." A polite no.

questions.stem: Read Wang Fang's message: "{安娜|Ān nà}：{你好|nǐ hǎo}！{好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn}！{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{是|shì}{春节|Chūn jié}，{我们|wǒ men}{全家|quán jiā}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}{过节|guò jié}。{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{说|shuō}，{欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}！{我们|wǒ men}{会|huì}{一起|yì qǐ}{包饺子|bāo jiǎo zi}、{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{新年|xīn nián}{晚会|wǎn huì}。{我们|wǒ men}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{早上|zǎo shang}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{出发|chū fā}，{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{回来|huí lái}。{你|nǐ}{平时|píng shí}{习惯|xí guàn}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{老家|lǎo jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{都|dōu}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{辣|là}。{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{不|bù}{来|lái}？{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{三|sān}{前|qián}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}。{王芳|Wáng Fāng}" ({包饺子|bāo jiǎo zi}: to make dumplings) What is Wang Fang inviting Anna to?
choices: the Spring Festival at her family's home
questions.explanation: {下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{是|shì}{春节|Chūn jié}，{我们|wǒ men}{全家|quán jiā}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}{过节|guò jié}。{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{说|shuō}，{欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}！ Her family is going back to their hometown ({老家|lǎo jiā}) for the Spring Festival ({春节|Chūn jié}), and Anna is welcome to come.

questions.stem: Read the message again: "{安娜|Ān nà}：{你好|nǐ hǎo}！{好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn}！{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{是|shì}{春节|Chūn jié}，{我们|wǒ men}{全家|quán jiā}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}{过节|guò jié}。{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{说|shuō}，{欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}！{我们|wǒ men}{会|huì}{一起|yì qǐ}{包饺子|bāo jiǎo zi}、{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{新年|xīn nián}{晚会|wǎn huì}。{我们|wǒ men}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{早上|zǎo shang}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{出发|chū fā}，{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{回来|huí lái}。{你|nǐ}{平时|píng shí}{习惯|xí guàn}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{老家|lǎo jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{都|dōu}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{辣|là}。{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{不|bù}{来|lái}？{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{三|sān}{前|qián}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}。{王芳|Wáng Fāng}" When do they leave?
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{早上|zǎo shang}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{出发|chū fā}，{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{回来|huí lái}: they leave by high-speed train on Friday morning and come back on Monday. Wednesday is the day to reply by.

questions.stem: Read the message once more: "{安娜|Ān nà}：{你好|nǐ hǎo}！{好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn}！{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{是|shì}{春节|Chūn jié}，{我们|wǒ men}{全家|quán jiā}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}{过节|guò jié}。{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{说|shuō}，{欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}！{我们|wǒ men}{会|huì}{一起|yì qǐ}{包饺子|bāo jiǎo zi}、{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{新年|xīn nián}{晚会|wǎn huì}。{我们|wǒ men}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{早上|zǎo shang}{坐|zuò}{高铁|gāo tiě}{出发|chū fā}，{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{回来|huí lái}。{你|nǐ}{平时|píng shí}{习惯|xí guàn}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{老家|lǎo jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{都|dōu}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{辣|là}。{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{不|bù}{来|lái}？{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{三|sān}{前|qián}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}。{王芳|Wáng Fāng}" Why does Wang Fang ask whether Anna is used to spicy food?
choices: The food in her hometown is a bit spicy.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{平时|píng shí}{习惯|xí guàn}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}{吗|ma}？{我|wǒ}{老家|lǎo jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{都|dōu}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{辣|là}: "Are you normally used to eating spicy food? The dishes in my hometown are all a bit spicy." ({辣|là}: spicy.)

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: She's still not used to life here.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{还|hái}{不|bù}{习惯|xí guàn}{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}。 {还|hái}{不|bù} + {习惯|xí guàn} + what you're not used to. {还|hái} (still) goes before {不|bù}, and {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó} (life here) is the object; it can also come first as the topic: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{她|tā}{还|hái}{不|bù}{习惯|xí guàn}。

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{件|jiàn} ___ 物。 (I bought my mum a present.)
questions.explanation: {礼物|lǐ wù}: {={礼|lǐ} is 礻 (the altar radical) + the long hooked stroke 乚, five strokes in all=}. The traditional form is {+{礼|lǐ}+}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {礼物|lǐ wù}, present: third tone + fourth tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {结婚|jié hūn}, to get married: second tone + first tone.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 欢迎大家来参加我们的新年晚会！

choices: welcoming people to a New Year party
questions.explanation: {欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{来|lái}{参加|cān jiā}…: "welcome, everyone, to…", and {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{新年|xīn nián}{晚会|wǎn huì} is "our New Year party". {欢迎|huān yíng}…{参加|cān jiā} is the usual formula for welcoming guests or inviting them.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Mum is very angry with me."?
questions.explanation: The person someone is angry with takes {对|duì}, before {生气|shēng qì}: {妈妈|mā ma}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì}. {生气|shēng qì} takes no object, and {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{妈妈|mā ma}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì} is the other way round: I'm angry with Mum.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This made me very happy."?
questions.explanation: Cause + {让|ràng} + person + feeling: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}. {做|zuò} is "to do", not "to make someone feel", and the person who feels comes right after {让|ràng}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ} ___ {帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。 (I'm happy to help you.)
questions.explanation: {愿意|yuàn yì} + verb is "to be willing, glad to": {我|wǒ}{愿意|yuàn yì}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}. {同意|tóng yì} is "to agree", {相信|xiāng xìn} "to believe", and {放心|fàng xīn} "to stop worrying".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {你|nǐ} ___ {吧|ba}，{我|wǒ}{会|huì}{照顾|zhào gù}{自己|zì jǐ}。 (Don't worry, I'll look after myself.)
questions.explanation: {放心|fàng xīn} is "to stop worrying, to be at ease", and {你|nǐ}{放心|fàng xīn}{吧|ba} is "don't worry". {担心|dān xīn} is the opposite, "to worry"; {你|nǐ}{担心|dān xīn}{吧|ba} would tell the person to worry.

questions.stem: How do you say "in front of everyone" (with everyone watching)?
questions.explanation: {面前|miàn qián} is "in front of someone, in their presence": {在|zài}{大家|dà jiā}{面前|miàn qián}. {前面|qián miàn} is about places ({在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{前面|qián miàn}, in front of the school), and the person always comes before {面前|miàn qián} / {前面|qián miàn}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这个|zhè ge}{节目|jié mù} ___ {了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{欢迎|huān yíng}。 (This act was very popular.)
questions.explanation: {受到|shòu dào} + {欢迎|huān yíng} / {喜爱|xǐ ài} / {影响|yǐng xiǎng}: to meet with. {收到|shōu dào} is for things sent to you ({收到|shōu dào}{邮件|yóu jiàn}), {得分|dé fēn} is "to score", and {感到|gǎn dào} + a feeling is "to feel".

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{他|tā}{不|bù}{来|lái}。" mean?
choices: I don't want him to come.
questions.explanation: {怕|pà} + a clause is "I'm afraid that, I worry that": {我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{他|tā}{不|bù}{来|lái}, "I'm worried he won't come". "I'm afraid of him" would be {我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{他|tā}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? 害___ (to be afraid)
questions.explanation: {害怕|hài pà}: {怕|pà} is the heart 忄 + {白|bái}, which gives the sound. {拍|pāi} (in {拍照|pāi zhào}) has the hand 扌 instead, {白|bái} alone is "white", and {百|bǎi} is "hundred".

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {生气|shēng qì} angry, {开心|kāi xīn} cheerful, {难过|nán guò} sad, {奇怪|qí guài} strange, {热情|rè qíng} warm and friendly. "To cry" is {哭|kū}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 别哭了，我们明天再去买一个吧。

choices: asking someone to buy something today
questions.explanation: {别|bié}{哭|kū}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{一|yí}{个|gè}{吧|ba}: "Don't cry; let's go and buy another one tomorrow." {别|bié}{哭|kū}{了|le} comforts someone who is crying.

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the speaker find it strange?

audio.text: 真奇怪，他今天怎么没来上课？

choices: He didn't come to class today.
questions.explanation: {真|zhēn}{奇怪|qí guài}，{他|tā}{今天|jīn tiān}{怎么|zěn me}{没|méi}{来|lái}{上课|shàng kè}？ "How strange, why didn't he come to class today?" {奇怪|qí guài} often comes before a question like this.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?

audio.text: 我不同意你一个人去，太晚了。

choices: They agree you can go alone.
They don't agree to you going alone.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{不|bù}{同意|tóng yì}{你|nǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{去|qù}，{太|tài}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}: "I don't agree to you going on your own: it's too late." {同意|tóng yì} + a clause.

questions.stem: Read Wang Fang's note: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}：{昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{事|shì}，{真|zhēn}{对不起|duì bu qǐ}！{你|nǐ}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{画|huà}，{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{说|shuō}“{一般|yì bān}”，{你|nǐ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}。{我|wǒ}{回|huí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{感到|gǎn dào}{很|hěn}{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{画|huà}，{特别|tè bié}{是|shì}{那|nà}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{的|de}。{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}{画展|huà zhǎn}{的|de}{票|piào}，{你|nǐ}{还|hái}{愿意|yuàn yì}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{吗|ma}？{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{见|jiàn}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？{希望|xī wàng}{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{生|shēng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{气|qì}{了|le}！{王芳|Wáng Fāng}" Why was Li Ming upset?
choices: Wang Fang called his painting "so-so" without looking properly.
Wang Fang didn't buy him a ticket.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{说|shuō}“{一般|yì bān}”，{你|nǐ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}: she said "so-so" ({一般|yì bān}) without looking properly, and he was upset to hear it. {好好|hǎo hǎo}{看|kàn} is "to look properly".

questions.stem: Read the note again: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}：{昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{事|shì}，{真|zhēn}{对不起|duì bu qǐ}！{你|nǐ}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{画|huà}，{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{说|shuō}“{一般|yì bān}”，{你|nǐ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}。{我|wǒ}{回|huí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{感到|gǎn dào}{很|hěn}{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{画|huà}，{特别|tè bié}{是|shì}{那|nà}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{的|de}。{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}{画展|huà zhǎn}{的|de}{票|piào}，{你|nǐ}{还|hái}{愿意|yuàn yì}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{吗|ma}？{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{见|jiàn}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？{希望|xī wàng}{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{生|shēng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{气|qì}{了|le}！{王芳|Wáng Fāng}" How did Wang Fang feel when she got home?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{回|huí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{感到|gǎn dào}{很|hěn}{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}: when she got home she felt very bad about it. {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si} (HSK 2) is embarrassed, sorry.

questions.stem: Read the note once more: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}：{昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{事|shì}，{真|zhēn}{对不起|duì bu qǐ}！{你|nǐ}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{画|huà}，{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{说|shuō}“{一般|yì bān}”，{你|nǐ}{听|tīng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}。{我|wǒ}{回|huí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{感到|gǎn dào}{很|hěn}{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{画|huà}，{特别|tè bié}{是|shì}{那|nà}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{的|de}。{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}{画展|huà zhǎn}{的|de}{票|piào}，{你|nǐ}{还|hái}{愿意|yuàn yì}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{吗|ma}？{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{见|jiàn}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？{希望|xī wàng}{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{生|shēng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{气|qì}{了|le}！{王芳|Wáng Fāng}" What is Wang Fang inviting Li Ming to?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}{画展|huà zhǎn}{的|de}{票|piào}，{你|nǐ}{还|hái}{愿意|yuàn yì}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{吗|ma}？ She has bought two tickets for an art exhibition ({画展|huà zhǎn}) and asks whether he's still willing to go with her. The panda is in one of his paintings.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'm a bit scared of speaking in front of everyone.
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{大家|dà jiā}{面前|miàn qián}{说话|shuō huà}，{我|wǒ}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{害怕|hài pà}。 The whole situation comes first as the topic (or after {我|wǒ}), then {有点儿|yǒu diǎnr} + {害怕|hài pà}. Before an audience, it's {面前|miàn qián}, not {前面|qián miàn}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {孩子|hái zi} ___ {了|le}。 (The child is crying.)
questions.explanation: {哭|kū}: two {口|kǒu} on top and 犬 below. Don't forget the dot at the top right; it's the last stroke.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {害怕|hài pà}, to be afraid: fourth tone + fourth tone, two falls.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {奇怪|qí guài}, strange: second tone + fourth tone.

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel?

audio.text: 看到你这么开心，我也很高兴。

choices: happy because the listener is happy
questions.explanation: {看|kàn}{到|dào}{你|nǐ}{这么|zhè me}{开心|kāi xīn}: "seeing you so happy", {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}: "I'm happy too". {开心|kāi xīn} and {高兴|gāo xìng} both mean "happy"; {也|yě} links the two feelings.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He didn't come until ten."?
questions.explanation: Late is time + {才|cái} + verb, with no {了|le}: {他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{来|lái}. {他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{来|lái}{了|le} says he came early, by ten. {才|cái}{来|lái}{了|le} adds a {了|le} that late {才|cái} doesn't take, and {才|cái}{十|shí}{点|diǎn} puts {才|cái} before the number ("only ten o'clock").

questions.stem: Which sentence means "She was up by six." (earlier than you'd think)?
questions.explanation: Early is time + {就|jiù} + verb + {了|le}: {她|tā}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{起床|qǐ chuáng}{了|le}. {她|tā}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{起床|qǐ chuáng} is "she didn't get up till six". {就|jiù} goes straight before the verb, after the time.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}， ___ {去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。 (First we'll eat, then we'll go to a film.)
questions.explanation: {先|xiān}…，{然后|rán hòu}…: first…, then…. {以前|yǐ qián} is "before" (after an event: {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{以前|yǐ qián}), {后天|hòu tiān} "the day after tomorrow", and {刚才|gāng cái} "a moment ago".

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I've only been here three days."?
questions.explanation: {刚|gāng} is an adverb before the verb, and it can take a length of time after the verb: {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{来|lái}{三|sān}{天|tiān}. {刚才|gāng cái} is a time noun, "a moment ago", and doesn't go with a length of time.

questions.stem: How do you say "before eating"?
questions.explanation: {以前|yǐ qián} follows the event: {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{以前|yǐ qián}, the opposite of English order. {后来|hòu lái} (afterwards) never follows an event; "after eating" is {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{工作|gōng zuò}。 (In the future I'd like to work in China.)
questions.explanation: {以后|yǐ hòu} alone is "in the future, from now on". {后来|hòu lái} is only for past stories, {最后|zuì hòu} is "finally, last of all" in a list of steps, and {然后|rán hòu} is "then" after a first step.

questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{才|cái}{十|shí}{岁|suì}。" mean?
questions.explanation: {才|cái} + a number is "only": {他|tā}{才|cái}{十|shí}{岁|suì}, he's only ten. "Already ten" would be {他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{十|shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Which character is mò, "end", as in {周末|zhōu mò}?
questions.explanation: 末: 木 with the long line on top, the tip of the tree. {未|wèi} (not yet) has the short line on top, 木 is "tree", and {本|běn} has its extra line at the bottom (the root).

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {前天|qián tiān} the day before yesterday, {后年|hòu nián} the year after next, {前年|qián nián} the year before last, {刚才|gāng cái} a moment ago, {最近|zuì jìn} recently. The weekend is {周末|zhōu mò}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 电影八点开始，他八点半才到。

choices: The film started at half past eight.
He arrived half an hour late.
questions.explanation: {电影|diàn yǐng}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{他|tā}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{才|cái}{到|dào}: the film started at eight and he didn't get there until half past eight. {才|cái} says he was late.

questions.stem: Listen. Where do they go second?

audio.text: 我们先去银行，然后去超市，最后回家做饭。

questions.explanation: {先|xiān}{去|qù}{银行|yín háng}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{超市|chāo shì}，{最后|zuì hòu}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{做饭|zuò fàn}: first the bank, then the supermarket, and finally home to cook.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want to know?

audio.text: 你刚才去哪儿了？我给你打了三次电话。

questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{刚才|gāng cái}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{了|le}？{我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}{电话|diàn huà}: "Where did you go just now? I called you three times."

questions.stem: Read David's diary: "{今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}。{我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{起床|qǐ chuáng}{了|le}，{因为|yīn wèi}{今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{考试|kǎo shì}。{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。{考试|kǎo shì}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{可是|kě shì}{李明|Lǐ Míng}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{才|cái}{到|dào}，{他|tā}{说|shuō}{地铁|dì tiě}{晚点|wǎn diǎn}{了|le}。{考试|kǎo shì}{完|wán}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}，{然后|rán hòu}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{电影|diàn yǐng}，{直到|zhí dào}{十一|shí yī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{才|cái}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。{后天|hòu tiān}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{考试|kǎo shì}，{明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{复习|fù xí}。" Why did David get up at six?
choices: He had to catch a train.
He wanted to watch a film.
He had an exam that day.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{起床|qǐ chuáng}{了|le}，{因为|yīn wèi}{今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{考试|kǎo shì}: he was up by six because he had an exam. {就|jiù}…{了|le} says it was early.

questions.stem: Read the diary again: "{今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}。{我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{起床|qǐ chuáng}{了|le}，{因为|yīn wèi}{今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{考试|kǎo shì}。{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。{考试|kǎo shì}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{可是|kě shì}{李明|Lǐ Míng}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{才|cái}{到|dào}，{他|tā}{说|shuō}{地铁|dì tiě}{晚点|wǎn diǎn}{了|le}。{考试|kǎo shì}{完|wán}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}，{然后|rán hòu}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{电影|diàn yǐng}，{直到|zhí dào}{十一|shí yī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{才|cái}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。{后天|hòu tiān}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{考试|kǎo shì}，{明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{复习|fù xí}。" When did Li Ming arrive, and why?
choices: at nine, because he got up late
at 9:15, because the metro was late
at 8:45, because he wanted to revise
questions.explanation: {李明|Lǐ Míng}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{才|cái}{到|dào}，{他|tā}{说|shuō}{地铁|dì tiě}{晚点|wǎn diǎn}{了|le}: he didn't arrive until a quarter past nine; he said the metro was late ({晚点|wǎn diǎn}, lesson 13). ({可是|kě shì}, "but", is lesson 27's word.)

questions.stem: Read the diary once more: "{今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}。{我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{起床|qǐ chuáng}{了|le}，{因为|yīn wèi}{今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{考试|kǎo shì}。{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。{考试|kǎo shì}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{可是|kě shì}{李明|Lǐ Míng}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{才|cái}{到|dào}，{他|tā}{说|shuō}{地铁|dì tiě}{晚点|wǎn diǎn}{了|le}。{考试|kǎo shì}{完|wán}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}，{然后|rán hòu}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{电影|diàn yǐng}，{直到|zhí dào}{十一|shí yī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{才|cái}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。{后天|hòu tiān}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{考试|kǎo shì}，{明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{复习|fù xí}。" When is David's next exam?
questions.explanation: {后天|hòu tiān}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{考试|kǎo shì}: there's another exam the day after tomorrow. Today is Monday ({今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}), so that's Wednesday. Tomorrow he'll revise.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Let's eat first and then go and see a film.
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{吧|ba}。 {先|xiān} goes after the subject and before the first verb; {然后|rán hòu} starts the second step; {吧|ba} makes it a suggestion. {以前|yǐ qián} would have to follow an event.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {我|wǒ} ___ {到|dào}{家|jiā}。 (I've only just got home.)
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{到|dào}{家|jiā}: {={刚|gāng} (only just) is {冈|gāng} + the knife 刂, six strokes=} (traditional {+{刚|gāng}+}). {刚|gāng} is an adverb, straight before the verb. In speech {我|wǒ}{才|cái}{到|dào}{家|jiā} can also mean "I've only just got home", so {才|cái} counts too.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {周末|zhōu mò}, weekend: first tone + fourth tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {然后|rán hòu}, then: second tone + fourth tone.

questions.stem: Listen. When did the speaker phone Mum?

audio.text: 我前天就到北京了，昨天才给妈妈打电话。

questions.explanation: {前天|qián tiān}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}{了|le}: the speaker arrived the day before yesterday (and {就|jiù} says "already then"), but {昨天|zuó tiān}{才|cái}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}: only yesterday, a day late ({才|cái}), did they phone Mum.

questions.stem: What are the "four treasures of the study" ({文房四宝|wén fáng sì bǎo})?
questions.explanation: The four treasures are the brush ({毛笔|máo bǐ}), the ink stick ({墨|mò}), paper ({纸|zhǐ}) and the inkstone ({砚|yàn}), on which the ink stick is ground with a little water.

questions.stem: Which style of script do most learners of calligraphy start with?
questions.explanation: Regular script ({楷书|kǎi shū}): every stroke is separate and clear, so it teaches the shape and balance of each character. Running and cursive script join strokes and come later.

questions.stem: In which year was Chinese calligraphy inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.explanation: 2009. Its description names five styles of script: seal, clerical ("official"), regular, running and cursive. (Peking opera followed in 2010: lesson 25h2.)

questions.stem: Why can you see stroke order in running and cursive script?
choices: Each stroke is a different colour.
The brush goes straight from the end of one stroke to the start of the next, so the joins show the path.
Running script has fewer strokes than regular script.
questions.explanation: In the faster scripts the brush hardly lifts: one stroke runs into the next, and the joins show the order. Written in the wrong order, a character comes out a different shape.

questions.stem: Who is traditionally called the "Sage of Calligraphy"?
questions.explanation: {王羲之|Wáng Xī zhī}, Wang Xizhi, of the 4th century, the {书圣|shū shèng}. Fan Kuan was a landscape painter, Mei Lanfang an opera performer (lesson 25h2), and Cao Cao a Three Kingdoms warlord.

questions.stem: What does {山水画|shān shuǐ huà} mean?
questions.explanation: {山|shān} (mountain) + {水|shuǐ} (water) + {画|huà} (painting): landscape painting, which became the main subject of Chinese painting in the 10th and 11th centuries.

questions.stem: Which is true of the Orchid Pavilion Preface ({兰亭集序|Lán tíng Jí Xù})?
choices: It was printed in a book in 1790.
It was written in 353 in running script, and the original is lost.
It is written in seal script on a stone.
questions.explanation: Wang Xizhi wrote it in 353, in running script, for a collection of poems. The original has long been lost; copies, tracings and rubbings survive.

questions.stem: Listen. What is Grandpa interested in?

audio.text: 我爷爷对书法特别感兴趣，他每天早上都写字。

questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{对|duì}{书法|shū fǎ}{特别|tè bié}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}，{他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{都|dōu}{写字|xiě zì}: Grandpa is especially interested in calligraphy and writes every morning.

questions.stem: Listen. What do you have to learn first?

audio.text: 写书法要先学会怎么拿毛笔。

questions.explanation: {写|xiě}{书法|shū fǎ}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{学会|xué huì}{怎么|zěn me}{拿|ná}{毛笔|máo bǐ}: to write calligraphy, you first have to learn how to hold the brush. {学会|xué huì} is "to learn (until you can)": a result complement.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国画|Zhōng guó huà}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。{上|shàng}{个|gè}{周末|zhōu mò}，{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{画展|huà zhǎn}。{画展|huà zhǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{山水画|shān shuǐ huà}，{有的|yǒu de}{画|huà}{上|shàng}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{诗|shī}。{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}：{一|yí}{座|zuò}{大|dà}{山|shān}，{山|shān}{下面|xià miàn}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{小|xiǎo}{河|hé}，{河|hé}{边|biān}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}{人|rén}。{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{那|nà}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}{前面|qián miàn}{看|kàn}{了|le}{半天|bàn tiān}。" ({画展|huà zhǎn}: art exhibition; {座|zuò}: measure word for mountains) What did the writer see at the exhibition?
choices: many landscape paintings, some with poems on them
paintings of people at a party
questions.explanation: {画展|huà zhǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{山水画|shān shuǐ huà}，{有的|yǒu de}{画|huà}{上|shàng}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{诗|shī}: lots of landscape paintings, some of them with poems on them, as many Chinese paintings have.

questions.stem: Read again: "{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国画|Zhōng guó huà}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。{上|shàng}{个|gè}{周末|zhōu mò}，{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{画展|huà zhǎn}。{画展|huà zhǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{山水画|shān shuǐ huà}，{有的|yǒu de}{画|huà}{上|shàng}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{诗|shī}。{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}：{一|yí}{座|zuò}{大|dà}{山|shān}，{山|shān}{下面|xià miàn}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{小|xiǎo}{河|hé}，{河|hé}{边|biān}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}{人|rén}。{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{那|nà}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}{前面|qián miàn}{看|kàn}{了|le}{半天|bàn tiān}。" What is the writer's favourite painting like?
choices: two big people by a river
a big mountain with a little river below and two tiny people
a mountain with a big house
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{座|zuò}{大|dà}{山|shān}，{山|shān}{下面|xià miàn}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{小|xiǎo}{河|hé}，{河|hé}{边|biān}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}{人|rén}: a big mountain, a little river below it and two tiny people by the river: tiny people under a huge mountain, as in many landscapes.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {山水|shān shuǐ}, mountains and water (landscape): first tone + third tone.

questions.stem: Which four skills does UNESCO's description of Peking opera name?
choices: singing, reciting, acting and martial arts
questions.explanation: Singing, reciting, acting and martial arts: in Chinese {唱|chàng}, {念|niàn}, {做|zuò}, {打|dǎ}.

questions.stem: According to tradition, when and how did Peking opera begin?
choices: in the Tang dynasty, at the emperor's palace
in 1790, when four theatre companies from Anhui came to Beijing
questions.explanation: In 1790 four famous Anhui companies came to Beijing for the Qianlong emperor's 80th birthday. The form took shape in the 19th century; 2010 is the year of its UNESCO inscription.

questions.stem: Which role type is the clown?
questions.explanation: The chou ({={丑|chǒu}=}) is the clown, with a white patch around the eyes and nose. Sheng ({生|shēng}) are male roles, dan ({旦|dàn}) female roles, and jing ({净|jìng}) the painted faces.

questions.stem: In Peking opera face painting, what does red usually stand for?
questions.explanation: Red is for loyalty, courage and uprightness, as for the general Guan Yu ({关羽|Guān Yǔ}). Cunning is white.

questions.stem: Which character is usually shown with a white face, as a cunning schemer?
questions.explanation: Cao Cao ({曹操|Cáo Cāo}), as the old stories show him. Guan Yu has a red face, Judge Bao ({包公|Bāo gōng}) a black one, and Mei Lanfang was a performer, not a character.

questions.stem: Who was Mei Lanfang ({梅兰芳|Méi Lán fāng})?
choices: a jinghu player who wrote the first opera
a famous performer of female roles (1894–1961)
questions.explanation: {梅兰芳|Méi Lán fāng} played mostly female roles, at a time when men played all of them, and became known around the world; he toured the United States in 1930.

questions.stem: On a Peking opera stage, what does an actor waving a whip mean?
choices: The actor is riding a horse.
A fight is about to start.
questions.explanation: The stage is almost empty, and props stand for things: a whip means a horse, a table can be a hill or a wall, and walking in a circle is a long journey.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?

audio.text: 我爷爷年轻的时候唱过京剧。

choices: Grandpa sang Peking opera when he was young.
Grandpa has never seen Peking opera.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{年轻|nián qīng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{唱|chàng}{过|guo}{京剧|jīng jù}: my grandpa sang Peking opera when he was young ({过|guo}: experience).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about the painted faces?

audio.text: 红脸是好人，白脸常常是坏人。

choices: Red and white faces are both villains.
Red faces are good people; white faces are often bad people.
questions.explanation: {红|hóng}{脸|liǎn}{是|shì}{好人|hǎo rén}，{白|bái}{脸|liǎn}{常常|cháng cháng}{是|shì}{坏人|huài rén}: red faces are good people, white faces are often bad people ({常常|cháng cháng}, often: lesson 27).

questions.stem: Read: "{今天|jīn tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}，{学校|xué xiào}{请|qǐng}{来|lái}{了|le}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{京剧|jīng jù}{老师|lǎo shī}。{她|tā}{先|xiān}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{讲|jiǎng}{了|le}{京剧|jīng jù}{的|de}{四|sì}{种|zhǒng}{角色|jué sè}，{然后|rán hòu}{表演|biǎo yǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}。{她|tā}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{好听|hǎo tīng}{极|jí}{了|le}！{表演|biǎo yǎn}{完|wán}{了|le}，{她|tā}{还|hái}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{画|huà}{脸谱|liǎn pǔ}。{我|wǒ}{画|huà}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{红脸|hóng liǎn}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}。" ({角色|jué sè}: role; {脸谱|liǎn pǔ}: painted face) What did the opera teacher do first?
choices: told the students about the four kinds of role
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{先|xiān}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{讲|jiǎng}{了|le}{京剧|jīng jù}{的|de}{四|sì}{种|zhǒng}{角色|jué sè}，{然后|rán hòu}{表演|biǎo yǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}: first she told them about the four kinds of role, then she performed a section. Painting faces came last.

questions.stem: Read again: "{今天|jīn tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}，{学校|xué xiào}{请|qǐng}{来|lái}{了|le}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{京剧|jīng jù}{老师|lǎo shī}。{她|tā}{先|xiān}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{讲|jiǎng}{了|le}{京剧|jīng jù}{的|de}{四|sì}{种|zhǒng}{角色|jué sè}，{然后|rán hòu}{表演|biǎo yǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}。{她|tā}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{好听|hǎo tīng}{极|jí}{了|le}！{表演|biǎo yǎn}{完|wán}{了|le}，{她|tā}{还|hái}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{画|huà}{脸谱|liǎn pǔ}。{我|wǒ}{画|huà}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{红脸|hóng liǎn}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}。" What did the writer paint?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{画|huà}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{红|hóng}{脸|liǎn}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}: a red face, and the classmates all said it looked like the real thing.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {京剧|jīng jù}, Peking opera: first tone + fourth tone. {京|jīng} is the {京|jīng} of {北京|Běi jīng}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "If you go, I'll go."?
questions.explanation: {就|jiù} is an adverb: it goes after the subject of the second clause and before its verb, {我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{去|qù}. {如果|rú guǒ} goes at the start (or after the subject: {你|nǐ}{如果|rú guǒ}{去|qù}), never after the verb.

questions.stem: Choose the pair: ___ {多|duō}{听|tīng}{多|duō}{说|shuō}，___ {能|néng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 (Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese well.)
questions.explanation: "Only by…" is the only way, a necessary condition: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái}. {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} would make it merely enough ("as long as you…"), and {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} is "although… but".

questions.stem: What does "{只要|zhǐ yào}{不|bú}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{去|qù}。" mean?
choices: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.
We'll only go if it rains.
We won't go even if it doesn't rain.
Only if it doesn't rain at all will we go.
questions.explanation: {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} sets a condition that is enough: no rain, and we go. "Only if…" (the only way) would be {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái}: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{不|bú}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{才|cái}{去|qù}, a stricter statement.

questions.stem: You're asking a guest to choose. Which is right? "Would you like tea or coffee?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}{或者|huò zhě}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}？
{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}{还是|hái shi}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}？
{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}{而且|ér qiě}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}？
questions.explanation: A question that asks someone to choose takes {还是|hái shi}. {或者|huò zhě} (written {或|huò}) is "or" in statements: {茶|chá}{或者|huò zhě}{咖啡|kā fēi}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ} (tea or coffee, either is fine). {而且|ér qiě} is "and also".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{昨天|zuó tiān}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}___ {迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。 (He was late yesterday, and he was late again today.)
questions.explanation: The repetition has already happened, so "again" is {又|yòu}. {再|zài} is for a repetition still to come ({明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái}, come again tomorrow). {也|yě} would be "also" (someone else was late too).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "To learn Chinese well, he watches Chinese films every day."?
choices: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}{为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{他|tā}{为了|wèi le}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{为了|wèi le}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
{为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
questions.explanation: The {为了|wèi le} phrase (the purpose) normally comes first. At the end it needs {是|shì}{为了|wèi le}: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}，{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}. English order without {是|shì} is the usual mistake.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (She can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.)
choices: {她|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。
{不但|bú dàn}{她|tā}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。
{她|tā}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{不但|bú dàn}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。
{她|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{她|tā}{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。
questions.explanation: With one subject, the subject comes first and {不但|bú dàn} follows it: {她|tā}{不但|bú dàn}…，{而且|ér qiě}…. {不但|bú dàn} goes before the subject only when the two clauses have different subjects ({不但|bú dàn}{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}，{而且|ér qiě}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{也|yě}{喜欢|xǐ huan}).

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{老师|lǎo shī}{请|qǐng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{假|jià}。" mean?
choices: The teacher gave me two days of homework.
I went to see the teacher two days ago.
I asked the teacher for two days off.
I took the teacher on a two-day holiday.
questions.explanation: {向|xiàng} + person marks who the action is aimed at, and {请假|qǐng jià} is "to ask for leave", split by {了|le}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān} (a separable verb with a quantity inside, lesson 19): {请|qǐng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{假|jià}, asked for two days off.

questions.stem: How do you say "Only he knows about this."?
choices: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{他|tā}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
{他|tā}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
questions.explanation: {={只|zhǐ}=} is an adverb and goes before a verb ({他|tā}{只|zhǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}), never before a subject. "Only he…" is {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{他|tā}. {他|tā}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{知道|zhī dào} isn't a sentence.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {如果|rú guǒ} rú guǒ (if): a rising tone, then a dipping one, 2+3.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {或者|huò zhě} huò zhě (or): a falling tone, then a dipping one, 4+3.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? 而___ (moreover)
questions.explanation: {而且|ér qiě} ér qiě: {且|qiě} has two short horizontals inside and the long bottom stroke written last. {目|mù} (eye) has three inside, 旦 is {日|rì} over a line, and 具 has legs below.

questions.stem: Which character is huò, "or"?
questions.explanation: {或|huò} has 戈 on the right and {口|kǒu} with a short stroke below it on the left. {成|chéng} ({成绩|chéng jì}) and {我|wǒ} have 戈-like parts too; simplified {={国|guó}=} is 玉 in a box ({囗|wéi}), while traditional {+{国|guó}+} is {或|huò} in a box.

questions.stem: Listen. When will they go hiking?

audio.text: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。

questions.explanation: {如果|rú guǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{不|bú}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}: if it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is the best reply?

audio.text: 你喝茶还是喝咖啡？

questions.explanation: "Tea or coffee?" ({还是|hái shi} asks you to choose) is answered with a choice: {我|wǒ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}. {茶|chá}{或者|huò zhě}{咖啡|kā fēi}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ} (either is fine) would work too. {我|wǒ}{又|yòu}{喝|hē}{了|le} is "I drank some again".

questions.stem: Listen. How many times has Xiao Wang come?

audio.text: 小王昨天来了，今天又来了。

questions.explanation: {昨天|zuó tiān}{来|lái}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}{又|yòu}{来|lái}{了|le}: he came yesterday and again today. {又|yòu} is "again" for something that has happened. A visit still to come would be {明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái}.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{游泳馆|yóu yǒng guǎn}{通知|tōng zhī}：{只要|zhǐ yào}{有|yǒu}{游泳|yóu yǒng}{卡|kǎ}，{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{进去|jìn qù}{游泳|yóu yǒng}。{如果|rú guǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{卡|kǎ}，{可以|kě yǐ}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{买|mǎi}{票|piào}，{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{票|piào}{二十五|èr shí wǔ}{元|yuán}。{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{一|yì}{米|mǐ}{四|sì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{进去|jìn qù}{游泳|yóu yǒng}。" Which is true?
choices: Without a card you can't swim.
Children under 1.4 metres can't come at all.
A child of 1.5 metres may swim alone.
questions.explanation: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{一|yì}{米|mǐ}{四|sì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{进去|jìn qù}{游泳|yóu yǒng}: only children of 1.4 m and over may go in alone, so 1.5 m is fine. Without a card you buy a ticket ({二十五|èr shí wǔ}{元|yuán}, 25 yuan). Smaller children aren't banned; they come with an adult.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{旁边|páng biān}{新|xīn}{开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}。{那儿|nàr}{的|de}{菜|cài}{不但|bú dàn}{好吃|hǎo chī}，{而且|ér qiě}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}。{只要|zhǐ yào}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{去|qù}{那儿|nàr}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。{可是|kě shì}{周末|zhōu mò}{人|rén}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{才|cái}{有|yǒu}{位子|wèi zi}。" ({位子|wèi zi}: seat) When does the writer get a seat at the weekend?
choices: never: they don't go at weekends
questions.explanation: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{才|cái}{有|yǒu}{位子|wèi zi}: only by going early is there a seat. The food is {不但|bú dàn}{好吃|hǎo chī}，{而且|ér qiě}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi} (good and cheap), and the writer goes {只要|zhǐ yào}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān} (whenever there's time). ({可是|kě shì} is "but", next lesson's word.)

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: As long as you practise every day, you can learn Chinese well.
questions.explanation: {只要|zhǐ yào}{你|nǐ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 {只要|zhǐ yào} sets the condition and {就|jiù} starts the result. {只要|zhǐ yào} can also follow the subject ({你|nǐ}{只要|zhǐ yào}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}…). {才|cái} goes with {只有|zhǐ yǒu}, not {只要|zhǐ yào}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}___ {者|zhě}{打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}{吧|ba}。 (Let's go by metro or by taxi.)
questions.explanation: {或者|huò zhě} huò zhě (or, in a statement): {我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{或者|huò zhě}{打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}{吧|ba}。 {或|huò} has 戈 on the right; don't confuse it with {国|guó}.

questions.stem: How do you say "You don't have to go."?
questions.explanation: The negative of {得|děi} (have to) and {必须|bì xū} (must) is {不用|bú yòng} (or {不必|bú bì}): {你|nǐ}{不用|bú yòng}{去|qù}. ×{不|bú}{必须|bì xū} doesn't exist, and {不得|bù dé} on notices means "may not", the opposite of what you want to say.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {除了|chú le}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{以外|yǐ wài}，{我们|wǒ men}___ {去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}。 (We've all been to Beijing except Xiao Wang.)
questions.explanation: {除了|chú le} X {以外|yǐ wài} + {都|dōu} makes X the exception: everyone except Xiao Wang. With {还|hái} or {也|yě} it would mean "besides Xiao Wang, we too…", so Xiao Wang would be included.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {除了|chú le}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{他|tā}___ {会|huì}{说|shuō}{英语|Yīng yǔ}。 (Besides Chinese, he also speaks English.)
questions.explanation: "Besides X, also…" is {除了|chú le} X + {还|hái} (or {也|yě}): Chinese is included, and English comes on top. {都|dōu} would make Chinese the exception. ({英语|Yīng yǔ}: English.)

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I don't often drink coffee."?
questions.explanation: "Not often" is {不|bù}{常|cháng}. ×{不|bù}{常常|cháng cháng} is wrong, and {常常|cháng cháng}{不|bù}{喝|hē} means "often don't drink", a different idea.

questions.stem: What does "{雨|yǔ}{一直|yì zhí}{下|xià}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。" mean?
choices: It rained non-stop for three days.
It always rains for three days.
It will rain for three more days.
questions.explanation: {一直|yì zhí} is "without a break, all along": the rain went on for three days. {总是|zǒng shì} would be "always, every time" (a repeated habit), which doesn't fit one spell of rain.

questions.stem: Your friend has just finished a twelve-hour shift. What does "{你|nǐ}{一定|yí dìng}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}{了|le}{吧|ba}！" mean here?
questions.explanation: {一定|yí dìng} with a guess is "must be": you must be tired. With a plan it's a promise ({我|wǒ}{一定|yí dìng}{来|lái}), and with {要|yào} it's "be sure to" ({你|nǐ}{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{来|lái}).

questions.stem: The sky has gone dark and the wind is up. Which sentence fits?
questions.explanation: {看来|kàn lái} (it looks as if) starts the sentence, and {要|yào}…{了|le} says something is about to happen: {看来|kàn lái}{要|yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}. {看来|kàn lái}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le} would mean it has started raining.

questions.stem: How do you say "You'd better take an umbrella."?
questions.explanation: {最好|zuì hǎo} goes before the verb, like a modal verb: {你|nǐ}{最好|zuì hǎo}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}. ({伞|sǎn}: umbrella, lesson 10.) Between the verb and its object it doesn't work: {带|dài}{最好|zuì hǎo}{伞|sǎn} would need {的|de} ("the best umbrella"), and that isn't advice.

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}。" mean?
choices: This is the only nice item, and it's expensive.
This is nice, but only if it's cheap.
This is nice; it's just a bit expensive.
questions.explanation: {只是|zhǐ shì} is a soft "it's just that": the good part stays in front, and the small problem follows.

questions.stem: How is {几乎|jī hū} (almost) written in pinyin?
questions.explanation: {几乎|jī hū} is jī hū, two first tones. {几|jǐ} is jǐ in {几|jǐ}{个|gè} (how many), but jī in {几乎|jī hū}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {应该|yīng gāi} yīng gāi (should): two high, level tones, 1+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {必须|bì xū} bì xū (must): a falling tone, then a level one, 4+1.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? 必___ (must)
questions.explanation: {必须|bì xū} bì xū: {须|xū} is 彡 (three strokes of hair) and {页|yè}. All four have {页|yè} on the right: {颜|yán} ({颜色|yán sè}, colour), {顾|gù} ({照顾|zhào gù}, look after) and {题|tí} ({问题|wèn tí}, question).

questions.stem: Which character is gāi, as in "should"?
questions.explanation: {该|gāi} is the speech radical 讠 with 亥, which also gives the sound of {孩|hái} hái ({孩子|hái zi}). {刻|kè} kè has 亥 with 刂, and {课|kè} kè is 讠 with {果|guǒ}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker mean?

audio.text: 你不用来了，我一个人可以。

choices: There's no need for you to come.
questions.explanation: {不用|bú yòng}{来|lái} is "no need to come", and {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{可以|kě yǐ} is "I can manage on my own". "Must not" would be much stronger ({别|bié}{来|lái}, {不|bù}{能|néng}{来|lái}).

questions.stem: Listen. Who didn't come?

audio.text: 除了小李，大家都来了。

questions.explanation: {除了|chú le}{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}: everyone came except Xiao Li. ({小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}: a name.)

questions.stem: Listen. Why is the speaker leaving?

audio.text: 我得走了，明天还要早点儿上班。

choices: they have to work early tomorrow
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{得|děi}{走|zǒu}{了|le} (I have to go), {明天|míng tiān}{还|hái}{要|yào}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{上班|shàng bān} (I've got to be at work early tomorrow too).

questions.stem: Read: "{考试|kǎo shì}{通知|tōng zhī}：{大家|dà jiā}{必须|bì xū}{在|zài}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{以前|yǐ qián}{到|dào}{教室|jiào shì}。{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{带|dài}{学生卡|xué sheng kǎ}，{没有|méi yǒu}{学生卡|xué sheng kǎ}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{可以|kě yǐ}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}。{除了|chú le}{笔|bǐ}{以外|yǐ wài}，{其他|qí tā}{东西|dōng xi}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{能|néng}{带|dài}{进|jìn}{教室|jiào shì}。{不用|bú yòng}{带|dài}{词典|cí diǎn}。" ({学生卡|xué sheng kǎ}: student card) Which is true?
choices: Students may bring a pen into the room.
Students without a card can't sit the exam.
Students should arrive after half past eight.
questions.explanation: {除了|chú le}{笔|bǐ}{以外|yǐ wài}，{其他|qí tā}{东西|dōng xi}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{能|néng}{带|dài}{进|jìn}{教室|jiào shì}: nothing but a pen may go in. A passport replaces a missing card, and {不用|bú yòng}{带|dài}{词典|cí diǎn} means no dictionary is needed. {必须|bì xū}…{以前|yǐ qián}{到|dào}: arrive before 8:30.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Everyone has gone home except him.
questions.explanation: {除了|chú le}{他|tā}{以外|yǐ wài}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}。 {除了|chú le}…{以外|yǐ wài} + {都|dōu} makes him the exception; {以外|yǐ wài} can be left out, and the {除了|chú le} phrase can also follow the subject ({大家|dà jiā}{除了|chú le}{他|tā}{以外|yǐ wài}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}). {还|hái} would make it "besides him".

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {你|nǐ}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{应|yīng}___ {多|duō}{休息|xiū xi}。 (You've got a cold; you should rest more.)
questions.explanation: {应该|yīng gāi} yīng gāi (should). {该|gāi} is 讠 (speech) with 亥 on the right.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I've finished my homework."?
questions.explanation: A person finishing a task uses a result complement: {写|xiě}{完|wán} (write + finish). {结束|jié shù} is for events coming to an end ({比赛|bǐ sài}{结束|jié shù}{了|le}, the match is over), so ×{我|wǒ}{结束|jié shù}{了|le}{作业|zuò yè} is a typical mistake.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我们|wǒ men}___ {了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{问题|wèn tí}。 (We came up against lots of problems learning Chinese.)
questions.explanation: Problems are {遇到|yù dào} (come up against). {遇见|yù jiàn} is meeting people by chance, {见面|jiàn miàn} a planned meeting (lesson 29), and {分开|fēn kāi} is "to part".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {到|dào}{了|le}{公司|gōng sī}，{我|wǒ}{才|cái}___ {手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。 (Only when I got to the office did I notice my phone was missing.)
questions.explanation: {发现|fā xiàn} is noticing or finding out a fact, often followed by a whole clause: {发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}. {找|zhǎo}{到|dào} is finding something you were looking for ({我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{手机|shǒu jī}), the opposite situation here.

questions.stem: Your friend says "{你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{吗|ma}？" What does your friend think?
choices: You have never been to Beijing.
You are going to Beijing soon.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ is a rhetorical question: the negative question makes a positive point, "you've been to Beijing, haven't you?" Your friend expects you to know about it.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{哪儿|nǎr}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{啊|a}？" mean?
choices: I don't have any time at all.
questions.explanation: {哪儿|nǎr}…{啊|a}？ is rhetorical here: "where would I find the time?", that is, I have none. A positive rhetorical question makes a negative point.

questions.stem: How is 长 read in "{她|tā}长{得|de}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{她|tā}{妈妈|mā ma}。" (She looks just like her mum.)
questions.explanation: {长|zhǎng}{得|de} + description is about how someone has grown to look: zhǎng, as in {长大|zhǎng dà} (grow up). {长|cháng} (long) describes length: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}. {张|zhāng} zhāng is the measure word for flat things.

questions.stem: What does "{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{这个|zhè ge}{很|hěn}{难|nán}，{其实|qí shí}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}。" mean?
choices: Everyone says it's hard; actually it's easy.
Everyone says it's hard, and it really is.
Everyone says it's easy, but it's hard.
Of course it's hard, as everyone says.
questions.explanation: {其实|qí shí} (actually, in fact) corrects what people think: they say it's hard, but in fact it's easy. "Of course" would be {当然|dāng rán}.

questions.stem: How do you say "a book about Chinese history"?
choices: {一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}
{一|yì}{本|běn}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}
{一|yì}{本|běn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{关于|guān yú}{的|de}{书|shū}
{关于|guān yú}{一|yì}{本|běn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{书|shū}
questions.explanation: A {关于|guān yú} phrase before a noun takes {的|de}, and the whole thing goes in front of the noun, after the number and measure word: {一|yì}{本|běn} + {关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ} + {的|de} + {书|shū}. English order (a book about…) puts it after.

questions.stem: What does "{过去|guò qù}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}，{现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。" mean? ({辣|là}: spicy)
choices: I used to dislike spicy food; now I love it.
I went over to eat spicy food and liked it.
I don't like spicy food any more.
Spicy food is from the past.
questions.explanation: {过去|guò qù} here is the noun "the past", set against {现在|xiàn zài} (now). The verb {过去|guò qù} (to go over) would follow a verb of movement or stand before a place.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {重要|zhòng yào} zhòng yào (important): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {当然|dāng rán} dāng rán (of course): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened?

audio.text: 回到家，我才发现手机不见了。

choices: The speaker found the phone at home.
The speaker noticed only at home that the phone was missing.
The speaker couldn't find the way home.
questions.explanation: {回|huí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{发现|fā xiàn}…: "only when I got home did I notice…", and {手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}: "my phone had gone". {发现|fā xiàn} is noticing or discovering, not finding the thing again (that would be {找|zhǎo}{到|dào}).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? 结___ (to end)
questions.explanation: {结束|jié shù} jié shù: {束|shù} is 木 with a {口|kǒu} tied round its middle. {={来|lái}=} (come) has two short strokes (a dot and a left-falling stroke) instead of {口|kǒu}, {={东|dōng}=} (east) is simpler, and {末|mò} ({周末|zhōu mò}) has two horizontals. (In traditional characters {+{东|dōng}+} looks very like {束|shù}: look for the {日|rì} inside it.)

questions.stem: Which character is shí, as in {其|qí}___ (actually)?
questions.explanation: {其实|qí shí} qí shí: {={实|shí} is the roof 宀 over {头|tóu}. {头|tóu} (head) has no roof, {买|mǎi} (buy) has 乛 on top, and {卖|mài} (sell) adds {十|shí} to {买|mǎi}.=} In traditional characters the four are {+{实|shí}+}, {+{头|tóu}+}, {+{买|mǎi}+} and {+{卖|mài}+}.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened?

audio.text: 昨天我在路上遇到了一个老同学，我们已经十年没见了。

choices: The speaker ran into an old classmate after ten years.
The speaker arranged to meet a classmate.
The speaker has a new classmate.
The speaker sees this classmate every year.
questions.explanation: {遇到|yù dào} is meeting by chance (not planned), and {十|shí}{年|nián}{没|méi}{见|jiàn}{了|le} means they hadn't seen each other for ten years.

questions.stem: Listen. How long is the match?

audio.text: 比赛晚上八点开始，十点结束。

questions.explanation: {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{结束|jié shù}: it starts at eight and ends at ten, so it lasts two hours.

questions.stem: Your friend has been looking for her phone. Listen. What is the speaker saying?

audio.text: 你看，这不是你的手机吗？

questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ is a rhetorical question: "isn't this your phone?" means "here it is!". The speaker isn't asking, and isn't saying it isn't hers.

questions.stem: Read: "{有一次|yǒu yí cì}，{我|wǒ}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{去|qù}{公司|gōng sī}。{下|xià}{车|chē}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{发现|fā xiàn}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{包|bāo}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}，{先|xiān}{给|gěi}{公司|gōng sī}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{电话|diàn huà}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{了|le}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{的|de}{服务员|fú wù yuán}。{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{服务员|fú wù yuán}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{说|shuō}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{包|bāo}。{最后|zuì hòu}，{我|wǒ}{终于|zhōng yú}{拿|ná}{到|dào}{了|le}{包|bāo}，{里面|lǐ miàn}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{都|dōu}{在|zài}。" How did the story end?
choices: The writer got the bag back with everything in it.
The writer was late and lost the job.
The writer found the bag at the office.
questions.explanation: {最后|zuì hòu}，{我|wǒ}{终于|zhōng yú}{拿|ná}{到|dào}{了|le}{包|bāo}，{里面|lǐ miàn}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{都|dōu}{在|zài}: in the end the writer got the bag back and nothing was missing.
