The story moves from cause ({发现|fā xiàn}{包|bāo}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}) through process ({先|xiān}…{然后|rán hòu}…) to result ({最后|zuì hòu}…{终于|zhōng yú}…).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: When I got home, I found that my phone was missing.
questions.explanation: {到|dào}{家|jiā}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。 The time clause comes first, and {发现|fā xiàn} takes a whole clause after it ({手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}). {找|zhǎo}{到|dào} would mean you found the phone.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{很|hěn}___ {要|yào}。 (This matter is very important.)
questions.explanation: {重要|zhòng yào} zhòng yào (important). {重|zhòng} starts with a short left-falling stroke; its long vertical goes through the middle after the box.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm meeting him tomorrow."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{明天|míng tiān}{见面|jiàn miàn}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {见面|jiàn miàn} is a separable verb with its own object ({面|miàn}, face), so the person comes in with {跟|gēn}: {跟|gēn}{他|tā}{见面|jiàn miàn}. ×{见面|jiàn miàn}{他|tā} is the usual mistake. {见面|jiàn miàn}{了|le} would say the meeting has already happened.

questions.stem: Which one is wrong?
questions.explanation: {帮忙|bāng máng} already has its object ({忙|máng}), so it can't take a person after it: ×{帮忙|bāng máng}{我|wǒ}. Say {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}, {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng}, or use {帮助|bāng zhù}, which is also a noun ({谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}).

questions.stem: How do you say "He lent me a book."?
questions.explanation: {借|jiè} is both "borrow" and "lend"; "lend to" is {借|jiè}{给|gěi} + person: {他|tā}{借|jiè}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}. {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{借|jiè}{了|le}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū} and {他|tā}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{借|jiè}{了|le}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū} are borrowing (I from him, he from me), and {还|huán} is "give back".

questions.stem: How is 还 read in "{我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}还{书|shū}。" (I'll return the books tomorrow.)
questions.explanation: As a verb, "to give back", it's huán: {还|huán}{书|shū}, {还|huán}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}. {还|hái} (still, also) is the adverb of {还是|hái shi}. {换|huàn} huàn (to change, lesson 08) is the fourth tone.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。" tell you?
choices: The speaker studied in China last year.
The speaker would vaguely like to visit China one day.
The speaker has decided to study in China next year.
The speaker is studying in China now.
questions.explanation: {打算|dǎ suàn} is a plan, a decision about the future: next year ({明年|míng nián}) the speaker intends to study abroad ({留学|liú xué}) in China. A vague wish would be {想|xiǎng}; a past experience {留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}.

questions.stem: How do you say "Thank you for your help!"?
questions.explanation: {帮助|bāng zhù} is a verb and also a noun, so it can follow {你|nǐ}{的|de}: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}. {帮|bāng} is only a verb, and {帮忙|bāng máng} can't take {我|wǒ} after it. ({谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮忙|bāng máng} is also heard, with {帮忙|bāng máng} as a noun.)

questions.stem: A Chinese student is doing a degree in Britain. In Britain, what is she?
questions.explanation: {留学生|liú xué shēng} is a student studying in another country, whichever country that is. {校长|xiào zhǎng} is a head teacher, {名单|míng dān} a list of names, and {男生|nán shēng} a male student.

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{关系|guān xi}。" mean?
choices: You and I don't get on.
This has nothing to do with you.
questions.explanation: {跟|gēn}…{有|yǒu}{关系|guān xi} is "to have to do with"; with {没有|méi yǒu}, "to have nothing to do with". {关系|guān xi} also means a relationship between people ({我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{关系|guān xi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}).

questions.stem: What does "{有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì}{的话|de huà}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{看看|kàn kan}。" mean?
choices: If I get the chance, I'd like to visit Shanghai.
I went to Shanghai when I had the chance.
I'm going to Shanghai on business.
Shanghai has a lot of opportunities.
questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì} (have the chance) + {的话|de huà} (if): if I get the chance. {想|xiǎng}{去|qù}…{看看|kàn kan} is a wish: I'd like to go and see.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {留学|liú xué} liú xué (to study abroad): two rising tones, 2+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {打算|dǎ suàn} dǎ suàn (to plan): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Why is the speaker thanking the listener?

audio.text: 谢谢你的帮助，我的汉语水平提高了很多。

choices: for help that has improved the speaker's Chinese
questions.explanation: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}: "thank you for your help", and {我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}: "my Chinese has improved a lot". {帮助|bāng zhù} is the noun here, after {你|nǐ}{的|de}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? 帮___ (to help)
questions.explanation: {帮助|bāng zhù} bāng zhù: {助|zhù} is {且|qiě} + {力|lì}. All four contain {力|lì} (strength): {动|dòng} ({运动|yùn dòng}), {加|jiā} (to add) and {男|nán} (田 + {力|lì}).

questions.stem: Which character is jiè, "to borrow"?
questions.explanation: {借|jiè} is 亻 (person) with 昔. {错|cuò} cuò (wrong) has the same right side with 钅. {住|zhù} (to live) and {信|xìn} (letter) also have 亻.

questions.stem: Listen. Where will they meet?

audio.text: 我们明天下午三点在图书馆门口见面吧。

questions.explanation: {在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{门口|mén kǒu}{见面|jiàn miàn}: meet at the library entrance, tomorrow at three in the afternoon.

questions.stem: Listen. How long can the book be borrowed?

audio.text: 这本书可以借两个星期，借书的时候请带学生卡。

questions.explanation: {可以|kě yǐ}{借|jiè}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}: two weeks. The rest is "please bring your student card when you borrow books" ({学生卡|xué sheng kǎ}: student card).

questions.stem: Listen. What are the speaker's plans?

audio.text: 我叫露西，是美国人。我去过一次北京，明年我打算去上海留学。

choices: to study in Shanghai next year
to study in Beijing next year
to visit Beijing for the first time
questions.explanation: {明年|míng nián}{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{留学|liú xué}: next year she plans to study in Shanghai. Beijing is a past experience: {去|qù}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{北京|Běi jīng} (she's been to Beijing once). ({美国|Měi guó}: the USA.)

questions.stem: Read the email: "{各位|gè wèi}{新|xīn}{同学|tóng xué}：{为了|wèi le}{帮助|bāng zhù}{大家|dà jiā}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{习惯|xí guàn}{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}，{学校|xué xiào}{打算|dǎ suàn}{在|zài}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{五|wǔ}{日|rì}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}，{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{开|kāi}{一|yí}{个|gè}{见面会|jiàn miàn huì}。{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{参加|cān jiā}，{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{三|sān}{日|rì}{以前|yǐ qián}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{回信|huí xìn}。{留学生|liú xué shēng}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}" ({各位|gè wèi}: everyone; {见面会|jiàn miàn huì}: welcome meeting; {回信|huí xìn}: reply) What should you do if you want to go?
choices: go to the library on 3 September
reply to the email by 3 September
nothing: everyone is on the list
questions.explanation: {如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{参加|cān jiā}，{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{三|sān}{日|rì}{以前|yǐ qián}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{回信|huí xìn}: reply ({回信|huí xìn}) before 3 September. The meeting itself is on 5 September, at 2 p.m., on the library's third floor.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'm planning to go and study in China next year.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。 The time word goes before the verb phrase, either after {打算|dǎ suàn} or before it (or at the very start). {过|guo} is for experiences, not plans.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{可以|kě yǐ}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}___ {一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}{吗|ma}？ (Can I borrow a book from you?)
questions.explanation: {跟|gēn} + person + {借|jiè} + thing: borrow from someone. {借|jiè} is 亻 with 昔 on the right.

questions.stem: According to the reports this course used, how many questions does the written part of the new HSK 3 have?
questions.explanation: 70: 30 listening, 30 reading and 10 writing, in about 83 minutes. 40 and 60 are the new HSK 1 and 2. Check the official site before your exam: formats can change.

questions.stem: According to the reports this course used, what is new about the speaking test at HSK 3?
choices: It is now a required part of the exam, taken at a separate time.
It is only for candidates on a computer.
questions.explanation: From level 3, reports say the new HSK includes a speaking test of about 15 minutes, registered for with the written exam and taken at a separate time. It doesn't replace the writing part.

questions.stem: You have one minute to find the start time of a meeting in a long email. What do you do?
choices: Read every sentence carefully from the start.
Translate the email into English first.
Look for {点|diǎn} and a number: scan for the fact.
questions.explanation: Scanning: read the question, then look for the characters that carry the fact, here a time ({点|diǎn}, {半|bàn}, {刻|kè}, {上午|shàng wǔ} / {下午|xià wǔ}). Skimming (title, first and last lines) tells you what the text is about, not the time.

questions.stem: Scan the notice: "{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{通知|tōng zhī}：{从|cóng}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{到|dào}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{早上|zǎo shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}；{周末|zhōu mò}{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}，{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}。" When does the library close on Saturdays?
questions.explanation: {周末|zhōu mò}…{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}: at the weekend it closes at 5 p.m. On weekdays it closes at 10 p.m. ({晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}), and at the weekend it opens at 10 a.m. ({上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Please shut the door."?
questions.explanation: {把|bǎ} + object + verb + result: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{门|mén}{关|guān}{上|shàng} (lesson 03). The object ({门|mén}) comes between {把|bǎ} and the verb, and the verb needs something after it ({上|shàng}).

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。" mean?
choices: Someone has ridden off on my bike.
I lent my bike to someone.
My bike is too old to ride.
questions.explanation: {被|bèi} marks the passive (lesson 13): the bike was ridden away by someone ({人|rén}, an unnamed person). {被|bèi} sentences are usually about something unwelcome.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Beijing isn't as hot as Shanghai."?
choices: {北京|Běi jīng}{没有|méi yǒu}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}。
{北京|Běi jīng}{不|bù}{比|bǐ}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}。
{北京|Běi jīng}{跟|gēn}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{不|bú}{热|rè}{一样|yí yàng}。
questions.explanation: A {没有|méi yǒu} B ({那么|nà me}) + adjective (lesson 04): {北京|Běi jīng}{没有|méi yǒu}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}. ×{比|bǐ}…{不|bú}{热|rè} isn't the way to say "less"; {跟|gēn}…{一样|yí yàng} is "the same as".

questions.stem: Your friend speaks too fast for you. Which sentence says "I can't understand."?
questions.explanation: The negative potential complement puts {不|bù} between the verb and the result: {听|tīng}{不|bù}{懂|dǒng} (lesson 06). The positive is {听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}. {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng} (without {得|de}) would be "I didn't understand" (just now).

questions.stem: The meeting started at nine. What does "{他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{来|lái}。" tell you?
choices: He only came at ten: late.
He came at ten and left at once.
questions.explanation: {才|cái} before the verb means "not until": later than expected (lesson 25). Early would be {他|tā}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{来|lái}{了|le} ({就|jiù}, with {了|le}).

questions.stem: Choose the words: {天气|tiān qì}___ {冷|lěng}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{点儿|diǎnr}{衣服|yī fu}{吧|ba}。 (It's getting colder and colder: put more clothes on.)
questions.explanation: {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè} + adjective: more and more (lesson 12). {越|yuè}…{越|yuè} needs two parts ({越|yuè}{下|xià}{越|yuè}{大|dà}), and {一边|yì biān} goes with a second {一边|yì biān}.

questions.stem: Which pair completes it? ___ {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}，{我|wǒ}___ {听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}。 (As long as you speak a little more slowly, I can understand.)
questions.explanation: "As long as" is a condition that is enough: {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}. {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái} would make slow speech the only way.

questions.stem: Listen. Will the man go to the party?

audio.text: 我很想去，可是明天晚上我得加班。

choices: No: he has to work late.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可是|kě shì}… is a polite no: what follows {可是|kě shì} is the answer. {明天|míng tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{加班|jiā bān}: he has to work overtime tomorrow evening. ({加班|jiā bān}: to work overtime.)

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. When is the panda house closed?

audio.text: 各位游客，大熊猫馆中午十二点到下午两点休息，如果想看大熊猫，最好上午去。

questions.explanation: {中午|zhōng wǔ}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{休息|xiū xi}: closed from noon to two. The advice is to go in the morning ({最好|zuì hǎo}{上午|shàng wǔ}{去|qù}).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker mean?

audio.text: 你不是说过要来吗？怎么没来？

choices: "You said you'd come: why didn't you?"
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ is rhetorical: "didn't you say you'd come?", meaning you did say so. {怎么|zěn me}{没|méi}{来|lái}？ asks why you didn't.

questions.stem: Read the ad: "{找|zhǎo}{同屋|tóng wū}：{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{附近|fù jìn}{租|zū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{房子|fáng zi}，{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{房间|fáng jiān}。{房子|fáng zi}{离|lí}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。{我|wǒ}{希望|xī wàng}{同屋|tóng wū}{不但|bú dàn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{安静|ān jìng}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。" ({同屋|tóng wū}: flatmate; {租|zū}: to rent) What does the writer want in a flatmate?
choices: someone who likes quiet and speaks some Chinese
someone who can pay four thousand a month
someone who lives near the metro
questions.explanation: {不但|bú dàn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{安静|ān jìng}，{而且|ér qiě}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}: likes quiet and speaks a little Chinese. {两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}{钱|qián} is the rent per month, and the flat itself is near the metro.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {考试|kǎo shì} kǎo shì (exam): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {水平|shuǐ píng} shuǐ píng (level, standard): a dipping tone, then a rising one, 3+2.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: My bike has been ridden off by someone.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{别人|bié ren}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 {被|bèi} + the doer + verb + result. {把|bǎ} would make the bike the thing someone acts on with the doer first: {别人|bié ren}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Write the word in characters (or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{门口|mén kǒu} ___ 。 (jiàn miàn: to meet)
questions.explanation: {见面|jiàn miàn} jiàn miàn: {见|jiàn} (see) + {面|miàn} (face). Remember it takes no object: {跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{见面|jiàn miàn}.

questions.stem: Which is zhòng yào, "important"?
questions.explanation: {重要|zhòng yào}: {重|zhòng} (heavy) + {要|yào}. {种|zhǒng} zhǒng (kind) and {中|zhōng} zhōng (middle) sound close but aren't the same syllable and tone; 众 isn't a course character.

questions.stem: Who wrote 《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》 (Journey to the West)?
choices: It's traditionally credited to Wu Cheng'en, though the early editions name no author.
The monk Xuanzang wrote it about his own journey.
It was written by Sun Wukong's followers.
Nobody knows when or where it was written.
questions.explanation: The novel is traditionally attributed to {吴承恩|Wú Chéng ēn} (Wu Cheng'en), but the early editions don't name him and the attribution is disputed. {玄奘|Xuán zàng} (Xuanzang) was the real monk behind {唐僧|Táng sēng}, and the earliest surviving edition is known: Nanjing, 1592, in the Ming dynasty.

questions.stem: What is the history behind the novel?
choices: a war between two Tang emperors
a real monk's journey to India in the 7th century to bring back Buddhist scriptures
the building of the Great Wall
a monkey kept at the Ming court
questions.explanation: Xuanzang (602–664) travelled from Chang'an to India and back, leaving in 629, to bring scriptures to China. The novel turns his journey into a fantasy with demons and magic.

questions.stem: Read: "{她|tā}{听说|tīng shuō}，{只要|zhǐ yào}{吃|chī}{了|le}{唐僧|Táng sēng}{的|de}{肉|ròu}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{长生不老|cháng shēng bù lǎo}。" ({长生不老|cháng shēng bù lǎo}: live for ever) Why does the demon want to catch the monk?
choices: She wants him to teach her.
She believes eating him will make her live for ever.
She is looking for her daughter.
questions.explanation: {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} (as long as… then): as long as she eats the Tang monk's flesh ({肉|ròu}), she will live for ever. Her daughter is only an excuse she makes up later, in disguise.

questions.stem: Read: "{她|tā}……{马上|mǎ shàng}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{漂亮|piào liang}{的|de}{女孩儿|nǚ háir}……{白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}{又|yòu}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{奶奶|nǎi nai}……{第|dì}{三|sān}{次|cì}，{白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{爷爷|yé ye}。" What does the demon ({白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}) turn into first, second and third?
choices: an old man, an old woman, a girl
a girl, an old woman, an old man
a monk, a monkey, a pig
a girl, a horse, a pile of bones
questions.explanation: First {一|yí}{个|gè}{漂亮|piào liang}{的|de}{女孩儿|nǚ háir} (a pretty girl) with food, then {一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{奶奶|nǎi nai} (an old woman) looking for her daughter, then {一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{爷爷|yé ye} (an old man) looking for his family. After the last blow she becomes {一堆白骨|yì duī bái gǔ}, a pile of bones.

questions.stem: Read: "{他|tā}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{双|shuāng}{火眼金睛|huǒ yǎn jīn jīng}，{一|yí}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{发现|fā xiàn}{她|tā}{是|shì}{妖怪|yāo guài}。" How does Sun Wukong know she is a demon?
choices: His fiery golden eyes see through her disguise at a glance.
questions.explanation: {火眼金睛|huǒ yǎn jīn jīng} are his "fiery golden eyes", and {一|yí}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{发现|fā xiàn} ({一|yī}…{就|jiù}) is "as soon as he looked, he saw". {发现|fā xiàn} is finding out a fact.

questions.stem: Sun Wukong strikes the girl the demon has turned into, and she falls down. Read: "{唐僧|Táng sēng}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì}：“{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{打死|dǎ sǐ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{人|rén}？”" ({打死|dǎ sǐ}: to kill) Why is the monk angry with Sun Wukong?
choices: He thinks Sun Wukong has killed innocent people.
Sun Wukong didn't bring any food.
Sun Wukong ate the girl's food.
Sun Wukong left without saying goodbye.
questions.explanation: {唐僧|Táng sēng}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì}：“{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{打死|dǎ sǐ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{人|rén}？” He believes the girl, the old woman and the old man were real people: he can't see what Sun Wukong sees.

questions.stem: Read the end of the episode: "{唐僧|Táng sēng}{又|yòu}{难过|nán guò}{又|yòu}{生气|shēng qì}，{最后|zuì hòu}{让|ràng}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{离开|lí kāi}。{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{哭|kū}{着|zhe}{跟|gēn}{师父|shī fu}{说|shuō}{了|le}{再见|zài jiàn}，{回|huí}{到|dào}{了|le}{他|tā}{的|de}{家|jiā}{花果山|Huā guǒ Shān}。" ({师父|shī fu}: master, the monk) How does the episode end?
choices: The monk thanks Sun Wukong and they travel on.
The monk sends Sun Wukong away, and he goes home to Flower-Fruit Mountain.
questions.explanation: {最后|zuì hòu}{让|ràng}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{离开|lí kāi}: in the end the monk makes him leave, and he returns to {花果山|Huā guǒ Shān}. Without him the travellers run into trouble ({遇到|yù dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{麻烦|má fan}), and later in the novel he comes back.

questions.stem: In "{白骨精|Bái gǔ jīng}{又|yòu}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{奶奶|nǎi nai}", what does {又|yòu} tell you?
choices: She changes again: it has happened before.
questions.explanation: {又|yòu} is "again" for a repetition that has happened (lesson 26): she had already turned into a girl once. A repetition still to come would take {再|zài}.

questions.stem: What does "{附近|fù jìn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}" mean?
choices: There was nobody at all nearby.
questions.explanation: {一|yī} + measure word + noun + {也|yě} + negative is "not a single…": {一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}, not a soul.

questions.stem: Listen. What happens?

audio.text: 孙悟空一看就知道她是妖怪，拿起棍子就打。

choices: Sun Wukong sees she is a demon and strikes at once.
Sun Wukong runs away from the demon.
Sun Wukong asks the girl her name.
Sun Wukong gives the girl some food.
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{知道|zhī dào}: as soon as he looks, he knows; {拿|ná}{起|qǐ}{棍子|gùn zi}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}: he picks up his staff and strikes straight away. ({棍子|gùn zi}: stick, staff.)

questions.stem: Listen. How does the monk feel?

audio.text: 唐僧又难过又生气，最后让孙悟空离开了。

questions.explanation: {又|yòu}{难过|nán guò}{又|yòu}{生气|shēng qì}: both sad and angry ({又|yòu}…{又|yòu}, lesson 08). {让|ràng}{孙悟空|Sūn Wù kōng}{离开|lí kāi}{了|le}: he made Sun Wukong leave.

questions.stem: Listen. What does Sun Wukong mean?

audio.text: 师父，您看，这不是一堆白骨吗？

choices: "Master, this isn't a pile of bones."
"Master, is this a pile of bones or not?"
"Master, look: it's a pile of bones, isn't it? (She was a demon.)"
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ is a rhetorical question (lesson 28): "isn't this a pile of bones?" means "look, it is!", proof that she was a demon.

questions.stem: Who wrote 《{春晓|Chūn xiǎo}》 (Spring Morning)?
questions.explanation: 《{春晓|Chūn xiǎo}》 is by {孟浩然|Mèng Hào rán} (Meng Haoran, about 689–740), a Tang poet of the countryside. {王之涣|Wáng Zhī huàn} wrote 《{登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}》; {吴承恩|Wú Chéng ēn} is the traditional author of 《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》, and {孔子|Kǒng zǐ} is Confucius.

questions.stem: How many characters does each of these two poems have?
questions.explanation: Both are five-character quatrains ({五言绝句|wǔ yán jué jù}): four lines of five characters, twenty in all.

questions.stem: How is 觉 read in "{春眠|chūn mián}{不|bù}觉{晓|xiǎo}"?
questions.explanation: Here {觉|jué} means "to feel, to notice", read jué as in {觉得|jué de}. The jiào of {睡觉|shuì jiào} means sleep, which doesn't fit: the poet doesn't notice the dawn.

questions.stem: In "{处处闻啼鸟|chù chù wén tí niǎo}", what does {闻|wén} mean?
questions.explanation: In classical Chinese {闻|wén} is "to hear": everywhere I hear the birds calling. Modern Chinese uses {闻|wén} for "smell", but "hear" survives in {新闻|xīn wén} (news, "newly heard").

questions.stem: 《{春晓|Chūn xiǎo}》 by {孟浩然|Mèng Hào rán} reads: "{春眠不觉晓|chūn mián bù jué xiǎo}，{处处闻啼鸟|chù chù wén tí niǎo}。{夜来风雨声|yè lái fēng yǔ shēng}，{花落知多少|huā luò zhī duō shǎo}。" What does the last line add to the poem?
choices: After the night's wind and rain, who knows how many flowers have fallen?
The poet counts the flowers exactly.
questions.explanation: {知多少|zhī duō shǎo} is "who knows how many?": the wind and rain in the night ({夜来风雨声|yè lái fēng yǔ shēng}) have brought flowers down, a small sadness that spring is passing.

questions.stem: Where did the Stork Tower ({鹳雀楼|Guàn què lóu}) stand?
choices: in Beijing, by the Forbidden City
on the east bank of the Yellow River, in today's Yongji in Shanxi
questions.explanation: The tower looked over the Yellow River at Puzhou, in today's Yongji, Shanxi. The old tower was lost long ago; a new one in the Tang style opened there in 2002.

questions.stem: A friend writes "{希望|xī wàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}！" What do they mean?
choices: They hope your Chinese gets even better.
They hope you move to a higher floor.
They hope you visit the Stork Tower.
They think your Chinese is too difficult.
questions.explanation: {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}, the last line of 《{登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}》, is used today for "to go one step further, to do even better".

questions.stem: What does "{黄河入海流|Huáng Hé rù hǎi liú}" mean?
choices: The Yellow River flows into the sea.
The sea flows into the Yellow River.
We sail on the Yellow River.
questions.explanation: {入|rù} is "to enter" and {流|liú} "to flow": the Yellow River flows into the sea. In modern Chinese: {黄河|Huáng Hé}{流进|liú jìn}{了|le}{大|dà}{海|hǎi}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which poem is it?

audio.text: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。

questions.explanation: {春眠不觉晓|chūn mián bù jué xiǎo}，{处处闻啼鸟|chù chù wén tí niǎo} is the opening of 《{春晓|Chūn xiǎo}》 by {孟浩然|Mèng Hào rán}. 《{静夜思|Jìng yè sī}》 is Li Bai's moon poem (HSK 2), and 《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》 is a novel.

questions.stem: Listen to the first line. Which line comes next?

audio.text: 白日依山尽

choices: {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}
{花落知多少|huā luò zhī duō shǎo}
{处处闻啼鸟|chù chù wén tí niǎo}
{黄河入海流|Huáng Hé rù hǎi liú}
questions.explanation: {白日依山尽|bái rì yī shān jìn}，{黄河入海流|Huáng Hé rù hǎi liú}: the sun sets along the hills, the Yellow River flows into the sea. Then {欲穷千里目|yù qióng qiān lǐ mù}， {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}.

questions.stem: Read the modern paraphrase: "{如果|rú guǒ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{得|de}{更|gèng}{远|yuǎn}，{就|jiù}{要|yào}{再|zài}{上|shàng}{一|yì}{层|céng}{楼|lóu}。" Which line of 《{登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}》 (On the Stork Tower) does it explain?
choices: {春眠不觉晓|chūn mián bù jué xiǎo}
{白日依山尽|bái rì yī shān jìn}
{欲穷千里目|yù qióng qiān lǐ mù}，{更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu}
{夜来风雨声|yè lái fēng yǔ shēng}
questions.explanation: {欲|yù} (wish to) {穷|qióng} (reach the end of) {千里目|qiān lǐ mù} (a view of a thousand li): to see further, go up one more floor. The paraphrase uses {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù} from lesson 26.

questions.stem: Which two words rhyme at the ends of lines 2 and 4 of 《{登鹳雀楼|Dēng Guàn què lóu}》?
questions.explanation: {黄河入海流|Huáng Hé rù hǎi liú} liú and {更上一层楼|gèng shàng yì céng lóu} lóu: the finals iu (iou) and ou rhyme, and they still do in Mandarin.

glossary.definition: The official spelling of Mandarin in the Latin alphabet, with tone marks over the vowels: {邻居|lín jū} is lín jū. This course shows it above every character; the Pinyin switch hides it.

The pitch pattern that belongs to every Mandarin syllable and changes its meaning: first (high, level) ā, second (rising) á, third (low, dipping) ǎ, fourth (falling) à, and the neutral tone (unmarked). {碗|wǎn} (bowl) and {万|wàn} (ten thousand) differ only in tone.
A short, light syllable with no tone of its own, written without a mark: the second syllable of {叔叔|shū shu}, {耳朵|ěr duo} and {别人|bié ren}, and suffixes such as {子|zi} in {房子|fáng zi}.

A change of tone caused by the next syllable. Two third tones: the first is said as a second ({打扫|dǎ sǎo} sounds like dá sǎo); this change is never written. {一|yī} and {不|bù} change too, and this course writes their changes: {一样|yí yàng}, {不用|bú yòng}.
A written unit of Chinese: one syllable, usually one meaning, and a shape made of strokes. A word can have one character ({灯|dēng}) or several ({洗衣机|xǐ yī jī}).
A smaller shape that recurs inside characters and often hints at meaning or sound: {腿|tuǐ} is built from the components {月|yuè} (here ⺼, the body) and 退.
The component a dictionary files a character under, often a hint at its meaning: ⺼ (the body) in {脸|liǎn} and {脚|jiǎo}, 扌 (hand) in {搬|bān} and {把|bǎ}, 石 (stone) in {碗|wǎn}.

{=The component of a character that once gave its sound. In some characters it still matches exactly (建 jiàn in 健 jiàn), in others only the rhyme is left ({令|lìng} lìng in {冷|lěng} lěng and 邻 lín), and in some it no longer helps (古 gǔ in 居 jū). Most characters are a meaning part plus a sound part.=}

How words are built from smaller meaningful pieces. Most Chinese words are two pieces side by side ({名|míng} + {人|rén} = {名人|míng rén}, a famous person); a few pieces attach in a fixed place as a prefix or a suffix ({老王|Lǎo Wáng}, {服务员|fú wù yuán}).
A piece that attaches before the main part of a word: {老|lǎo} in {老王|Lǎo Wáng} (friendly, for someone you know well), {小|xiǎo} in {小王|Xiǎo Wáng}, {第|dì} in {第|dì}{一|yī}.

A piece that attaches after the main part of a word: {员|yuán} (a member, staff: {服务员|fú wù yuán}), {子|zi} (a noun maker: {房子|fáng zi}, {箱子|xiāng zi}), {家|jiā} (an expert: {画家|huà jiā}), {们|men} (plural for people: {咱们|zán men}).

A word between a number (or {这|zhè} / {那|nà}) and a noun, chosen by the kind of thing: {一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}, {两|liǎng}{层|céng}{楼|lóu} (two floors), {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{椅子|yǐ zi} (a chair). Some measure words also count actions or amounts.
Who or what the sentence is about, usually first: {我|wǒ} in {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}, {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī} in {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}.
What the sentence says about the subject: the verb or adjective and everything that goes with it. In {他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}{多了|duō le}, the predicate is {比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}{多了|duō le}.
The person or thing a verb acts on, usually after the verb: {碗|wǎn} in {我|wǒ}{洗碗|xǐ wǎn}. In a {把|bǎ} sentence the object comes before the verb: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}.

A word or phrase that describes a noun and comes before it, often with {的|de}: {可爱|kě ài}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}, {我|wǒ}{邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}. One-syllable adjectives often join the noun without {的|de}: {新|xīn}{书|shū}, {旧|jiù}{房子|fáng zi}.

Several descriptions before one noun, in a fixed order: whose ({我|wǒ}{邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de}), which ({这|zhè} / {那|nà} + number + measure word: {那个|nà ge}), what it's like ({可爱|kě ài}{的|de}), then the noun: {我|wǒ}{邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de}{那个|nà ge}{可爱|kě ài}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}.

A word that goes before a verb or adjective to say how, when, how much or whether: {很|hěn}, {都|dōu}, {也|yě}, {就|jiù}, {不用|bú yòng} (no need to). Adverbs go before {把|bǎ} in a {把|bǎ} sentence: {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{关|guān}{了|le}.

A verb placed before another verb to add ability, permission, wish or need: {会|huì}, {能|néng}, {可以|kě yǐ}, {想|xiǎng}, {要|yào}. In a {把|bǎ} sentence it goes before {把|bǎ}: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{把|bǎ}{房间|fáng jiān}{打扫|dǎ sǎo}{一下|yí xià}.

A two-syllable verb made of a verb and its own object, which other words can go between: {搬家|bān jiā} ({搬|bān}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}{家|jiā}), {住院|zhù yuàn} ({住|zhù}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{院|yuàn}), {洗澡|xǐ zǎo} ({洗|xǐ}{个|gè}{澡|zǎo}), {睡觉|shuì jiào}.
A sentence where the object of the first verb is the doer of the second: {医生|yī shēng}{让|ràng}{他|tā}{住院|zhù yuàn} (the doctor had him admitted): {他|tā} is what {让|ràng} acts on and who {住院|zhù yuàn}.

Two clauses squeezed into one sentence without a pause or a full connector, linked only by a pair of adverbs. {一|yī}…{就|jiù} makes one: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}{就|jiù}{睡觉|shuì jiào}{了|le} (as soon as I got home, I went to sleep); {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{锻炼|duàn liàn}{就|jiù}{累|lèi} (whenever I exercise, I get tired).

A sentence where {把|bǎ} brings a particular object before the verb, and something must follow the verb to say what happened to it: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}, {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}, {别|bié}{把|bǎ}{灯|dēng}{关|guān}{了|le}. Negatives and modal verbs go before {把|bǎ}. Not used with verbs like {喜欢|xǐ huan}, {知道|zhī dào}, {是|shì}, {有|yǒu}.

The meaning of a {把|bǎ} sentence: what the subject does to a particular thing, and what becomes of it: moved ({放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}), changed ({洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}), finished or switched off ({吃|chī}{了|le}, {关|guān}{了|le}), handed over ({给|gěi}{他|tā}).

How an action unfolds (completed, in progress, lasting, experienced) rather than when. Chinese marks it with particles and adverbs instead of tenses: {了|le} (completed), {在|zài} (in progress), {着|zhe} (lasting state), {过|guo} (experience).
The light particle {着|zhe} after a verb for a state that lasts: {她|tā}{穿|chuān}{着|zhe}{红色|hóng sè}{的|de}{大衣|dà yī} (she's wearing a red coat), {门|mén}{开|kāi}{着|zhe} (the door is open).

A word or phrase right after a verb (or adjective) that says how the action came out, which way it went, how well it was done or how much: {洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng} (result), {搬|bān}{上去|shàng qù} (direction), {说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (degree), {高|gāo}{多了|duō le} (how much more).

A verb or adjective right after a verb, saying how the action turned out: {洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng} (wash clean), {吃|chī}{完|wán} (eat up), {关|guān}{上|shàng} (shut). Negative: {没|méi} + verb + complement: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}.

A movement word after a verb, often with {来|lái} (towards the speaker) or {去|qù} (away): {搬|bān}{进来|jìn lái}, {走|zǒu}{上去|shàng qù}, {拿|ná}{下来|xià lái}. A place object goes before {来|lái} / {去|qù} ({搬|bān}{进|jìn}{新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{去|qù}); a thing can go before or after them ({搬|bān}{进来|jìn lái}{一|yí}{个|gè}{沙发|shā fā}).
A description after verb + {得|de}, saying how well or how much something is done: {他|tā}{跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}, {她|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}.

A result or direction complement with {得|de} or {不|bù} between the verb and the complement, saying whether the result can be reached: {吃得完|chī de wán} (can finish eating), {吃不完|chī bu wán} (can't finish), {听不懂|tīng bu dǒng} (can't understand), {放不下|fàng bu xià} (won't fit), {搬不进去|bān bu jìn qù} (can't be moved in). The {得|de} and {不|bù} are light. Questions use {吗|ma} or both forms ({吃得完|chī de wán}{吃不完|chī bu wán}？); the object follows the verb or comes first as the topic, and the pattern isn't used with {把|bǎ}. Not to be confused with the degree complement, where {得|de} is followed by a description ({吃|chī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}, eats a lot) and the negative keeps {得|de} ({吃|chī}{得|de}{不|bù}{多|duō}).

Doubling a measure word (or one of the few one-syllable nouns that double like one, such as {天|tiān}, {人|rén} and {家|jiā}) to mean "every single one": {个个|gè gè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī} (every one of them is delicious), {天天|tiān tiān} (every day), {人人|rén rén} (everyone), {家家|jiā jiā} (every family). The doubled word comes before the verb, usually with {都|dōu}, and is the subject or topic, never the object. With {一|yī}, the doubled phrase {一|yí}{个|gè}{一|yí}{个|gè}({地|de}) (one by one) or {一|yì}{口|kǒu}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}({地|de}) (mouthful by mouthful) says how an action is done, before the verb.

"The more… the more…": {越|yuè} + A, {越|yuè} + B, where B changes with A: {雨|yǔ}{越|yuè}{下|xià}{越|yuè}{大|dà} (the more it rains, the heavier it gets: it's raining harder and harder), {他|tā}{越|yuè}{说|shuō}{越|yuè}{快|kuài} (he talks faster and faster). {越来越|yuè lái yuè} + adjective is "more and more", a change over time: {天气|tiān qì}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{冷|lěng}{了|le}. Like {更|gèng}, it's never used with {很|hěn} or {非常|fēi cháng}: not ~~{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}~~. Taught in lesson 12.

Saying how big the difference is when you compare: a little ({比|bǐ}…{一点儿|yì diǎnr}, {冬天|dōng tiān}{比|bǐ}{秋天|qiū tiān}{冷|lěng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}), a lot ({比|bǐ}…{多|duō}{了|le} / {得|de}{多|duō}: {冷|lěng}{多|duō}{了|le}, {冷|lěng}{得|de}{多|duō}), an exact amount ({他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{大|dà}{三|sān}{岁|suì}), not as much ({没有|méi yǒu}…{那么|nà me} + adjective), the same ({跟|gēn}…{一样|yí yàng}), even more ({更|gèng}), and the most ({最|zuì}). The degree words go after the adjective in a {比|bǐ} sentence, and {很|hěn}, {非常|fēi cháng} and {太|tài} can't be used there: not ~~{比|bǐ}{秋天|qiū tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}~~.

A sentence that starts with the person or thing something happens to, with {被|bèi} before the doer and the verb last: receiver + {被|bèi} + (doer) + verb + something more. {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le} (someone has ridden off on my bike). The doer can be left out ({我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}); the verb needs a result, a direction, a place or {了|le} after it; {没|méi} and {别|bié} go before {被|bèi}. In speech it is used mostly for things that went wrong, and {让|ràng} or {叫|jiào} can replace {被|bèi}. The {把|bǎ} sentence tells the same event from the doer's side: {弟弟|dì di}{把|bǎ}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃|chī}{了|le} = {蛋糕|dàn gāo}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}.

A sentence that describes a scene: place + verb + {着|zhe} + (number + measure word) + thing or person. {路口|lù kǒu}{站|zhàn}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén} (there's someone standing at the crossing), {桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū} (there's a book lying on the table). The place comes first without {在|zài}; what is there is new to the listener, so it usually has a number and a measure word; {着|zhe} says how it is there (standing, sitting, lying, written). Compare place + {有|yǒu} + thing, which only says that it exists.

Two actions done by the same person at the same time, each introduced by {一边|yì biān}: subject + {一边|yì biān} + verb + {一边|yì biān} + verb. {他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà} (he talks on the phone as he walks). The subject comes once, before the first {一边|yì biān}; both verbs are actions, not states (not {是|shì}, {有|yǒu}, {喜欢|xǐ huan}). In quick speech the {一|yī} can drop: {边|biān}{走|zǒu}{边|biān}{说|shuō}. Compare {又|yòu}…{又|yòu}, which joins two qualities ({又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}).

A measure word that counts actions instead of things: {次|cì} (occasions: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān}{次|cì}{北京|Běi jīng}), {遍|biàn} (times through, from beginning to end: {请|qǐng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}) and {下|xià} (quick, short actions; {一下|yí xià} makes an action brief: {你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}). Number + verb measure word goes after the verb and its {了|le} or {过|guo}. An ordinary noun object usually follows it ({我|wǒ}{读|dú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}), a pronoun object comes before it ({我|wǒ}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{他|tā}{一|yí}{次|cì}), and a long or definite object often comes first as the topic ({这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}). Ask with {几|jǐ}: {几|jǐ}{次|cì}？ {几|jǐ}{遍|biàn}？

Saying a verb twice when it has an object and also a complement after it, because {得|de} (or the time or number) must follow the verb directly: verb + object + verb + {得|de} + how well ({他|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}: he speaks Chinese well), or verb + object + verb + {了|le} + length of time ({我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{历史|lì shǐ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}). The first verb can be dropped, with the object first as a topic ({他|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}). Only the second verb takes {了|le}, and a negative goes after {得|de} ({他|tā}{打|dǎ}{球|qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}). ×{他|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} is wrong.

A question word used without asking anything, for "any", "every" or, with a negative, "none": {什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào} (knows everything), {谁|shéi}{都|dōu}{会|huì} (anyone can), {哪儿|nǎr}{都|dōu}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào} (can't find it anywhere), {我|wǒ}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng} (I can't understand anything). It goes before the verb with {都|dōu} or {也|yě} after it. In a yes/no question with {吗|ma}, a question word can also mean "any": {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{问题|wèn tí}{吗|ma}？ (do you have any questions?).

A complement after an adjective (or a verb of feeling) that only says "extremely, very": adjective + {极了|jí le} ({好听|hǎo tīng}{极了|jí le}, just wonderful; {累|lèi}{极了|jí le}, exhausted) or adjective + {得|de}{很|hěn} ({冷|lěng}{得|de}{很|hěn}, very cold). Nothing goes before the adjective (not {很|hěn}{好听|hǎo tīng}{极了|jí le}), and {极了|jí le} takes no {得|de}. Unlike an ordinary degree complement ({他|tā}{唱|chàng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, he sings well), it describes no action, only how strong the quality is.

Two adverbs that show how the speaker sees a time or an amount. After a time, {就|jiù} + verb + {了|le} is "already, as early as" ({他|tā}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{来|lái}{了|le}, he came at seven already), and {才|cái} + verb, with no {了|le}, is "not until, only then" ({他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{来|lái}, he didn't come until ten). {才|cái} before a number is "only" ({他|tā}{才|cái}{十|shí}{岁|suì}), and {直到|zhí dào}…{才|cái} is "not until…".

Steps told in order: {先|xiān} (first) before the first verb, {然后|rán hòu} (then) at the start of the next clause, and {最后|zuì hòu} (finally) for the last step: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{吃饭|chī fàn}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。 For plans and instructions, {再|zài} (then) before the second verb works too: {先|xiān}{洗手|xǐ shǒu}，{再|zài}{吃饭|chī fàn}。 {然后|rán hòu} is used for the past and the future; {再|zài} in this sense only for what hasn't happened yet.

Two clauses joined into one sentence, usually by a pair of linking words: {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ} (cause), {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} (contrast), {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù} (supposition), {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} and {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái} (condition), {不但|bú dàn}…{而且|ér qiě} (progression). In each pair the conjunction ({如果|rú guǒ}, {因为|yīn wèi}, {不但|bú dàn}) starts its clause or follows the subject, and the adverb ({就|jiù}, {才|cái}, {也|yě}, {还|hái}) goes after the subject of its clause. One half can often be left out.

A complex sentence whose first clause imagines a situation and whose second says what follows: {如果|rú guǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。 The first clause can end with {的话|de huà}, with or without {如果|rú guǒ}.

A complex sentence that sets a condition for the result. {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} makes the condition enough ("as long as"): {只要|zhǐ yào}{你|nǐ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}。 {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái} makes it the only way ("only if"): {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{多|duō}{听|tīng}{多|duō}{说|shuō}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 Note the different second words: {就|jiù} with {只要|zhǐ yào}, {才|cái} with {只有|zhǐ yǒu}.

A complex sentence whose second clause goes further than the first: {他|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{而且|ér qiě}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 With one subject, the subject comes before {不但|bú dàn}; with two, {不但|bú dàn} comes first and the second clause often adds {也|yě} or {还|hái}.

What an action is for. Chinese puts a purpose with {为了|wèi le} at the start ({为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}), or at the end with {是|shì}{为了|wèi le} ({他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}，{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}). For the person who benefits, use {为|wèi}: {妈妈|mā ma}{为|wèi}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}。

A question asked to make a point, not to get an answer. A negative rhetorical question makes a positive point and a positive one a negative point: {你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{吗|ma}？ (you have been), {我|wǒ}{哪儿|nǎr}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{啊|a}？ (I have no time). Common frames: {不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？, {这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？, {怎么|zěn me}{会|huì}…{呢|ne}？, {谁|shéi}{不|bù}…？

The standard test of Chinese for learners ({汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{考试|kǎo shì}). Its new version, often called HSK 3.0, has nine levels and a syllabus in force since July 2026. Level 3 covers 1,000 words and 655 characters, with a written exam of 70 questions (listening, reading, writing) in about 83 minutes and a speaking test of about 15 minutes, as reported from the official sample papers.

The spoken part of the new HSK from level 3 up, registered for with the written exam and taken at a separate time. At level 3 it has 15 questions in about 15 minutes: one detailed report on the sample paper describes repeating sentences, describing pictures and answering two questions after preparation (check the official sample paper). Reports say it takes the place of the old, separate HSKK.

Reading a text quickly for its general idea: what kind of text it is, who wrote it, to whom and why. With a notice or an email, the title or subject line ({主题|zhǔ tí}) and the name and date at the end tell you most of this before you read the middle.

Looking through a text for one fact, a time, a price or a place, without reading everything. Read the question first, then look for the characters that carry that fact: {点|diǎn}, {半|bàn} and {刻|kè} for times, {元|yuán} and {块|kuài} for prices, {在|zài} and the position words for places.

references.title: The 把 sentence
references.body:
## The pattern

Subject + (negative / modal verb / adverb) + {把|bǎ} + particular object + verb + **something after the verb**

| Subject | Before {把|bǎ} | {把|bǎ} + object | Verb | After the verb |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {我|wǒ} | | {把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn} | {洗|xǐ} | {干净|gān jìng}{了|le} |
| {请|qǐng} | | {把|bǎ}{书|shū} | {放|fàng} | {在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng} |
| {你|nǐ} | | {把|bǎ}{灯|dēng} | {关|guān} | {了|le}{吧|ba} |
| {他|tā} | | {把|bǎ}{箱子|xiāng zi} | {搬|bān} | {进来|jìn lái}{了|le} |
| {我|wǒ} | | {把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī} | {给|gěi} | {他|tā}{了|le} |
| {我|wǒ} | {没|méi} | {把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn} | {洗|xǐ} | {干净|gān jìng} |
| （{你|nǐ}） | {别|bié} | {把|bǎ}{脏|zāng}{衣服|yī fu} | {放|fàng} | {在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng} |
| {你|nǐ} | {能|néng} | {把|bǎ}{门|mén} | {关|guān} | {上|shàng}{吗|ma}？ |
| {我|wǒ} | {想|xiǎng} | {把|bǎ}{房间|fáng jiān} | {打扫|dǎ sǎo} | {一下|yí xià} |

## What can come after the verb

| Ending | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| {了|le} | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{饭|fàn}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 | I've eaten the food (it's done) |
| result complement | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}。 | I've washed the bowls clean |
| direction complement | {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{箱子|xiāng zi}{搬|bān}{上去|shàng qù}{了|le}。 | He's carried the box up |
| {在|zài} / {到|dào} + place | {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}。 | Please put the books here |
| {给|gěi} + person | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{钱|qián}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}。 | I'll give you the money |
| {一下|yí xià} or a doubled verb | {把|bǎ}{门|mén}{开|kāi}{一下|yí xià}。 / {把|bǎ}{房间|fáng jiān}{打扫打扫|dǎ sǎo dǎ sǎo}。 | Open the door a moment / give the room a clean |

Never a bare verb: ~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{饭|fàn}{吃|chī}~~, ~~{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{放|fàng}~~.

## When to use it

- **The object is particular**: this one, that one, the one both speakers know about ({把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}: the
  bowls in the sink). A new, unknown object takes the ordinary order: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{碗|wǎn}.
- **The verb does something to the object, with a result**: moving, changing, finishing, switching
  on or off, handing over. That's **disposal**.
- **With {在|zài} / {到|dào} + place after the verb, {把|bǎ} is required**: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng} (~~{我|wǒ}{放|fàng}{书|shū}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}~~).
- It's very common in requests and instructions: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}…, {别|bié}{把|bǎ}…, {你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}…{吧|ba}.

## Verbs that never take {把|bǎ}

Verbs of feeling, knowing, being and perceiving don't act on their object:

{喜欢|xǐ huan}, {爱|ài}, {知道|zhī dào}, {认识|rèn shi}, {觉得|jué de}, {是|shì}, {有|yǒu}, {在|zài}, {看见|kàn jiàn}, {听见|tīng jiàn}

~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{喜欢|xǐ huan}~~ → {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{他|tā}. ~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{看见|kàn jiàn}{了|le}~~ → {我|wǒ}{看见|kàn jiàn}{他|tā}{了|le}.

## Two other ways to say it

| {把|bǎ} sentence | Topic first | Plain order |
|---|---|---|
| {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}。 | {碗|wǎn}{我|wǒ}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}。 | (stiff here) |
| {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}。 | {书|shū}{我|wǒ}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}。 | ~~{我|wǒ}{放|fàng}{书|shū}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}~~ (wrong) |
| {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{饭|fàn}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 | {饭|fàn}{我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{了|le}{饭|fàn}。 (fine, but says less about the food) |

## {把|bǎ} as a measure word

For things held by a handle or a back: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{椅子|yǐ zi} (a chair), {两|liǎng}{把|bǎ}{伞|sǎn} (two umbrellas), {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{牙刷|yá shuā} (a
toothbrush). Number + {把|bǎ} + noun is counting; {把|bǎ} + noun + verb is the {把|bǎ} sentence:
{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{椅子|yǐ zi}{搬|bān}{出去|chū qù} (please carry this chair out).

## Related: {不见|bú jiàn}{了|le} and {丢|diū}

| | Subject | Example |
|---|---|---|
| {不见|bú jiàn}{了|le} | the missing thing | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。 (My phone's gone.) |
| {丢|diū} | the person who lost it | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{丢|diū}{了|le}。 / {我|wǒ}{丢|diū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{手机|shǒu jī}。 (I've lost my phone / a phone.) |

references.title: The 被 sentence and existential sentences (被, 着, 有, 在)
references.body:
## {被|bèi}: something happens to the subject

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| receiver + {被|bèi} + doer + verb + result | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | My phone's been taken by my little brother. |
| receiver + {被|bèi} + {人|rén} + verb + result | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | Someone's taken my bike. |
| receiver + {被|bèi} + verb + result (no doer) | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | My bike's been taken. |
| receiver + {被|bèi} + doer + verb + place | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{书|shū}{被|bèi}{他|tā}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}。 | My book was put on the table by him. |
| {没|méi} + {被|bèi} + … | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{没|méi}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}。 | My umbrella wasn't blown away. |
| {别|bié} + {被|bèi} + … | {别|bié}{被|bèi}{老师|lǎo shī}{看见|kàn jiàn}！ | Don't let the teacher see you! |
| time word + {被|bèi} + … | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{昨天|zuó tiān}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | My umbrella was blown away yesterday. |

- The verb never stands alone: add {了|le}, a result ({走|zǒu}, {完|wán}, {坏|huài}), a direction or a place.
- {没|méi}, {别|bié} and time words go **before** {被|bèi}: ~~{我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{没|méi}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}~~.
- In speech, {被|bèi} is mostly for unwelcome events; {让|ràng} and {叫|jiào} can replace it (then the doer must be
  said: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}).
- For ordinary events, use an active sentence: {老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}, not ~~{我们|wǒ men}{被|bèi}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}~~.

## {把|bǎ} and {被|bèi}: the same event from two sides

| Doer first: {把|bǎ} | Receiver first: {被|bèi} |
|---|---|
| {弟弟|dì di}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 |
| {风|fēng}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{伞|sǎn}{被|bèi}{风|fēng}{刮|guā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{他|tā}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| {他|tā}{没|méi}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{没|méi}{被|bèi}{他|tā}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}。 |

## Saying what is where: {有|yǒu}, {着|zhe} and {在|zài}

| Pattern | Example | Use |
|---|---|---|
| place + {有|yǒu} + thing | {桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。 | that something is there |
| place + verb + {着|zhe} + thing | {桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。 | how it is there (lying, standing, sitting) |
| place + verb + {着|zhe} + person | {路口|lù kǒu}{站|zhàn}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}。 | someone new in the scene |
| known thing / person + {在|zài} + place | {那|nà}{本|běn}{书|shū}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}。 | where something you know of is |
| person + verb + {在|zài} + place | {王芳|Wáng Fāng}{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{路口|lù kǒu}。 | where a known person is standing, sitting… |

- In the {着|zhe} sentence the place comes first, without {在|zài}, and the thing usually has a number and
  a measure word: {门口|mén kǒu}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{两|liǎng}{辆|liàng}{自行车|zì xíng chē}.
- Common verbs: {站|zhàn}, {坐|zuò}, {放|fàng}, {住|zhù} ({楼|lóu}{上|shàng}{住|zhù}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{家人|jiā rén}), {写|xiě} ({门|mén}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}“{出口|chū kǒu}”), {开|kāi} ({门口|mén kǒu}{开|kāi}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{花|huā}: flowers are
  blooming by the door).
- The same {着|zhe} makes descriptions of people and things: {门|mén}{开|kāi}{着|zhe} (the door is open), {他|tā}{穿|chuān}{着|zhe}{红色|hóng sè}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}.

references.title: The 284 characters of HSK 3
references.body:
Every new character of this course in the order it is taught. With the 371 of HSK 1 and HSK 2 they make the 655 characters of the level. Pinyin gives the readings our words use ("and others" when the character has more readings in later levels). Radical is the one the stroke-order data (Make Me a Hanzi) gives, which is usually but not always the radical a dictionary files it under. Strokes follow mainland stroke order. ✎ marks the 150 characters HSK expects you to write by hand at level 3; the second table lists all 250 handwriting characters of levels 1–3.

The list shows the simplified forms the course teaches, so it stays in simplified characters when the script switch is on Traditional; the Traditional column gives the Taiwan form the switch shows ("same" when the two scripts write it alike, and the form each of our words uses when a character has two). Radicals and stroke counts are those of the simplified form.

references.title: Comparing (比…多了, 没有…那么, 跟…一样, 越…越, 更)
references.body:
## A {比|bǐ} B + adjective, and how much

| How much | Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| (plain) | A {比|bǐ} B + adj. | {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{冷|lěng}。 | Today is colder than yesterday. |
| a little | … + {一点儿|yì diǎnr} | {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{贵|guì}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。 | This one is a bit dearer than that one. |
| a lot | … + {多|duō}{了|le} / {得|de}{多|duō} | {北京|Běi jīng}{比|bǐ}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{冷|lěng}{多|duō}{了|le}。 | Beijing is much colder than Shanghai. |
| exactly | … + amount | {他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{大|dà}{三|sān}{岁|suì}。 {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{热|rè}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}。 | He's three years older than me. Today is five degrees hotter. |
| even more | A {比|bǐ} B {更|gèng} + adj. | {七月|qī yuè}{比|bǐ}{六月|liù yuè}{更|gèng}{热|rè}。 | July is even hotter than June. |
| with a verb | A + verb + {得|de} + {比|bǐ} B + adj. | {他|tā}{跑|pǎo}{得|de}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{快|kuài}。 | He runs faster than me. |

- Degree words go **after** the adjective; only {更|gèng} (or {还|hái}, "even") goes before it.
- No {很|hěn}, {非常|fēi cháng}, {太|tài} or {真|zhēn} in a {比|bǐ} sentence: ~~{今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}~~.
- The negative is usually {没有|méi yǒu} (below). {不|bù}{比|bǐ} exists but argues with what someone said: {今天|jīn tiān}{不|bù}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{冷|lěng}
  (today is no colder than yesterday).

## Not as… as: A {没有|méi yǒu} B ({那么|nà me}) + adjective

| Example | Meaning |
|---|---|
| {春天|chūn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{夏天|xià tiān}{那么|nà me}{热|rè}。 | Spring isn't as hot as summer. |
| {我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{哥哥|gē ge}{高|gāo}。 | I'm not as tall as my brother. |
| {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{菜|cài}{没有|méi yǒu}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{那么|nà me}{好吃|hǎo chī}。 | The food here isn't as good as at that place. |

{那么|nà me} (or {这么|zhè me}, for something here and now) is optional and comes after B.

## The same: A {跟|gēn} B {一样|yí yàng} (+ adjective)

| Example | Meaning |
|---|---|
| {今天|jīn tiān}{跟|gēn}{昨天|zuó tiān}{一样|yí yàng}{冷|lěng}。 | Today is as cold as yesterday. |
| {我|wǒ}{的|de}{鞋|xié}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}。 | My shoes are the same as yours. |
| {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。 | I'm not like him. (We're different.) |
| {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{哥哥|gē ge}{差不多|chà bu duō}{高|gāo}。 | My brother and I are about the same height. (lesson 07) |

{和|hé} can replace {跟|gēn}. The negative is {不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}. {像|xiàng} / {好像|hǎo xiàng} (lesson 04): A looks like B.

## Even more: {更|gèng} (lesson 12)

{更|gèng} goes before the adjective or verb and says "even more", beyond something already true:

{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{更|gèng}{好看|hǎo kàn}。 — This one's nice, and that one's even nicer.

{我|wǒ}{更|gèng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{秋天|qiū tiān}。 — I prefer autumn. (I like autumn more.)

## More and more: {越来越|yuè lái yuè}, {越|yuè}…{越|yuè} (lesson 12)

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| {越来越|yuè lái yuè} + adj. | {天|tiān}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{冷|lěng}{了|le}。 | It's getting colder and colder. |
| {越|yuè} + verb + {越|yuè} + adj. | {雨|yǔ}{越|yuè}{下|xià}{越|yuè}{大|dà}。 | The rain's getting heavier and heavier. |
| {越|yuè} A {越|yuè} B | {衣服|yī fu}{越|yuè}{便宜|pián yi}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}。 | The cheaper the clothes, the better. |

No {很|hěn} after {越|yuè}: ~~{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}~~.

## The most: {最|zuì}

{最|zuì} + adjective or verb: {秋天|qiū tiān}{最|zuì}{舒服|shū fu} (autumn is the most comfortable), {我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{冬天|dōng tiān}.
To say "of all", put the group first: {四|sì}{个|gè}{季节|jì jié}{里|lǐ}，{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{秋天|qiū tiān}。

references.title: Complements (看完, 走进去, 吃得完, 说得很好, 去过两次)
references.body:
## Everything that can follow a verb

A complement comes after the verb and adds what happened, where it went, whether it can happen,
how it was done, or how often and how long. HSK 1 and 2 taught the first ones; HSK 3 adds the
potential complement (lesson 06) and uses them all with objects, {把|bǎ} and {被|bèi}.

| Kind | Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| result | verb + result | {我|wǒ}{看完|kàn wán}{了|le}。 | I've finished reading it. |
| direction, simple | verb + {来|lái} / {去|qù} | {他|tā}{进来|jìn lái}{了|le}。 | He came in. |
| direction, compound | verb + {上|shàng} / {下|xià} / {进|jìn} / {出|chū} / {回|huí} / {过|guò} / {起|qǐ} + {来|lái} / {去|qù} ({起|qǐ} only with {来|lái}) | {他|tā}{走进去|zǒu jìn qù}{了|le}。 | He walked in (away from me). |
| potential | verb + {得|de} / {不|bù} + result or direction | {我|wǒ}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。 | I can't finish it. |
| degree | verb + {得|de} + description | {她|tā}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 | She speaks well. |
| degree, strong | adjective + {极了|jí le} / adjective + {得|de}{很|hěn} | {好吃|hǎo chī}{极了|jí le}。 | Absolutely delicious. (lesson 22) |
| quantity: times | verb + number + {次|cì} / {遍|biàn} / {下|xià} | {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}。 | I've been twice. |
| quantity: duration | verb + length of time | {我|wǒ}{等|děng}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 | I waited half an hour. |

## Result complements

| Result | Meaning | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| {完|wán} | finished | {吃完|chī wán}, {看完|kàn wán}, {做完|zuò wán} |
| {懂|dǒng} | understood | {听懂|tīng dǒng}, {看懂|kàn dǒng} |
| {到|dào} | reached, got | {买到|mǎi dào}, {找到|zhǎo dào}, {收到|shōu dào} (lesson 09) |
| {见|jiàn} | perceived | {看见|kàn jiàn}, {听见|tīng jiàn} |
| {好|hǎo} | done properly | {做好|zuò hǎo}, {准备好|zhǔn bèi hǎo} |
| {错|cuò} / {对|duì} | wrong / right | {写错|xiě cuò}, {说对|shuō duì} |
| {饱|bǎo} | full | {吃饱|chī bǎo} (lesson 06) |
| {干净|gān jìng} | clean | {洗干净|xǐ gān jìng}, {打扫|dǎ sǎo}{干净|gān jìng} (lesson 03) |
| {在|zài} + place | placed at | {放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng} (lesson 03) |

Negative with {没|méi}, no {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听懂|tīng dǒng}。 With {把|bǎ}: {把|bǎ}{碗|wǎn}{洗干净|xǐ gān jìng}.

## Direction complements

{来|lái} is towards the speaker, {去|qù} away. A place goes before {来|lái} / {去|qù}; a thing can go before
or after it:

| Form | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| verb + place + {来|lái} / {去|qù} | {他|tā}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{去|qù}{了|le}。 | He's gone home. |
| verb + direction + place + {来|lái} / {去|qù} | {我们|wǒ men}{搬|bān}{进|jìn}{新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{去|qù}{了|le}。 | We've moved into the new flat. (lesson 02) |
| verb + direction + {来|lái} / {去|qù} + thing | {他|tā}{拿|ná}{出来|chū lái}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。 | He took out a book. |
| verb + direction + thing + {来|lái} / {去|qù} | {他|tā}{拿|ná}{出|chū}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}{来|lái}。 | (the same) |

## Potential complements (lesson 06)

| Can | Can't | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| {吃得完|chī de wán} | {吃不完|chī bu wán} | can / can't finish (eating) |
| {看得见|kàn de jiàn} | {看不见|kàn bu jiàn} | can / can't see |
| {听得懂|tīng de dǒng} | {听不懂|tīng bu dǒng} | can / can't understand |
| {买得到|mǎi de dào} | {买不到|mǎi bu dào} | can / can't get hold of |
| {吃得下|chī de xià} | {吃不下|chī bu xià} | have / have no room to eat more |
| {放得下|fàng de xià} | {放不下|fàng bu xià} | fits / won't fit |
| {进得去|jìn de qù} | {进不去|jìn bu qù} | can / can't get in |
| {搬得进去|bān de jìn qù} | {搬不进去|bān bu jìn qù} | can / can't be moved in |

- {得|de} and {不|bù} in the middle are light: *chī de wán*, *chī bu wán*.
- Questions: {你|nǐ}{吃得完|chī de wán}{吗|ma}？ / {你|nǐ}{吃得完|chī de wán}{吃不完|chī bu wán}？
- The object follows the verb, or comes first as the topic: {这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{菜|cài}{我|wǒ}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。
- Not in a {把|bǎ} sentence: ~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{菜|cài}{吃不完|chī bu wán}~~.
- {不能|bù néng} + verb: not allowed, not possible at all. Potential: the result won't come
  (amount, distance, noise, ability).

## Degree or potential?

| | Degree | Potential |
|---|---|---|
| after {得|de} | a description: {很|hěn}{多|duō}, {太|tài}{快|kuài}{了|le} | a result or direction: {完|wán}, {到|dào}, {下|xià} |
| positive | {他|tā}{吃|chī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。 He eats a lot. | {他|tā}{吃得完|chī de wán}。 He can finish it. |
| negative | {他|tā}{吃|chī}{得|de}{不|bù}{多|duō}。 He doesn't eat much. | {他|tā}{吃不完|chī bu wán}。 He can't finish it. |
| with an object | {他|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 | {他|tā}{听得懂|tīng de dǒng}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 |

## Quantity complements

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| verb + {过|guo} / {了|le} + number + {次|cì} | {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān}{次|cì}{北京|Běi jīng}。 | I've been to Beijing three times. |
| verb + pronoun + number + {次|cì} | {我|wǒ}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{他|tā}{一|yí}{次|cì}。 | I've met him once. |
| verb + {了|le} + length of time | {他|tā}{睡|shuì}{了|le}{八|bā}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 | He slept eight hours. |
| separable verb with a length of time | {他|tā}{睡|shuì}{了|le}{八|bā}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{觉|jiào}。 | He had eight hours' sleep. |

{遍|biàn} (from start to finish) and {一下|yí xià} (briefly) are lesson 16's verb measure words.

references.title: Complex sentences of HSK 2 and HSK 3
references.body:
Every pair of linking words that HSK 2 and this course teach, by what the two clauses do. In each
pattern, a linking word that is an adverb ({就|jiù}, {才|cái}, {也|yě}, {还|hái}, {都|dōu}, {又|yòu}, {越|yuè}) goes after the subject of its
clause and before the verb; a conjunction ({如果|rú guǒ}, {虽然|suī rán}, {因为|yīn wèi}, {不但|bú dàn}, {只要|zhǐ yào}, {只有|zhǐ yǒu}) goes at the start of
its clause or straight after the subject. One half of a pair can often be left out in speech
(the "Alone" column).

## Cause, contrast and concession

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Alone | Taught |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ}… | {因为|yīn wèi}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我们|wǒ men}{没|méi}{去|qù}。 | Because it rained, we didn't go. | either half | HSK 2 lesson 5 |
| {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì}… | {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}。 | Although I'm tired, I'm happy. | {但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì} alone | HSK 2 lesson 15; {可是|kě shì} lesson 27 |
| …，{只是|zhǐ shì}… | {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}。 | This is nice, it's just a bit expensive. | — | lesson 27 |

## Conditions and suppositions

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Alone | Taught |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {如果|rú guǒ}…({的话|de huà})，…{就|jiù}… | {如果|rú guǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。 | If it rains tomorrow, we won't go. | …{的话|de huà} without {如果|rú guǒ}; {就|jiù} often dropped before a suggestion | lesson 26 |
| {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}… | {只要|zhǐ yào}{你|nǐ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}。 | As long as you practise every day, you'll learn it. | — | lesson 26 |
| {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái}… | {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{多|duō}{听|tīng}{多|duō}{说|shuō}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 | Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese. | — | lesson 26 |
| {一|yī}…{就|jiù}… | {他|tā}{一|yì}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{就|jiù}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。 | As soon as he gets home, he goes to sleep. | — | lesson 05 |

{只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}: the condition is enough. {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái}: it is the only way. {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù}: a supposition. {一|yī}…{就|jiù}: one
thing follows straight after the other (or every time the first happens).

## Adding, choosing and excluding

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Alone | Taught |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {不但|bú dàn}…{而且|ér qiě}… ({也|yě} / {还|hái}) | {他|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}，{而且|ér qiě}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 | Not only can he speak it, he speaks it well. | {而且|ér qiě} alone | lesson 26 |
| {又|yòu}…{又|yòu}… | {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{又|yòu}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好吃|hǎo chī}。 | This restaurant is both cheap and good. | — | lesson 08 |
| …{或者|huò zhě}… | {你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{或者|huò zhě}{后天|hòu tiān}{来|lái}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}。 | You can come tomorrow or the day after. | {或|huò} (written) | lesson 26 |
| …{还是|hái shi}…？ | {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}{还是|hái shi}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}？ | Tea or coffee? | — | HSK 2 lesson 21 |
| {除了|chú le}…({以外|yǐ wài})，…{都|dōu}… | {除了|chú le}{他|tā}{以外|yǐ wài}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。 | Everyone came except him. | — | lesson 27 |
| {除了|chú le}…({以外|yǐ wài})，…{还|hái} / {也|yě}… | {除了|chú le}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{以外|yǐ wài}，{他|tā}{还|hái}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{英语|Yīng yǔ}。 | Besides Chinese, he also speaks English. | — | lesson 27 |

## Time, sequence and change

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Alone | Taught |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {一边|yì biān}…{一边|yì biān}… | {他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{一边|yì biān}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}。 | He eats while looking at his phone. | — | lesson 14 |
| {先|xiān}…{然后|rán hòu} / {再|zài}… | {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。 | We'll eat first and then see a film. | {然后|rán hòu} alone | lesson 25 |
| {越|yuè}…{越|yuè}… | {雨|yǔ}{越|yuè}{下|xià}{越|yuè}{大|dà}。 | The rain is getting heavier and heavier. | — | lesson 12 |
| {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}… | {天气|tiān qì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{冷|lěng}{了|le}。 | It's getting colder and colder. | — | lesson 12 |

## Purpose and rhetorical questions

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Taught |
|---|---|---|---|
| {为了|wèi le}…，… | {为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}。 | To learn Chinese well, he watches Chinese films every day. | lesson 26 |
| …，{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}… | {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}，{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 | He watches Chinese films every day in order to learn Chinese. | lesson 26 |
| {不|bú}{是|shì}…{吗|ma}？ | {你|nǐ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{吗|ma}？ | Haven't you been to Beijing? (You have.) | lesson 28 |
| {怎么|zěn me}{会|huì}…{呢|ne}？ | {他|tā}{怎么|zěn me}{会|huì}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{呢|ne}？ | How could he not know? (Of course he knows.) | lesson 28 |

{英语|Yīng yǔ} (English) and {北京|Běi jīng} (Beijing) are glossed here; every other word is a course word.

references.title: Time and sequence
references.body:
The words that place an event in time and put events in order, from HSK 1 to lesson 25 of this
course. Adverbs ({先|xiān}, {再|zài}, {就|jiù}, {才|cái}, {刚|gāng}, {一直|yì zhí}, {终于|zhōng yú}) go after the subject and straight
before the verb; time nouns ({刚才|gāng cái}, {以前|yǐ qián}, {后来|hòu lái}, {最近|zuì jìn}, {前天|qián tiān}…) go before or after the subject.

## First, then, finally

| Word | Kind | Example | Meaning | Taught |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {先|xiān} | adverb | {我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | I'll go first (I'm off). | lesson 25 |
| {然后|rán hòu} | conjunction | {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{吃饭|chī fàn}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。 | First we'll eat, then we'll see a film. | lesson 25 |
| {再|zài} | adverb | {先|xiān}{洗手|xǐ shǒu}，{再|zài}{吃饭|chī fàn}。 | Wash your hands, then eat. (plans, instructions) | HSK 1; lesson 25 |
| {最后|zuì hòu} | noun | {最后|zuì hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{回家|huí jiā}{了|le}。 | Finally we went home. | lesson 25 |
| {终于|zhōng yú} | adverb | {他|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{来|lái}{了|le}。 | At last he came (after a wait). | lesson 21 |
| {一直|yì zhí} | adverb | {雨|yǔ}{一直|yì zhí}{下|xià}。 | It kept raining. | lesson 21 |

## Early and late: 就 and 才

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| time + {就|jiù} + verb + {了|le} | {他|tā}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{来|lái}{了|le}。 | He came as early as seven. |
| time + {才|cái} + verb (no {了|le}) | {他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{来|lái}。 | He didn't come until ten. |
| {才|cái} + number | {他|tā}{才|cái}{十|shí}{岁|suì}。 | He's only ten. |
| {直到|zhí dào} + time + {才|cái} | {我|wǒ}{直到|zhí dào}{昨天|zuó tiān}{才|cái}{知道|zhī dào}。 | I didn't know until yesterday. |
| {刚|gāng}…{就|jiù}… | {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{就|jiù}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。 | As soon as I got home, it rained. |
| {一|yī}…{就|jiù}… | {他|tā}{一|yí}{锻炼|duàn liàn}{就|jiù}{累|lèi}。 | Whenever he exercises, he gets tired. (lesson 05) |

## Just now: 刚, 刚刚, 刚才

| | {刚|gāng} / {刚刚|gāng gāng} | {刚才|gāng cái} |
|---|---|---|
| Kind | adverb: only before the verb | time noun: before or after the subject |
| Example | {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{到|dào}。 I've just arrived. | {刚才|gāng cái}{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{了|le}？ Where did you go just now? |
| Length of time | {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{来|lái}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。 I've only been here three days. | — |
| Negative | — | {刚才|gāng cái}{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听|tīng}{清楚|qīng chu}。 |

## Before, after, when

| Word | After an event | Alone | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| {以前|yǐ qián} | {吃饭|chī fàn}{以前|yǐ qián} (before eating) | in the past | {以前|yǐ qián}{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。 I used to live in Shanghai. |
| {以后|yǐ hòu} | {下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu} (after class) | in the future, from now on | {以后|yǐ hòu}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{工作|gōng zuò}。 |
| {后来|hòu lái} | — | afterwards (past stories only) | {后来|hòu lái}{他|tā}{去|qù}{了|le}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。 Later on he went to Shanghai. |
| …{的|de}{时候|shí hou} | {我|wǒ}{到|dào}{的|de}{时候|shí hou} (when I arrived) | — | {我|wǒ}{到|dào}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他们|tā men}{已经|yǐ jīng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| {最近|zuì jìn} | — | recently, these days | {我|wǒ}{最近|zuì jìn}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。 |
| {直到|zhí dào} | {直到|zhí dào}{现在|xiàn zài} (until now) | — | {他|tā}{直到|zhí dào}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。 |

## Days, years and times

| Before | | Now | | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {前天|qián tiān} | {昨天|zuó tiān} | {今天|jīn tiān} | {明天|míng tiān} | {后天|hòu tiān} |
| {前年|qián nián} | {去年|qù nián} | {今年|jīn nián} | {明年|míng nián} | {后年|hòu nián} |

| Time | Chinese |
|---|---|
| 2:15 | {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè} / {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{十五|shí wǔ} |
| 2:30 | {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn} |
| 2:45 | {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{三|sān}{刻|kè} / {差|chà}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{三|sān}{点|diǎn} |
| 15 minutes | {一|yí}{刻|kè}{钟|zhōng} / {十五|shí wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng} |
| half a day; ages | {半天|bàn tiān} |
| a period | {一|yí}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān} |
| the weekend | {周末|zhōu mò} |

references.title: Verb measure words and verb repetition
references.body:
## Verb measure words: counting actions

Number + verb measure word goes after the verb (and after {了|le} or {过|guo}). Lesson 16.

| Word | Counts | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| {次|cì} | occasions, times | {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān}{次|cì}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。 | I've been to Shanghai three times. |
| {遍|biàn} | times through, from beginning to end | {这个|zhè ge}{课文|kè wén}{我|wǒ}{读|dú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}。 | I read this text twice (through). |
| {下|xià} | quick, short actions | {他|tā}{拍|pāi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{下|xià}{手|shǒu}。 | He clapped twice. |
| {一下|yí xià} | (no counting) briefly, have a go | {你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}。 | Have a look. |

- {次|cì} or {遍|biàn}? A visit, a meeting or an exam is an occasion: {次|cì}. A text, a recording, a film or a
  sentence you go through from start to finish: {遍|biàn} ({请|qǐng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}, please say it again). With a film
  or a text either can be right: {看|kàn}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì} (on two occasions), {看|kàn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn} (twice through).
- Questions: {几|jǐ}{次|cì}？ {几|jǐ}{遍|biàn}？ (how many times?). Ordinals: {第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì} (the first time), {第|dì}{三|sān}{遍|biàn} (the third time
  through).

## Where the object goes

| Object | Order | Example |
|---|---|---|
| ordinary noun | verb + {了|le} / {过|guo} + number + measure + object | {我|wǒ}{读|dú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}。 {他|tā}{去|qù}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{中国|Zhōng guó}。 |
| pronoun | verb + {了|le} / {过|guo} + pronoun + number + measure | {我|wǒ}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{他|tā}{一|yí}{次|cì}。 {老师|lǎo shī}{叫|jiào}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}。 |
| place name | either order | {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}。 = {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{北京|Běi jīng}。 |
| long or definite object | as the topic, or with {把|bǎ} | {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。 {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{这个|zhè ge}{句子|jù zi}{读|dú}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}。 |

"How many times" goes after the verb; "when" goes before it: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{读|dú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{课文|kè wén}, never ×{我|wǒ}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{读|dú}{课文|kè wén}.

## Separable verbs with a quantity inside

{了|le} goes after the verb part, the quantity before the object part. Lesson 19.

| Verb | With a quantity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| {请假|qǐng jià} | {请|qǐng}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jià} | took three days off |
| {开会|kāi huì} | {开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{会|huì} / {开|kāi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{会|huì} | had a meeting / a two-hour meeting |
| {放假|fàng jià} | {放|fàng}{五|wǔ}{天|tiān}{假|jià} | have five days off |
| {休假|xiū jià} | {休|xiū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{假|jià} | took a week's holiday |
| {睡觉|shuì jiào} | {睡|shuì}{了|le}{八|bā}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{觉|jiào} | slept for eight hours |
| {帮忙|bāng máng} | {帮|bāng}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng} | did me a favour |

Not ×{请假|qǐng jià}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān} or ×{开会|kāi huì}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}.

## Verb repetition

When a verb has an object and also {得|de} + "how well", or a length of time or a number of times, say the
verb twice, or drop the first one and put the object first. Lesson 17.

| With | Repeat the verb | Without repeating |
|---|---|---|
| {得|de} + how well | {他|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 | {他|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 |
| time | {我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{历史|lì shǐ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 | {我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{历史|lì shǐ}。 |
| number of times | {她|tā}{看|kàn}{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{看|kàn}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。 | {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{她|tā}{看|kàn}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。 |

- {得|de} must follow a verb: ×{他|tā}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}.
- Only the second verb takes {了|le}: ×{我|wǒ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{历史|lì shǐ}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}.
- The negative goes after {得|de}: {他|tā}{打|dǎ}{球|qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}.

references.title: Word formation and sound parts (老-, -员, -子, -家)
references.body:
## Prefixes and suffixes

| Piece | Where | What it does | Examples | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {老|lǎo}- | before a family name | friendly name for someone you know well, your age or older | {老王|Lǎo Wáng}, {老张|Lǎo Zhāng} | 01 |
| {小|xiǎo}- | before a family name | friendly name for someone younger | {小王|Xiǎo Wáng}, {小李|Xiǎo Lǐ} | 01 (HSK 1) |
| {老|lǎo} | before a noun | old, of long standing | {老人|lǎo rén}, {老朋友|lǎo péng you} | 01 |
| {老|lǎo}- | fixed words | a prefix with no meaning of its own | {老师|lǎo shī} | HSK 1 |
| {第|dì}- | before a number | ordinal: first, second | {第|dì}{一|yī}, {第|dì}{二|èr}{个|gè} | HSK 1 |
| -{员|yuán} | after a job or place | a member, staff, a person with a role | {服务员|fú wù yuán}, {店员|diàn yuán}, {学员|xué yuán}, {运动员|yùn dòng yuán} | 01 |
| -{子|zi} (light *zi*) | after a syllable | makes a noun, usually without changing the meaning | {桌子|zhuō zi}, {房子|fáng zi}, {箱子|xiāng zi}, {盘子|pán zi}, {瓶子|píng zi} | 01–03 |
| -{家|jiā} | after a field | an expert in it | {画家|huà jiā}, {作家|zuò jiā} | 01, 22 |
| -{们|men} | after people | plural (never after a number) | {我们|wǒ men}, {咱们|zán men}, {老师们|lǎo shī men} | HSK 1 |
| -{边|biān} / -{面|miàn} | after a direction | a side, a place | {外边|wài bian}, {前面|qián miàn} | HSK 1–2 |

- {员|yuán} isn't a word on its own: ~~{他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{员|yuán}~~; say {他|tā}{是|shì}{服务员|fú wù yuán}.
- In {儿子|ér zi} and {孩子|hái zi}, {子|zi} keeps its old meaning, "child". With a full tone, {子|zǐ}, it's in the names of
  ancient thinkers ({孔子|Kǒng zǐ}, Confucius).
- {家|jiā} after a field ({画家|huà jiā}) is the same character as {家|jiā} "home, family" ({我|wǒ}{家|jiā}, {家人|jiā rén}); {大家|dà jiā} is "everyone".

## Words with {人|rén}

Many words for people are a description + {人|rén}. Light {人|rén} in three of them:

| Word | Meaning | {人|rén} |
|---|---|---|
| {大人|dà ren} | adult | light: dà ren |
| {爱人|ài ren} | spouse | light: ài ren |
| {别人|bié ren} | other people | light: bié ren |
| {老人|lǎo rén} | old person | rén |
| {男人|nán rén} / {女人|nǚ rén} | man / woman | rén |
| {名人|míng rén} | famous person | rén |
| {病人|bìng rén} | patient | rén |
| {家人|jiā rén} | family member | rén |
| {客人|kè rén} | guest (lesson 07) | rén |
| {年轻人|nián qīng rén} | young person | rén |

## Several descriptions before one noun

| Whose (+ {的|de}) | Which ({这|zhè} / {那|nà} + number + measure) | What it's like (+ {的|de}) | One-syllable adjective | Noun |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {我|wǒ}{邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de} | {那个|nà ge} | {可爱|kě ài}{的|de} | | {孩子|hái zi} |
| {王叔叔|Wáng shū shu}{家|jiā}{的|de} | {那|nà}{两|liǎng}{个|gè} | {很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de} | | {房间|fáng jiān} |
| {我|wǒ}{的|de} | {这|zhè}{本|běn} | | {新|xīn} | {书|shū} |

{=
## Sound parts met in module 1

Most characters are a meaning part (often the radical) plus a sound part. The sound part tells you
roughly how a character was read when it was made; some still match exactly, some only rhyme, and
some no longer help at all.

| Sound part | Characters (reading) | How well it matches today | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 令 lìng | 冷 lěng, 零 líng, 邻 lín | rhyme kept | 01 |
| 可 kě | 阿 ā, 河 hé, 哥 gē, 歌 gē | drifted | 01 |
| 夷 yí | 姨 yí | exact | 01 |
| 般 bān | 搬 bān (and traditional 盤 pán) | exact | 02 |
| 弟 dì | 梯 tī | vowel kept | 02 |
| 相 xiāng | 箱 xiāng | exact | 02 |
| 工 gōng | 红 hóng, 空 kōng, 江 jiāng | rhyme kept | 02 |
| 丁 dīng | 灯 dēng (traditional 燈 has 登 dēng: exact) | close | 02 |
| 方 fāng | 房 fáng, 放 fàng | exact apart from the tone | 02, 03 |
| 青 qīng | 请 qǐng, 晴 qíng, 情 qíng, 睛 jīng, 清 qīng | close | 02 |
| 争 zhēng | 净 jìng, 静 jìng | drifted (净 and 静 match each other) | 02, 03 |
| 巴 bā | 把 bǎ, 爸 bà, 吧 ba | exact apart from the tone | 03 |
| 宛 wǎn | 碗 wǎn | exact | 03 |
| 并 bìng | 瓶 píng | rhyme kept | 03 |
| 喿 zào | 澡 zǎo | exact apart from the tone | 03 |
| 退 tuì | 腿 tuǐ | exact apart from the tone | 04 |
| 象 xiàng | 像 xiàng | exact | 04 |
| 半 bàn | 胖 pàng | drifted | 04 |
| 佥 qiān | 脸 liǎn, 检 jiǎn | rhyme kept | 04, 05 |
| 建 jiàn | 健 jiàn | exact | 05 |
| 段 duàn | 锻 duàn | exact | 05 |
| 主 zhǔ | 住 zhù, 注 zhù | exact apart from the tone | 05 |
| 旦 dàn | 担 dān, 但 dàn | exact apart from the tone | 05 |
| 寺 sì | 持 chí (and traditional 時 shí) | drifted | 05 |

## More sound families of HSK 1–3

| Sound part | Characters (reading) |
|---|---|
| 马 mǎ | 吗 ma, 妈 mā, 码 mǎ (号码, lesson 09) |
| 包 bāo | 饱 bǎo (lesson 06), 跑 pǎo |
| 白 bái | 拍 pāi (lesson 14), 怕 pà (lesson 24) |
| 门 mén | 们 men, 问 wèn, 闻 wén (新闻, lesson 20) |
| 交 jiāo | 校 xiào, 饺 jiǎo, 较 jiào (比较, lesson 12) |
| 元 yuán | 远 yuǎn, 园 yuán (lesson 12) |

## Meaning parts met in module 1

| Part | Meaning | Characters |
|---|---|---|
| 阝 on the left | hill, mound | 阿, 院, 阴 |
| 阝 on the right | town | 邻, 都 |
| 尸 | a roof or building shape (new radical, lesson 02) | 屋, 层, 展; also 居 in many dictionaries |
| 石 | stone (new radical, lesson 03) | 碗, 矿, 码 |
| 耳 | ear (new radical, lesson 04) | 耳, 聪, 聊 |
| ⺼ | the body ("meat moon") | 脸, 脚, 腿, 胖, 脏, 脑 |
| 矢 | arrow | 矮, 短 |
| 冫 | ice | 冰, 冷 (and 净, where it stands for water) |
| 心 / 忄 | heart, feelings | 感, 心, 想, 意; 忙, 快, 懂 |
| 火 / 灬 | fire | 灯, 烧, 炼; 照, 点 |
| 扌 | hand | 搬, 扫, 把, 持, 担 |

language.name: Chinese
language.vocabSource: covers the words and characters of HSK 3.0 level 3 (2025 exam syllabus; 1,000 words and 655 characters with levels 1-2); grouping, glosses and examples are our own

vocab.note: yī when you count and inside numbers ({十一|shí yī}, eleven). Before other words its tone changes, and this app writes the change: {一|yí}{个|gè} (one, of something), {一起|yì qǐ} (together).
vocab.example: {一|yī}、{二|èr}、{三|sān}！
vocab.exampleEn: One, two, three!

vocab.note: For counting and inside numbers ({十二|shí èr}, twelve). Before a measure word Chinese says {两|liǎng} instead: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}, two people (Chinese HSK 1).
vocab.example: {一|yī}、{二|èr}、{三|sān}、{四|sì}、{五|wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: One, two, three, four, five.
