vocab.exampleEn: Can I take photos here?

vocab.note: Separable: {照|zhào}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{相|xiàng}. A little older than {拍照|pāi zhào}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{照|zhào}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{相|xiàng}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Could you take a photo of us, please?

vocab.note: {相|xiàng} is xiàng here; in {相信|xiāng xìn} (to believe) it is xiāng.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{带|dài}{了|le}{相机|xiàng jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've brought my camera.

vocab.note: Measure word {张|zhāng}: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{拍|pāi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{照片|zhào piàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I took lots of photos on my phone.

vocab.note: {太阳|tài yang}{照|zhào}{着|zhe}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē} (the sun shines on this street); {照|zhào}{了|le}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn} (took a photo).
vocab.example: {太阳|tài yang}{照|zhào}{着|zhe}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街|jiē}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sun is shining on this street.

meanings: while (一边…一边: two things at once)
vocab.note: Subject + {一边|yì biān} + verb + {一边|yì biān} + verb. Quick speech: {边|biān}{走|zǒu}{边|biān}{说|shuō}. Also "one side": {马路|mǎ lù}{的|de}{一边|yì biān}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's talking on the phone as he walks.

vocab.note: Spoken, very common in the North. In writing use {一起|yì qǐ}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{一块儿|yí kuàir}{去|qù}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go together!

vocab.note: Measure word {座|zuò} (zuò). {爬|pá}{山|shān} (to go hiking), {山上|shān shàng} (on the mountain), {山下|shān xià} (at its foot). sh, not the s of {三|sān}.
vocab.example: {星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go hiking on Saturday!

vocab.note: Measure word {条|tiáo}: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}. {河边|hé biān}: the riverside. Same sound as {和|hé} (and).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{河边|hé biān}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{河边|hé biān}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: My home is by the river; every morning I go running along it.

vocab.note: {海边|hǎi biān} (seaside), {大海|dà hǎi} (the open sea). Third tone; {还|hái} hái rises.
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{我们|wǒ men}{经常|jīng cháng}{去|qù}{海边|hǎi biān}。
vocab.exampleEn: In summer we often go to the seaside.

vocab.example: {公园|gōng yuán}{的|de}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of people sitting on the grass in the park.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{花园|huā yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a little garden on our estate.

meanings: to climb (on hands and feet; also to crawl)
vocab.note: {爬|pá}{山|shān} (to go hiking), {爬|pá}{树|shù} (to climb a tree), {孩子|hái zi}{会|huì}{爬|pá}{了|le} (the baby can crawl). {怕|pà} pà (to fear) falls.
vocab.example: {小|xiǎo}{孩子|hái zi}{不|bù}{能|néng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{爬|pá}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Small children shouldn't climb trees on their own.

vocab.note: Any small plant. {吃|chī}{草|cǎo}: to graze.
vocab.example: {羊|yáng}{在|zài}{山下|shān xià}{吃|chī}{草|cǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sheep are grazing at the foot of the hill.

vocab.note: {请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}: please keep off the grass.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{别|bié}{在|zài}{草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{走|zǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please keep off the grass.

vocab.note: Measure word {棵|kē} (kē): {一|yì}{棵|kē}{树|shù}. Fourth tone; {书|shū} (book) is level.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{棵|kē}{大|dà}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a big tree outside my home.

vocab.note: Verb + object: {开|kāi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{花|huā}, or {花|huā}{开|kāi}{了|le} (the flowers are out). Not {花|huā}{开花|kāi huā}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{棵|kē}{树|shù}{四|sì}{月|yuè}{开花|kāi huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: This tree flowers in April.

vocab.note: {小|xiǎo}{动物|dòng wù} (small animals, pets).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{养|yǎng}{过|guo}{动物|dòng wù}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Have you ever kept animals?

vocab.example: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{山下|shān xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The zoo is right at the foot of the hill.

vocab.note: Literally "big bear-cat"; often just {熊猫|xióng māo}. Counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}.
vocab.example: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two giant pandas at the zoo.

vocab.note: Measure word {匹|pǐ} (pǐ). {骑|qí}{马|mǎ}: to ride a horse. Third tone; {妈|mā} mā is level and {吗|ma} ma light.
vocab.example: {骑|qí}{马|mǎ}{很|hěn}{好玩儿|hǎo wánr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Horse riding is great fun.

vocab.note: Measure word {头|tóu}: {一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}. Slang: {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{牛|niú}{了|le}！ (you're amazing!), only with friends. {牛奶|niú nǎi}: milk.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{一|yì}{头|tóu}{牛|niú}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa keeps a cow.

vocab.note: Counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}. {绵羊|mián yáng} (sheep) and {山羊|shān yáng} (goat) when it matters. Rising tone; {养|yǎng} yǎng dips.
vocab.example: {老人|lǎo rén}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{三十|sān shí}{多|duō}{只|zhī}{羊|yáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The old man keeps more than thirty sheep.

vocab.note: The bird and its meat. Counted {一|yì}{只|zhī}, {两|liǎng}{只|zhī}. {鸡蛋|jī dàn}: egg.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{鸡|jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I was little we kept two chickens.

meanings: to keep (animals or plants; to raise)
vocab.note: {养|yǎng}{狗|gǒu} (to have a dog), {养|yǎng}{花|huā} (to grow flowers), {养|yǎng}{孩子|hái zi} (to bring up children).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{养|yǎng}{花|huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: My mum loves growing flowers.

meanings: school class (as a unit of the school)
vocab.note: The written, more formal word; in speech and in names people say {班|bān} ({我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}, {三|sān}{年级|nián jí}{二|èr}{班|bān}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{班级|bān jí}{有|yǒu}{四十|sì shí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are forty students in this class.

vocab.note: Number + {年级|nián jí}: {一|yì}{年级|nián jí} (first year, grade one). {初二|chū èr} and {高一|gāo yī} are short forms for the years of junior and senior high.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{上|shàng}{小学|xiǎo xué}{三|sān}{年级|nián jí}。
vocab.exampleEn: My younger sister is in the third year of primary school.

vocab.note: Three years after {小学|xiǎo xué} and before {高中|gāo zhōng}. {初|chū} is "beginning".
vocab.example: {他|tā}{今年|jīn nián}{上|shàng}{初中|chū zhōng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He started junior high this year.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{学期|xué qī}{我们|wǒ men}{有|yǒu}{六|liù}{门|mén}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have six subjects this term.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{打开|dǎ kāi}{课本|kè běn}，{看|kàn}{第|dì}{十|shí}{页|yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone, please open your textbooks at page ten.

meanings: lesson text (the text of a lesson)
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{课文|kè wén}{我|wǒ}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've read this text three times.

vocab.note: Measure word {个|gè}: {一|yí}{个|gè}{句子|jù zi}. {子|zi} is light.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{句子|jù zi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{长|cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This sentence is a bit long.

meanings: measure word for sentences and lines
vocab.note: A measure word, so nothing goes between it and its noun: {一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà} (a sentence, a remark). The noun is {句子|jù zi}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{了|le}{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}{就|jiù}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He said one sentence and left.

vocab.note: Lists words; {字典|zì diǎn} lists single characters.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{词|cí}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{词典|cí diǎn}{里|lǐ}{查|chá}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I looked this word up in the dictionary.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{字典|zì diǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Is this character in the character dictionary?

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{笔记|bǐ jì} or {记|jì}{笔记|bǐ jì}: to take notes ({记|jì}, to note down, is lesson 18's word).
vocab.example: {上课|shàng kè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{她|tā}{做|zuò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{笔记|bǐ jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She took lots of notes in class.

vocab.note: Both a notebook to write in and a laptop ({笔记本|bǐ jì běn}{电脑|diàn nǎo}); {本子|běn zi} is any notebook or exercise book.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{新|xīn}{的|de}{词|cí}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{笔记本|bǐ jì běn}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I write the new words in my notebook.

vocab.note: Its measure word is {支|zhī} zhī ({一|yì}{支|zhī}{铅笔|qiān bǐ}), outside HSK 3; {个|gè} is also heard.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{带|dài}{铅笔|qiān bǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: You need to bring a pencil to the exam.

vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{在|zài}{黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher wrote a few characters on the board.

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{作业|zuò yè} or {写|xiě}{作业|zuò yè}: to do homework.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a lot of homework today.

vocab.note: Fourth tone; {也|yě} yě (also) dips. {第|dì}{十|shí}{页|yè}: page ten.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{页|yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book has three hundred pages.

vocab.note: A verb measure word: verb + number + {遍|biàn} ({读|dú}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}, {请|qǐng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}). {次|cì} counts occasions; {遍|biàn} counts complete runs through something.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}，{请|qǐng}{您|nín}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Could you say that again, please?

meanings: school is out (to finish school for the day)
vocab.note: For pupils and schools; adults {下班|xià bān}, university students {下课|xià kè}.
vocab.example: {孩子们|hái zi men}{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{放学|fàng xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children finish school at four in the afternoon.

vocab.note: A sheet of paper: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{纸|zhǐ}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{纸|zhǐ}{吗|ma}？{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Have you got any paper? Give me a sheet.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{数学|shù xué}{成绩|chéng jì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her maths results are very good.

vocab.note: {数|shù} is shù here (number); as a verb, "to count", it is {数|shǔ} shǔ.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{数学|shù xué}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have maths every day.

vocab.note: Traditional {歷史|lì shǐ}; the {曆|lì} of {日曆|rì lì} (calendar) is another character.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{历史|lì shǐ}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I really like history lessons.

vocab.note: The school subject ({体育|tǐ yù}{课|kè}) and sport in general; {运动|yùn dòng} is exercise.
vocab.example: {星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{有|yǒu}{体育|tǐ yù}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's PE on Friday afternoon.

vocab.example: {学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{要|yào}{每天|měi tiān}{练习|liàn xí}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you learn a foreign language, you have to practise every day.

vocab.note: Language in general; a particular language is {汉语|Hàn yǔ}, {外语|wài yǔ}, {中文|Zhōng wén} and so on.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{三|sān}{种|zhǒng}{语言|yǔ yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: He can speak three languages.

vocab.note: Going over what you have learned; {预习|yù xí} yù xí (outside HSK 3) is preparing a lesson before class.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{考试|kǎo shì}，{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{复习|fù xí}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's an exam tomorrow, so I have to revise a bit.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {做|zuò}{练习|liàn xí} (do exercises).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每天|měi tiān}{练习|liàn xí}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I practise writing characters every day.

meanings: to drill (practise a skill, short form)
vocab.note: The short form, usually with a one-character object or a quantity: {练|liàn}{字|zì} (practise handwriting), {练|liàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{练|liàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He practises handwriting for an hour every day.

vocab.note: Often with {水平|shuǐ píng} or {成绩|chéng jì}: {提高|tí gāo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{提高|tí gāo}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I want to improve my Chinese.

vocab.note: A third tone, then a second: the dip of shuǐ is short before píng.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her Chinese is at a very high level.

vocab.note: Also before a verb with {地|de}: {认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}{听|tīng} (listen carefully).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{学习|xué xí}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very conscientious about his studies.

vocab.note: A verb ({我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{努力|nǔ lì}) and an adjective ({他|tā}{很|hěn}{努力|nǔ lì}).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{学习|xué xí}{非常|fēi cháng}{努力|nǔ lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She works very hard at her studies.

vocab.note: How to do something; {办法|bàn fǎ} (lesson 09) is a way out of a problem.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{学|xué}{汉字|hàn zì}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your way of learning characters is very good.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{难题|nán tí}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I thought about this hard problem for a long time.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {他|tā}{的|de}{回答|huí dá} (his answer).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{回答|huí dá}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you answer this question?

vocab.note: Mostly a noun: {听|tīng}{对话|duì huà} (listen to a dialogue); also a verb, {跟|gēn}…{对话|duì huà} (to hold a dialogue with).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{听|tīng}{两|liǎng}{遍|biàn}{这个|zhè ge}{对话|duì huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'll listen to this dialogue twice.

meanings: to explain (also: to tell, to speak)
vocab.note: {讲|jiǎng}{课|kè} (to lecture), {讲|jiǎng}{清楚|qīng chu} (to explain clearly); in speech often the same as {说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher explained it very clearly; I understood all of it.

meanings: to find out about (know well, understand)
vocab.note: {了|liǎo} is liǎo here, not le. Knowing a subject or a person well: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{了解|liǎo jiě}{他|tā}. Taiwan also writes {瞭解|liǎo jiě}; this course uses {了解|liǎo jiě}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{多|duō}{了解|liǎo jiě}{一下|yí xià}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to find out more about Chinese history.

vocab.note: Also an adjective, "clear": {讲|jiǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{明白|míng bai}. {白|bai} is light.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{意思|yì si}{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I see what you mean.

meanings: clear (distinct; also: to be clear about)
vocab.note: An adjective ({写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{清楚|qīng chu}) and a verb ({我|wǒ}{不|bù}{清楚|qīng chu}: I'm not sure). {楚|chu} is light.
vocab.example: {黑板|hēi bǎn}{上|shàng}{的|de}{字|zì}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't see the characters on the board clearly.

meanings: to grasp (a principle; know how to)
vocab.note: For understanding a principle or knowing how to do something ({懂得|dǒng de}{怎么|zěn me}{学习|xué xí}); {懂|dǒng} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{懂得|dǒng de}{学习|xué xí}{的|de}{方法|fāng fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He knows how to study (he understands the method of learning).

vocab.note: Recognising a character, a road or a person (spoken); {认识|rèn shi} is the general word.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{我|wǒ}{认得|rèn de}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bú}{会|huì}{写|xiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: I recognise this character, but I can't write it.

vocab.note: Giving an opinion, a little more formal than {觉得|jué de}. {为|wéi} is wéi here.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{认为|rèn wéi}{每天|měi tiān}{复习|fù xí}{很|hěn}{有用|yǒu yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I think revising every day is very useful.

vocab.note: Usually for a belief that turned out wrong: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}…，{但是|dàn shì}… (I thought…, but…).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{来|lái}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: I thought you weren't coming!

vocab.note: Also with the source inside: {听|tīng}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō} (I heard from the teacher that…).
vocab.example: {听说|tīng shuō}{明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I hear there's an exam tomorrow.

vocab.note: {记|jì}{笔记|bǐ jì} (take notes), {记|jì}{在|zài}{本子|běn zi}{上|shàng} (write down in a notebook), {记|jì}{住|zhù} (to memorise). {记得|jì de} (HSK 2) is "to remember".
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{记|jì}{在|zài}{本子|běn zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I wrote down everything the teacher said in my notebook.

vocab.note: Means the same as {忘|wàng} (HSK 2), a little more written; {忘|wàng}{了|le} is the usual spoken form.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{忘记|wàng jì}{带|dài}{护照|hù zhào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't forget to bring your passport.

vocab.note: {明|ming} is light.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{聪明|cōng ming}。
vocab.exampleEn: This child is very clever.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question is very simple.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {容易|róng yì}{懂|dǒng} (easy to understand), {很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}{忘|wàng} (easy to forget, likely to be forgotten).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}{写|xiě}{错|cuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: This character is easy to get wrong.

vocab.note: Mostly an adjective ({这个|zhè ge}{题|tí}{很|hěn}{难|nán}) and before a verb: {难|nán}{写|xiě} (hard to write), {很|hěn}{难|nán}{说|shuō} (hard to say).
vocab.example: {汉字|hàn zì}{难|nán}{写|xiě}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bù}{难|nán}{认|rèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Characters are hard to write, but not hard to recognise.

vocab.note: The room or rooms where people work; the company itself is {公司|gōng sī}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{在|zài}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Is the manager in the office?

vocab.note: The formal word, also for big conferences ({会议|huì yì}{室|shì}: meeting room). Measure {个|gè} or {次|cì}.
vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{的|de}{会议|huì yì}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{开|kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The afternoon meeting will be held on the third floor.

vocab.note: Separable: {开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{会|huì}, {开|kāi}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{会|huì}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{正在|zhèng zài}{开会|kāi huì}{呢|ne}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager is in a meeting.

vocab.note: The noun, mostly with {开|kāi}: {开会|kāi huì}, {开|kāi}{个|gè}{会|huì}. Not the verb {会|huì} "can" (HSK 1).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{会|huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a meeting tomorrow morning.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{工作日|gōng zuò rì}{能|néng}{完成|wán chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This work can be done in five working days.

vocab.note: Also a title after the surname: {王|Wáng}{经理|jīng lǐ} (Manager Wang).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{经理|jīng lǐ}{姓|xìng}{李|Lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our manager's surname is Li.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{和|hé}{同事|tóng shì}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃|chī}{午饭|wǔ fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I go to lunch with my colleagues.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}{就|jiù}{解决|jiě jué}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The problem was soon solved.

vocab.note: For tasks and plans: {完成|wán chéng}{工作|gōng zuò}, {完成|wán chéng}{作业|zuò yè}. {完|wán} (HSK 2) is mostly a result complement: {做|zuò}{完|wán}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{完成|wán chéng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've already finished today's work.

vocab.note: {要|yāo} is yāo here, first tone. A verb ({经理|jīng lǐ}{要求|yāo qiú}{我们|wǒ men}…) and a noun ({他|tā}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}).
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{要求|yāo qiú}{我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{写|xiě}{一百|yì bǎi}{个|gè}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher requires us to write a hundred characters every day.

vocab.note: A modal verb before a verb ({你|nǐ}{需要|xū yào}{休息|xiū xi}), a verb before a noun ({需要|xū yào}{时间|shí jiān}) and a noun ({我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{需要|xū yào}). The negative is {不|bù}{需要|xū yào}, or {不用|bú yòng} before a verb.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{需要|xū yào}{我|wǒ}{帮忙|bāng máng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you need my help?

vocab.note: {为|wèi}…{服务|fú wù} (to serve someone; {为|wèi} is lesson 26's word). {服务员|fú wù yuán} is a waiter or attendant.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{饭店|fàn diàn}{的|de}{服务|fú wù}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The service in this restaurant is very good.

vocab.note: Separable: {请|qǐng}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{假|jià}, {请|qǐng}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jià}, {跟|gēn}{经理|jīng lǐ}{请假|qǐng jià}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{请假|qǐng jià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm ill: I'll ask for the day off tomorrow.

vocab.note: Separable: {休|xiū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{假|jià}. Taking the holiday you are given at work.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{休假|xiū jià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager is on holiday next week.

meanings: to have a holiday (school or work closes)
vocab.note: Separable: {放|fàng}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jià}. Its subject is the school, the company or the people who get the holiday.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{七|qī}{月|yuè}{放假|fàng jià}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our school breaks up in July.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{假期|jià qī}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}？
vocab.exampleEn: Where are you going these holidays?

vocab.note: Before a verb: {决定|jué dìng}{去|qù} (decide to go). Also a noun: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{决定|jué dìng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{决定|jué dìng}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{学习|xué xí}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've decided to go and study in China next year.

meanings: to be up to, to do (spoken)
vocab.note: Fourth tone. Spoken: {你|nǐ}{干|gàn}{什么|shén me}{呢|ne}？ (what are you up to?), {干活儿|gàn huór} (to work). {干净|gān jìng} (clean) is gān, first tone, and traditional {乾|gān}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{干|gàn}{什么|shén me}{呢|ne}？
vocab.exampleEn: What are you up to?

vocab.note: In words such as {教室|jiào shì}, {办公室|bàn gōng shì}, {会议|huì yì}{室|shì}; alone it is written style, as on door signs (302{室|shì}: room 302).
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{室|shì}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The meeting room is on the third floor.

vocab.note: Short for {电子邮件|diàn zǐ yóu jiàn} (email; {电子|diàn zǐ}: electronic); also post sent by mail. Measure {封|fēng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{经理|jīng lǐ}{发|fā}{了|le}{一|yì}{封|fēng}{邮件|yóu jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I sent the manager an email.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{邮箱|yóu xiāng}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your email address?

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{新闻|xīn wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's lots of news on this website.

vocab.note: Mostly the noun "letter" ({一|yì}{封|fēng}{信|xìn}, {写|xiě}{信|xìn}); as a verb, "to believe": {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{信|xìn}. {相信|xiāng xìn} (lesson 24) is the full verb.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{爷爷|yé ye}{写|xiě}{了|le}{一|yì}{封|fēng}{信|xìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I wrote a letter to my grandfather.

meanings: measure word for letters and emails
vocab.note: First tone, like {风|fēng} (wind). {一|yì}{封|fēng}{信|xìn}, {两|liǎng}{封|fēng}{邮件|yóu jiàn}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{收到|shōu dào}{了|le}{三|sān}{封|fēng}{邮件|yóu jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I got three emails today.

vocab.note: {=Traditional {發|fā} for "send"; the {发|fà} of {头发|tóu fa} (hair) is {髮|fà}.=} {发|fā}{邮件|yóu jiàn}, {发|fā}{短信|duǎn xìn} (send a text), {发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{照片|zhào piàn}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Send me the photos.

meanings: to pick up (a person; also: to answer the phone)
vocab.note: {接|jiē}{人|rén} (meet, collect someone), {接|jiē}{电话|diàn huà} (answer the phone), {接|jiē}{到|dào} (to receive).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{机场|jī chǎng}{接|jiē}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll pick you up at the airport.

vocab.note: {子|zǐ} is zǐ here (third tone): {电子|diàn zǐ} is "electronic".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}{电子书|diàn zǐ shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: I read e-books on my phone.

vocab.note: Measure {份|fèn} fèn or {张|zhāng} (one sheet); "read the paper" is {看|kàn}{报纸|bào zhǐ} or {看|kàn}{报|bào}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{每天|měi tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{看|kàn}{报纸|bào zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandfather reads the paper every morning.

vocab.note: Measure {条|tiáo} ({一|yì}{条|tiáo}{新闻|xīn wén}: a piece of news).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{新闻|xīn wén}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Have you seen today's news?

meanings: programme (on TV or radio; an item in a show)
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{电视|diàn shì}{节目|jié mù}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。
vocab.exampleEn: This TV programme is very interesting.

vocab.note: {里|li} is light. Traditional {+{心里|xīn li}+}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{嘴|zuǐ}{上|shàng}{不|bù}{说|shuō}，{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}。
vocab.exampleEn: He doesn't say so, but inside he's very worried.

meanings: to follow closely (pay close attention to)
vocab.note: Following news or events; also "to follow" an account online.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{关注|guān zhù}{这个|zhè ge}{新闻|xīn wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many people are following this news story.

vocab.note: Caring about a person or a matter: {关心|guān xīn}{别人|bié ren}, {关心|guān xīn}{孩子|hái zi}{的|de}{学习|xué xí}.
vocab.example: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{关心|guān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you for your concern.

vocab.note: A verb ({影响|yǐng xiǎng}{学习|xué xí}) and a noun ({有|yǒu}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}, {受|shòu}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}, to be affected: {受|shòu} is lesson 24's word). Two third tones: said yíng xiǎng.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{玩|wán}{手机|shǒu jī}{会|huì}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{睡觉|shuì jiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Using your phone at night affects your sleep.

meanings: to be related to (have to do with)
vocab.note: A {跟|gēn} B {有关|yǒu guān} (A has to do with B); before a noun, {有关|yǒu guān} + noun + {的|de} ({有关|yǒu guān}{学习|xué xí}{的|de}{书|shū}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{跟|gēn}{天气|tiān qì}{有关|yǒu guān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This problem has to do with the weather.

vocab.note: Usually at the start: {根据|gēn jù}{天气|tiān qì}{预报|yù bào}… (according to the weather forecast…). Also a noun: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{根据|gēn jù}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.example: {根据|gēn jù}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}，{我们|wǒ men}{每天|měi tiān}{写|xiě}{一百|yì bǎi}{个|gè}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: As the teacher requires, we write a hundred characters every day.

vocab.note: Noun and verb. The other side takes {跟|gēn}: {我们|wǒ men}{跟|gēn}{三|sān}{班|bān}{比赛|bǐ sài}. Matches are counted with {场|chǎng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。
vocab.exampleEn: This match is very interesting.

vocab.note: {得|dé} + {分|fēn} (point). A number goes inside: {得|dé}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{分|fēn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{比赛|bǐ sài}{里|lǐ}{得|dé}{了|le}{十|shí}{分|fēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He scored ten points in the match.

vocab.note: The object is an event, never a person: {参加|cān jiā}{比赛|bǐ sài}, {参加|cān jiā}{晚会|wǎn huì}.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{的|de}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}{你|nǐ}{参加|cān jiā}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Are you taking part in tomorrow's sports meeting?

vocab.note: Played with {打|dǎ}: {打|dǎ}{网球|wǎng qiú}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{都|dōu}{打|dǎ}{网球|wǎng qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: I play tennis every Saturday.

vocab.note: "Feather ball": {羽毛|yǔ máo} (feather) + {球|qiú}. Played with {打|dǎ}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{打|dǎ}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go to the sports hall and play badminton!

vocab.note: Any court or pitch; {足球|zú qiú}{场|chǎng}, {网球|wǎng qiú}{场|chǎng}, {篮球|lán qiú}{场|chǎng} are built the same way.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{球场|qiú chǎng}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of people on the school sports field.

vocab.note: {体育|tǐ yù} (sport, PE) + {馆|guǎn} (hall).
vocab.example: {体育馆|tǐ yù guǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a badminton competition in the sports hall.

vocab.note: A school "holds" one with {开|kāi}: {开|kāi}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{每年|měi nián}{都|dōu}{开|kāi}{运动会|yùn dòng huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our school holds a sports day every year.

vocab.note: {运动|yùn dòng} (sport) + the suffix -{员|yuán} (a member, someone with a role).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{网球|wǎng qiú}{运动员|yùn dòng yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a tennis player.

vocab.note: Fourth tone; {条|tiáo} (a measure word) rises. {跳高|tiào gāo} high jump, {跳远|tiào yuǎn} long jump, {跳舞|tiào wǔ} to dance.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{跳|tiào}{得|de}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He jumps very high.

meanings: to get (a prize, a score, an illness)
vocab.note: Read dé. Not the particle {得|de} ({他|tā}{跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}), nor {得|děi} "must" (lesson 27).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{得|dé}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She came first.

vocab.note: For things that come to you: a ticket, help, care. For things sent to you, {收到|shōu dào}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{得到|dé dào}{了|le}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{的|de}{票|piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I got a ticket for the match.

vocab.note: Before the verb: {一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{练习|liàn xí}, {一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{得分|dé fēn}. Also "straight on": {一直|yì zhí}{往|wǎng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu}.
vocab.example: {雨|yǔ}{一直|yì zhí}{下|xià}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{不|bù}{能|néng}{开始|kāi shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: It kept raining, so the match couldn't start.

meanings: at last (finally, after a long wait)
vocab.note: Relief after waiting or effort; the sentence usually ends in {了|le}.
vocab.example: {等|děng}{了|le}{半天|bàn tiān}，{他|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After waiting for ages, at last he came.

vocab.note: Also the spoken exaggeration "ages": {我|wǒ}{等|děng}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{半天|bàn tiān}！ After the verb, like other lengths of time.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{等|děng}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{半天|bàn tiān}！
vocab.exampleEn: I've been waiting for you for ages!

meanings: section (measure word for a stretch or period)
vocab.note: Fourth tone; {短|duǎn} (short) dips. {一|yí}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}, {一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù}, {这|zhè}{段|duàn}{课文|kè wén}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've been busy these days.

vocab.note: {两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè} (2:15), {三|sān}{刻|kè}{钟|zhōng} (45 minutes). There is no {两|liǎng}{刻|kè}: say {半|bàn}.
vocab.example: {比赛|bǐ sài}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}{一|yí}{刻|kè}{开始|kāi shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The match starts at a quarter past three.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {表演|biǎo yǎn}{节目|jié mù}, {他|tā}{的|de}{表演|biǎo yǎn}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{晚会|wǎn huì}{上|shàng}{表演|biǎo yǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{节目|jié mù}。
vocab.exampleEn: They put on an act at the party.

vocab.note: An evening of performances; {开|kāi}{晚会|wǎn huì} to hold one.
vocab.example: {新年|xīn nián}{晚会|wǎn huì}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}？
vocab.exampleEn: What time does the New Year gala start?

vocab.note: 乐 is yuè here; in {快乐|kuài lè} it's lè.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{音乐|yīn yuè}？
vocab.exampleEn: What music do you like?

vocab.note: {玩|wán}{游戏|yóu xì}, to play a game. Sports matches are {比赛|bǐ sài}, not {游戏|yóu xì}.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{在|zài}{外面|wài miàn}{玩|wán}{游戏|yóu xì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are playing games outside.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: gù shi. {讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}, to tell a story.
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{讲|jiǎng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{故事|gù shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandma told us a story.

vocab.note: {画|huà} (to paint) + the suffix -{家|jiā} (an expert, a professional).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{爸爸|bà ba}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{画家|huà jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: His father is a well-known painter.

vocab.note: Any sound, and a person's voice.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}{很|hěn}{好听|hǎo tīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She has a lovely voice.

meanings: sound (measure word for cries and calls)
vocab.note: In fixed phrases ({大|dà}{声|shēng}, {小|xiǎo}{声|shēng}) and as a measure word: {叫|jiào}{了|le}{一|yì}{声|shēng}, {说|shuō}{一|yì}{声|shēng} (let someone know).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{大|dà}{声|shēng}{说|shuō}！
vocab.exampleEn: Please speak up!

vocab.note: {耳|ěr} (ear) + {机|jī} (machine). {戴|dài}{耳机|ěr jī}, to put headphones on.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{用|yòng}{耳机|ěr jī}{听|tīng}{音乐|yīn yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I listen to music on headphones.

vocab.note: A noun: {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{兴趣|xìng qù}, {我|wǒ}{的|de}{兴趣|xìng qù}. Two fourth tones.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{兴趣|xìng qù}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has lots of interests.

vocab.note: The topic goes before, with {对|duì}: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{音乐|yīn yuè}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}. It takes no object.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{对|duì}{什么|shén me}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}？
vocab.exampleEn: What are you interested in?

vocab.note: Mostly written; in speech, {喜欢|xǐ huan} or {爱|ài}. {受到|shòu dào}…{的|de}{喜爱|xǐ ài}: to be loved by….
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{喜爱|xǐ ài}{的|de}{歌|gē}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a song many people love.

vocab.note: Takes what you talk about: {聊|liáo}{电影|diàn yǐng}, {聊|liáo}{什么|shén me}. {聊聊|liáo liao} (have a chat).
vocab.example: {你们|nǐ men}{在|zài}{聊|liáo}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.exampleEn: What are you talking about?

vocab.note: Verb + object: no other object after it. Chat about films: {聊|liáo}{电影|diàn yǐng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're chatting.

vocab.note: Often with {的|de}: {挺|tǐng}{好|hǎo}{的|de}, {挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{的|de}. {听|tīng} (to listen) is level.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{挺|tǐng}{好看|hǎo kàn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This film is pretty good.

vocab.note: Adverb ({特别|tè bié}{好|hǎo}) and adjective ({很|hěn}{特别|tè bié}). {特别|tè bié}{是|shì}…: especially….
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{音乐|yīn yuè}，{特别|tè bié}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{音乐|yīn yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I like music, especially Chinese music.

vocab.note: Opposite of {好看|hǎo kàn}. Strong: {不|bú}{太|tài}{好看|hǎo kàn} is kinder.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{真|zhēn}{难看|nán kàn}！
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of clothing is really ugly!

vocab.note: Opposite of {好听|hǎo tīng}; also of words: {难听|nán tīng}{的|de}{话|huà} (rude words).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{太|tài}{难听|nán tīng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This song sounds terrible.

vocab.note: Festival names end in {节|jié}: {春节|Chūn jié}, {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{节日|jié rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Spring Festival is China's biggest festival.

vocab.note: {过|guò} (to spend) + {节|jié}, like {过年|guò nián} and {过|guò}{生日|shēng rì}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{每年|měi nián}{都|dōu}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}。
vocab.exampleEn: We go home for the festival every year.

vocab.note: The calendar New Year; the lunar new year is {春节|Chūn jié}. {新年|xīn nián}{快乐|kuài lè}！
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{大家|dà jiā}{新年|xīn nián}{快乐|kuài lè}！
vocab.exampleEn: Happy New Year, everyone!

vocab.note: {送|sòng}{礼物|lǐ wù}, to give a present; counted with {件|jiàn} or {个|gè}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{礼物|lǐ wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought my mum a present.

vocab.note: {中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}, {节日|jié rì}{文化|wén huà}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

vocab.note: {欢迎|huān yíng} + person + verb is a polite invitation: {欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}.
vocab.example: {欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{过节|guò jié}！
vocab.exampleEn: You're welcome to spend the holiday at our home!

vocab.note: Separable: {跟|gēn}…{结婚|jié hūn} (never {结婚|jié hūn} + person), {结|jié}{了|le}{婚|hūn}, {结|jié}{过|guo}{婚|hūn}, {结婚|jié hūn}{十|shí}{年|nián}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{结婚|jié hūn}{十|shí}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: They've been married for ten years.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}, {在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}{生活|shēng huó}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}. For "where you live", {住|zhù}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}{生活|shēng huó}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I lived in China for two years.

vocab.note: Ordinary days against special ones: {平时|píng shí}…，{周末|zhōu mò}….
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{平时|píng shí}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Normally I get up at seven.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {好|hǎo}{习惯|xí guàn}; {习惯|xí guàn}{了|le} (got used to), {不|bù}{习惯|xí guàn} + verb.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{不|bù}{习惯|xí guàn}{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm still not used to the weather here.

vocab.note: Said háo jiǔ. {好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn}！ Long time no see!
vocab.example: {好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn}！{你好|nǐ hǎo}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Long time no see! How are you?

vocab.note: {不|bù} stays bù before {久|jiǔ} (third tone).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{结婚|jié hūn}{不久|bù jiǔ}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{旅游|lǚ yóu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Not long after they married, they went travelling.

vocab.note: For time only; {长|cháng} is long in space or time. {多|duō}{久|jiǔ}？ (how long?), {很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}. {酒|jiǔ} (alcohol) sounds the same.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{等|děng}{了|le}{多|duō}{久|jiǔ}？
vocab.exampleEn: How long did you wait?

vocab.note: For events, usually unplanned: {发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{是|shì}{去年|qù nián}{发生|fā shēng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This happened last year.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {城市|chéng shì}{发展|fā zhǎn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}, {中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{发展|fā zhǎn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city has developed very fast.

vocab.note: Measure word for school lessons ({四|sì}{节|jié}{课|kè}), and "festival" in names ({春节|Chūn jié}).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{我们|wǒ men}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{节|jié}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have four lessons today.

vocab.note: An ordinary verb in Chinese: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}2005{年|nián}{出生|chū shēng}{的|de}, {她|tā}{出生|chū shēng}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{出生|chū shēng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was born in Beijing.

vocab.note: The opposite of {担心|dān xīn}. {你|nǐ}{放心|fàng xīn}{吧|ba}: don't worry. {不|bú}{放心|fàng xīn}: feel uneasy.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{放心|fàng xīn}{吧|ba}，{我|wǒ}{会|huì}{照顾|zhào gù}{自己|zì jǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't worry, I'll look after myself.

vocab.note: The fuller word for real fear: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{害怕|hài pà}, {别|bié}{害怕|hài pà}.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{别|bié}{害怕|hài pà}！
vocab.exampleEn: Don't be scared, children!

vocab.note: Also "can't stand" ({怕|pà}{冷|lěng}) and "worry that" ({我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{他|tā}{不|bù}{来|lái}). {爬|pá} (to climb) rises.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{狗|gǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm afraid of dogs.

vocab.note: The person takes {对|duì} or {跟|gēn}: {对|duì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì}. Split form: {别|bié}{生|shēng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{气|qì}.
vocab.example: {妈妈|mā ma}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mum is very angry with me.

vocab.note: The everyday word for having a good time: {玩|wán}{得|de}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{玩|wán}{得|de}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We had a great time.

vocab.note: {难|nán} (hard) + {过|guò} (to pass).
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{了|le}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was very sad to hear about it.

vocab.note: The opposite of {笑|xiào}. {别|bié}{哭|kū}{了|le} (don't cry).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{哭|kū}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child is crying.

vocab.note: {真|zhēn}{奇怪|qí guài}！ How strange! Often before a question.
vocab.example: {真|zhēn}{奇怪|qí guài}，{他|tā}{今天|jīn tiān}{怎么|zěn me}{没|méi}{来|lái}？
vocab.exampleEn: Strange, why hasn't he come today?

vocab.note: About people: {对|duì}{客人|kè rén}{很|hěn}{热情|rè qíng}. {热情|rè qíng}{地|de}{欢迎|huān yíng} (warmly welcome).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{对|duì}{客人|kè rén}{非常|fēi cháng}{热情|rè qíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: They're very warm towards their guests.

vocab.note: A person, words or a clause: {我|wǒ}{相信|xiāng xìn}{你|nǐ}, {我|wǒ}{相信|xiāng xìn}{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{怕|pà}，{我|wǒ}{相信|xiāng xìn}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't be afraid; I believe in you.

vocab.note: Alone ({我|wǒ}{同意|tóng yì}) or with a plan or clause: {妈妈|mā ma}{不|bù}{同意|tóng yì}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{同意|tóng yì}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you agree?

vocab.note: A modal verb before another verb: {愿意|yuàn yì}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}. {不|bú}{愿意|yuàn yì}: doesn't want to.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{愿意|yuàn yì}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm happy to help you.

vocab.note: Only for feelings and impressions; {觉得|jué de} can also give an opinion.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{感到|gǎn dào}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I feel very happy.

vocab.note: Mostly in set phrases: {很|hěn}{受|shòu}{欢迎|huān yíng} (very popular), {受|shòu}{影响|yǐng xiǎng} (be affected). In longer sentences, {受到|shòu dào}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{节目|jié mù}{很|hěn}{受|shòu}{欢迎|huān yíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This act is very popular.

meanings: to meet with (be given: welcome, influence)
vocab.note: With {欢迎|huān yíng}, {喜爱|xǐ ài}, {影响|yǐng xiǎng}, {关心|guān xīn}. Not for things sent to you: that is {收到|shōu dào}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{节目|jié mù}{受到|shòu dào}{了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{欢迎|huān yíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This act was very popular.

vocab.note: {身|shēn} (body) + {边|biān} (side): {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{身边|shēn biān}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{在|zài}{身边|shēn biān}。
vocab.exampleEn: My friends aren't around.

meanings: in someone's presence (in front of a person)
vocab.note: About people: {在|zài}{大家|dà jiā}{面前|miàn qián}. For places, {前面|qián miàn}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{大家|dà jiā}{面前|miàn qián}{说话|shuō huà}，{我|wǒ}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{害怕|hài pà}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm a bit scared of speaking in front of everyone.

vocab.note: An adverb before the verb: {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{到|dào}, {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{来|lái}{三|sān}{天|tiān}. It can't be negated: use {刚才|gāng cái}{没|méi}….
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{到|dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've just arrived.

vocab.note: A little stronger than {刚|gāng}; both syllables full.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{刚刚|gāng gāng}{走|zǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's only just left.

vocab.note: A time noun: before or after the subject; {刚才|gāng cái}{没|méi}…; {刚才|gāng cái}{他|tā}{来|lái}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{刚才|gāng cái}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{了|le}？
vocab.exampleEn: Where did you go just now?

meanings: afterwards (later on, in a past story)
vocab.note: Past stories only; for the future use {以后|yǐ hòu}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{去年|qù nián}{去|qù}{了|le}{北京|Běi jīng}，{后来|hòu lái}{去|qù}{了|le}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He went to Beijing last year, and later on to Shanghai.

vocab.note: {前年|qián nián}, {去年|qù nián}, {今年|jīn nián}, {明年|míng nián}, {后年|hòu nián}.
vocab.example: {后年|hòu nián}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: The year after next I'd like to go and work in China.

vocab.note: {前天|qián tiān}, {昨天|zuó tiān}, {今天|jīn tiān}, {明天|míng tiān}, {后天|hòu tiān}.
vocab.example: {后天|hòu tiān}{是|shì}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The day after tomorrow is Saturday.

vocab.note: {前|qián} (before) + {年|nián}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{前年|qián nián}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I went to Shanghai the year before last.

vocab.note: {前|qián} (before) + {天|tiān}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{前天|qián tiān}{见|jiàn}{过|guo}{面|miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We met the day before yesterday.

vocab.note: An adverb before the verb: {我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{走|zǒu}{了|le}. {先|xiān}…{然后|rán hòu}… / {先|xiān}…{再|zài}….
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{先|xiān}{休息|xiū xi}{一下|yí xià}，{再|zài}{做|zuò}{作业|zuò yè}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Have a rest first, then do your homework.

vocab.note: Starts the next step: {先|xiān}…，{然后|rán hòu}…. Past or future.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}，{然后|rán hòu}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: First we'll eat, then we'll go to a film.

vocab.note: The last step ({先|xiān}…{然后|rán hòu}…{最后|zuì hòu}…); also "last": {最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{天|tiān}. {终于|zhōng yú} is "at last" after a wait.
vocab.example: {最后|zuì hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{走|zǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Finally we went for a walk in the park.

vocab.note: The time up to now: {你|nǐ}{最近|zuì jìn}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ (Also {最|zuì} + {近|jìn}, nearest.)
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{最近|zuì jìn}{特别|tè bié}{忙|máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've been really busy recently.

vocab.note: After an event: {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{以前|yǐ qián}. Alone: in the past: {以前|yǐ qián}{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{以前|yǐ qián}{没|méi}{学|xué}{过|guo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before I came to China, I hadn't studied Chinese.

vocab.note: After an event: {下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu}. Alone: in the future: {以后|yǐ hòu}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{网球|wǎng qiú}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: After class, let's go and play tennis.

vocab.note: Often with {才|cái}: {直到|zhí dào}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{睡觉|shuì jiào} (didn't go to bed until midnight). {知道|zhī dào} zhīdào (to know) is level.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{直到|zhí dào}{昨天|zuó tiān}{才|cái}{知道|zhī dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I didn't know until yesterday.

vocab.note: The end ({末|mò}) of the week. Traditional {+{周末|zhōu mò}+}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{周末|zhōu mò}{你|nǐ}{有空|yǒu kòng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Are you free this weekend?

vocab.note: Late: time + {才|cái} + verb, no {了|le} ({他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{来|lái}). Also "only" before a number ({他|tā}{才|cái}{十|shí}{岁|suì}). {菜|cài} falls.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: He didn't come until ten.

vocab.note: Often with {就|jiù} in the second clause, after its subject: {如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{去|qù}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{去|qù}。 The clause can end with {的话|de huà}.
vocab.example: {如果|rú guǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the park.

meanings: if (at the end of a clause)
vocab.note: Closes an "if" clause, with or without {如果|rú guǒ}: ({如果|rú guǒ}){你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{的话|de huà}，{就|jiù}{来|lái}{吧|ba}。 A little more spoken than {如果|rú guǒ} alone.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{累|lèi}{的话|de huà}，{就|jiù}{休息|xiū xi}{一会儿|yí huìr}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you're tired, have a rest.

vocab.note: A condition that is enough; pairs with {就|jiù}: {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}…. Compare {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái} (the only way).
vocab.example: {只要|zhǐ yào}{你|nǐ}{多|duō}{练习|liàn xí}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: As long as you practise a lot, you'll speak well.

vocab.note: A condition that is the only way; pairs with {才|cái}, not {就|jiù}: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}…{才|cái}…. Before a noun it is simply "only": {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{他|tā}{知道|zhī dào}。
vocab.example: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{周末|zhōu mò}，{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I only have time to go to the cinema at the weekend.

vocab.note: Before the verb: {我|wǒ}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{十|shí}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。 Not before a subject: "only he" is {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{他|tā}. A different word from the measure word in {一|yì}{只|zhī}{猫|māo} (a cat), written 隻 in traditional.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{只|zhǐ}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}，{不|bù}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He only drinks tea, not coffee.

vocab.note: {={只|zhǐ}=} + {能|néng}: the only thing possible. {没有|méi yǒu}{地铁|dì tiě}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{只能|zhǐ néng}{打车|dǎ chē}。
vocab.example: {公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{只能|zhǐ néng}{走路|zǒu lù}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the park you can only walk; no cycling.

vocab.note: Pairs with {而且|ér qiě} (and {也|yě} / {还|hái}): {不但|bú dàn}…{而且|ér qiě}…. With one subject, the subject comes first: {他|tā}{不但|bú dàn}…; with two, {不但|bú dàn} comes first.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{不但|bú dàn}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{而且|ér qiě}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room is not only big but quiet too.

vocab.note: After {不但|bú dàn}, or on its own to add a stronger point: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}，{而且|ér qiě}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}。
vocab.example: {她|tā}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{而且|ér qiě}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She can speak Chinese, and she speaks it very well.

vocab.note: The short, written form of {或者|huò zhě}, on notices and forms: {星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{或|huò}{星期日|xīng qī rì}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{或|huò}{星期日|xīng qī rì}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please come on Saturday or Sunday.

vocab.note: In statements and suggestions. In a question that asks someone to choose, "or" is {还是|hái shi}: {你|nǐ}{去|qù}{还是|hái shi}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}？
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{或者|huò zhě}{打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go by metro or by taxi.

vocab.note: For a repetition in the past; {再|zài} is "again" in the future. Also in {又|yòu}…{又|yòu} (both… and…). Fourth tone, like {右|yòu} (right).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{昨天|zuó tiān}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}{又|yòu}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was late yesterday, and he was late again today.

vocab.note: {为|wèi} + person + verb: {妈妈|mā ma}{为|wèi}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}。 Also {我|wǒ}{为|wèi}{你|nǐ}{高兴|gāo xìng} (I'm happy for you). The {为|wèi} of {为什么|wèi shén me} and {因为|yīn wèi}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{这么|zhè me}{好|hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{为|wèi}{你|nǐ}{高兴|gāo xìng}！
vocab.exampleEn: You did so well in the exam: I'm really happy for you!

vocab.note: A purpose; the {为了|wèi le} phrase usually comes first: {为了|wèi le}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{看|kàn}{中国|Zhōng guó}{电影|diàn yǐng}。 At the end of a sentence use {是|shì}{为了|wèi le}.
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{身体|shēn tǐ}{健康|jiàn kāng}，{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{走路|zǒu lù}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I walk to work every day to stay healthy.

meanings: facing; towards (a place or a person)
vocab.note: {向|xiàng} + direction = {往|wǎng} ({向|xiàng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu}). Unlike {往|wǎng} it also takes a person: {向|xiàng}{老师|lǎo shī}{请假|qǐng jià} (ask the teacher for leave), {向|xiàng}{他|tā}{学习|xué xí} (learn from him).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{老师|lǎo shī}{请|qǐng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{假|jià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I asked the teacher for two days off.

vocab.note: A short spoken "but": {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可|kě}{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{时间|shí jiān}。 Also stresses what follows: {今天|jīn tiān}{可|kě}{冷|lěng}{了|le}！ (it's so cold today!), {你|nǐ}{可|kě}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}！
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}，{可|kě}{我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{不|bú}{下|xià}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dish is delicious, but I can't eat any more.

meanings: but (a little more spoken than dànshì)
vocab.note: Like {但是|dàn shì}, and it pairs with {虽然|suī rán} too: {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{可是|kě shì}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}。 Don't put two "but"s in one sentence.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{可是|kě shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd love to go, but I don't have time.

vocab.note: {除了|chú le} X ({以外|yǐ wài}) + {都|dōu}: everyone or everything except X. {除了|chú le} X ({以外|yǐ wài}) + {还|hái} / {也|yě}: X and more besides.
vocab.example: {除了|chú le}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{以外|yǐ wài}，{我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've all been to Beijing except Xiao Wang.

vocab.note: The short form of {总是|zǒng shì}, often before a negative: {他|tā}{总|zǒng}{不|bú}{在|zài}{家|jiā}。 As an adjective, "total; general": {总|zǒng}{经理|jīng lǐ} (general manager).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{总|zǒng}{不|bù}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He never has breakfast.

vocab.note: Again and again, as a habit; often a complaint. Compare {一直|yì zhí} (without a break): {他|tā}{总是|zǒng shì}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà} vs {他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{总是|zǒng shì}{迟到|chí dào}，{老师|lǎo shī}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's always late, and the teacher isn't pleased.

vocab.note: The same as {常常|cháng cháng}, a little more written. The negative is {不|bù}{常|cháng} (not often).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{常|cháng}{去|qù}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We often eat at that restaurant.

vocab.note: Like {经常|jīng cháng} (HSK 2). Its negative is {不|bù}{常|cháng}, not ×{不|bù}{常常|cháng cháng}: {我|wǒ}{不|bù}{常|cháng}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}。
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我|wǒ}{常常|cháng cháng}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends I often go hiking with friends.

vocab.note: First tone: jī, not the jǐ of {几|jǐ}{个|gè}. Often with {都|dōu} or {没|méi}: {几乎|jī hū}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}…, {几乎|jī hū}{没|méi}{睡|shuì} (hardly slept).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{几乎|jī hū}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{锻炼|duàn liàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He goes to exercise almost every day.

vocab.note: Before the verb, a likely guess: {他|tā}{大概|dà gài}{不|bù}{来|lái}{了|le}。 Before a number, "about": {大概|dà gài}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. Also an adjective, "rough, general" ({大概|dà gài}{的|de}{意思|yì si}).
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{到|dào}{机场|jī chǎng}{大概|dà gài}{要|yào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's about an hour from here to the airport.

vocab.note: A promise ({我|wǒ}{一定|yí dìng}{来|lái}), a confident guess ({你|nǐ}{一定|yí dìng}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}{了|le}), or "be sure to" with {要|yào} ({你|nǐ}{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{来|lái}！). {不|bù}{一定|yí dìng}: not necessarily. {一|yī} is yí before the fourth tone.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{一定|yí dìng}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll definitely come a bit earlier tomorrow.

vocab.note: Before a noun ({其他|qí tā}{人|rén}, {其他|qí tā}{国家|guó jiā}) or with {的|de} ({其他|qí tā}{的|de}). Often "the rest": {其他|qí tā}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
vocab.example: {除了|chú le}{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}，{其他|qí tā}{的|de}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{看|kàn}{过|guo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Apart from this book, I've read all the others.

vocab.note: Before a noun or on its own: {还|hái}{有|yǒu}{别的|bié de}{吗|ma}？ (anything else?). More spoken than {其他|qí tā}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{面条儿|miàn tiáor}，{有|yǒu}{别的|bié de}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: I don't want noodles. Is there anything else?

vocab.note: A conclusion from what you can see, usually at the start: {看来|kàn lái}{要|yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.example: {他|tā}{还|hái}{没|méi}{来|lái}，{看来|kàn lái}{他|tā}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He still isn't here; it seems he doesn't know about it.

vocab.note: Before a verb, advice: {你|nǐ}{最好|zuì hǎo}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}。 Negative {最好|zuì hǎo}{别|bié} / {最好|zuì hǎo}{不要|bú yào}. On its own it is also the plain "best".
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{最好|zuì hǎo}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's raining outside, so you'd better take an umbrella.

vocab.note: A soft contrast after something good: {很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}。 Also "only, merely": {我|wǒ}{只是|zhǐ shì}{问|wèn}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房子|fáng zi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{离|lí}{公司|gōng sī}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{远|yuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This flat is very nice; it's just a bit far from the office.

vocab.note: The firmest "must", for rules. The negative is {不用|bú yòng} or {不必|bú bì} (need not), never ×{不|bú}{必须|bì xū}.
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{必须|bì xū}{在|zài}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{以前|yǐ qián}{到|dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone must arrive before eight.

vocab.note: Advice ({你|nǐ}{应该|yīng gāi}{多|duō}{休息|xiū xi}) and a sensible guess ({他|tā}{现在|xiàn zài}{应该|yīng gāi}{到|dào}{了|le}). Negative {不|bù}{应该|yīng gāi} (shouldn't). Two first tones.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{应该|yīng gāi}{多|duō}{喝|hē}{水|shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: You've got a cold; you should drink plenty of water.

vocab.note: Spoken and short. Set uses: {该|gāi}{你|nǐ}{了|le} (your turn), {该|gāi} + verb + {了|le} (it's time to…: {该|gāi}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le}).
vocab.example: {十一|shí yī}{点|diǎn}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{该|gāi}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's eleven o'clock; I should be getting home.

vocab.note: Third tone, before a verb: {我|wǒ}{得|děi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 Not the particle {得|de} ({说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}) or {得|dé} "to get". "Don't have to" is {不用|bú yòng}, never ×{不得|bù dé}.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{起床|qǐ chuáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have to get up early tomorrow.

vocab.note: Before a noun ({主要|zhǔ yào}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}, the main problem) or before a verb or {是|shì} ({主要|zhǔ yào}{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}…, mainly because…).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{主要|zhǔ yào}{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm learning Chinese mainly because of work.

vocab.note: An adjective: {很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}, {最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}. {重|zhòng} is zhòng here (heavy); in other words it can be chóng (again).
vocab.example: {健康|jiàn kāng}{比|bǐ}{钱|qián}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Health is more important than money.

vocab.note: {常|cháng} (often) + {见|jiàn} (see): things you meet often. {常见|cháng jiàn}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí} (a common problem).
vocab.example: {感冒|gǎn mào}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{常见|cháng jiàn}{的|de}{病|bìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: A cold is a very common illness.

vocab.note: {常|cháng} (often) + {用|yòng} (use): {常用|cháng yòng}{的|de}{词|cí} (common words), {常用|cháng yòng}{的|de}{汉字|hàn zì}.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{最|zuì}{常用|cháng yòng}{的|de}{汉字|hàn zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: These are all the most commonly used characters.

vocab.note: {不|bù} stays fourth tone before the rising {行|xíng}. {明天|míng tiān}{不行|bù xíng}，{后天|hòu tiān}{行|xíng}{吗|ma}？ Also "not good at": {我|wǒ}{唱|chàng}{歌|gē}{不行|bù xíng}。
vocab.example: {这样|zhè yàng}{做|zuò}{不行|bù xíng}，{我们|wǒ men}{得|děi}{换|huàn}{个|gè}{办法|bàn fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Doing it this way won't work; we'll have to find another way.

vocab.note: Agreement ({行|xíng}，{我们|wǒ men}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}) or praise ({你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{行|xíng}！ you're great!). The same character is háng in {银行|yín háng} (bank).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{来|lái}，{行|xíng}{吗|ma}？——{行|xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Can you come tomorrow afternoon? — OK.

vocab.note: A more written {怎么|zěn me} / {怎么样|zěn me yàng}: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{怎样|zěn yàng}{写|xiě}？ In speech you mostly hear {怎么|zěn me}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}{这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{怎样|zěn yàng}{做|zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please tell me how to make this dish.

vocab.note: On its own ({怎么办|zěn me bàn}？) or after a problem: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{丢|diū}{了|le}，{怎么办|zěn me bàn}？ {办|bàn} (lesson 09): to do, to handle.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{复习|fù xí}，{怎么办|zěn me bàn}？
vocab.exampleEn: The exam's tomorrow and I haven't revised yet. What shall I do?

vocab.note: People, and also problems, weather and luck: {遇到|yù dào}{问题|wèn tí}, {遇到|yù dào}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}. Compare {遇见|yù jiàn} (people only).
vocab.example: {学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{你|nǐ}{遇到|yù dào}{过|guo}{什么|shén me}{问题|wèn tí}？
vocab.exampleEn: What problems have you come up against learning Chinese?

vocab.note: A meeting nobody planned; a planned one is {见面|jiàn miàn}. With people, {遇见|yù jiàn} and {遇到|yù dào} are interchangeable.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{在|zài}{超市|chāo shì}{遇见|yù jiàn}{了|le}{王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bumped into Teacher Wang at the supermarket yesterday.

vocab.note: People parting ({我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{路口|lù kǒu}{分开|fēn kāi}{了|le}) and things kept apart ({把|bǎ}{白|bái}{衣服|yī fu}{和|hé}{黑|hēi}{衣服|yī fu}{分开|fēn kāi}{洗|xǐ}).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{分开|fēn kāi}{了|le}，{他|tā}{往|wǎng}{东|dōng}，{我|wǒ}{往|wǎng}{西|xī}。
vocab.exampleEn: We parted at the metro station; he went east, I went west.

vocab.note: For events: {比赛|bǐ sài}{结束|jié shù}{了|le}, {会议|huì yì}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}{结束|jié shù}？ A person finishing a task uses {完|wán}: {我|wǒ}{写|xiě}{完|wán}{了|le}{作业|zuò yè} (not ×{结束|jié shù}{了|le}{作业|zuò yè}).
vocab.example: {晚会|wǎn huì}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{结束|jié shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The party ends at ten.

vocab.note: The same character as {长|cháng} (long). {长大|zhǎng dà} (grow up), {长|zhǎng}{高|gāo} (get taller), {长|zhǎng}{得|de}{像|xiàng} (look like); after a noun, "head of": {校长|xiào zhǎng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{真|zhēn}{快|kuài}！
vocab.exampleEn: Your child is growing so fast!

vocab.note: A time noun, often set against {现在|xiàn zài}: {过去|guò qù}…，{现在|xiàn zài}…. The same characters are the verb {过去|guò qù} (to go over, HSK 2).
vocab.example: {过去|guò qù}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{现在|xiàn zài}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I used to dislike sport; now I go running every day.

vocab.note: {变|biàn} (change) + {成|chéng} (into): always names the result. {水|shuǐ}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{冰|bīng}。
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{水|shuǐ}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{冰|bīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's got cold, and the water has turned to ice.

vocab.note: Often before a whole clause: {我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。 For finding something you looked for, say {找|zhǎo}{到|dào}.
vocab.example: {到|dào}{了|le}{公司|gōng sī}，{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Only when I got to the office did I notice my phone was missing.

vocab.note: Alone as an answer ({当然|dāng rán}！) or before a verb or {是|shì}: {当然|dāng rán}{可以|kě yǐ}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{跟|gēn}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吗|ma}？——{当然|dāng rán}{想|xiǎng}！
vocab.exampleEn: Do you want to come with us? — Of course I do!

vocab.note: Corrects what people think: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{难|nán}，{其实|qí shí}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}。
vocab.example: {他|tā}{看起来|kàn qǐ lai}{很|hěn}{年轻|nián qīng}，{其实|qí shí}{已经|yǐ jīng}{五十|wǔ shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks young, but actually he's already fifty.

vocab.note: Before the examples: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{比如|bǐ rú}{游泳|yóu yǒng}、{爬|pá}{山|shān}。 Also {比如|bǐ rú}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}，{比如|bǐ rú}{西瓜|xī guā}、{香蕉|xiāng jiāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I like fruit, for example watermelon and bananas.

vocab.note: At the start ({关于|guān yú}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}，…) or before a noun with {的|de}: {一|yì}{本|běn}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{关于|guān yú}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{的|de}{节目|jié mù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to watch a programme about giant pandas.

vocab.note: A student studying in a country not their own, wherever that is.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{留学生|liú xué shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are twenty international students in our class.

vocab.note: {名|míng} (name) + {单|dān} (a list, as in {菜单|cài dān}). {在|zài}{名单|míng dān}{上|shàng} (on the list).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{看看|kàn kan}{名单|míng dān}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{没有|méi yǒu}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please check whether your name is on the list.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì} + verb: {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì}{的话|de huà}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{看看|kàn kan}。 A good chance to do something: {一|yí}{个|gè}…{的|de}{好|hǎo}{机会|jī huì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{练习|liàn xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{好|hǎo}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a good opportunity to practise Chinese.

vocab.note: The second syllable is light: guān xi. {跟|gēn}…{有|yǒu}{关系|guān xi} (to have to do with); {没关系|méi guān xi} (it doesn't matter) is literally "no connection".
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{关系|guān xi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of them get on very well.

vocab.note: {校|xiào} (school) + {园|yuán} (garden, park). {校园|xiào yuán}{生活|shēng huó}: campus life.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{校园|xiào yuán}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{也|yě}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our campus is big and beautiful.

vocab.note: {图书|tú shū} (books, written) + {馆|guǎn} (a building for a purpose). {去|qù}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{借|jiè}{书|shū}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: I go to the library to read every afternoon.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {帮|bāng}, and also a noun: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}！ {帮忙|bāng máng} takes no object (×{帮忙|bāng máng}{我|wǒ}).
vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{来|lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{帮助|bāng zhù}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I'd just arrived, my classmates helped me a lot.

vocab.note: Separable, with no object after it: {跟|gēn}{他|tā}{见面|jiàn miàn} (not ×{见面|jiàn miàn}{他|tā}), {见|jiàn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{面|miàn}. By chance is {遇见|yù jiàn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{门口|mén kǒu}{见面|jiàn miàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's meet at the library entrance tomorrow afternoon.

vocab.note: A decision about the future, before a verb ({我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}), or a noun ({你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{打算|dǎ suàn}？). Compare {想|xiǎng} (a wish) and {准备|zhǔn bèi} (get ready).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm planning to go and study in China next year.

vocab.note: At school or university; in everyday speech also "boys, lads", even for adults.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{的|de}{男生|nán shēng}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: The boys in our class all like playing football.

vocab.note: At school or university; in everyday speech also "girls", even for adults. {女|nǚ} has ü: type nv3.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{班|bān}{女生|nǚ shēng}{比|bǐ}{男生|nán shēng}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are more women than men in this class.

vocab.note: {校|xiào} (school) + {长|zhǎng} (head of). Also the president of a university. Polite address: {王校长|Wáng xiào zhǎng}.
vocab.example: {校长|xiào zhǎng}{明天|míng tiān}{来|lái}{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{看看|kàn kan}。
vocab.exampleEn: The head teacher is coming to see our class tomorrow.

vocab.note: {去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué} (go to study in China), {在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{留学|liú xué}. It splits like a separable verb: {留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}, {留|liú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}{学|xué}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}，{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She studied in Beijing, and she speaks Chinese very well.

vocab.note: Borrow: {跟|gēn} / {向|xiàng} + person + {借|jiè} + thing. Lend: {借|jiè}{给|gěi} + person + thing ({我|wǒ}{借|jiè}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{可以|kě yǐ}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{借|jiè}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can I borrow a book from you?

vocab.note: The same character as {还|hái} (still, also). {还|huán}{书|shū} (return books), {还|huán}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ} (give it back to you). {他|tā}{还|hái}{没|méi}{还|huán}: he hasn't returned it yet.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{还|huán}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll give you this book back tomorrow.

readingList.title: Mandarin Companion graded readers (levels 1 and 2)
readingList.note: Short novels for learners, many of them retellings of well-known stories set in China, written with a fixed set of characters. With the 655 characters of HSK 3 you can read both levels; start with level 2 for a challenge. Simplified and traditional editions, as books and e-books. Paid.

readingList.title: Chinese Breeze (汉语风) graded readers, levels 3 and 4
readingList.note: A long-running series of original stories by level. Level 3 is built on 750 basic words, comfortably inside the 1,000 of HSK 3; level 4 is the step after this course. Paid; sold by many booksellers (the link is one).

readingList.title: Mandarin Bean
readingList.note: Short graded texts marked with HSK levels, with recordings by teachers, pinyin and tap-to-translate words. At the end of this course, read the HSK 3 texts with pinyin off and try a few HSK 4 ones. The graded lessons are free; some extras need an account.

readingList.title: Chinese Reading Practice (练读中文)
readingList.note: Short texts in simplified characters with pinyin and an English translation you can switch on and off, no account needed. After this course, the intermediate texts are within reach; read each one first without the translation.

readingList.title: Du Chinese
readingList.note: An app and website of graded lessons and stories with audio, a pop-up dictionary, adjustable pinyin and a setting that marks words by HSK level. After this course, the Intermediate lessons are a good fit. A limited selection is free; the rest needs a subscription.

readingList.title: Chinese Grammar Wiki
readingList.note: A free reference of Chinese grammar points sorted by level, each with many example sentences in characters, pinyin and English. Its A2 and B1 points cover this course's grammar (把 and 被, potential complements, 只要…就, 不但…而且, rhetorical questions); use it when you want more examples of a pattern.

readingList.title: HSK sample papers and syllabus
readingList.note: The official HSK site, with the HSK 3.0 syllabus, sample questions and online demos of the new exam, test dates and test centres. Do a sample paper in the last weeks before the test (lesson 30), and check the format, the speaking test and the pass mark there before you register.
